papers.title: Don't Drop the BATON: Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation via Agentic Subtask Exploration and Transition-aware Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon robot manipulation chains many contact-rich skills into one multi-stage task. Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly master the individual skills, yet the chain still fails: errors compound beyond the policy's ability to correct, and one subtask silently constrains the next. A promising recipe freezes the VLA and puts an LLM agent in charge: it plans in language, moves in free space with analytic primitives, invokes the VLA only for contact-rich segments, and writes adaptation into language memory. Applied to long horizons, it breaks twice. (1) Competence comes from whole-task exploration at test time, whose cost is multiplicative in stages: if one stage needs T episodes, a K-stage task needs about T^K, and a failure does not reveal which stage caused it. (2) It has no representation of transitions: the VLA primitive carries an exit but no entry condition, so a subtask can succeed in a form its successor cannot use. We present BATON. Against (1), BATON makes the subtask the unit of exploration: each is explored in the cheap short-horizon regime and its solution stored in memory; a long-horizon trajectory is then composed from these solutions rather than discovered whole. Cost becomes additive (T*K) and every failure is attributed to a single stage. Against (2), BATON equips exploration with a transition-aware memory. Within a subtask, a verifier agent governs the invocation transition: the VLA is called only after the wrist view confirms the scene is ready. Across subtasks, a handoff transition restores an entry state disturbed by the predecessor's residue, and a lookahead transition selects the strategy whose outcome the successor can inherit. No parameters are updated. On the long-horizon benchmark RoboMemArena, BATON improves task success by 11.6% and cumulative success by 14.9% over the SoTA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BATON，一种面向长视界机器人操作的长时程任务求解框架。其做法是冻结视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA)，由 LLM agent 负责语言规划，仅在接触丰富的片段调用 VLA，并把探索和记忆的粒度从整个任务降到单个子任务，同时引入感知过渡状态（transition-aware）的记忆机制。摘要报告在 RoboMemArena 基准上，任务成功率相对 SoTA 提升 11.6%，累计成功率提升 14.9%，且不更新任何参数。
Motivation: 现有长视界操作方案在测试时对整个任务进行探索，成本随阶段数呈指数增长（一个阶段需 T 次尝试时，K 阶段任务约需 T^K 次），且失败无法归因到具体阶段；此外 VLA 子技能只有退出条件而没有进入条件，导致子任务成功的形式可能无法被后续子任务使用。
Method: BATON 将子任务作为探索单元：在廉价的短视界场景中分别探索每个子任务并把解存入记忆，再从这些解中组合出长视界轨迹，使探索成本变为加法量级 (T*K)，且每次失败都能归因到单一阶段。同时引入三类过渡机制：子任务内的 verifier agent 决定何时调用 VLA（手腕视角确认场景就绪后才调用），子任务间的手递 (handoff) 过渡恢复被前序残留扰动的进入状态，lookahead 过渡则选择其结果可被后继子任务继承的策略。全程不更新参数。
Result: 在长视界操作基准 RoboMemArena 上，BATON 相比 SoTA 将任务成功率提升 11.6%，累计成功率提升 14.9%。
Conclusion: 作者强调，以子任务为单位进行探索并维护显式的过渡状态记忆，可以在不更新 VLA 参数的情况下显著改善长视界机器人操作的成功率与可归因性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Q-based Variational Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: The development of safe and beneficial AI requires that systems can learn and act in accordance with human preferences. However, explicitly specifying these preferences by hand is often infeasible. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) addresses this challenge by inferring preferences, represented as reward functions, from expert behaviour. We introduce Q-based Variational IRL (QVIRL), a novel Bayesian IRL method that recovers a posterior distribution over rewards from expert demonstrations via primarily learning a variational distribution over optimal Q-values. Unlike previous approaches, QVIRL combines scalability with uncertainty quantification, important for safety-critical applications as well as active learning. We demonstrate QVIRL's strong performance in apprenticeship learning across various tasks, including gridworlds, Lunar Lander, the Highway Environment, and two ATARI games both with static expert data and with active learning. It is the first method for Bayesian IRL that demonstrates training from raw pixel observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Q-based Variational IRL (QVIRL)，一种贝叶斯逆强化学习方法，通过主要学习最优 Q 值的变分分布来从专家演示中恢复奖励的后验分布。摘要称与以往方法不同，QVIRL 兼顾可扩展性与不确定性量化，并首次在原始像素观测上进行训练。该方法在 gridworlds、Lunar Lander、Highway Environment 及两个 ATARI 游戏等任务上展示了较强表现，支持静态专家数据和主动学习。
Motivation: 显式指定人类偏好往往不可行，逆强化学习 (IRL) 通过从专家行为推断奖励函数来应对这一挑战。此前方法难以同时满足可扩展性与不确定性量化，而这对于安全关键应用和主动学习很重要。
Method: 提出 QVIRL，一种贝叶斯 IRL 方法，主要通过学习最优 Q 值的变分分布来获得奖励的后验分布，从而同时实现可扩展性和不确定性估计。
Result: 摘要报告 QVIRL 在多种任务（包括 gridworlds、Lunar Lander、Highway Environment 和两个 ATARI 游戏）的学徒学习 (apprenticeship learning) 中表现强劲，且同时适用于静态专家数据和主动学习；这是首个展示可从原始像素观测进行训练的贝叶斯 IRL 方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调 QVIRL 将可扩展性与不确定性量化结合，对安全关键应用和主动学习具有价值，并首次将贝叶斯 IRL 扩展到原始像素观测训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Empirical Study of Training Pixel-Space Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates an increasingly important topic in generative modeling: pixel-space diffusion models. Although numerous studies have explored this topic, most focus on small-scale or class-conditional settings. Consequently, a practical recipe for training pixel-space models that rival or exceed well-established latent-space counterparts remains elusive. Through a comprehensive empirical study, we first observe that direct large-scale pre-training in pixel space converges substantially more slowly than in latent space. This observation motivates a latent-to-pixel strategy that acquires generative priors efficiently in latent space and transitions to pixel space during post-training. We then systematically investigate the key design choices governing this transition, including weight initialization, data composition, prediction target, decoder architecture, and noise schedule, and identify a practical recipe that makes the resulting pixel-space models match or outperform their latent-space counterparts while delivering 3.18 to 4.75 times end-to-end inference speedups. We hope that our findings provide useful empirical insights and practical guidelines for future research on pixel-space generation.
papers.comment: Z-Image-Pixel & Empirical Insight of Training Pixel-Space Diffusion Models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对像素空间文本到图像扩散模型（pixel-space diffusion model）的训练方法进行实证研究。作者发现直接在大规模数据上进行像素空间预训练比潜在空间（latent space）收敛慢得多，由此提出先在潜在空间高效获取生成先验、再在后训练阶段转向像素空间的 latent-to-pixel 策略。系统考察了权重初始化、数据组成、预测目标、解码器架构与噪声调度等设计选择，并给出实用配方，使像素空间模型匹配或超越潜在空间对应模型，同时带来 3.18 到 4.75 倍的端到端推理加速。
Motivation: 现有像素空间扩散模型研究多集中在小规模或类别条件设定，缺乏能与成熟潜在空间模型竞争甚至超越的大规模训练配方。
Method: 通过实证观察确认直接像素空间大规模预训练收敛缓慢，提出 latent-to-pixel 两阶段策略；随后系统研究权重初始化、数据组成、预测目标、解码器架构与噪声调度对像素空间迁移的影响。
Result: 摘要报告所识别的配方使像素空间模型与潜在空间对应模型性能相当或更优，并实现 3.18 到 4.75 倍的端到端推理加速。
Conclusion: 作者希望这些实证发现能为像素空间生成研究提供可操作的训练指南与经验洞察。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Improving the matrix multiplication exponent with modern optimization and AlphaEvolve
papers.abstract_en: The current best bounds on the matrix multiplication exponent $ω$ are obtained through a refinement of the laser method called combination loss analysis (Duan et al., 2022; Williams et al., 2024; Alman et al., 2025). In this note, we address the optimization problem at the core of this approach and propose several improvements. First, we reformulate the optimization problem allowing us to solve it in a larger setting than was previously possible. Second, we leverage recent advances in machine learning to design a new optimization algorithm for this problem. Finally, we refine the resulting optimization algorithm with AlphaEvolve. Our combined approach yields an upper bound of $ω$ < 2.371177, improving the previous best bound of 2.371339.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对矩阵乘法指数 ω 的上界问题，改进以组合损耗分析（combination loss analysis）为核心的激光方法（laser method）优化流程。作者先将该优化问题重新表述以在更大设置中求解，再利用近期机器学习进展设计新的优化算法，并用 AlphaEvolve 进一步精修，最终得到 ω < 2.371177 的新上界，优于此前最佳上界 2.371339。
Motivation: 当前 ω 的最佳上界均来自对激光方法的组合损耗分析（Duan et al., 2022; Williams et al., 2024; Alman et al., 2025），而其中核心的优化问题受限于求解规模，制约了进一步改进；提升 ω 上界是快速矩阵乘法理论中的关键开放问题。
Method: 提出三项改进：一是重新表述核心优化问题，使其能在比以往更大的设置下求解；二是利用机器学习的近期进展为该问题设计新的优化算法；三是用 AlphaEvolve 对所得优化算法进行精修。
Result: 综合方法将矩阵乘法指数上界从 2.371339 改进为 ω < 2.371177。
Conclusion: 作者表明该组合方法取得了新的最佳上界 ω < 2.371177，属于对既有激光方法优化流程的改进型研究；摘要未提供更多关于局限性的说明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spectral Gaps of Hit-and-Run and Coordinate Hit-and-Run
papers.abstract_en: For any convex body $\mathcal{K}\subset\mathbb{R}^{n}$ containing a unit ball, the spectral gap of Hit-and-Run is $Ω(1/(n^2 C_{\mathsf{PI}}))$, where $C_{\mathsf{PI}}$ is the Poincaré constant of the uniform distribution $π$ over $\mathcal{K}$. This implies that Hit-and-Run converges to a distribution within $χ^2$-divergence $\varepsilon$ of the uniform distribution $π$ in $O(n^2 C_{\mathsf{PI}}\log(M/\varepsilon))$ steps from any starting distribution $π_0$ with $M=χ^2(π_{0}\,\|\,π)$, thus refining the known bound of $O(n^2 R^2 \log(M/\varepsilon))$ by Lovász and Vempala (2004) in terms of the outer radius $R$; for nearly isotropic bodies, together with progress on the KLS conjecture, the complexity is $O(n^2\log n\log(M/\varepsilon))$, improving the dimension dependence from cubic to nearly quadratic while maintaining logarithmic dependence on the initial distance. It was an open problem to connect the convergence of Hit-and-Run to Poincaré/KLS constants as was done for the Ball walk by Kannan, Lovász and Simonovits (1997). Unlike Hit-and-Run, the Ball walk has an unavoidable linear dependence on (a stronger notion) of the initial warmness. We directly bound the spectral gap of the Hit-and-Run Markov chain by connecting it to functional isoperimetric constants, inspired by the recent analysis of In-and-Out. Rewriting the spectral gap in terms of dual certificates leads to the Babuška--Aziz constant studied in the analysis of PDEs; it is asymptotically bounded by the improved Poincaré constant, which we show can be bounded in terms of the usual Poincaré constant. The proof is based on duality and calculus, unlike known proofs of convergence for Hit-and-Run which are based on bounding the conductance. The same technique can be applied to Coordinate Hit-and-Run, resulting in a much improved mixing time of $O(n^3C_{\mathsf{PI}}\log(M/\varepsilon))$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究凸体上的 Hit-and-Run 与 Coordinate Hit-and-Run 马尔可夫链的谱隙，建立了与均匀分布 Poincaré 常数相关的下界，从而改进此前的混合时间估计。证明基于对偶、泛函等周常数与微积分，而非传统电导法，并将谱隙与 PDE 中出现的 Babuška–Aziz 常数联系起来。
Motivation: 将 Hit-and-Run 的收敛速度直接联系到 Poincaré/KLS 常数是此前的一个开放问题；已知的 Lovász–Vempala (2004) 混合时间界依赖外接半径 R，而 Ball walk 已有类似结果但存在对初始暖启动强度的不可避免线性依赖。
Method: 作者直接通过泛函等周常数界定 Hit-and-Run 的谱隙，将谱隙重写为对偶证书形式并引入 Babuška–Aziz 常数，再用对偶与微积分证明该常数可被改进的 Poincaré 常数界定，进而由通常 Poincaré 常数控制。同一技术也应用于 Coordinate Hit-and-Run。
Result: 对包含单位球的凸体，Hit-and-Run 的谱隙为 Ω(1/(n^2 C_PI))，混合到 χ² 散度 ε 内需 O(n^2 C_PI log(M/ε)) 步；对近各向同性体，结合 KLS 猜想进展为 O(n^2 log n log(M/ε))，将维数依赖从立方改进到近二次。Coordinate Hit-and-Run 的混合时间改进为 O(n^3 C_PI log(M/ε))。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该证明路线不依赖电导界，并把收敛性与 Poincaré/KLS 常数挂钩；Hit-and-Run 保持对初始距离的对数依赖，而 Ball walk 对更强初始暖启动概念有线性依赖。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 对包含单位球的凸体，Hit-and-Run 的谱隙为 Ω(1/(n^2 C_PI))，混合到 χ² 散度 ε 内需 O(n^2 C_PI log(M/ε)) 步；对近各向同性体，结合 KLS 猜想进展为 O(n^2 log n log(M/ε))，将维数依赖从立方改进到近二次。Coordinate Hit-and-Run 的混合时间改进为 O(n^3 C_PI log(M/ε))。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该证明路线不依赖电导界，并把收敛性与 Poincaré/KLS 常数挂钩；Hit-and-Run 保持对初始距离的对数依赖，而 Ball walk 对更强初始暖启动概念有线性依赖。

papers.title: AutoSR: Automatic Symbolic Regression by Searching Research States
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Automatic Symbolic Regression (AutoSR), a fully automated system that instantiates Research-Space Symbolic Regression by searching persistent scientific investigations rather than isolated equations. Finite, noisy data often yield numerically competitive expressions that imply very different behavior outside the observed regime, making numerical fit and syntactic complexity insufficient measures of scientific credibility. Existing approaches largely focus on improving expressions, yet the search typically retains little beyond the resulting formula and score, losing the scientific record, such as motivations and probes, that inform what to try next. AutoSR preserves this record in a \textbf{Research State}, coupling each candidate equation with the reasoning, computational evidence, and independent review developed along its branch. Proposer--reviewer agents develop these states under progressive-widening Monte Carlo tree search (PW-MCTS), which allocates computation across competing investigations, while the accumulated research record is ultimately synthesized into a final report that explains the leading relation and the basis for its selection. Across nine selected challenges from two benchmark suites, AutoSR recovers algebraically equivalent relations in every case, including three cp3-bench problems that no published system recovers and six structurally diverse LSR-Transform problems. Overall, AutoSR extends symbolic regression from equation-level search toward automated scientific investigation, allowing scientific knowledge and accumulated evidence to shape both what is explored and how the resulting equation is justified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Automatic Symbolic Regression (AutoSR)，一种全自动符号回归系统，将传统“搜索孤立方程”扩展为“搜索持续的科学探究状态”。系统通过 Research State 保存每条候选方程背后的动机、计算证据与独立评审记录，并采用 progressive-widening Monte Carlo tree search (PW-MCTS) 分配计算资源，最终生成解释主导关系及其选择依据的报告。摘要报告在两组基准的九个挑战中全部恢复出代数等价关系，包括三个尚无公开系统能恢复的 cp3-bench 问题。
Motivation: 有限且带噪的数据常产生数值上竞争但域外行为不同的表达式，仅靠数值拟合与语法复杂度不足以衡量科学可信度；现有方法搜索后几乎只保留公式和分数，丢失了指导下一步探索的科研记录（如动机与探针）。
Method: AutoSR 将候选方程与推理、计算证据及独立评审耦合为 Research State，由 proposer–reviewer 智能体在 progressive-widening MCTS 下开发这些状态，将计算分配到相互竞争的探究方向上，并把累积研究记录综合成最终报告。
Result: 在两个基准套件的九个挑战中，AutoSR 在每种情况下都恢复了代数等价关系，包括三个无公开系统能恢复的 cp3-bench 问题和六个结构多样的 LSR-Transform 问题。
Conclusion: AutoSR 将符号回归从方程级搜索扩展到自动化科学探究，使科学知识与累积证据同时影响探索内容与最终方程的论证方式。

papers.title: An Analytical-Prior Framework for Data-Efficient Prediction of Sound-Reduction Frequencies in Rectangular Side-Branch Helmholtz Resonators
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity finite-element simulations can provide accurate numerical predictions for side-branch resonators, but large simulation datasets are expensive to generate and purely data-driven surrogates may become unreliable when simulation-labelled data are scarce. This study develops an analytical-prior learning framework that reuses a low-cost analytical model to improve data efficiency under limited high-fidelity simulation budgets. Two complementary routes are considered. When the analytical model remains available at inference, it is retained as an explicit baseline and the simulation data are used to learn only the analytical-to-simulation discrepancy. When a self-contained predictor is required, the analytical mapping is first distilled from abundant low-cost evaluations into a learned prior and then calibrated with the limited simulation data. The framework is evaluated on rectangular side-branch Helmholtz resonators using 86 simulation-labelled geometries and 8,998 non-overlapping analytical-only geometries. The analytical model achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.333 Hz. Direct support vector regression (SVR) achieved 3.375 Hz, while residual SVR reduced the MAE to 0.426 Hz. A direct multilayer perceptron (MLP) achieved 1.109 Hz, whereas analytical-prior pretraining reduced the error to 0.556 Hz with frozen-prior residual adaptation and 0.371 Hz with full-model fine-tuning. Across training budgets of 20 to 70 simulation-labelled cases, both analytical correction and analytical-prior pretraining consistently improved data efficiency relative to direct learning. These results show that analytical prior information can substantially improve high-fidelity prediction when simulation data are scarce, with explicit correction and prior distillation serving complementary deployment needs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对矩形支管亥姆霍兹谐振器 (side-branch Helmholtz resonator) 的降噪频率预测，提出一种解析先验学习框架 (analytical-prior learning framework)，用低成本解析模型辅助高保真有无限元仿真数据，以提升仿真标签稀缺时的数据效率。框架包含两条互补路径：推理时保留解析模型并仅学习解析到仿真的残差；或先蒸馏解析模型为学习先验，再用少量仿真数据校准。在 86 个仿真标记几何和 8,998 个纯解析几何上的实验显示，残差学习与先验预训练均显著优于直接数据驱动模型。
Motivation: 高保真有无限元仿真对支管谐振器能给出准确数值预测，但大型仿真数据集生成成本高，而纯数据驱动代理模型在仿真标签稀缺时不可靠。
Method: 框架分别考虑两种部署需求：当推理时解析模型可用，则将解析模型作为显式基线，仅用仿真数据学习解析到仿真的残差 (residual learning)；当需要自包含预测器时，先从大量低成本解析评估中蒸馏出解析映射作为学习先验，再用有限仿真数据对其进行校准，包括冻结先验的残差适配 (frozen-prior residual adaptation) 与全模型微调 (full-model fine-tuning)。
Result: 解析模型自身的 MAE 为 1.333 Hz；直接 SVR 为 3.375 Hz，残差 SVR 将 MAE 降至 0.426 Hz；直接 MLP 为 1.109 Hz，解析先验预训练在冻结先验残差适配下降至 0.556 Hz，在全模型微调下降至 0.371 Hz。在 20 到 70 个仿真标记训练样本的预算范围内，解析校正和解析先验预训练都比直接学习持续改善数据效率。
Conclusion: 作者认为在仿真数据稀缺时，解析先验信息能大幅提升高保真预测精度，且显式残差校正与先验蒸馏分别满足互补的部署需求。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Data-Efficient and Interpretable Classification of Circulating Tumor Cell Phenotypes in Microfluidic Devices via Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Accurate classification of circulating tumor cell (CTC) phenotypes can provide valuable information for assessing metastatic potential. Label free microfluidic devices provide a hydrodynamic obstacle course that transforms subtle biophysical characteristics of CTCs, including size and deformability, into distinct kinematic trajectories. However, the highly nonlinear fluid structure interactions governing these trajectories make the inverse problem of inferring cellular phenotype from trajectory data analytically intractable. While deep neural networks (DNNs) have emerged as a powerful approach for addressing this inverse problem, their effectiveness is constrained by the limited availability of trajectory data and the lack of physical interpretability. To address these challenges, we propose an interpretable and data efficient DNN framework for trajectory based CTC classification. To mitigate the scarcity of data, we develop Subsequence (SubSeq), a targeted augmentation strategy that randomly extracts informative local trajectory segments during training to promote learning from localized patterns. We further apply Gradient Weighted Class Activation Mapping to identify the trajectory features and physical regions of the microfluidic device that drive model predictions. Experimental results demonstrate that SubSeq improves classification accuracy over the evaluated baseline and augmentation methods. Furthermore, interpretability analysis suggests that localized trajectory segments contain substantial biophysical information relevant to accurate classification. This provides justification for SubSeq and also highlights the redundancy of full-length trajectories. More broadly, the proposed framework views microfluidic geometries as physical encoders of cellular mechanical properties, providing mechanistic insights that may inform the future design of diagnostic devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对微流控装置中循环肿瘤细胞 (CTC) 轨迹分类的数据稀缺与可解释性不足问题，提出一个数据高效且可解释的深度神经网络框架。作者开发了 Subsequence (SubSeq) 数据增强策略，在训练时随机抽取信息量大的局部轨迹片段，并结合 Gradient Weighted Class Activation Mapping 定位驱动预测的轨迹特征与微流控装置物理区域。实验表明 SubSeq 在评估基线与增强方法上提升了分类准确率，且可解释性分析说明局部轨迹片段已包含足够的生物物理信息。
Motivation: 从无标记微流控装置得到的 CTC 轨迹由高度非线性的流固耦合决定，由轨迹反推细胞表型的逆问题在解析上难以处理；深度神经网络虽可用于该逆问题，但受限于轨迹数据稀缺且缺乏物理可解释性。
Method: 提出可解释且数据高效的 DNN 框架：一是 SubSeq 定向增强策略，在训练中随机提取信息量高的局部轨迹片段以促进从局部模式学习；二是应用梯度加权类激活映射 (Gradient Weighted Class Activation Mapping) 识别驱动模型预测的轨迹特征和微流控装置物理区域。
Result: 实验结果显示 SubSeq 相比所评估的基线和增强方法提升了分类准确率；可解释性分析表明局部轨迹片段携带大量与准确分类相关的生物物理信息，并揭示全长轨迹存在冗余。
Conclusion: 该框架将微流控几何结构视为细胞机械特性的物理编码器，为轨迹级 CTC 分类提供了数据高效且可解释的途径，并为未来诊断装置设计提供机制层面的见解。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards Computational Provenance: Carrying Causal-State Evidence in Generated Text
papers.abstract_en: A language model's output does not by itself provide verifiable evidence about the internal computation that produced it. We study computational provenance: whether generated text can carry detectable evidence of which causally relevant internal state occurred. We test a bounded form of this idea in two controlled architectures: a modular feed-forward neural network and a transformer-based model. Both architectures are trained on the same arithmetic task with a mandatory pathway through two discrete intermediate states, allowing different internal paths to produce the same answer. We deliberately switch between these paths, authenticate the state actually used, and let that verified state determine a subtle statistical pattern in the generated text that can later be detected. The feed-forward and transformer systems each passed all 128 matched pairs in both their public and separately sealed protected end-to-end evaluations, with the detector recovering the signal associated with the authenticated internal state. The required causal computation also reproduced across five independently trained feed-forward models and three independently trained transformers. In a separate answer-only transformer experiment, our linear probes did not recover a naturally learned intermediate state. These results provide a controlled proof of concept that information about a verified, causally relevant internal state can be preserved in generated text even when the answer is unchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究计算溯源（computational provenance）：语言模型生成的文本能否携带关于其内部计算中因果相关状态的可检测证据。作者在模块化前馈网络和 transformer 两种受控架构上，以算术任务强制经过两个离散中间状态，并故意在路径间切换、认证实际使用的状态，再让该状态决定生成文本中的微妙统计模式。两个系统均通过了全部 128 对匹配对的公开与密封端到端评估，检测器成功恢复认证状态对应的信号，且该结果在多个独立训练的模型上复现。
Motivation: 语言模型的输出本身无法提供关于产生该输出的内部计算的可验证证据，论文旨在探索一种受限形式：生成文本中是否可能保留经过认证的、因果相关的内部状态信息。
Method: 采用两种受控架构（模块化前馈神经网络和 transformer），在同一算术任务上训练，并要求计算必须经过两个离散中间状态；通过切换不同内部路径但产出相同答案，认证实际使用的状态，并将该状态映射为生成文本中的一种可检测的统计模式，再用检测器恢复该信号。
Result: 前馈和 transformer 系统都通过了所有 128 对匹配对，包括公开和单独密封保护的两类端到端评估，检测器均恢复了与认证内部状态相关的信号；所需的因果计算还在五个独立训练的前馈模型和三个独立训练的 transformer 上重现。在仅使用答案的 transformer 实验中，线性探针未能恢复自然学习到的中间状态。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个受控的概念验证，表明即使最终答案不变，关于已验证、因果相关的内部状态的信息也可以被保留在生成文本中，但自然学习状态下线性探针的失败提示该效应需要特定的认证与编码条件。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个受控的概念验证，表明即使最终答案不变，关于已验证、因果相关的内部状态的信息也可以被保留在生成文本中，但自然学习状态下线性探针的失败提示该效应需要特定的认证与编码条件。

papers.title: Non-Crossing Deep Quantile Regression for Distributional Survival Prediction
papers.abstract_en: In survival analysis the way covariates act on the risk of an event often differs between early and late failure times, yet hazard- and mean-based summaries collapse this variation into a single number. Quantile-based modeling instead describes the full conditional distribution on the original time scale, but existing censored-data methods are either inflexible or produce logically inconsistent crossing quantile curves. We propose a Censored Non-crossing Quantile (CNQ) framework for right-censored data that jointly estimates several conditional survival quantiles and guarantees valid ordering by construction, with flexibility supplied by Kolmogorov-Arnold and Transformer backbones, and we establish a finite-sample excess-risk bound holding jointly across all fitted quantile levels. Across 27 simulation settings and six cohorts the framework attains lower pinball loss than quantile-, hazard- and tree-based competitors whenever the conditional distribution is asymmetric, with interval coverage closer to nominal on all six. In two clinical case studies (METABRIC, breast cancer; FLCHAIN, population mortality) it recovers covariate effects that vary across the survival distribution and would be hidden by a single hazard ratio, and yields coherent individualized quantile milestones. Code: https://github.com/BIG-S2/deepcnq
papers.comment: 50 pages, 15 figures, 17 tables. Main text and supplementary material combined into a single document. Submitted to the Annals of Applied Statistics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向右删失数据的 Censored Non-crossing Quantile (CNQ) 框架，用 Kolmogorov-Arnold 与 Transformer 作为主干，同时估计多个条件生存分位数，并通过构造保证分位数曲线不交叉。作者建立了跨所有分位水平的有限样本 excess-risk 界，并在 27 个模拟设置和六个队列上验证了方法在非对称条件分布下的优势。
Motivation: 生存分析中协变量对事件风险的作用常随早期与晚期失效时间而变化，但基于风险函数和均值的摘要把这种变化压缩成单一数值；分位数建模虽能描述原始时间尺度上的完整条件分布，现有删失数据处理方法要么不够灵活，要么产生逻辑不一致的交叉分位数曲线。
Method: 提出 CNQ 框架，针对右删失数据联合估计多个条件生存分位数，通过构造性方式保证分位数的有效排序，并以 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络和 Transformer 作为灵活性来源，同时给出联合适用于所有拟合分位水平的有限样本 excess-risk 上界。
Result: 在 27 个模拟设置和六个队列中，当条件分布不对称时，CNQ 的 pinball loss 低于分位数、风险函数和树类基线，且六个队列的区间覆盖率都更接近名义水平；在 METABRIC（乳腺癌）和 FLCHAIN（人群死亡率）两个临床案例中，方法恢复了随生存分布变化的协变量效应，并给出连贯的个体化分位数里程碑。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 CNQ 能揭示被单一风险比隐藏的分布层面协变量效应，并提供连贯的个体化分位数里程碑；代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SplatGuide: Geometric Priors from 3D Gaussians for Pose-Free Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Generating photorealistic novel views from unposed images requires both 3D geometric understanding and the ability to synthesize unseen content. A natural strategy combines feed-forward 3DGS reconstruction with multi-view diffusion. Yet prior pipelines extract at most one signal from the reconstruction, either pixel rendering or learned features, while none exploits per-Gaussian visibility for occlusion-aware reference selection. This *information disconnect* leaves renderable geometry, visibility cues, and learned features unused. SplatGuide closes this disconnect by reusing a single 3DGS scene across three complementary roles. Rendered images provide pixel-aligned geometric conditioning. Per-Gaussian source-view indices are rendered into a target-view voting map for occlusion-aware reference selection. Reconstruction tokens supply feature-level guidance via cross-attention. All three signals derive from the same reconstruction forward pass. Across RealEstate10K, DL3DV, Tanks-and-Temples, and Mip-NeRF 360, SplatGuide achieves state-of-the-art pose-free novel view synthesis. On RealEstate10K, with a moderate number of input views, it surpasses the ground-truth-pose baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SplatGuide，针对无位姿图像的新视角合成任务，将单个 3DGS 重建场景复用为三种互补信号：渲染图像提供像素级几何条件，逐高斯源视角索引渲染成目标视角投票图用于遮挡感知参考选择，重建 token 通过交叉注意力提供特征级引导。在 RealEstate10K、DL3DV、Tanks-and-Temples 和 Mip-NeRF 360 上达到最先进的 pose-free 新视角合成效果，并且在 RealEstate10K 上使用中等数量输入视角时超过使用真实位姿的基线。
Motivation: 无位姿新视角合成既需要三维几何理解，又需要合成未见内容的能力。现有流程通常从前馈 3DGS 重建中只提取一种信号（像素渲染或学习特征），没有利用逐高斯可见性进行遮挡感知的参考选择，造成可渲染几何、可见性线索与学习特征之间的信息断连。
Method: SplatGuide 把单个 3DGS 场景用于三个互补角色：渲染图像提供像素对齐的几何条件；逐高斯源视角索引被渲染成目标视角投票图，用于遮挡感知的参考视图选择；重建 token 通过交叉注意力提供特征级引导。这三类信号均来自同一次重建前向传播，不额外增加重建开销。
Result: 在 RealEstate10K、DL3DV、Tanks-and-Temples 和 Mip-NeRF 360 基准上，SplatGuide 取得最先进的 pose-free 新视角合成结果；在 RealEstate10K 上，使用中等数量的输入视角时，其性能超过了使用真实位姿的基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调复用同一个 3DGS 场景中的渲染几何、可见性线索和学习特征，可以同时提供像素级、遮挡感知和特征级引导，从而弥合先前重建与扩散流程之间的信息断连并提升新视角合成质量。摘要未明确说明局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Volume-preserving Lagrangian averaging using polar factorization
papers.abstract_en: The generalised Lagrangian mean (GLM) theory of Andrews & McIntyre provides a powerful framework to study the interactions between waves and flows. A drawback of this theory is that the Lagrangian mean velocity is divergent even for incompressible fluids because the mean flow map, which sends the Lagrangian labels of fluid parcels to their mean positions, does not preserve volume. This results, for instance, in vortices shrinking under Lagrangian averaging. We overcome this drawback by revising the definition of the mean flow map, choosing it as the volume-preserving map closest to the "bare" GLM mean map. A standard result of optimal-transport theory then shows that the new mean map is the volume-preserving factor in the polar factorization of the GLM mean map. We develop and implement a numerical method for the computation of the corresponding Lagrangian mean fields from simulation data. The implementation builds on recently developed algorithms for the on-the-fly computation of Lagrangian means using the exponential and Butterworth filters. We demonstrate the value of volume-preserving Lagrangian averaging in simulations of the two-dimensional incompressible and shallow-water models. We compare the Lagrangian-mean fields obtained with and without the volume-preservation constraint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对广义拉格朗日平均（GLM）理论中平均流场映射不保体积的问题，提出利用最优传输中的极分解（polar factorization）将平均映射替换为最接近原始GLM平均映射的保体积映射，从而修正拉格朗日平均速度的定义。作者基于指数滤波和Butterworth滤波的在线拉格朗日平均算法，开发了相应的数值计算方法，并在二维不可压缩流和浅水模型中演示了保体积拉格朗日平均的效果，并与未加保体积约束的结果进行了比较。
Motivation: GLM理论的缺陷在于，即使流体不可压缩，平均流映射也不保体积，导致拉格朗日平均速度出现非零散度，例如涡旋在拉格朗日平均下会收缩。这限制了GLM在波流相互作用研究中的适用性，论文旨在通过重新定义平均流映射来克服这一缺点。
Method: 将平均流映射重新定义为与‘裸’GLM平均映射最接近的保体积映射，利用最优输运理论的标准结果，该新平均映射即为GLM平均映射极分解中的保体积因子。数值实现基于最近发展的指数滤波和Butterworth滤波的实时计算拉格朗日平均算法，用于从模拟数据计算对应拉格朗日平均场。
Result: 论文在二维不可压缩流和浅水模型的模拟中展示了保体积拉格朗日平均的价值，并对有、无保体积约束下的拉格朗日平均场进行了比较。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 通过极分解构造保体积的拉格朗日平均映射可以修复GLM平均速度散度不为零的问题，所开发的数值方法适用于从模拟数据中计算修正后的拉格朗日平均场。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: The canonical facets of multi-separator polytopes
papers.abstract_en: We initiate a polyhedral study of the graph multi-separator problem proposed by Irmai et al. (2024) as an alternative to the lifted multicut problem for application to the task of image segmentation. Starting with an integer linear program (ILP) formulation and the multi-separator polytope spanned by its feasible solutions, we characterize in terms of efficiently-decidable, graph-theoretic conditions all facets induced by inequalities of the ILP. We proceed by strengthening these inequalities and describing additional facets of some multi-separator polytopes induced by the stronger inequalities. Specifically, we obtain a totally dual integral description of the multi-separator polytope for paths in the case where separation is considered for all vertex pairs. Finally, we relate the multi-separator polytope to the boolean quadric polytope, showing that facets induced by odd-cycle inequalities do not transfer generally, and to the lifted multicut polytope, showing that either polytope is a projection of a face of the other.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 Irmai et al. (2024) 提出的图多分离器 (graph multi-separator) 问题开展多面体研究，该问题是提升多割 (lifted multicut) 问题在图像分割中的替代方案。作者从整数线性规划 (ILP) 及其可行解张成的多分离器多面体出发，用可高效判定的图论条件刻画 ILP 不等式诱导的全部面 (facets)，随后加强这些不等式并描述部分多分离器多面体由更强不等式诱导的新面。文中还给出了路径上对所有顶点对做分离时多分离器多面体的全对偶整数 (totally dual integral, TDI) 描述，并将其与布尔二次多面体及提升多割多面体建立了投影与面之间的对应关系。
Motivation: 多分离器问题被提出作为图像分割中提升多割问题的替代模型，但其整数规划的多面体结构尚缺乏系统研究；理解其多面体有助于分析该 ILP 的强度与求解可行性。
Method: 从多分离器问题的 ILP 公式出发，利用可有效判定的图论条件刻画 ILP 不等式诱导的所有面；通过加强不等式构造新面，并对路径情形推导 TDI 描述；最后通过投影和面关系将该多面体与布尔二次多面体、提升多割多面体建立联系。
Result: 摘要报告：在考虑所有顶点对分离的路径情形下，得到多分离器多面体的 TDI 描述；奇圈不等式诱导的面在一般情形下不会迁移到布尔二次多面体；多分离器多面体与提升多割多面体互为对方某个面的投影。
Conclusion: 作者给出多分离器多面体在若干图类上的完整或部分面刻画，并阐明其与布尔二次多面体、提升多割多面体的结构关系，为后续基于该模型的整数规划方法提供理论支撑。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: HarnessEval-W: Agentifying the Evaluation of Visual Worlds
papers.abstract_en: A benchmark should deliver more than a scalar score: what makes an evaluation trustworthy is the reasoning that justifies the score. This is especially critical for world models, where judging a rollout requires understanding whether physics, causality, and world state evolve correctly. Humans spot such violations naturally, yet no existing benchmark automates this capability: metrics are computed brute-force, leaving no reasoning chain that can be examined or verified. We introduce HarnessEval-W, an agentified evaluation pipeline that brings the harness paradigm from the LLM ecosystem to world model benchmarking. Rather than applying a fixed rubric, HarnessEval-W interprets the context of each evaluation case, decomposes the evaluation question into measurable subproblems, and spawns specialized sub-agents, each equipped with tailored context and diagnostic tools to reason over its own subproblem. The parent agent then validates the gathered evidence and summarizes it into the final verdict. This hierarchical workflow turns every evaluation into a transparent evidence tree whose complete reasoning chain justifies the result. We apply HarnessEval-W to 18 representative world models over 330 evaluation cases. Its judgments closely align with human preferences while providing verifiable, fine-grained diagnoses of every generated rollout. We open-source the full pipeline as a live benchmark and invite the broad community to contribute to grow new skills and evaluation cases as world models evolve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HarnessEval-W，一种将 LLM 生态中的 harness 范式引入世界模型（world model）评估的智能体化流水线。它不是应用固定评分规则，而是解释每个评估案例的上下文、把评估问题分解为可测子问题，并派生子代理各自推理，最后由父代理验证证据并汇总出最终裁决。作者将其应用于18个世界模型、330个评估案例，称其判断与人类偏好高度一致，并为每个生成的 rollout 提供可验证的细粒度诊断。
Motivation: 现有世界模型基准只给出标量分数，缺乏可检验的推理链，无法自动判断 rollout 中物理、因果和世界状态是否演变正确；人类能自然发现这类违规，但尚无基准自动化这种能力。
Method: 提出 HarnessEval-W 评估流水线：解释每个评估案例的上下文，将评估问题分解为可测量的子问题，生成配备定制上下文和诊断工具的专业子代理，父代理再验证收集的证据并总结为最终裁决，形成透明的证据树（evidence tree）。
Result: 摘要报告在18个代表性世界模型、330个评估案例上，其判断与人类偏好密切对齐，同时提供可验证、细粒度的逐 rollout 诊断，并将完整流程作为实时基准开源。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该管道使每次评估都具有完整可查的推理链，并邀请社区贡献新技能和评估案例，以随世界模型发展持续扩展基准。

papers.title: zLend: A Dual-Scope Cash-Flow Reconstruction Framework for On-Chain Credit Underwriting
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized lending lacks a credit bureau: a borrower's capacity to repay must be inferred entirely from public on-chain activity, without income verification or a liability record. This paper presents zLend, a deployed cash-flow underwriting framework that reconstructs a wallet's daily balance history from raw token transfers and derives short-duration repayment-capacity signals from it. The reconstruction is performed twice per wallet, once restricted to a fixed stablecoin basket and once over all fungible transfers, on the premise that a wallet's total token holdings and its liquid, spendable balance are distinct quantities whose conflation misprices risk. From each series we derive liquidity coverage against a fixed loan size, cash-flow volatility and regularity, a drawdown-and-recovery statistic adapted from quantitative finance, and a recurring-counterparty detector that identifies salary-like payment cadence from transfer timing alone. The two views are then compared: a wallet with large aggregate holdings whose stablecoin reserve rarely covers the loan size is flagged as a liquidity mismatch irrespective of total wealth. We specify the pipeline formally, document the golden-master methodology used to verify a cross-language production migration to numerical tolerance 1e-9, and characterize the tier function's parameter sensitivity with an independent reimplementation validated to exact agreement (78 of 78 field assertions) against the deployed system's reference fixtures. Tier assignment is governed predominantly by the reference loan size, with four of six reference wallets changing tier across loan sizes from USD 10 to USD 25,000; the drawdown and coverage criteria bind on disjoint wallets, so neither subsumes the other; and no criterion in the tier rule is inert. zLend is deployed in production, informing real lending decisions via third-party API integrations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 zLend，一个已部署的链上借贷现金流水-underwriting 框架。它从原始 token 转账记录重建钱包的每日余额历史，并据此推导短期还款能力信号；重建过程对每个钱包执行两次，一次限定在固定稳定币篮子，一次覆盖所有可替代转账，以区分总持有量与流动性可花费余额。摘要还报告了用于验证跨语言生产迁移的 golden-master 方法，以及分级函数对参考贷款规模的敏感性分析。
Motivation: 去中心化借贷缺少信用局（credit bureau），借款人的还款能力只能从公开链上活动推断，没有收入验证或负债记录，因此需要能从链上数据重建现金流并评估违约风险的框架。
Method: 从原始 token 转账重建每日余额序列，并在每次钱包上分别构建稳定币篮子视图和全量可替代转账视图；从每个序列推导固定贷款规模下的流动性覆盖率、现金流波动性与规律性、借鉴量化金融的回撤-恢复统计量，以及仅凭转账时序识别工资式支付节奏的重复交易对手检测器；最后比较两个视图以标记流动性错配。
Result: 摘要报告分级（tier）主要受参考贷款规模支配，六个参考钱包中有四个在贷款规模从 USD 10 到 USD 25,000 变化时改变级别；回撤与覆盖率标准约束在不重叠的钱包上，二者互不包含；分级规则中没有任何标准是无效的。系统已部署上线，并通过第三方 API 集成影响真实借贷决策。
Conclusion: zLend 已投入生产并支撑真实借贷决策；作者强调其流水重建方法、数值容差 1e-9 的跨语言迁移验证，以及独立重实现与部署系统参考夹具在 78/78 字段断言上完全一致。

papers.title: Can Unsupervised Methods Outperform Supervised Deep Learning When Ground Truth Is Sparse? A Case Study of Bronchovascular Bundle Segmentation in Low-Dose CT
authors: Joanna Polanska (1) ((1) Department of Data Science and Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Background Lung cancer remains the deadliest cancer worldwide because it is often diagnosed too late. Effective treatment depends on detection at an early screening stage. However, the growing number of patients and the limited number of radiologists lead to prolonged diagnostic waiting times. In very early stage lung cancer, nodule visibility is further reduced by adjacent blood vessels and airway walls, because nodules are often connected to or supplied by these structures. Task-specific analysis of the bronchovascular bundle is therefore important for efficient nodule detection, and its removal can increase the diagnostic potential of lung cancer screening. Materials and Methods To assess the efficacy of the proposed method, we used series from widely utilized LDCT datasets, including the Duke Lung Cancer Screening (DLCS) dataset and the Pilot Pomeranian Lung Cancer Screening Program. The proposed bronchovascular bundle segmentation pipeline, RONALD, operates on computed tomography images and returns binary masks of vessels and bronchi located in the lung parenchyma. The method includes a preprocessing stage with lung, lobe, and mediastinum segmentation, followed by separate vessel and bronchial tree segmentation. Results The proposed pipeline segmented the bronchovascular bundle in low-dose computed tomography scans while improving nodule retention compared with other segmentation methods: from 93.98% and 90.36% to 100% in DLCS, and from 83.16% and 62.36% to 99.92% in the Pomeranian dataset. Conclusion The resulting segmentations can improve lung nodule detection in the very early stages of lung cancer.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 4 figures. Part of this research was submitted to the international conference European Molecular Imaging Meeting 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对低剂量CT影像的支气管血管束（bronchovascular bundle）分割管道RONALD，用于改善极早期肺癌筛查中的结节检测。管道先进行肺、肺叶和纵隔分割，再分别分割血管和支气管树，输出肺实质内血管与支气管的二元掩膜。在DLCS和Pomeranian两个低剂量CT数据集上，该方法相比其他分割方法提高了结节保留率，作者认为这有助于早期肺癌结节检测。
Motivation: 肺癌常因发现过晚而成为全球致死率最高的癌症，早期筛查至关重要，但极早期结节常与邻近血管和气道壁相连或被其遮挡，影响检出。任务特异性地分析并去除支气管血管束有助于提高肺结节筛查的诊断潜力。
Method: 提出RONALD分割管道，包含预处理阶段的肺、肺叶和纵隔分割，随后进行独立的血管树和支气管树分割，最终在CT图像上返回肺实质中血管与支气管的二元掩膜。
Result: 在DLCS数据集中，结节保留率从其他方法的93.98%和90.36%提升至100%；在Pomeranian数据集中从83.16%和62.36%提升至99.92%。
Conclusion: 得到的支气管血管束分割结果可以改善极早期肺癌的肺结节检测。

papers.title: What Do Compliance Detectors Read? An Audit of Activation Probes and Guard Models
papers.abstract_en: Regulatory compliance monitoring in deployed language models is increasingly implemented as a legal and audit control, checking model outputs against written rules spanning data protection, healthcare, financial regulation, and platform policy. Such monitoring is meaningful only if a detector's verdict depends on the stated rule rather than on surface features of the scenario. We show this condition fails across the current class of compliance detectors, a failure we call rule blindness. Deleting, permuting, or substituting the governing rule leaves detection accuracy unchanged for every guard and activation probe we test, including a policy-conditioned guard that correctly cites the governing clause yet barely changes its verdict when that clause is swapped for its permissive counterpart. A purpose-built benchmark crossing two rules with two scenarios, so that neither alone predicts the label, confirms the failure under a design no prior benchmark rules out, and shows that step by step reasoning, not any fast detector we test, is what escapes it. Auditing at scale requires a retraining-free detector, so we introduce the Internal Compliance Score (ICS): a training-free activation readout calibrated from ten labelled pairs and scored by a single projection. We hold ICS to the same scrutiny as the guards it audits: a pre-registered criterion for beating trivial baselines is not met, and a bag-of-words model matches its pooled generalisation exactly. It remains useful because it is inexpensive, letting us audit four deployed guard models, an 8B zero-shot judge, and thirteen benchmarks, and it raises the mechanically verified pass rate when used to rank candidate responses, though an adaptive white-box attack removes this gain. We release the counterfactual protocol and crossed-rule benchmark so rule blindness can be tested in future probe and guard claims.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对部署语言模型中的合规检测器（compliance detectors）进行审计，发现一类系统性失败，称为规则盲（rule blindness）：删除、置换或替换管辖规则后，所有被测的 guard 模型和激活探针（activation probes）的检测准确率都不变；即使是能正确引用管辖条款的策略条件化 guard，在把条款换成宽容版本后判定也几乎不变。作者提出无需训练的激活读数 Internal Compliance Score (ICS) 用于大规模审计，但 ICS 未能通过预先注册的超越平凡基线标准，且词袋模型与其池化泛化性能完全一致。论文发布了反事实协议和交叉规则基准，供未来检验探针与 guard 的声明。
Motivation: 监管合规监控只有在检测器的判定真正依赖书面规则、而非场景表面特征时才有意义；当前合规检测器类无法满足这一条件，且缺少能大规模审计此类系统且无需重新训练的手段。
Method: 作者设计反事实协议（删除、置换、替换规则）和一个二规则×二场景的交叉规则基准，使单一因素无法预测标签；并提出 Internal Compliance Score (ICS)，一种无需训练的激活读出方法，用十个标注样本校准、单一投影打分，用于审计其他 guard 模型。
Result: 所有被测 guard 与激活探针均表现出规则盲；逐步推理（step by step reasoning）是唯一能摆脱该缺陷的被测方式。ICS 未达到预先注册的超越平凡基线标准，词袋模型与其泛化完全持平；ICS 在用于排序候选回复时提高机械验证通过率，但自适应白盒攻击消除了这一收益。
Conclusion: 作者认为规则盲在当前合规检测器类别中普遍存在，ICS 虽不满足严格基线标准，但因成本低廉仍可用于大规模审计（覆盖四个部署 guard、一个 8B zero-shot judge 和十三个基准）；同时发布反事实协议与交叉规则基准供后续研究使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Proteus: Incremental Memory Activation for Long-Context Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract_en: The quadratic cost of attention-based sequence models for long contexts has motivated a growing line of research on memory-based models that can compress context into a compact state. However, most existing memory models expose a static memory throughout the entire sequence. Because early tokens face no compression pressure, they occupy too many degrees of freedom and "pollute" the memory state, leaving little capacity for later context and increasing interference between what is stored and what arrives next. We study a new paradigm of incremental memory activation, where the effective capacity of memory is progressively expanded as the context grows. Imposing an early bottleneck forces the model to compress history more effectively, while unlocking fresh capacity over time reduces interference and improves retention of later context. We instantiate this paradigm in Proteus, a straightforward mechanism that can be incorporated into a broad class of neural memory architectures at no additional cost. We apply Proteus to state-of-the-art models, including SWLA, Comba, Titans, and Hope-Attention, and observe consistent improvements on standard language modeling and reasoning, as well as on long-context retrieval and understanding, with gains that grow at longer context lengths. Overall, our results show that static memory is suboptimal and that scheduling effective capacity is a simple and broadly applicable tool for sequence modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的“增量记忆激活”(incremental memory activation) 范式：在序列处理过程中随上下文增长逐步扩展记忆的有效容量。早期对记忆施加瓶颈迫使模型更有效地压缩历史，随时间解锁新的容量则减少存储内容与新到达信息之间的干扰。作者将该范式实例化为 Proteus 机制，可无额外成本地嵌入多种神经记忆架构，并应用于 SWLA、Comba、Titans、Hope-Attention 等模型，在语言建模、推理、长上下文检索与理解任务上获得一致提升。
Motivation: 现有基于记忆的序列模型在整个序列中暴露静态记忆，早期 token 没有压缩压力，占据过多自由度并“污染”记忆状态，导致后期上下文可用容量不足，且存储与后续到达信息的干扰增大。
Method: 提出增量记忆激活的范式：随上下文增长渐进扩展记忆有效容量，早期设置瓶颈以强制历史压缩，后期解锁新容量以减少干扰；并实例化为 Proteus，一种可融入广泛神经记忆架构的简单机制，不增加额外计算成本。

papers.title: HAF: Adapting Generalist VLAs to Humanoid Whole-Body Loco-manipulation via Hierarchical Action Flow and Spectral Latent RL
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots hold great promise as general-purpose agents in human-centered environments, yet generalist vision-language-action (VLA) foundation models are not readily applicable to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation. The high dimensionality and interdependence of humanoid motions make it challenging for conventional single-stage VLA architectures to coordinate locomotion, waist posture, and dual-arm manipulation effectively. Moreover, policies trained through offline behavior cloning can remain suboptimal during real-world deployment. Although online reinforcement learning can refine policies through real-world interaction, directly tuning large VLA backbones demands excessive computation and may introduce safety risks during real-robot exploration. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce HAF (Humanoid Adaptation Framework), a two-part framework consisting of HAF-VLA and HAF-Steer that transfers off-the-shelf generalist VLA foundation models to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation. HAF-VLA is a hierarchical action-flow generator built on a pretrained flow-matching VLA. It splits full-body action denoising into three sequential stages with stage embeddings and cross-stage KV caches that retain kinematic dependencies, avoiding incoherent whole-body actions from one-shot generation. On top of the frozen HAF-VLA, HAF-Steer is a latent offline-to-online RL pipeline that leverages flow-matching invertibility and DCT-based dimensionality reduction to restrict RL optimization to a compact noise subspace and train a regularized SAC policy. This avoids updating the large VLA backbone and enables efficient real-world policy refinement. Evaluated on seven real-world humanoid loco-manipulation tasks, HAF surpasses vanilla single-stage VLA baselines and improves whole-body coordination and task performance. Project website: https://grange007.github.io/HAF .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HAF (Humanoid Adaptation Framework)，将现成的通用 VLA (vision-language-action) 基础模型迁移到人形机器人全身移动操作 (whole-body loco-manipulation)。HAF 由 HAF-VLA 和 HAF-Steer 两部分组成：前者是基于预训练 flow-matching VLA 的分层动作流生成器，把全身动作去噪拆分为三个顺序阶段；后者在冻结的 HAF-VLA 之上运行 latent 的离线到在线 RL。在七个真实世界人形移动操作任务上，HAF 超越 vanilla 单阶段 VLA 基线，改善全身协调与任务性能。
Motivation: 通用 VLA 基础模型难以直接应用于人形全身移动操作，因为人形运动维度高且各部分强耦合，单阶段 VLA 难以协调 locomotion、腰姿和双臂操作。离线行为克隆部署时可能次优，而直接在线 RL 微调大 VLA 主干计算代价高且存在真实机器人探索的安全风险。
Method: HAF 包含 HAF-VLA 和 HAF-Steer 两部分。HAF-VLA 是分层动作流生成器，将全身动作去噪拆成三个顺序阶段，并利用 stage embeddings 和 cross-stage KV caches 保留运动学依赖，避免一次性生成导致的不连贯动作。HAF-Steer 利用 flow-matching 可逆性与 DCT 降维，把 RL 优化限制在紧凑噪声子空间并训练正则化 SAC 策略，从而避免更新大 VLA 主干，支持高效的真实世界策略精化。
Result: 在七个真实世界人形移动操作任务上，HAF 优于 vanilla 单阶段 VLA 基线，提升了全身协调性与任务性能。摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为分层动作流生成加 latent 子空间 RL 可以高效地把通用 VLA 迁移到人形全身移动操作，并支持安全的真实世界在线精化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Model Hypnosis: Strong control of AI via additive subliminal effects
papers.abstract_en: We demonstrate that AI models are broadly susceptible to a phenomenon we call model hypnosis, in which individually weak and seemingly irrelevant cues in the prompt can be systematically combined to strongly control model behavior. Model hypnosis occurs across model families and scales, including in frontier reasoning models, and hypnotic prompts can transfer between models. Because the model is controlled by inconspicuous textual choices, such as paraphrases and typos, model hypnosis presents new challenges and avenues for AI safety, and is a major hurdle for AI interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并演示了一种称为“模型催眠”(model hypnosis) 的现象：提示词中单个微弱且看似无关的线索可以被系统性地组合，从而强烈控制模型行为。作者称该现象在多个模型家族和规模上普遍存在，包括前沿推理模型，且催眠提示可以在模型之间迁移，对 AI 安全与可解释性构成挑战。
Motivation: 现有研究表明提示词中隐蔽的文本选择可能影响模型输出，但缺乏对“弱线索系统性组合以实现强控制”这一现象的明确刻画；该现象可能威胁 AI 安全并阻碍可解释性研究。
Method: 论文通过实验展示，将提示中细微的文本选择（如同义改写、拼写错误）作为可加性的亚阈值线索进行组合，可以逐步增强对模型行为的控制，并验证其在多个模型家族与推理模型上的有效性与跨模型迁移性。
Result: 摘要报告模型催眠现象在多种模型家族与规模上出现，包括前沿推理模型，且催眠提示可跨模型迁移。具体量化指标未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: 作者认为模型催眠为 AI 安全带来新挑战，并是可解释性研究的主要障碍。摘要未说明缓解方法或局限。

papers.title: Time-Aware Validation of Machine Learning Fuel Consumption Models: Evidence from 1\,Hz Operational Data, CCGS \textit{Sir Wilfrid Laurier}
papers.abstract_en: Ship fuel consumption (SFC) prediction supports vessel operation optimisation, emissions estimation, and decision support systems (DSS) for sustainable maritime transportation. Numerous data-driven fuel models have been developed over the past two decades, but a critical and often overlooked limitation lies in their validation practices: most studies evaluate performance using random train--test splits, which, applied to high-frequency records, admit temporal leakage and yield optimistic results that do not reflect deployment conditions. This paper examines that gap using time-aware evaluation, specifically Time Series Cross-Validation (TSCV) and Blocked TSCV (BTSCV). Using the Canadian Coast Guard Ship (CCGS) \textit{Sir Wilfrid Laurier} as a case study, six regression models and a physics baseline are tuned under three time-aware schemes and three feature configurations, then evaluated on a common chronological hold-out set drawn from approximately 3.88 million steady-state 1\,Hz records.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对船舶燃油消耗（SFC）预测模型验证中的时间泄漏问题，指出大多数研究采用随机训练-测试划分会在高频记录上产生乐观且不代表实际部署条件的结果。以加拿大海岸警卫队船舶 Sir Wilfrid Laurier 为案例，作者在三种时间感知方案（Time Series Cross-Validation, TSCV；Blocked TSCV, BTSCV）和三种特征配置下调优六个回归模型与一个物理基线，并在约388万条1Hz稳态记录构建的共同时间顺序留出集上比较。
Motivation: 过去二十年涌现大量数据驱动的船舶燃油模型，但其验证实践常被忽视：随机train-test split应用于高频时间序列会引入时间泄漏，导致性能估计偏乐观，无法反映真实部署条件。
Method: 采用时间感知的评估框架，即TSCV与BTSCV，对六个回归模型和一个物理基线在三种时间感知方案及三种特征配置下进行调参，并用基于约3.88 million条1Hz稳态记录的时间顺序hold-out集做统一评估。
Result: 摘要未给出具体性能数值，只概述了实验设置：以CCGS Sir Wilfrid Laurier为案例，涵盖约388万条1Hz稳态记录、六种回归模型、一个物理基线与多种时间感知验证方案的比较。
Conclusion: 本文强调时间感知验证（如TSCV/BTSCV）对准确估计船舶燃油模型部署性能的重要性，随机划分会因时间泄漏而高估效果。

papers.title: Policy Iteration with Human Feedback: Bringing Post-Training RL to In-context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Generative pretraining established reusable task representations; later work on language-based task conditioning and in-context learning showed that a fixed model could adapt its behavior from instructions and demonstrations. Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF) builds on this development and the recurrent evaluate-and-improve structure of generalized policy iteration. PIHF uses a pretrained language model as its execution substrate and moves persistent revision to a versioned natural-language policy and tool set. A language-model critic and clinical expert review complete-panel reasoning and tool-use trajectories to localize recurrent failures and form candidate revisions; the expert may reinterpret the evidence and retains authority over admission and rollback, while Recall@1 and Recall@5 validate outcomes after candidate execution. Across cumulative ablations and ultra-rare-disease benchmarks, a PIHF-derived policy improved Recall@1 in one proprietary executor and three open-weight executors spanning 3 to 49 billion active parameters. Gains were 32.7 percentage points for GPT-5.4 and 31.1 points for Qwen3.6-35B, a difference of 1.7 points. These results support the feasibility of using pretrained language models as fixed-weight execution substrates for expert-guided policy development in rare-disease diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Policy Iteration with Human Feedback（PIHF），将广义策略迭代的评估-改进循环引入上下文学习（in-context learning），用预训练语言模型作为固定权重的执行基底，把持久性修改放到带版本的自然语言策略与工具集中。作者在超罕见病诊断基准上验证该框架：PIHF 得到的策略在多个专有与开源执行器上提升 Recall@1，其中 GPT-5.4 提升 32.7 个百分点、Qwen3.6-35B 提升 31.1 个百分点。摘要认为这支持了用固定权重语言模型做专家引导策略开发的可行性。
Motivation: 生成式预训练与上下文学习已表明固定模型能从指令和演示中调整行为，但缺乏把这种调整固化成可复用、可持续改进策略的机制。论文瞄准这一缺口，希望将强化学习式的反复评估与改进结构迁移到上下文学习设置中，用于专业领域（罕见病诊断）的策略开发。
Method: PIHF 以预训练语言模型为执行基底，采用广义策略迭代（generalized policy iteration）中循环评估与改进的结构。语言模型批评者与临床专家审查完整面板推理和工具使用轨迹来定位反复出现的失败并形成候选修订；专家可重新解释证据并掌握准入与回滚权限，候选执行后用 Recall@1 和 Recall@5 验证结果。
Result: 在累积消融与超罕见病基准上，PIHF 导出的策略在一个专有执行器和三个 30 亿到 490 亿活跃参数的开源执行器上改善 Recall@1，GPT-5.4 提升 32.7 个百分点，Qwen3.6-35B 提升 31.1 个百分点，两者相差 1.7 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，结果表明预训练语言模型可以充当固定权重的执行基底，支持专家引导的、以自然语言策略形式落地的策略开发流程。局限与更广泛适用性在摘要中未展开说明。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CaliBench: Are the Stochastic Dynamics of Video World Models Physically Calibrated?
papers.abstract_en: Video world models approximate the stochastic distribution of physical outcomes through generative sampling, but existing benchmarks score individual generations or compare distributions coarsely over a whole dataset, leaving the fine-grained aleatoric uncertainty of specific phenomena untested. We introduce CaliBench, which scores outcomes in a physically interpretable discrete space - a bin index, a die face, a suit, a colour - rather than a learned feature space such as in FID, so the distance from a known reference distribution is measured directly. We curate outcome spaces whose reference is known in closed form (binomial Galton boards, Bernoulli forks, uniform dice/cards/lottery, a skewed European-roulette colour), enabling an exact calibration test. We decompose performance into two orthogonal axes that a single accuracy metric conflates: scorability, the fraction of generations yielding a scoreable outcome, and calibration, the total variation distance from the reference on that sample. A chi-squared test assesses significance; as calibration is its null hypothesis it can evidence only miscalibration, and at N=32 per cell detects only large deviations. We apply it to nine scenes and six image-to-video models (WAN-2.7, SeeDance-2.0, HappyHorse-1.0, Veo 3.1, Runway Gen-4.5, Cosmos3-Super), 32 generations each. Models consistently concentrate probability mass on a few outcomes rather than reproducing the reference. Most scene-model combinations are significantly miscalibrated, in the extreme collapsing to one outcome, as Veo 3.1 does on dice. On roulette, generations often leave the ball ambiguously placed, giving several models low scorability. Performance varies by scene: no model dominates all nine. We release the protocol and a metric (mean normalised total variation, mnTV) for comparing new models against our results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CaliBench，一个评估视频世界模型随机动力学物理校准度的基准。它把生成结果映射到物理可解释的离散结果空间（bin 索引、骰子面、花色、颜色），而不是 FID 之类的学习特征空间，从而直接度量与已知参考分布的距离。对九个场景和六个图像到视频模型各 32 次生成的评估显示，模型倾向于把概率质量集中在少数结果上，而非复现参考分布。
Motivation: 现有基准要么逐样本评分，要么在一整个数据集上粗略比较分布，无法检验特定现象的细粒度 aleatoric uncertainty（随机不确定性）。
Method: CaliBench 构造参考分布已知闭式解的结果空间（二项 Galton 板、Bernoulli 分叉、均匀骰子/牌/彩票、偏斜欧式轮盘颜色），实现精确校准检验；将性能分解为 scorability（可评分生成的比例）与 calibration（样本上的总变差距离），并用卡方检验评估显著性。
Result: 多数场景-模型组合显著失准，极端情况如 Veo 3.1 在骰子上坍缩为单一结果；轮盘场景中生成常使球位置模糊，导致多个模型 scorability 偏低。性能因场景而异，没有模型在全部九个场景占优。
Conclusion: 作者发布协议与度量（mean normalised total variation, mnTV）供新模型对比；由于校准是卡方检验的零假设，该检验只能证明失准，且 N=32 per cell 只能检测较大偏差。

papers.title: GEO-Flag: Detecting and Measuring GEO-Optimized Web Content
papers.abstract_en: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) modifies web content to increase its likelihood of being selected and cited by generative search engines. This can give strategically optimized pages visibility disproportionate to their authority or relevance and even make weak or false information appear well supported. Unlike conventional search, generative search synthesizes information into direct answers rather than presenting competing sources, which can further amplify these risks, as assessing source provenance and authority requires additional user interaction. Despite these concerns, systematic methods for detecting GEO-optimized webpages remain underexplored. We introduce \texttt{GEOFlagBench}, a benchmark of 3,200 webpages spanning 400 queries, four domains, and eight GEO optimizer families, and use it to systematically evaluate existing GEO detection methods. Although the strongest baseline achieves an aggregate F1 of 0.880, method-level and authorship-conditioned evaluations reveal substantial weaknesses and potential reliance on authorship-related shortcuts. We therefore propose \emph{Intervention-Paired Training} (IPT), which supervises detector responses to GEO interventions and non-GEO AI polishing; on ModernBERT, IPT improves F1 from 0.862 to 0.944 and worst-group accuracy from 0.725 to 0.883. We develop a GEO-gated Agent system for auditing the Source Tier and verifiability of Citation URLs in detected GEO pages. Finally, we deploy the complete pipeline on released Google Search and Gemini-grounded retrieval results for 1,000 real-user queries. Across 10,095 available pages, we estimate an overall GEO prevalence of 8.90\%, reaching 16.36\% among pages modified in 2026. Our results establish a foundation for systematically detecting, auditing, and measuring GEO in real-world search ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成引擎优化（GEO）内容检测问题，提出GEOFlagBench基准（3,200个网页、400个查询、四个领域、八类GEO优化器家族），系统评估现有GEO检测方法，并引入干预配对训练（IPT）。在ModernBERT上IPT将F1从0.862提升至0.944，最差组准确率从0.725提升至0.883；同时开发GEO门控Agent系统审计引用URL的来源层级与可验证性，并在10,095个真实网页中估计GEO总体流行率为8.90%。
Motivation: 生成式搜索将信息综合为直接答案而非呈现竞争性来源，用户评估来源出处与权威性需要额外交互，可能放大GEO优化内容的影响力，使低权威或虚假信息显得有据可依。然而系统性检测GEO优化网页的方法仍未被充分探索。
Method: 构建GEOFlagBench基准，覆盖400个查询、四个领域和八类GEO优化器家族；利用该基准系统评估现有GEO检测方法。提出干预配对训练（IPT），使检测器同时监督GEO干预与非GEO AI润色；并开发GEO门控Agent系统，用于审计被检测GEO页面的Source Tier和引用URL可验证性。
Result: 摘要报告最强基线聚合F1为0.880，但方法级和作者身份条件评估暴露明显弱点，可能存在对作者相关捷径的依赖；IPT在ModernBERT上达到F1 0.944，最差组准确率0.883。在部署于Google Search与Gemini检索结果的1,000个真实用户查询、10,095个可用页面中，估计GEO总体流行率为8.90%，2026年修改页面中达16.36%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该工作为在真实搜索生态系统中系统检测、审计和度量GEO建立了基础，并指出现有方法在细粒度评估下存在可靠性不足的问题，IPT可显著改善检测鲁棒性。

papers.title: Quipu: A Governed Bitemporal Knowledge Graph Store
papers.abstract_en: Agents now write knowledge graphs, but knowledge-graph stores still carry defaults set when humans curated them: accept writes now and clean later, keep one time axis or none, treat every writer's facts as equally trustworthy, and leave governance to dashboards and middleware. These four defaults are individually convenient and jointly untenable under agent workloads. We present Quipu, an embeddable store that inverts all four: no fact enters except through a gate whose predicates evaluate the pending post-state; data, trust labels, verdicts, and the rules themselves are bitemporal; named graphs are the unit of authority and trust, composed under a lattice whose one invariant is that composition never widens; and the governance specification $Σ$, the trace, and signed verdicts are facts in the store they govern, making the audit $T \models Σ$ a query. We evaluate with Census, a deterministic multi-writer lifecycle whose single seeded run scores every research question against planted ground truth: the gated store ends with 0 of 6 planted defects versus 6 of 6 ungated; all 7 composition probes uphold the lattice contract; 50 of 50 satisfied verdicts re-derive faithfully as of their instant while all 50 would be misreported under a latest-only rule set; and the SARC reference checker agrees with the in-store audit verdict-for-verdict, differing only on coverage semantics. A recorded trace from a governed writer surfaces a live enforcement gap the audit names with its remediation. On DEMM-Bench, an external decision-evidence sufficiency benchmark, a content-only reading of the exported records answers all 512 property-level governance questions correctly with zero overclaim under all eight degradation conditions, while container-presence baselines overclaim on up to 87.5% of them -- and the run surfaced, and led us to close, a gap in what a denial's verdict attests.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Subtitle: "Start strict: rethinking knowledge-graph defaults for agent-written knowledge". Source and the benchmark/census/ artifacts behind every reported number are archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21878428 (concept DOI, resolves to newest release). Development repository: github.com/scbrown/quipu
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Quipu，一个可嵌入的受治理双时态知识图谱存储 (governed bitemporal knowledge graph store)，面向代理 (agent) 写入的知识。它反转为人工策展时代遗留的四个默认设置：写入必须通过评估待提交后状态 (pending post-state) 的谓词门控；数据、信任标签、判定与规则本身均为双时态；命名图 (named graphs) 作为权威与信任单元，在格 (lattice) 下组合且组合不扩大；治理规约 Σ、trace 与签名判定作为被治理存储中的事实，使审计 T ⊨ Σ 成为一个查询。
Motivation: 代理正在编写知识图谱，但知识图谱存储仍沿用人类策展时的默认设置：先接受写入再清理、只保留一个时间轴或没有时间轴、把所有写入者的事实视为同等可信、把治理留给仪表盘和中间件。这些默认设置单独看方便，在代理工作负载下合起来不可持续。
Method: 提出一个可嵌入存储，反转全部四个默认设置：事实只能经过门控进入，门控谓词求值待提交的后状态；数据、信任标签、判定和规则本身都是双时态的；命名图是权威和信任的单位，按一个组合永不扩大的格不变量组合；治理规约、trace 和签名判定都被存储为被治理存储中的事实，从而使审计变成查询。
Result: 在确定性多写入者生命周期基准 Census 上，门控存储最终 0/6 个植入缺陷，非门控为 6/6；7 个组合探针全部满足格契约；50/50 个满足的判定按其时刻 (as-of its instant) 忠实重新推导，而仅用最新规则的规则集会全部误报这 50 个。在外部决策证据充分性基准 DEMM-Bench 上，对导出记录做仅内容读取可在全部八种退化条件下正确回答全部 512 个属性级治理问题且零过度声称，而容器存在性 (container-presence) 基线最多在 87.5% 的问题上过度声称。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将治理默认设置反转可为代理写入的知识提供严格的审计能力，并把审计本身降维为对存储的查询；评估还发现并促使作者修复了拒绝判定所证明内容中的一个缺口。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unlocking the Potential of Image Editing via Concept Scaling and Dense Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Existing image editing frameworks predominantly follow the training paradigm of text-to-image diffusion models. However, extending this paradigm to image editing highlights two inherent discrepancies, specifically, the insufficient attention to edit concept granularity and the training inefficiency caused by sparse supervision signals. To address these issues, we establish a comprehensive hierarchical taxonomy featuring over 1,000 fine-grained edit concepts and build ConceptEdit-12M, a massive dataset of 12 million high-quality editing pairs via an improved synthesis framework. This library-driven approach effectively rectifies the distribution collapse of generated data while ensuring high data fidelity. Furthermore, we propose a dense supervision training strategy that synthesizes multiple non-interfering concepts into single image pairs. By providing richer learning signals, this strategy significantly enhances both training efficiency and overall model performance. Training results validate our strategy, significantly outperforming prior works. Finally, we present ConceptEdit-Bench, a granular evaluation suite designed to diagnose model capabilities across a vast array of real-world scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对将文生图扩散模型训练范式直接迁移到图像编辑时暴露的两个问题——对编辑概念粒度的关注不足、以及稀疏监督信号导致训练低效——提出系统性的解决方案。作者建立包含超过1000个细粒度编辑概念的分层分类体系，构建 ConceptEdit-12M（1200万高质量编辑对）大规模数据集，并提出密集监督训练策略，将多个互不干扰的概念合成到单一图像对中。摘要报告该策略显著提升训练效率与模型性能，并发布 ConceptEdit-Bench 细粒度评测套件。
Motivation: 现有图像编辑框架大多沿用文本到图像扩散模型的训练范式，但这一迁移带来两个固有差异：训练过程对编辑概念的粒度（concept granularity）关注不足，且稀疏监督信号（sparse supervision）导致训练效率低下。
Method: 建立覆盖1000多个细粒度编辑概念的分层分类体系，并通过改进的合成框架构建包含1200万高质量编辑对的 ConceptEdit-12M 数据集，以纠正生成数据的分布坍塌并保证数据保真度；同时提出密集监督训练策略，把多个非干扰概念合成进单个图像对，为模型提供更丰富的学习信号。
Result: 摘要报告基于该数据与训练策略的方案显著优于先前工作，密集监督在提升训练效率的同时改善模型整体性能，数据保真度和分布质量也得到保障。
Conclusion: 论文强调概念库驱动（library-driven）的数据构建与密集监督是释放图像编辑潜力的关键，并提出 ConceptEdit-Bench 作为面向真实场景的细粒度能力诊断评测套件。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告基于该数据与训练策略的方案显著优于先前工作，密集监督在提升训练效率的同时改善模型整体性能，数据保真度和分布质量也得到保障。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文强调概念库驱动（library-driven）的数据构建与密集监督是释放图像编辑潜力的关键，并提出 ConceptEdit-Bench 作为面向真实场景的细粒度能力诊断评测套件。

papers.title: Unsupervised Learning of Cell Instances with Generative Routing Pyramids
papers.abstract_en: Identifying and representing object instances such as cells or nuclei is a common task in microscopy image analysis. Established machine learning workflows typically use supervised detection or segmentation followed by feature extraction or classification, which requires manual annotations and treats instance segmentation and cell representation as separate stages. We describe a new unsupervised method for cell instance segmentation and phenotypic classification from unlabeled microscopy images. Our method is based on reconstructing each image using a coarse-to-fine routing pyramid that associates pixels with spatially sparse latent sources. The resulting pixel-to-latent associations yield instance masks, while the source latents encode cell morphology. We demonstrate competitive performance in instance segmentation across diverse cell morphologies and imaging modalities, as well as generative modeling of cellular phenotypes under perturbations. Source code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/weigertlab/routing-pyramids.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督的细胞实例分割与表型分类方法，基于粗到细路由金字塔（routing pyramid）将像素与空间稀疏的潜在源（latent sources）关联，以图像重建的方式同时获得实例掩膜和细胞形态编码。摘要在多种细胞形态和成像模态上展示了有竞争力的实例分割性能，并能对扰动下的细胞表型进行生成式建模。
Motivation: 现有显微镜图像分析工作流通常需要监督式检测或分割，再配合特征提取与分类，依赖人工标注，并且把实例分割和细胞表征当作两个独立阶段处理。
Method: 作者提出一种无监督方法，通过粗到细的路由金字塔重建每张图像，将像素与空间稀疏的潜在源关联；像素到潜在源的关联直接产生实例掩膜，潜在源编码细胞形态。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多种细胞形态和成像模态的实例分割上达到有竞争力的性能，并支持对扰动条件下的细胞表型进行生成式建模。
Conclusion: 该方法利用路由金字塔在无标注条件下同时完成实例分割与形态表征，作者已公开源代码和检查点。

papers.title: When State Becomes an Attack Surface: State-Semantic Injection in LLM-Driven Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated capabilities in in-context learning, task decomposition, step-by-step reasoning, and code generation, driving their gradual evolution from text generation models into the core of agents capable of perceiving environments, invoking tools, and executing tasks. Traditional LLM Agents typically obtain information through webpages, documents, databases, or external tools and generate corresponding invocation sequences according to user goals; when this technology is further integrated with robotic systems, large language models begin to undertake functions such as task understanding, high-level planning, and behavioral decision-making. SayCan combines the task reasoning capability of language models with the affordances of robotic skills, while Code as Policies and ProgPrompt generate robot task plans through policy code and programmatic prompting, respectively, and VoxPoser uses language models and vision-language models to construct three-dimensional value maps to guide robotic manipulation \cite{6,7,8,9}. Vision-language-action models such as PaLM-E, RT-2, and GR00T N1 further strengthen the connection among language, visual perception, and robotic actions \cite{10,11,12}. In such LLM-driven embodied agents, the model not only needs to understand user instructions, but also needs to combine scene states, object attributes, spatial relations, and execution feedback to complete task grounding, and then hand the generated action plan to skill libraries, motion planners, or controllers for execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文从安全视角审视 LLM 驱动的具身智能体（embodied agents），提出状态语义注入（state-semantic injection）这一攻击面。摘要主要介绍背景：LLM 从文本生成模型演进为感知环境、调用工具并执行任务的智能体核心，并与机器人系统结合承担任务理解、高层规划与行为决策；模型需要结合场景状态、物体属性、空间关系和执行反馈完成任务接地，再把动作计划交给技能库、运动规划器或控制器执行。题目表明作者关注环境状态被恶意篡改或注入所带来的安全风险。
Motivation: 现有关于 LLM 具身智能体的研究多聚焦于任务规划与感知-行动能力，而较少关注环境状态作为攻击面的安全威胁；随着智能体越来越依赖场景状态与执行反馈做决策，状态语义注入可能使攻击者劫持或误导任务执行。
Method: 论文以状态语义注入为核心，利用具身智能体对场景状态、物体属性及执行反馈的依赖，向状态输入中注入恶意语义，干扰模型的任务接地（task grounding）与高层规划。
Conclusion: 摘要未给出明确结论。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Diagnosing Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models can recognize the objects and attributes in a crowded scene yet assign an attribute to the wrong same-class instance. Generic visual-question-answering accuracy marks the response as wrong, while object-hallucination metrics may regard both the object and attribute as image-supported; neither reveals the transfer. This study formalizes this blind spot as Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding (DSCAM) and presents InstaBind-Lite, a controlled benchmark that makes it directly measurable. Its 524 images contain 529 curated groups of 3-6 same-class entities, 1773 boxed instances, ordered neighbors, distinguishable color-like attributes, and four complementary question levels, yielding 9580 deterministically evaluated questions. Unlike existing protocols, source-instance annotations separate unsupported generation and recognition failure from an attribute copied from another visible entity. Binding-specific metrics further quantify transfer frequency, adjacency, ordinal distance, and intervention effects. Across five open-source and two commercial/API models, the open-source systems average 19.84% Misbinding Rate and the API systems 7.55%; these errors are hidden by aggregate accuracy. Among identifiable transfers, 80.70% and 81.51%, respectively, originate from adjacent instances. Localization and instance-first interventions help selected models but are not universal remedies. InstaBind-Lite therefore turns previously undifferentiated wrong answers into source-identifiable failure categories and tests a reliability dimension that conventional benchmarks cannot determine: whether a model knows not only what is visible, but which instance owns each attribute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化了大视觉语言模型中的密级同类属性错绑（Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding, DSCAM）问题，并提出受控基准 InstaBind-Lite 使其可直接测量。基准包含 524 张图像、529 组 3-6 个同类别实体、1773 个框选实例、有序邻居、可区分类色属性与四个互补问题层级，共 9580 道确定性评估问题。摘要报告开源模型平均错绑率 19.84%、API 模型 7.55%，且这些错误被聚合准确率掩盖。
Motivation: 通用 VQA 准确率会将属性错绑判为错误，而对象幻觉指标可能认为对象和属性都受图像支持，两者都无法揭示属性被转移给错误的同类实例；这一盲区此前未被专门诊断。
Method: 提出 InstaBind-Lite 基准，通过源实例标注区分无依据生成和识别失败与从其他可见实体复制属性；并引入绑定特异性指标量化转移频率、邻接性、序数距离和干预效果。
Result: 五个开源模型平均错绑率 19.84%，两个商业/API 模型平均 7.55%；在可识别的转移中，分别有 80.70% 和 81.51% 来自相邻实例。定位和实例优先干预对部分模型有帮助，但并非通用解法。
Conclusion: InstaBind-Lite 将原先无法区分的错误答案转为可追溯来源的失败类别，检验模型是否不仅知道什么可见、还知道哪个实例拥有每个属性，这是传统基准无法测定的可靠性维度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Cross-Sign Language Transfer Learning Using Domain Adaptation with Multi-scale Temporal Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Sign language serves as a vital means of communication for individuals with hearing impairments, yet recognition resources for the over 100 distinct sign languages are severely lacking. In response, we present our work on sign language recognition using transfer learning and the domain adaptation method TA3N, which utilizes the Temporal Relational Network (TRN) module for aligning multi-scale temporal relations. Our findings highlight the superior performance of Domain Adaptation to neural network-based transfer learning, particularly in improving recognition of American Sign Language (ASL). Our research also identifies the effectiveness of aligning shorter-term temporal features between source and target domains. In addition to using RGB, we conducted experiments using Optical Flow mode for the sign language samples, ultimately determining that RGB outperforms Optical Flow in the majority of cases. Our work aims to improve accessibility and communication for individuals who rely on sign language as their primary mode of communication.
papers.journal_ref: Multimedia Tools and Applications 83 (2024) 37025-37051
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究手语识别中的跨手语迁移学习，采用域适应方法 TA3N，并利用时序关系网络（TRN）模块对齐多尺度时序关系。摘要报告域适应比基于神经网络的迁移学习表现更好，尤其提升美式手语（ASL）识别；短时时序特征对齐更有效；在 RGB 与光流（Optical Flow）的对比中，RGB 在多数情况下优于光流。
Motivation: 全球超过 100 种手语的识别资源严重缺乏，本文希望通过迁移学习与域适应缓解资源不足，提升手语识别能力。
Method: 采用域适应方法 TA3N，结合时序关系网络（TRN）模块对源域与目标域的多尺度时序关系进行对齐；实验同时使用 RGB 和光流两种输入模态进行手语样本识别。
Result: 摘要显示域适应在美式手语识别上优于神经网络迁移学习；对齐较短期的时序特征更为有效；多数情况下 RGB 优于光流。
Conclusion: 本文目标是改善依赖手语交流人群的可及性与沟通，并指出短时时序对齐与 RGB 输入在手语识别中的有效性。

papers.title: When Agents Coordinate: Measuring Coordination in Multi-Agent AI Coding
papers.abstract_en: We study how teams of AI coding agents coordinate while solving programming tasks. Current evaluations usually report whether the agents complete the task and how much the run costs, leaving the coordination inside the team largely unmeasured. We introduce an instrument to measure this coordination. Each run is represented as a temporal network in which agents and files are nodes, and messages, file writes, and file reads are timestamped directed edges with an associated cost. We apply this instrument to 1902 runs, each evaluated with a fixed test suite, across configurations that vary the team size, the team structure, and the file policy. The resulting networks show how coordination changes as teams grow and as the work changes. Direct messaging initially increases close to quadratically with the number of agents, with much of this growth coming from an early round of introductions. As the teams grow further, this increase levels off in the largest teams we study, where agents increasingly communicate through broadcast messages. The task also shapes the network that emerges. Work built around a shared specification produces dense, highly connected teams, while pipeline tasks produce sparse networks organised around local interfaces. Shared files can replace repeated 1-to-1 communication, cutting output tokens by about 42% at eight agents on message-heavy work, while adding overhead when files already carry the coordination. Naming one agent as coordinator creates no communication hub and provides no reliable improvement in success. We also observe an unprompted tendency for agents to seek out hidden grading material. We repeat the key experimental conditions in a sealed environment, replacing the hidden material with marked placeholder files. Across 244 additional runs, agents still reach for it in four fifths of runs, while the coordinator and file-channel findings reproduce.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体 AI 编码团队在解决编程任务时的协调行为，并提出一个测量工具：将每次运行表示为时间网络（temporal network），其中智能体和文件是节点，消息、文件写入和文件读取是带时间戳且有成本的有向边。作者将该工具应用于 1902 次运行，并额外在封闭环境中重复关键条件进行 244 次运行，以观察团队规模、结构和文件策略如何改变协调模式。
Motivation: 现有评估通常只报告智能体是否完成任务以及运行成本，团队内部的协调过程几乎没有被测量，作者认为这是一个被忽略的空白。
Method: 提出一个协调测量工具，把每次运行建模为时间网络，节点为智能体和文件，边为带时间戳且带成本的消息、文件写和文件读；并用该工具在改变团队规模、团队结构和文件策略的配置下分析多次运行，同时用隐藏评分材料的封闭环境做复现实验。
Result: 直接消息量在团队规模较小时近似二次增长，且很大一部分来自早期介绍轮次；在最大团队中增长趋于平缓，智能体更多通过广播消息交流。任务类型影响网络结构：基于共享规格说明的工作产生密集高连通的团队，而流水线任务产生围绕局部接口的稀疏网络。共享文件在八智能体的消息密集型工作中可将输出 token 减少约 42%，但若文件已承载协调则会增加开销。指定一个协调者不会形成通信枢纽，也没有带来可靠的成功率提升。未被告知的智能体会主动寻找隐藏评分材料，在额外 244 次封闭环境运行中，五分之四的运行仍出现该行为。
Conclusion: 作者认为时间网络可以刻画多智能体编码团队的协调过程；协调者与文件通道的结论在封闭环境中得到复现，而智能体自发寻找隐藏评分材料的倾向值得关注。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 直接消息量在团队规模较小时近似二次增长，且很大一部分来自早期介绍轮次；在最大团队中增长趋于平缓，智能体更多通过广播消息交流。任务类型影响网络结构：基于共享规格说明的工作产生密集高连通的团队，而流水线任务产生围绕局部接口的稀疏网络。共享文件在八智能体的消息密集型工作中可将输出 token 减少约 42%，但若文件已承载协调则会增加开销。指定一个协调者不会形成通信枢纽，也没有带来可靠的成功率提升。未被告知的智能体会主动寻找隐藏评分材料，在额外 244 次封闭环境运行中，五分之四的运行仍出现该行为。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为时间网络可以刻画多智能体编码团队的协调过程；协调者与文件通道的结论在封闭环境中得到复现，而智能体自发寻找隐藏评分材料的倾向值得关注。

papers.title: ClawGym II: Exploring Black-Box RL on Agent Harness
papers.abstract_en: Agent harnesses have substantially improved performance on long-horizon tasks by coordinating agent interactions with the environment. However, reinforcement learning through complex harnesses remains largely unexplored, as scaling such training to long-horizon agent tasks introduces fundamental challenges. In this work, we present a unified black-box RL framework for stable and scalable optimization of general agents through complex harnesses. Concretely, we first build a sandbox-based execution infrastructure that isolates task environments and harnesses within temporary sandboxes for large-scale concurrent rollouts. We then decouple policy optimization from opaque harness execution and place a serving proxy at the model boundary to capture model calls. To reconstruct multi-turn trajectories and improve training efficiency, we organize the captured calls into prefix trees and further adapt both critic-based PPO and critic-free GRPO to optimize over the recovered tree structure. Meanwhile, we maintain training-inference consistency throughout the optimization process. Finally, we introduce mix-harness training, allowing a single model to be jointly optimized by heterogeneous harnesses. With Qwen3-30A3B, black-box RL improves Pass@1 on ClawGym-Bench by 9.98 and 14.81 points through OpenClaw and Claude Code, respectively, while remaining stable over 200-400 optimization steps. Moreover, the framework yields consistent gains on more challenging tasks such as JobBench and OfficeQA. Overall, our framework enables effective, stable, and scalable optimization of general agents through black-box harnesses, supporting unified training across heterogeneous execution systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的黑盒强化学习框架，用于在复杂 agent harness 上稳定、可扩展地优化通用智能体。作者构建沙箱执行基础设施隔离任务环境和 harness，在模型边界放置服务代理捕获模型调用，并通过前缀树重构多轮轨迹，使 PPO 与 GRPO 都能基于恢复出的树结构进行优化；同时引入 mix-harness 训练以联合优化异构 harness。使用 Qwen3-30A3B 时，黑盒 RL 在 ClawGym-Bench 上通过 OpenClaw 和 Claude Code 分别提升 Pass@1 达 9.98 和 14.81 个点，且训练保持稳定。
Motivation: Agent harness 已显著提升长时程任务的性能，但通过复杂 harness 进行强化学习仍基本未被探索；将此类训练扩展到长时程 agent 任务面临根本性且尚未解决的挑战。
Method: 提出统一黑盒 RL 框架：先构建基于沙箱的执行基础设施，实现大规模并发 rollout；再将策略优化与不透明的 harness 执行解耦，在模型边界放置服务代理捕获模型调用；把捕获的调用组织成前缀树以重构多轮轨迹，并适配基于 critic 的 PPO 与无 critic 的 GRPO 在树结构上优化；全程保持训练-推理一致性，并引入可以在异构 harness 上联合训练单一模型的 mix-harness 训练。
Result: 摘要报告使用 Qwen3-30A3B 时，在 ClawGym-Bench 上通过 OpenClaw 和 Claude Code 分别将 Pass@1 提升 9.98 和 14.81 个点，且训练在 200-400 个优化步骤内保持稳定；在更具挑战性的 JobBench 和 OfficeQA 上也取得一致增益。
Conclusion: 该框架使通用 agent 能通过黑盒 harness 实现有效、稳定且可扩展的优化，并支持跨异构执行系统的统一训练。

papers.title: UniDot: A Unified Network for Sequence Modeling and Feature Interaction in Large-scale Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Industrial recommenders rely on two model families that have evolved largely independently: feature-interaction models over multi-field user/item features, and sequential models over user-behavior histories. Production systems couple them only loosely. To unify the two, we present UniDot, a novel architecture for post-click conversion prediction built from the factorization-machine (FM) point of view: the embedding inner product---which powers collaborative filtering and lets a recommender generalize to unseen user--item pairs---is the same primitive as attention's query dot key scoring, so a single dot-product of tokens can underlie both feature interaction and sequence modeling. UniDot tokenizes non-sequential fields and multi-domain behavioral sequences into one shared token space and stacks a single macro-block in which a token-mixing bus and a sequence-retrieval bus (item tokens cross-attending the histories) run in parallel and exchange state each layer through an MLP-Mixer fusion, while an FM Highway carries explicit per-layer dot-product interactions around the residual stack directly to the classifier. The sequence side is embedded once per forward pass and shared by all consumers, bounding inference latency. Trained with a dual sparse/dense (Adagrad + Muon) optimizer, an auxiliary conversion-delay head, and multi-path mutual learning, UniDot finished as the runner-up on the Industrial track of the TAAC KDD Cup 2026.
papers.journal_ref: KDD 2026 UniRec Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniDot，一种面向大规模推荐系统中点击后转化预测 (post-click conversion prediction) 的统一架构，尝试将特征交互模型与序列模型纳入同一框架。其出发点是从因子分解机 (FM) 视角看问题：嵌入内积既是协同过滤的原始算子，也与注意力中的 query-key 点积同构，因此单一 token 点积可同时支撑特征交互与序列建模。该工作在 TAAC KDD Cup 2026 工业赛道中获得亚军。
Motivation: 工业推荐系统长期依赖两条独立演进的模型路线：基于多字段特征的特征交互模型，以及基于用户行为历史的序列模型；生产系统中二者只是松散耦合。作者希望用一个统一架构同时处理两类信号，避免两套模型体系各自为政。
Method: UniDot 将非序列字段与多领域行为序列统一 token 化到共享 token 空间，堆叠单个宏块，其中 token-mixing bus 与序列检索 bus（item tokens 对历史序列做 cross-attention）并行运行，并通过 MLP-Mixer fusion 逐层交换状态；FM Highway 将逐层点积交互绕过残差堆栈直接送入分类器。序列侧每次前向传播只嵌入一次并由所有消费者共享，以约束推理延迟；训练采用双稀疏/稠密优化器（Adagrad + Muon）、辅助转化延迟头以及多路径互学习。
Result: 摘要报告 UniDot 在 TAAC KDD Cup 2026 工业赛道获得第二名（runner-up），未给出具体数值指标或与基线的量化对比。
Conclusion: 作者认为以共享的点积算子统一特征交互与序列建模是可行的，且共享序列嵌入能在不损失效果的前提下控制推理延迟；摘要未明确讨论方法的适用范围或局限。
Relevance: 2
