papers.title: Historical Backtesting for Scientific Question Discovery: A Protocol and Astronomy Pilot
papers.abstract_en: Systems that generate scientific research questions are evaluated today by expert scores, LLM-as-judge ratings, or curated case studies -- all subjective, none falsifiable. We formalize historical backtesting as an alternative: a system generates questions from a corpus frozen at a historical cutoff, the questions are frozen before any access to later literature, and a temporally isolated future corpus then determines whether each question was subsequently answered, partially addressed, independently posed, or ignored, and whether its underlying premise was supported or refuted. The protocol is model-agnostic: any system that emits frozen questions can be scored. We release reproducible astronomy instances with temporally isolated corpora, frozen questions, auditable labels, four reference baselines, and a submission interface. Two findings result. First, evidence-structure-first generation outperforms LLM-only prompting: across a generator decomposition crossed with a four-cutoff stress test (2010-2024, 798 judged questions) whose last window postdates model training, LLM-only generation shows memorized relevance without specific foresight, while a generator using no model weights at all finds questions whose premises the future refutes in every era. Second, a seven-rater agreement study (two blinded human annotators, five judge models, 90 items) indicts the outcome taxonomy rather than the judge: two careful humans agree at kappa = 0.17, every judge model agrees with the professional annotator as well or better (0.17-0.26), and frontier models agree with one another at 0.60 -- certifying an LLM judge by model-model agreement would have overstated its reliability threefold. A prospective instance -- 200 questions frozen 2026-08-17, scored 2027-2030 -- is released so the central claims become contamination-free tests that time itself will grade.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 10 tables. Benchmark, code, frozen instances, and the prospective 2026 submission: https://github.com/nonameisready/scientific-question-discovery-benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可证伪的科研问题生成评估协议——历史回测 (historical backtesting)：系统从设定历史截止点的冻结语料中生成问题，在接触后续文献前冻结问题，再由时间上隔离的未来语料判定问题是否被回答、部分回应、独立提出或被忽略，以及其前提是否被支持或反驳。作者发布了可复现的天文学实例（含时间隔离语料、冻结问题、可审计标注、四个参考基线与提交接口），并通过生成器分解与四截止点压力测试（2010-2024 年，798 个已判定问题）以及七评分者一致性研究（两位盲法人类标注者、五个评判模型、90 个条目）得出两个主要发现。
Motivation: 当前科研问题生成系统的评估依赖专家评分、LLM 作为裁判或精选案例研究，这些方法都带有主观性且不可证伪。作者希望建立一种模型无关、可审计、可被未来文献检验的客观评估方式。
Method: 形式化历史回测协议：系统从历史截止点冻结的语料生成问题，问题在接触后续文献前冻结，再用时间隔离的未来语料判定每个问题的结局并验证其前提。协议对任何能输出冻结问题的系统通用，并配套发布基准、代码、冻结实例和提交接口。
Result: 两项发现：第一，证据结构优先 (evidence-structure-first) 的生成器优于纯 LLM 提示——在最后一个窗口晚于模型训练时间的四截止点测试中，纯 LLM 生成表现出记忆性相关而无特定预见性，而不使用任何模型权重的生成器在每个时代都能找到未来会反驳其前提的问题。第二，七评分者一致性研究中，两位细心的人类标注者 kappa=0.17，每个评判模型与专业标注者的一致性为 0.17-0.26，前沿模型彼此间一致性达 0.60，说明用模型间一致性认证 LLM 裁判会把可靠性夸大近三倍，问题出在结局分类法而非裁判本身。
Conclusion: 作者认为该协议使核心主张成为无污染测试，并发布了前瞻性实例——200 个于 2026-08-17 冻结的问题，计划在 2027-2030 年评分，由时间本身来检验。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Neurosymbolic Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: Language and vision-language models generate plausible embodied plans but do not guarantee executability, as their outputs can violate environment dynamics or act on incorrectly grounded entities. We present a neurosymbolic agent that factors long-horizon household tasks into task-directed visual exploration and constrained symbolic planning. In the first phase, a vision-language model and exploration harness acquire goal-relevant predicates and instance bindings from egocentric observations and grounded interactions, producing a symbolic initial state. In the second, a PDDL transition model restricts decoding to tokens that extend applicable actions. Monte Carlo tree search then evaluates executable continuations using a domain-independent planning heuristic. The resulting plans are executable by construction under the transition model, with transfer to the environment conditioned on correct visual grounding. On VirtualHome and ALFWorld, open 4B-27B models exceed 90% success in both environments, and our smallest agent substantially outperforms a 27B direct visual policy in each. Constraints and search prove complementary rather than interchangeable: in ALFWorld either alone solves under a third of tasks, whereas their combination solves over 95%. The method also uses several times fewer generated tokens than extended thinking and far fewer model-visible images than direct interaction, and residual failures localize to state acquisition rather than plan generation without any specialized training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个神经符号体现智能体（neurosymbolic embodied agent），将长时程家务任务分解为任务导向的视觉探索和约束符号规划两个阶段。第一阶段用视觉语言模型与探索装置从自我中心观察和接地交互中获取目标相关谓词与实例绑定，生成符号初始状态；第二阶段用PDDL转移模型限制解码token只扩展可应用动作，并用蒙特卡洛树搜索结合领域无关规划启发式评估可执行延续。摘要报告在VirtualHome和ALFWorld上，开放4B-27B模型在两个环境的成功率均超过90%，最小智能体明显优于27B直接视觉策略，且约束与搜索互补。
Motivation: 语言和视觉语言模型生成看似合理的体现规划（embodied plans），但不保证可执行性，其输出可能违反环境动态，或作用于错误接地（grounded）的实体。这会影响需要可靠执行的长时程家庭任务。
Method: 提出两阶段神经符号智能体：第一阶段由视觉语言模型和探索装置从自我中心观察与交互中构造符号初始状态；第二阶段用PDDL转移模型约束解码token，只允许扩展可应用动作，再用蒙特卡洛树搜索基于领域无关启发式评估可执行延续，从而在转移模型下保证计划可执行。
Result: 在VirtualHome和ALFWorld上，开放4B-27B模型在两个环境的成功率均超过90%，最小智能体在每个环境中都明显优于27B直接视觉策略。ALFWorld中单独使用约束或搜索只能解决不到三分之一的任务，而两者组合能解决超过95%的任务；方法还比扩展思考（extended thinking）少生成数倍token，比直接交互少使用大量模型可见图像，残差失败集中在状态获取而非计划生成，且无需专门训练。

papers.title: PixRestore: Unified Image Restoration via Pixel Diffusion Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Unified image restoration (UIR) aims to recover high-quality (HQ) content from low-quality (LQ) images with different degradations using a single model. Most recent methods adapt large pretrained text-to-image (T2I) latent diffusion models for their strong capacity and generative priors. However, the variational autoencoder (VAE) in latent T2I models may discard restoration-sensitive details, while the open-ended synthesis prior can introduce content-inconsistent artifacts. We present PixRestore, a VAE-free pixel-space Diffusion Transformer (DiT) for UIR, where the diffusion backbone is trained entirely from scratch, without relying on T2I pretraining. PixRestore performs flow matching directly on patchified pixels, preserving fine-grained details while keeping the token sequence tractable. To adapt to different degradations, PixRestore learns to predict the reliability of layer features using LQ--HQ DINO feature similarity. Features from more reliable layers are fused as dense conditioning, while less reliable layers receive stronger HQ-feature supervision to encourage degradation removal. We train PixRestore on a large-scale corpus of diverse scenes and degradations, and further finetune it into a one-step generator using DINO-based adversarial objectives for efficient inference. Experiments on public benchmarks and real-world test sets show that, with only about 50M parameters and single-step inference, PixRestore achieves the best overall fidelity, perceptual quality, and robustness to degradations among competing UIR models while being far more efficient. Larger PixRestore variants can further boost performance, demonstrating the scalability of our pixel-space design. Code and the curated benchmark can be found at https://github.com/csslc/PixRestore.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PixRestore，一种无 VAE 的像素空间扩散 Transformer (DiT)，用于统一图像恢复 (unified image restoration, UIR)。模型从零训练，不依赖文本到图像预训练，直接在 patch 化像素上执行 flow matching，并利用 LQ–HQ DINO 特征相似度预测各层特征可靠性，以融合可靠层的密集条件并强化不可靠层的特征监督。在约 50M 参数和单步推理下，PixRestore 在公共基准与真实测试集上取得最佳综合保真度、感知质量和退化鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有 UIR 方法多采用大规模预训练文本到图像 (T2I) 潜扩散模型，但潜空间的 VAE 会丢弃恢复敏感细节，且开放式的合成先验可能引入与内容不一致的伪影。作者旨在避开这两类问题，构建能保留细节且不依赖预训练先验的统一恢复模型。
Method: PixRestore 采用无 VAE 的像素空间 DiT，从零训练，直接在 patch 化像素上做 flow matching 以保留细粒度细节并控制 token 序列长度。模型通过 LQ–HQ DINO 特征相似度评估每层特征可靠性，将可靠层的特征融合为密集条件，而对不可靠层施加更强的 HQ 特征监督以促进退化去除。之后用基于 DINO 的对抗目标微调为单步生成器以支持高效推理。
Result: 在公共基准和真实世界测试集上，约 50M 参数且单步推理的 PixRestore 在保真度、感知质量和退化鲁棒性方面取得最佳综合表现，同时效率更高；更大的变体还能进一步提升性能，显示其可扩展性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调像素空间设计避免了潜空间信息丢失和开放先验引入的伪影，从零训练的 DiT 配合可靠性感知特征融合与监督能够在高效单步推理下达到领先的 UIR 性能，且模型规模可扩展。

papers.title: Steering the Flow: Inverting Face Recognition Models via Gradient-Guided Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) aim to reconstruct representative training samples of target identities from face recognition models, exposing critical security vulnerabilities. Existing methods typically rely on indirect guidance or highly stochastic guidance, making it difficult to stably optimize generation trajectories toward target facial images. In this paper, we propose Steering Flow Model Inversion (SFMI), a novel two-stage white-box model inversion method that reformulates inversion as a trajectory-steering task. Specifically, Step I, Learning a Generic Flow Matching Prior, pre-trains a generic unconditional Flow Matching model to encode the manifold of human faces as a robust prior. Step II, Attacking with Progressive Guidance Scheduler (PGS), injects time-dependent target-specific gradients during sampling. By backpropagating through the target model to obtain gradients from intermediate generated states, PGS progressively injects adaptive guidance signals into the vector field. This process effectively steers the current generative flow from random noise toward the high-density regions of the target class. Under an identity-disjoint cross-evaluation setting using the CelebA dataset, SFMI achieves an ACC of 0.9248, an FID of 22.61, and an LPIPS of 0.3874 on the ArcFace target. Extensive experiments on multiple target models demonstrate that SFMI achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance in attack success and visual fidelity under the evaluated white-box protocol.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Steering Flow Model Inversion (SFMI)，一种两阶段白盒模型反演方法，旨在从人脸识别模型重构目标身份的代表性训练样本。第一阶段预训练一个无条件 Flow Matching 模型作为人脸流形先验；第二阶段通过渐进式引导调度器 (PGS) 在采样过程中注入随时间变化的目标特定梯度，将生成流从随机噪声导向目标类别的高密度区域。在 CelebA 的身份不相交交叉评估下，针对 ArcFace 获得 ACC 0.9248、FID 22.61、LPIPS 0.3874，并在多个目标模型上取得有竞争力的白盒攻击性能。
Motivation: 现有模型反演攻击 (MIA) 通常依赖间接或高度随机的引导，难以稳定地优化生成轨迹以逼近目标人脸图像，从而限制了攻击成功率与生成质量。
Method: SFMI 将反演重构为轨迹引导任务，分两步进行：第一步学习通用 Flow Matching 先验，预训练无条件生成模型以编码人脸流形；第二步使用渐进式引导调度器 (PGS)，通过目标模型反向传播获取中间生成状态的梯度，并在采样时渐进注入自适应引导信号，从而定向控制生成过程。
Result: 在 CelebA 数据集、身份不相交的交叉评估协议下，SFMI 在 ArcFace 上达到 ACC 0.9248、FID 22.61、LPIPS 0.3874；在多个目标模型上的实验表明其攻击成功率和视觉保真度在白盒协议下达到有竞争力的 SOTA 水平。
Conclusion: 作者认为将模型反演视为轨迹引导任务，并引入依赖时间的梯度引导，可以稳定优化生成轨迹，从而同时改善攻击成功率与生成图像的视觉质量。

papers.title: Revisiting Classifier-Free Guidance Methods in Latent Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time quality-enhancement methods are an effective and widely adopted means of improving diffusion models without expensive retraining. We study a family of training-free techniques conceptually rooted in Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG), most of which were originally proposed on older U-Net diffusion models and validated using metrics that assess image quality in isolation, without accounting for compositional alignment or semantic correspondence between the generated image and its associated text prompt. We re-evaluate eight such methods on two open-weight rectified-flow transformers under a fixed per-model protocol and three compositional-alignment benchmarks. No method consistently improves on CFG across the measured criteria. APG obtains several nominal best scores, but the corresponding gains often remain within the estimated evaluation uncertainty. Attention-perturbation methods provide isolated gains on SD3.5 Medium and more frequent degradations on FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base, while CFG remains a competitive lower-cost baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新评估潜在扩散模型（latent diffusion models）中一类概念上源于无分类器引导（Classifier-Free Guidance, CFG）的训练自由推理增强方法。作者在两种开放权重 rectified-flow transformer 上、按固定逐模型协议和三个组合对齐基准测试了八种方法，发现没有方法能在各项标准上一致超过 CFG；APG 虽获得若干名义最佳分数，但增益常落在估计的评估不确定性范围内。
Motivation: 现有 CFG 类训练自由方法大多在较老 U-Net 扩散模型上提出，且评估指标只孤立衡量图像质量，未考虑生成图像与文本提示之间的组合对齐与语义对应，因此需要在新架构和组合对齐基准上重新检验。
Method: 采用固定逐模型协议（fixed per-model protocol），在两种开放权重 rectified-flow transformer 上重新评估八种源于 CFG 的训练自由推理增强方法，并使用三个组合对齐基准进行评测。
Result: 没有方法在测量的标准上一致优于 CFG；APG 得到若干名义最佳分数，但增益通常处于评估不确定性以内；注意力扰动方法在 SD3.5 Medium 上提供孤立增益，而在 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base 上更常出现退化。
Conclusion: 在作者设定的协议和基准下，CFG 仍然是具有竞争力的低成本基线，既有 CFG 类训练自由方法的优势需要谨慎看待。

papers.title: Calibration-Free Vehicle Speed Estimation: A Monocular Keypoint-Template Approach
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a calibration-free framework for reliably and effectively estimating vehicle speeds from monocular videos, without relying on roadway features, camera calibration, or roadway-feature-based reference objects. The proposed framework estimates vehicle speeds using a 36-keypoint vehicle template and a homography matrix updated at each frame. A YOLO-based keypoint detection module is trained on diverse datasets, and two estimation strategies are compared: keypoint-only tracking and warped optical flow with dense spatial aggregation. Speed is estimated by projecting displacements into metric space using the homography, with validation conducted on over 400 video clips from roadside and overhead datasets, covering speeds from 30 to 100 mph. The method achieves reliable speed estimation on the VS13 and BrnoCompSpeed datasets, with the warped optical flow method delivering MAEs of 15.0% and 9.7%, respectively, and 77.9% and 93.1% of estimates falling within +/-20% error. After applying a 10% trim to remove edge-of-frame outliers, performance improves to MAEs of 11.7% and 7.6%, with within-+/-20% accuracy increasing to 85.3% and 95.4%. This work addresses key limitations of existing vision-based approaches and enables low-cost and efficient speed enforcement using portable devices such as dashcams and smartphones, thereby supporting citizen-based enforcement programs for traffic safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个无需相机标定和道路特征的单目视频车速估计框架，使用 36 关键点车辆模板和每帧更新的单应矩阵 (homography) 将像素位移投影到米制空间。作者比较了仅关键点跟踪与基于扭曲光流 (warped optical flow) 加密集空间聚合两种策略，并在路边和俯视视角的 400 余段视频上验证，覆盖 30–100 mph 速度范围。在 VS13 和 BrnoCompSpeed 数据集上，扭曲光流方法的 MAE 分别为 15.0% 和 9.7%，经 10% 修剪后提升至 11.7% 和 7.6%。
Motivation: 现有基于视觉的车速估计通常依赖摄像机标定或道路特征参考物，限制了低成本便携设备（如行车记录仪和手机）在公民执法等场景中的应用。本文旨在消除这些依赖，提供一种校准免费 (calibration-free) 的可靠车速估计方案。
Method: 采用 YOLO 关键点检测模块识别 36 关键点车辆模板，并逐帧更新 homography 矩阵以将位移投影到公制空间；对比了 keypoint-only 跟踪与 warped optical flow 结合密集空间聚合两种速度估计策略。
Result: 在 VS13 和 BrnoCompSpeed 上，warped optical flow 方法的 MAE 为 15.0% 和 9.7%，误差落在 ±20% 内的比例分别为 77.9% 和 93.1%；应用 10% 修剪去除帧边缘离群值后，MAE 降至 11.7% 和 7.6%，±20% 内准确率升至 85.3% 和 95.4%。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作解决了现有视觉测速方法的主要局限，支持使用行车记录仪、智能手机等便携设备进行低成本高效测速，从而服务基于公民参与的超速执法和交通安全项目。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一个无需相机标定和道路特征的单目视频车速估计框架，使用 36 关键点车辆模板和每帧更新的单应矩阵 (homography) 将像素位移投影到米制空间。作者比较了仅关键点跟踪与基于扭曲光流 (warped optical flow) 加密集空间聚合两种策略，并在路边和俯视视角的 400 余段视频上验证，覆盖 30–100 mph 速度范围。在 VS13 和 BrnoCompSpeed 数据集上，扭曲光流方法的 MAE 分别为 15.0% 和 9.7%，经 10% 修剪后提升至 11.7% 和 7.6%。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有基于视觉的车速估计通常依赖摄像机标定或道路特征参考物，限制了低成本便携设备（如行车记录仪和手机）在公民执法等场景中的应用。本文旨在消除这些依赖，提供一种校准免费 (calibration-free) 的可靠车速估计方案。

papers.title: GRIP: Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises
papers.abstract_en: High-capacity encoders in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can let the query dominate the latent state, leaving retrieved evidence functionally irrelevant. We call this failure mode query dominance. To address it, we introduce \textbf{GRIP} (Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises), which imposes capacity asymmetry: the decoder keeps full-dimensional access to the query, while retrieved evidence passes through a severe stochastic bottleneck. This forces the evidence channel to encode only the residual information unavailable from the query. Across five reasoning benchmarks, GRIP outperforms strong iterative baselines, cuts a query--latent mutual-information diagnostic by roughly 30$\times$ (14.8 $\to$ 0.47 bits), and reduces hallucination by 73\%. Residual-alignment analysis further shows that the bottleneck output occupies subspaces less aligned with the query than baseline representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GRIP（Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises），针对 RAG 中高容量编码器使查询主导潜在状态、导致检索证据功能上无关的失败模式（query dominance）。其做法是引入容量不对称：解码器保留查询的全维度访问，而检索证据经过强随机瓶颈（stochastic bottleneck），迫使证据通道只编码查询无法提供的残余信息。在五个推理基准上 GRIP 优于强迭代基线，将查询-潜在互信息诊断从 14.8 降至 0.47 bits（约 30 倍），并减少 73% 的幻觉。残差对齐分析进一步表明瓶颈输出占据与查询对齐更少的子空间。
Motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）中高容量编码器可能让查询在潜在状态中占主导，使检索到的证据变得功能上无关；作者将该失败模式命名为 query dominance，并旨在通过限制证据通道的信息容量来保证证据真正参与推理。
Method: 提出 GRIP，核心是容量不对称架构：解码器保持对查询的全维度访问，而检索证据通过严重随机瓶颈（stochastic bottleneck），从而迫使证据编码仅保留查询中缺失的残余信息，减少查询对证据表示的支配。
Result: 在五个推理基准上超过强迭代基线；查询-潜在互信息诊断从 14.8 bits 降至 0.47 bits（约 30 倍）；幻觉减少 73%；残差对齐分析显示瓶颈输出与查询对齐程度低于基线表示。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，对检索前提施加信息限制可以缓解查询主导现象，提升证据利用率并显著降低幻觉；该结论基于推理基准、互信息诊断和残差对齐分析的结果。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Topological Attribution Distance (TAD): Revealing Segment-Level RAG Influence on LLM Output Geometry for Incident Log Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed in cybersecurity operations to assist cybersecurity analysts with rapid decision-making against emerging threats. However, there is a main criteria that must be met when using LLMs in cybersecurity, that is, trust in the generated outputs. As Agentic AI is integrated into operational systems, a robust evidence attribution and provenance tracking technique is essential to trace the origins of model generations. When autonomous agents make a decision (right or wrong), the ability to trace back through the decision chain is critical, as without it, teams cannot identify which segment of the data caused the model generation. Existing methods often struggle to distinguish among complex and highly similar evidence sources, such as cyber incident logs. This reveals a key gap: current approaches do not adequately capture the holistic geometric relationship between the retrieved evidence and the generated response for reliable evidence verification. To bridge this gap, we propose Topological Attribution Distance (TAD), inspired by Topology, to characterize and capture the global geometric shape of an output and its changes against its retrieved logs. In other words, if the embeddings of a specific source log drastically changes the geometry of the model's response in the embedding space, this suggests that such log is a critical source for the model's generated response. Therefore, TAD is powered by segment-level ablation attribution to investigate incident logs of an actual cyberattack. We demonstrate how TAD finds the most attributed logs on LLM outputs in an adaptive manner. This can provide an explainable and trustworthy tracing based on each LLM's hidden state to understand how geometrically different retrieved logs influence the model generation, and provide evidence verification in cybersecurity and Agentic-AI workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Topological Attribution Distance (TAD)，一种基于拓扑思想的段级归因方法，用于在 RAG 场景下定位对 LLM 输出影响最大的检索日志片段。作者将输出的嵌入几何形状及其相对检索日志的变化作为归因依据，并在真实网络攻击事件日志上进行验证，可为网络安全与 Agentic-AI 工作流提供可解释的证据溯源。
Motivation: LLM 在网络安全运营中日益普及，但输出必须可信且可溯源；现有证据归因方法难以区分高度相似的事件日志，无法刻画检索证据与生成响应之间的整体几何关系，导致证据验证存在缺口。
Method: 借鉴拓扑学，TAD 刻画模型输出在嵌入空间中的全局几何形状，以及该形状随各检索日志变化的情况；通过段级消融归因 (segment-level ablation attribution) 衡量每个日志片段对生成几何的影响，并基于 LLM 的隐藏状态进行自适应的关键日志定位。
Result: 摘要报告在真实网络攻击的事件日志上，TAD 能以自适应方式找出对 LLM 输出贡献最大的日志片段，提供可解释且可信的溯源与证据验证；未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为 TAD 利用隐藏状态几何关系能够揭示不同检索日志对模型生成的影响，适用于网络安全和 Agentic-AI 工作流中的证据验证与溯源追踪。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond $L_2$: Generalizing Abductive Latent Explanations to Diverse Prototype-Based Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Prototype-based neural networks are hailed as interpretable-by-design architectures. Recently, Abductive Latent Explanations (ALE) were introduced to provide formal, mathematically guaranteed explanations that leverage the intrinsic structure of these networks to ensure both predictive safety and human readability. ALEs rely on computing tight bounds on latent space distances to produce formal explanations. However, existing ALE formulations are rigidly confined to Euclidean latent spaces. This leaves a critical gap: modern state-of-the-art architectures increasingly rely on non-Euclidean representations - such as spherical metrics, Gaussian densities, and dimensional projections - rendering current formal explanation methods incompatible. In this work, we generalize the ALE framework to support non-Euclidean prototype architectures. For each geometric variant, we systematically derive how to either map the architecture to existing bounds or construct novel, architecture-specific bounding algorithms. We validate our theoretical constructions by computing subset-minimal formal explanations on fully trained image classifiers. By unifying these diverse models under a single formal framework, we enable the first rigorous, cross-architecture comparison of their interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把溯因潜在解释 (Abductive Latent Explanations, ALE) 从欧氏潜空间推广到非欧原型网络架构，覆盖球面度量、高斯密度和维度投影等表示。作者针对每种几何变体推导出映射到已有边界或构造新的架构特定边界算法，并在训练好的图像分类器上计算子集极小形式解释，从而实现跨架构可解释性的统一比较。
Motivation: 现有 ALE 只能处理欧氏潜空间，而现代原型网络越来越多使用非欧表示，如球面度量、高斯密度和维度投影，导致当前形式化解释方法与之不兼容。
Method: 系统性地推广 ALE 框架：对每种非欧几何变体，要么将架构映射到已有的距离边界计算，要么设计架构特定的紧致边界算法，以保留形式化解释的数学保证。
Result: 在完整训练的图像分类器上验证了理论构造，能够计算子集极小正式解释，并在统一框架下首次实现严格的跨架构可解释性对比。
Conclusion: 作者强调这一工作将多样化的非欧原型模型纳入同一形式化框架，使不同架构的可解释性可以相互比较；摘要未展开讨论具体局限性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: TRACE-Bench: Decomposing and Diagnosing Multi-Reference Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent advances in unified multimodal models for multi-reference image generation, existing benchmarks remain organized around predefined task types (e.g., "subject composition"), which are ill-suited to this combinatorial setting and lead to fragmented coverage, uncontrolled complexity, and little diagnostic value. Recognizing that diverse multi-reference tasks share a common set of atomic operations, we adopt a capability-oriented perspective and formalize four operators: Anchor ($f$), Disentangle ($g$), Apply ($\oplus$), and Compose ($C$). Any multi-reference prompt can then be represented as a compositional formula over these operators, whose structural complexity is quantified by the number of operator slots. Building on this formulation, we construct TRACE-Bench, comprising approximately 1,600 evaluation cases across slot counts 1--8, built from 631 formula templates and around 4,000 reference images spanning diverse artistic styles and real-world subjects. The formula structure directly drives an operator-aligned evaluation protocol for per-capability scoring and a diagnostic tree analysis for recursive failure localization. Evaluating 9 leading models reveals insights invisible to holistic scoring: the primary bottleneck lies in disentanglement ($g$) and attribute binding ($\oplus$) rather than scene-level composition ($C$), with even the best model scoring only 0.74 on attribute fidelity. Project page: https://amuseum-whr.github.io/TraceBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE-Bench，一个面向多参考图像生成 (multi-reference image generation) 的能力导向型基准。作者将多参考任务分解为 Anchor ($f$)、Disentangle ($g$)、Apply ($\oplus$)、Compose ($C$) 四种原子算子，并将任意提示表示为算子组合公式，复杂度由算子槽位数衡量。基准包含约1600个评测案例、631个公式模板和约4000张参考图像，并配套算子对齐的评分协议与诊断树分析；对9个模型的评估发现主要瓶颈在于解缠 ($g$) 和属性绑定 ($\oplus$)，最优模型的属性保真度仅0.74。
Motivation: 现有基准按预定义任务类型（如“主体组合”）组织，难以覆盖多参考图像生成这一组合性场景，导致覆盖碎片化、复杂度不可控且缺乏诊断价值。
Method: 采用能力导向视角，形式化 Anchor、Disentangle、Apply、Compose 四种原子算子，将任意多参考提示表示为组合公式，并基于该公式结构构建 TRACE-Bench，引入算子对齐的逐能力评分协议和用于递归定位失败的诊断树分析。
Result: 对9个领先模型的评估显示，主要瓶颈在解缠 ($g$) 和属性绑定 ($\oplus$)，而非场景级组合 ($C$)，即使最优模型在属性保真度上也仅得0.74。
Conclusion: 本文强调基于算子分解的诊断方法能揭示整体评分掩盖的细粒度缺陷，可用于定位多参考图像生成中的具体能力短板。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LAVA: Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation Framework for Large-Scale Financial Document Auditing
papers.abstract_en: Financial document validation in production, such as payroll auditing, tax compliance, and loan underwriting, demands exceptional accuracy, consistency, and reproducibility under strict enterprise constraints. In practice, documents arrive with heterogeneous layouts and formats, semantically rich and context-dependent content, and embedded business rules that current pipelines struggle to process reliably. We introduce LAVA (Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation), a modular, backbone-agnostic pipeline built on multimodal large language models, that integrates a four-stage design: document-rule retrieval, layout-preserving information extraction, auxiliary metadata enrichment, and auditable symbolic/arithmetic verification. LAVA supports robust rule grounding, fine-grained error attribution, and consistent, traceable end-to-end execution, capabilities essential for high-stakes deployment. Evaluated on a large real-world benchmark with diverse financial documents and dozens of expert-curated validation rules, LAVA outperforms baselines in hallucination control and edge-case handling while maintaining efficient token usage, demonstrating practicality for high-volume, time-critical validation.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of The 10th Workshop on Financial Technology and Natural Language Processing (FinNLP 2025), Association for Computational Linguistics, pp. 75-92, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LAVA（Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation），一个基于多模态大语言模型（multimodal LLM）的模块化、骨干无关（backbone-agnostic）流水线，用于大规模金融文档审核。其四阶段设计包括文档-规则检索、保持版面的信息抽取、辅助元数据增强和可审计的符号/算术验证。在大规模真实金融文档基准和数十条专家规则上，LAVA 在幻觉控制和边缘案例处理上优于基线，同时保持高效的 token 使用。
Motivation: 生产环境中的金融文档验证（如工资单审计、税务合规、贷款承销）要求极高的准确性、一致性和可复现性，但文档布局异构、内容语义丰富且依赖上下文，内嵌业务规则使现有流水线难以可靠处理。
Method: LAVA 是一个四阶段流水线：文档-规则检索（document-rule retrieval）、保持版面的信息抽取（layout-preserving information extraction）、辅助元数据增强（auxiliary metadata enrichment）和可审计的符号/算术验证（auditable symbolic/arithmetic verification），支持稳健的规则 grounding、细粒度错误归因和可追溯的端到端执行。
Result: 在一个包含多种金融文档和数十条专家制定验证规则的大规模真实世界基准上，LAVA 在幻觉控制和边缘案例处理方面优于基线，同时保持高效的 token 使用，适合高吞吐、时间敏感的验证场景。
Conclusion: 作者强调 LAVA 面向高风险的部署场景，具备稳健的规则 grounding、细粒度错误归因以及一致、可追溯的端到端执行能力，并以实际基准验证了其对大批量、时间紧迫的金融文档验证任务的实用性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: On the Principles Behind Neural Network Optimizers
papers.abstract_en: Reliable optimization is central to neural network (NN) training, yet Adam, the default optimizer for modern LLMs, rests on a fragile foundation. This thesis develops a principled grounding for Adam and motivates new designs. First, we revisit Adam's divergence--convergence debate and show the existence of a problem-dependent phase transition: with properly chosen, batch-size-dependent hyperparameters, Adam converges, whereas under small-$β_2$ regimes it can diverge. Second, we investigate why Adam substantially outperforms SGD on Transformers through Hessian structure. We find that the Hessian evolves toward a near-block-diagonal form along training, accompanied by strong block heterogeneity. We prove that this structure makes Adam's diagonal preconditioner effective. We further show that this special Hessian structure originates from consecutive multiplications of large matrix variables, and we provide a rigorous analysis based on random matrix theory. Finally, these insights motivate Adam-mini, a new optimizer that reduces Adam's memory footprint by 50\% while preserving its performance. Our results also have broader implications beyond Adam: they reveal new local structures in matrix-based nonconvex problems, and also help understand and improve recent NN optimizers, such as Muon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇围绕神经网络优化器原理的学位论文，重新审视 Adam 的收敛-发散争论，证明存在依赖问题与 batch size 的相变；通过 Hessian 结构解释 Adam 在 Transformer 上显著优于 SGD 的原因；并提出 Adam-mini，将 Adam 的内存占用降低 50% 且保持性能。
Motivation: Adam 是现代 LLM 的默认优化器，但其理论基础脆弱，存在发散-收敛争论，且为何在 Transformer 上大幅优于 SGD 缺乏原理性解释。
Method: 先分析 Adam 的相变行为，给出 batch-size 相关超参数下收敛与小 β2 下发散的条件；再研究 Hessian 沿训练趋于近块对角且伴随强块异质性的结构，证明该结构使 Adam 的对角预条件有效；进一步用随机矩阵理论说明该结构源于大矩阵变量的连续相乘；最后据此设计 Adam-mini。
Result: 摘要报告 Adam-mini 将 Adam 的内存占用减少 50% 且保持同等性能，并称 Hessian 结构的发现有助于理解和改进 Adam 之外的近期优化器如 Muon。
Conclusion: 作者强调研究意义超越 Adam 本身：揭示了矩阵型非凸问题中的新局部结构，并为理解和改进近期 NN 优化器提供帮助。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Binarized High-Efficiency RAW Video Restoration and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: RAW video restoration is fundamental to high-quality low-level perception and serves as the basis for a wide range of downstream vision applications. While binary neural networks (BNNs) enable efficient lightweight deployment for image enhancement, their deficiencies in modeling temporal coherence and activation value distributions hinder their effectiveness when applied to video scenarios. In this paper, we propose BinRVR, a binarized RAW video restoration framework that reduces computation and parameters by approximately 96% while incurring only about 4% performance degradation. Specifically, we present a Binarized Information Interaction Module (BIIM) to jointly model spatial and temporal information in an efficient and unified manner. Moreover, we develop a Distribution-Aware Binarized Convolution (DAB-Conv) that leverages the statistics of full-precision activations to mitigate quantization errors. The proposed framework further supports multi-bit quantization, enabling flexible accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across different hardware constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our BinRVR achieves competitive performance compared with state-of-the-art binarized methods on RAW video restoration tasks, including low-light enhancement, denoising, deblurring, and super-resolution. We further explore the potential of our method on downstream video applications, including object detection and monocular depth estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BinRVR，一个面向 RAW 视频复原的二值化神经网络框架，通过二值化将计算量与参数减少约 96%，仅带来约 4% 的性能下降。框架包含二值化信息交互模块（BIIM）统一建模时空信息，以及利用全精度激活统计缓解量化误差的分布感知二值化卷积（DAB-Conv），并支持多比特量化以在不同硬件约束下灵活权衡精度与效率。实验在低光增强、去噪、去模糊和超分辨率等 RAW 视频复原任务上验证了其与先进二值化方法的竞争力，并探索了下游目标检测与单目深度估计应用。
Motivation: 二值化神经网络（BNNs）能为图像增强提供高效轻量部署，但在视频场景下建模时间一致性和激活值分布的能力不足，限制了其在 RAW 视频复原中的有效性。
Method: 提出 BinRVR 框架，包含二值化信息交互模块（BIIM）以统一且高效地联合建模空间与时间信息，以及分布感知二值化卷积（DAB-Conv），利用全精度激活的统计信息来缓解量化误差；框架还支持多比特量化以实现精度与效率的灵活权衡。
Result: BinRVR 在减少约 96% 计算量与参数的情况下仅造成约 4% 性能退化，并在 RAW 视频复原任务（低光增强、去噪、去模糊、超分辨率）上取得与先进二值化方法相当的性能，同时在下游目标检测和单目深度估计中展现潜力。
Conclusion: 作者强调二值化 RAW 视频复原能够在极大压缩计算与参数的同时保持接近全精度性能，且多比特量化扩展了其在不同硬件约束下的适用性。

papers.title: Beyond Uncertainty: Generalizable Failure Monitoring for Surgical Segmentation under Acquisition Degradation
papers.abstract_en: Surgical segmentation networks can fail silently under acquisition degradation: predicted masks may be wrong even when model confidence remains high. Existing deployment-time monitors rely primarily on uncertainty estimates and can therefore miss confident failures. We present TCSR-Monitor (Temporal Conformal Surgical Risk Monitor), a post-hoc failure-monitoring framework that combines confidence with observable shape, temporal-consistency, and image-quality cues. TCSR-Monitor wraps a frozen segmentation model, requires no model internals, and operates without ground truth at deployment. We also introduce a validation protocol to assess whether alarms remain credible under distribution shift. On EndoVis 2017, leave-one-corruption-out evaluation shows that TCSR-Monitor generalizes to unseen acquisition degradations and substantially outperforms confidence-based baselines. A circularity control confirms that it predicts segmentation failure rather than simply detecting corrupted images. Mondrian conformal calibration balances miss-rates across degradation severities, but a single global threshold still produces false alarms on up to 40% of correctly segmented frames at moderate corruption. Zero-shot transfer to SAM2 demonstrates feature portability, although entropy outperforms the transferred monitor at both evaluated thresholds. Overall, reliable monitoring under acquisition degradation benefits from complementary observable signals beyond confidence alone, but substantial false-alarm and transfer limitations remain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TCSR-Monitor，一种针对手术分割模型在后处理阶段进行失败监控的框架，将置信度与可观测的形状、时间一致性和图像质量线索结合。该方法包裹冻结的分割模型，不需要模型内部信息，也无需部署时的真值。在 EndoVis 2017 的 leave-one-corruption-out 评估中，TCSR-Monitor 能泛化到未见过的采集退化，并大幅优于基于置信度的基线；循环性控制表明它预测的是分割失败而非单纯检测图像损坏。Mondrian conformal calibration 可平衡不同退化严重度下的漏报率，但全局阈值在中度损坏下仍会对最多 40% 的正确分割帧产生误报；零样本迁移到 SAM2 显示特征可移植性，但两个评估阈值下熵方法均优于迁移后的监控器。
Motivation: 手术分割网络在采集退化下可能静默失败，即模型置信度高但预测掩码错误，而现有部署期监控主要依赖不确定性估计，会漏掉这类高置信失败。
Method: 提出 TCSR-Monitor，一种后置式失败监控框架，融合置信度与形状、时间一致性、图像质量等可观测线索；它包裹冻结的分割模型，不访问模型内部，也无需真值。同时引入验证协议来评估告警在分布偏移下是否仍然可信，并使用 Mondrian conformal calibration 平衡不同退化严重度下的漏报率。
Result: 在 EndoVis 2017 的 leave-one-corruption-out 评估中，TCSR-Monitor 泛化到未见过的采集退化并显著优于基于置信度的基线；循环性控制确认其预测分割失败而非仅检测损坏图像。Mondrian conformal calibration 平衡了各退化严重度的漏报率，但单一全局阈值在中度损坏下仍对最多 40% 的正确分割帧产生误报；零样本迁移到 SAM2 表现良好，但熵方法在两个评估阈值下均优于迁移后的监控器。
Conclusion: 在采集退化下，可靠监控需要超越置信度的互补可观测信号，但摘要同时指出误报率较高和迁移能力有限仍是显著局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Would this change your answer? Evaluating Explanations of LLM Behavior In The Wild with Counterfactual Experiments
papers.abstract_en: Many areas of AI research, such as language model interpretability and chain of thought faithfulness, seek to explain model behaviors. But what constitutes a "good" explanation? In this work, we evaluate explanations through the lens of counterfactual simulatability-whether the explanation is useful for predicting model behaviors on related counterfactual inputs. To this end, we introduce CHIVE (Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits), a novel agentic pipeline that identifies unexpected model behaviors in the wild and investigates them with counterfactual prompt edits. This yields thousands of high-quality explanations for naturally-occurring model behaviors along with supporting counterfactual evidence. We apply CHIVE in two ways. First, we evaluate whether common LLM interpretability techniques improve an agent's ability to predict counterfactual model behaviors. Surprisingly, we find no uplift from any of the interpretability techniques studied. Second, we use CHIVE to generate training data. We find that training models to predict outcomes of CHIVE-generated counterfactual experiments generalizes to various out-of-distribution settings. Overall, CHIVE automatically discovers explanations of naturally-occurring LLM behaviors, enabling us to evaluate and improve methods for explaining LLM behaviors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CHIVE (Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits)，一种 agentic pipeline，通过在真实环境中自动发现意外模型行为并执行反事实提示编辑，来生成带有反事实证据的高质量解释。作者以反事实可模拟性 (counterfactual simulatability) 作为评估解释的标准，并发现所研究的常见 LLM 可解释性技术并未提升预测反事实行为的能力；同时，用 CHIVE 生成的数据训练模型可泛化到多种分布外设置。
Motivation: 许多可解释性和思维链忠实性研究旨在解释模型行为，但缺少对“好解释”的明确定义。作者提出用反事实可模拟性——即解释能否帮助预测相关反事实输入上的模型行为——来评估解释质量。
Method: 引入 CHIVE 管线，自动识别自然出现的意外模型行为，通过反事实提示编辑检验解释假设，从而产出大量带反事实证据的解释。该管线被用于两个方向：评估常见可解释性技术是否改善 agent 对反事实行为的预测，以及生成训练数据来训练模型预测反事实实验结果。
Result: 摘要报告，所研究的 LLM 可解释性技术对预测反事实模型行为没有任何提升 (no uplift)；而使用 CHIVE 生成的反事实实验数据训练模型，能够泛化到多种分布外 (out-of-distribution) 设置。
Conclusion: CHIVE 能够自动发现自然出现的 LLM 行为的解释，并为评估和改进解释方法提供可扩展的途径。

summary_sections.motivation: 许多可解释性和思维链忠实性研究旨在解释模型行为，但缺少对“好解释”的明确定义。作者提出用反事实可模拟性——即解释能否帮助预测相关反事实输入上的模型行为——来评估解释质量。
summary_sections.method: 引入 CHIVE 管线，自动识别自然出现的意外模型行为，通过反事实提示编辑检验解释假设，从而产出大量带反事实证据的解释。该管线被用于两个方向：评估常见可解释性技术是否改善 agent 对反事实行为的预测，以及生成训练数据来训练模型预测反事实实验结果。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告，所研究的 LLM 可解释性技术对预测反事实模型行为没有任何提升 (no uplift)；而使用 CHIVE 生成的反事实实验数据训练模型，能够泛化到多种分布外 (out-of-distribution) 设置。
summary_sections.conclusion: CHIVE 能够自动发现自然出现的 LLM 行为的解释，并为评估和改进解释方法提供可扩展的途径。

papers.title: VicEdit: Learning to Edit Videos from Visual In-Context Examples
papers.abstract_en: Despite progress in instruction-based video editing, unimodal textual instructions inherently struggle to convey fine-grained textures and complex dynamics. To bridge this perceptual gap, we propose Visual In-context Editing, a new paradigm elevating video editing from textual instructions to multi-modal visual guidance encompassing single image, image pair, and video pair. To facilitate this paradigm, we curate VicEdit-400K, the first large-scale dataset for visual in-context video editing. We develop an automated pipeline to generate 400K high-quality samples across ten task types, ensuring superior visual fidelity and semantic consistency through multi-dimensional filtering. Leveraging this foundation, we introduce VicEdit, a unified framework to bridge visual and textual contexts. To adaptively extract editing semantics from heterogeneous references, we design Modality-Adaptive Semantic Distillation, which produces modality-specific semantic tokens from visual references. These tokens are then synergistically integrated with textual instructions through Dual-Context Injection, enabling the generation process to benefit from both visual and textual signals. Extensive evaluations on VicEditBench demonstrate that VicEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance across both basic instruction editing and visual in-context editing tasks, establishing visual in-context learning as a powerful and controllable paradigm for video editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出视觉上下文编辑 (Visual In-context Editing) 这一新范式，将视频编辑从纯文本指令扩展到单图、图像对和视频对等多模态视觉参考；为此构建了首个大规模数据集 VicEdit-400K，并提出统一框架 VicEdit，通过 Modality-Adaptive Semantic Distillation 提取模态特定语义 token，再经 Dual-Context Injection 与文本指令协同注入生成过程。在 VicEditBench 上，该方法在基础指令编辑和视觉上下文编辑任务上均达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 基于指令的视频编辑依赖单模态文本指令，难以传达细粒度纹理和复杂动态；现有方法存在感知鸿沟，缺少将视觉示例作为编辑条件的研究与数据支撑。
Method: 构建自动化流水线生成 400K 高质量视觉上下文视频编辑样本，覆盖十种任务类型，并通过多维过滤保证视觉保真度和语义一致性；提出 VicEdit 统一框架，用 Modality-Adaptive Semantic Distillation 从异构视觉参考中产生模态特定语义 token，再通过 Dual-Context Injection 与文本指令协同注入生成过程。
Result: 在 VicEditBench 上的大量评估显示，VicEdit 在基础指令编辑和视觉上下文编辑任务上均达到最先进 (state-of-the-art) 性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为视觉上下文学习可成为一种强大且可控的视频编辑范式，并提供了首个大规模数据集和统一框架作为基础。

papers.title: TDD-Agent: Test-Driven Reasoning for Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in code generation, yet ensuring correctness in complex, repository-level tasks remains challenging. Existing approaches often use generated tests as static post-hoc validators, which limits their ability to guide implementation and may introduce misleading feedback when the tests themselves are incomplete or incorrect. In this paper, we introduce TDD-Agent, which operationalizes the test-driven development paradigm for code generation. TDD-Agent first prompts the model to generate executable tests, encouraging it to clarify expected behaviors before implementation, and then performs iterative dual-track refinement over both the generated code and tests using execution feedback. We first isolate the effect of test-first reasoning through a prompt variant TDD-prompt on LiveCodeBench, where it consistently improves upon reasoning-based prompting baselines. Building on this finding, we evaluate the full TDD-Agent framework on RepoEval, a repository-level benchmark, and show that it consistently outperforms retrieval-based and agent-based baselines. Additional analyses show that iterative refinement improves not only code correctness but also the effectiveness of the generated tests, yielding higher pass rates, coverage, and mutation scores, suggesting that tests can serve as evolving reasoning artifacts rather than fixed validators. Our source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TDD-Agent-Framework-6370/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TDD-Agent，将测试驱动开发 (test-driven development) 范式引入代码生成：先让模型生成可执行测试以明确预期行为，再基于执行反馈对代码与测试进行迭代式双轨精化。在 LiveCodeBench 上，仅使用测试优先推理的提示变体 TDD-prompt 便一致优于基于推理的提示基线；在仓库级基准 RepoEval 上，完整框架优于基于检索和基于智能体的基线，并提升 pass rate、覆盖率与变异得分 (mutation score)。
Motivation: 现有方法常把生成测试当作静态的事后验证器，难以指导实现，且在测试本身不完整或错误时可能提供误导性反馈；复杂仓库级代码生成任务的正确性因此难以保证。
Method: 提出 TDD-Agent，先用提示让模型生成可执行测试以澄清预期行为，再对代码与测试同时进行基于执行反馈的迭代双轨精化，使测试从固定验证器变为持续演化的推理产物。
Result: 在 LiveCodeBench 上，TDD-prompt 一致优于基于推理的提示基线；在 RepoEval 上，TDD-Agent 一致优于基于检索和基于智能体的基线，并带来更高的 pass rate、覆盖率和变异得分。
Conclusion: 摘要强调迭代精化不仅提升代码正确性，也提升生成测试的有效性，说明测试可作为演化中的推理构件而非常态验证器；代码已公开。

papers.title: Le Critique: Privileged Value Functions for LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning algorithms for Large Language Models (LLMs) are largely distinguished by their variance reduction strategy. Group-relative methods like GRPO reduce gradient variance by sampling multiple rollouts per prompt, but provide only sequence-level credit. Training is also blocked by straggler rollouts, reducing throughput and increasing off-policyness. Learned value functions theoretically address both problems, providing token-level advantages without requiring large groups. However, additional infrastructure engineering challenges combined with the practical success of critic-free methods have made it difficult to justify their inclusion in RL pipelines. We propose two complementary strategies to improve the performance of value function RL: 1) Privileged Value Functions (PVF) which provide an elegant mechanism to inject additional task-relevant token-level signal without biasing the policy objective; 2) TETHER, a baseline that adaptively interpolates between group-relative and value baselines depending on the value function accuracy. Across several reasoning tasks, both strategies consistently improve over the standard value function baseline, and are competitive with or outperform mean-baseline GRPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 强化学习中学习型价值函数 (learned value function) 的使用难题，提出两种互补策略：Privileged Value Functions (PVF) 和 TETHER 基线。PVF 在不偏置策略目标的前提下注入任务相关的 token 级信号，TETHER 则根据价值函数精度在 group-relative 基线与 value 基线之间自适应插值。在多个推理任务上，两种策略都一致优于标准 value function 基线，并与 mean-baseline GRPO 相当或更优。
Motivation: 现有 LLM RL 算法主要依赖方差降低策略；GRPO 等 group-relative 方法需多次采样、只提供序列级信用，且受 straggler rollout 阻塞而降低吞吐并增加 off-policyness。学习型价值函数理论上能提供 token 级优势且不需要大组采样，但工程挑战和 critic-free 方法的实际成功使其难以被纳入 RL 流程。
Method: 提出两种互补策略：1) Privileged Value Functions (PVF)，通过不使策略目标产生偏置的机制注入额外的任务相关 token 级信号；2) TETHER，一种基线方法，根据价值函数准确度在 group-relative 基线与价值基线之间自适应插值。
Result: 在多个推理任务上，两种策略均一致优于标准 value function 基线，且与 mean-baseline GRPO 相比具有竞争力或更好。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些策略能使学习型价值函数在 LLM RL 管线中更具正当性和竞争力，实验范围集中在推理任务上。

papers.title: GoalEvolve: From Handcrafted Algorithm Priors to Goal-Driven Evolution of Physical Design Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Physical design algorithms operate within tightly coupled, multi-stage optimization flows, where stage-local gains may vanish or induce downstream degradation. Existing program-evolution frameworks often rely on stage-local objectives or undifferentiated multi-metric feedback, which neither guarantee better final results nor identify which unmet requirement should guide the next iteration. We present GoalEvolve, a goal-driven framework that makes physical design algorithm evolution accountable for the final quality of results (QoR) of the complete flow. Given a multi-objective QoR target region, GoalEvolve converts unmet requirements into normalized target gaps, identifies the dominant bottleneck, and uses stage-resolved checkpoint evidence to locate the responsible stage. An LLM-based Teacher then narrows the search to a relevant algorithmic decision and source region, while parallel Student agents implement and validate hypotheses through full-flow evaluation. Local effects, optimization debt, and downstream retention are retained as mechanism evidence for subsequent evolution. Across eight ASAP7 designs, GoalEvolve improves post-route TNS by 30.67% on average and reduces leakage and dynamic power by 21.18% and 9.42% versus default OpenROAD. Relative to commercial-tool goals, it closes 62.20% of the normalized power gap on power-dominant designs, surpasses the TNS goals on both timing-dominant designs, and closes 32.48% of the equal-weight timing-power gap on joint designs. Across all three designs evaluated against Codex goal mode under matched budgets, GoalEvolve further improves TNS by 26.46% while reducing leakage and dynamic power by 12.38% and 0.76%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GoalEvolve，一个目标驱动的物理设计算法进化框架，把未满足的多目标 QoR 需求转化为归一化目标差距，识别主导瓶颈并利用阶段级 checkpoint 证据定位责任阶段，再由 LLM Teacher 缩小算法决策与源码区域，Student 智能体通过全流程评估验证假设。在八个 ASAP7 设计上，相对默认 OpenROAD，post-route TNS 平均改善 30.67%，漏电和动态功耗分别降低 21.18% 和 9.42%。
Motivation: 物理设计算法处于紧耦合的多阶段优化流程中，阶段局部收益可能消失或导致下游退化；现有程序进化框架依赖阶段局部目标或未分化的多指标反馈，既不保证最终结果更好，也无法指出下一次迭代应优先满足哪个需求。
Method: GoalEvolve 将未满足需求转换为归一化目标差距，识别主导瓶颈，用阶段级 checkpoint 证据定位责任阶段；LLM 基 Teacher 将搜索收敛到相关算法决策和源码区域，并行 Student 智能体通过全流程评估实现并验证假设，并把局部效应、优化债务和下游保留作为机制证据供后续进化使用。
Result: 在八个 ASAP7 设计上，相对默认 OpenROAD，post-route TNS 平均提升 30.67%，漏电和动态功耗分别降低 21.18% 和 9.42%；相对商业工具目标，在功耗主导设计上缩小 62.20% 归一化功耗差距，在两个时序主导设计上超过 TNS 目标，在联合设计上缩小 32.48% 等权时序-功耗差距。在与 Codex goal mode 在匹配预算下对比的三个设计上，TNS 再提升 26.46%，漏电和动态功耗分别降低 12.38% 和 0.76%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调让物理设计算法进化对完整流程的最终 QoR 负责，通过瓶颈识别与机制证据指导迭代，可在与商业工具目标对比中改善时序和功耗。

papers.title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection for Image Dataset Quality Assurance in Multi-Center Breast MRI
papers.abstract_en: Corrupted, inconsistent, or anomalous data silently threatens the safety and reliability of medical AI. Despite growing regulatory recognition of dataset quality assurance (QA) for high-risk medical AI, scalable automated detection remains underdeveloped. We employ unsupervised anomaly detection (AD) and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection as an automated dataset QA mechanism for multi-center dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI. We build a controlled AD benchmark of 17 realistic QA-relevant anomaly types from six public datasets (protocol violations, processing errors, incorrect anatomical regions) and propose a taxonomy of radiological image anomalies based on human visual perception, enabling fine-grained analysis of AD failure modes. The benchmark includes near-, medium-far-, far-OOD samples, as well as in-distribution and external normal data. Four methods are evaluated: a projection-based method extended with a domain-specific feature extractor and a novel positional encoding, a reconstruction-based approach extended to full 3D volumes with an augmented training objective, and two unmodified hybrid OOD detection methods. Medium-far- and far-OOD samples are detected reliably, whereas near-OOD samples and external normal data from unseen institutions expose method-specific differences. The 3D reconstruction-based approach best balances detection performance (AUROC: 0.936) and generalization to unseen institutions. The projection-based method with positional encoding achieves the highest overall detection performance (AUROC: 0.954). Both hybrid methods exhibit critical failure modes, confirming that methods validated for one modality or anatomy may not generalize without domain-specific adaptation. Implants and mastectomies remain an open challenge for all methods. Our results establish a foundation and practical guidance on scalable unsupervised QA in medical AI pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将无监督异常检测 (AD) 和分布外 (OOD) 检测用作多中心动态对比增强乳腺 MRI 数据集的自动化质控 (QA) 机制。作者从六个公开数据集构建包含 17 类 QA 相关异常的受控基准，提出基于人类视觉感知的放射图像异常分类法，并评估四种方法（投影法、3D 重建法、两种混合 OOD 检测法）。结果显示中远 OOD 和远 OOD 样本可可靠检测，3D 重建法平衡性能与跨中心泛化 (AUROC 0.936)，投影法总体最高 (AUROC 0.954)，假体和乳房切除仍是开放挑战。
Motivation: 医疗 AI 中损坏、不一致或异常数据会威胁安全可靠性，尽管监管日益重视高风险医疗 AI 的数据集质控，但可扩展的自动化检测仍发展不足。
Method: 构建受控 AD 基准，包含 17 类 QA 相关异常（协议违规、处理错误、错误解剖区域），来自六个公开数据集，并提出基于人类视觉感知的异常分类法。评估四种方法：带领域特征提取器和新型位置编码的投影法、扩展到全 3D 体积并采用增强训练目标的重建法、以及两种未修改的混合 OOD 检测方法。
Result: 中远 OOD 和远 OOD 样本能可靠检测，近 OOD 和来自未见机构的正常数据暴露方法间差异。3D 重建法 AUROC 0.936，投影法 AUROC 0.954 最高。两种混合方法存在关键失败模式，假体和乳房切除对所有方法仍是挑战。
Conclusion: 结果表明针对单一模态或解剖部位验证的方法不经领域适配可能不泛化，该工作为医学 AI 流水线中可扩展的无监督 QA 提供基础和实用指导。

papers.title: GenRouter: Unified Workflow Routing for Agentic Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of text-to-image (T2I) generation models has effectively solved the foundational challenge of raw pixel synthesis, shifting the community's focus toward fulfilling increasingly intricate user requests. While recent agentic image generation workflows enhance static inference with advanced capabilities like external knowledge retrieval and iterative reasoning, they mostly operate in isolated silos with fixed ``one-size-fits-all" topologies. This inevitably leads to severe compute-mismatch, where simple queries are forced through computationally heavy pipelines. To bridge this gap, we present GenRouter, the first unified workflow routing framework for agentic image generation. We first formulate GenCanvas, standardizing diverse agentic pipelines into a universal set of foundational primitives and executable templates. Operating over this unified space, GenRouter adaptively routes heterogeneous prompts to their optimal workflows via (i) demand profiling, (ii) experience matching, and (iii) Pareto filtering. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that GenRouter achieves superior visual alignment while reducing execution costs by over 95% and latency by 65% compared to heavyweight static pipelines. Furthermore, the system continuously self-evolves via accumulated experience, enabling robust zero-shot generalization that boosts performance and halves computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GenRouter，据称是首个面向智能体图像生成 (agentic image generation) 的统一工作流路由框架。作者先定义 GenCanvas，将多种智能体流水线标准化为通用原语与可执行模板；GenRouter 在此统一空间上通过需求画像 (demand profiling)、经验匹配 (experience matching) 和 Pareto 过滤 (Pareto filtering) 将异构提示词路由到最优工作流。实验称相比重型静态流水线，该方法在保持视觉对齐的同时将执行成本降低超过 95%、延迟降低 65%，并可通过累积经验持续自进化。
Motivation: 文本到图像 (T2I) 生成已解决原始像素合成，社区转向满足更复杂的用户请求；现有智能体图像生成工作流大多以固定的一体化拓扑在孤立系统中运行，导致计算不匹配，简单查询也被迫经过高计算量流水线。
Method: 提出 GenCanvas 以统一标准化智能体流水线，并在此基础上构建 GenRouter 路由框架；路由决策由三部分组成：需求画像、经验匹配和 Pareto 过滤，以按提示词选择最优工作流。
Result: 摘要报告在多个基准上，GenRouter 相比重型静态流水线实现更优的视觉对齐，同时执行成本降低超过 95%、延迟降低 65%；系统还通过累积经验获得稳健的零样本泛化，提升性能并将计算开销减半。
Conclusion: 作者强调该系统通过累积经验持续自进化，针对的是智能体图像生成中静态流水线计算不匹配的问题。

papers.title: CytoFormer: A Molecularly Supervised Cell Foundation Model for Histopathology Cell Classification
papers.abstract_en: Identifying cell types directly from routine haematoxylin and eosin (H&E) histology would enable single-cell analysis at scale, but training such models has relied on manual pathologist annotations, which are slow, expensive and unreliable for many cell types. We instead supervise morphology with molecules. Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics profiles individual cells in situ on a section that can afterwards be stained with H&E, so that molecular identity and morphology are observed for the same physical cell. We assembled 81 such paired Xenium sections spanning 16 organs, derived per-cell labels by clustering, marker-gene annotation, organ-wise human review and quality control, and mapped them onto the cell types commonly reported in each organ. This yielded 15.4 million cells, each with a paired H&E image patch and one of 23 cell types, on which we trained CytoFormer, a cell foundation model with a multi-task, per-organ classification head. On spatially held-out tissue CytoFormer reached an accuracy of 0.85 and a macro-F1 of 0.78 across all 16 organs, and its predictions reproduced the tissue architecture of an entire held-out section. The representation also transfers: with the encoder frozen, a linear head on CytoFormer features performed better than six pathology foundation models on four expert-annotated benchmarks, including on organs and cell types that were not part of pretraining. Finally, in an interactive active-learning setting, CytoFormer's embeddings are markedly more label-efficient than existing pathology foundation models, detecting normal epithelium amid look-alike tumour with an F1 of 0.82 from only a few annotations and leading the strongest baseline by 0.13 in F1. CytoFormer turns paired H&E and spatial transcriptomics into a reusable, label-efficient representation for cell-level analysis of routine histology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CytoFormer，一个以分子为监督信号的细胞基础模型，用于常规 H&E 组织学图像中的细胞分类。作者利用成像空间转录组（Xenium）与 H&E 配对数据，构建了包含 16 个器官、23 种细胞类型、1540 万个细胞的数据集，并训练带多任务、每器官分类头的模型。摘要报告该模型在空间留出组织上达到 0.85 准确率与 0.78 macro-F1，其表征在迁移和主动学习设置下均优于多个现有病理学基础模型。
Motivation: 直接从 H&E 组织学中识别细胞类型有望实现大规模单细胞分析，但现有模型依赖病理学家手动标注，耗时、昂贵且对许多细胞类型不可靠。本文用分子身份（空间转录组）作为监督信号来替代手动标注。
Method: 利用成像空间转录组对同一物理细胞同时获取分子身份和 H&E 形态，收集 81 个配对 Xenium 切片；通过聚类、标记基因注释、器官级人工审查与质量控制定义 23 种细胞类型，训练名为 CytoFormer 的细胞基础模型，采用多任务、每器官分类头（multi-task, per-organ classification head）。
Result: 在空间留出的组织上，16 个器官的平均准确率为 0.85、macro-F1 为 0.78，预测能再现整个留出切片的组织结构；冻结编码器后，CytoFormer 特征的线性头在四个专家注释基准上优于六个病理学基础模型，包括预训练未见过的器官和细胞类型。在交互式主动学习中，其嵌入更标签高效，检测正常上皮与相似肿瘤的 F1 为 0.82，比最强基线高 0.13。
Conclusion: 摘要总结认为，CytoFormer 把配对 H&E 与空间转录组数据转化为可复用且标签高效的表征，适用于常规组织学切片的细胞级分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PersonaShot: Benchmarking Person-Centric Narrative Continuity in Multi-Shot Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video generation is rapidly evolving from single-shot clips to multi-shot narratives, where the human character serves as the core narrative anchor. However, existing benchmarks mainly assess character appearance or individual-shot quality, without measuring whether physical and emotional states remain coherent across cuts. They also rarely provide criterion-specific evaluation methods, although physical continuity, facial dynamics, and cinematic relations require different visual, temporal, and relational evidence. To address these limitations, we introduce PersonaShot, the first person-centric benchmark for narrative continuity in multi-shot video generation. PersonaShot contains approximately 1,000 multi-shot segments and 16 metrics spanning physical continuity, affective dynamics, and cinematic grammar. \textbf{\textit{1)} Narrative Continuity Benchmark:} We evaluate character coherence across three temporal levels: within-shot states, cross-shot transitions, and sequence-level trajectories. \textbf{\textit{2)} Human-Aligned Specialist Evaluators:} We distill reasoning from a large multimodal teacher into lightweight criterion-specific evaluators, each grounded in the visual, temporal, or relational evidence required by its metric, and align them with expert human judgments. \textbf{\textit{3)} Systematic Evaluation and Insights:} Our evaluation reveals distinct capability profiles across state-of-the-art models and a clear gap between perceptual quality and cross-shot narrative continuity. Even visually compelling videos frequently exhibit physical-state resets, abrupt affective shifts, and broken cinematic relations across shots. Human studies further demonstrate strong agreement between our evaluators and expert judgments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PersonaShot 是首个面向多镜头视频生成中人物中心叙事连贯性 (person-centric narrative continuity) 的基准，包含约 1,000 个多镜头片段和 16 个指标，覆盖物理连续性、情感动态 (affective dynamics) 与电影语法 (cinematic grammar)。作者从大型多模态教师模型中蒸馏出轻量级、按准则定制的专家评估器，并与人类专家判断对齐。评测显示当前模型的感知质量与跨镜头叙事连贯性之间存在明显差距，视觉上吸引人的视频也常出现物理状态重置、情感突变和电影关系断裂。
Motivation: 现有基准主要评估角色外观或单镜头质量，未系统衡量跨剪辑的身体与情感状态是否连贯，也很少提供针对具体准则的评估方法；物理连续性、面部动态和电影关系需要不同的视觉、时间与关系证据，这是当前多镜头视频生成评测的空白。
Method: 提出包含约 1,000 个多镜头片段和 16 个指标的基准，从镜头内状态、跨镜头转换和序列级轨迹三个时间层次评估角色连贯性；将大型多模态教师的推理蒸馏为轻量级、按准则定制的专家评估器，每个评估器依据其指标所需的视觉、时间或关系证据工作，并与专家人类判断对齐。
Result: 系统评测揭示了不同 SOTA 模型之间的能力差异，并显示感知质量与跨镜头叙事连贯性之间存在明显差距；即使视觉上高质量的视频也频繁出现物理状态重置、突变的情绪转变和跨镜头电影关系断裂，人类研究报告评估器与专家判断有较强一致性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调人物是多镜头叙事中的核心锚点，当前模型在跨镜头连贯性上仍有明显短板；PersonaShot 提供了人物中心的基准与准则特定的评估工具，供后续研究衡量和改进多镜头视频生成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Ethical Decision Head: Operationalizing Normative Ethics in Autonomous Vehicles via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous vehicles (AVs) approach Level 4 and Level 5 operational capability [SAE International, 2018], their on- board decision systems must handle not only safety-critical locomotion but also their subsequent moral weight. This paper details the Ethical Decision Head (EDH), a deep re- inforcement learning (RL) framework that encodes ethical reasoning as a differentiable reward signal, enabling a pol- icy gradient agent to learn morally-aligned driving behavior in scenarios whose state representation is aligned with the CARLA simulation environment [Dosovitskiy et al., 2017]. Two normative frameworks are instantiated and evaluated: a Utilitarian framework minimizing total casualties and a Kan- tian framework enforcing course maintenance as a categori- cal imperative. The EDH is trained via Proximal Policy Op- timization (PPO) [Schulman et al., 2017] against a Bradley- Terry reward model [Bradley and Terry, 1952] learned from pairwise human preference annotations over 200 collision- imminent scenarios. Results reveal an asymmetry in the learnability of normative ethical frameworks under human su- pervision. The Kantian condition, which reduces to a con- stant prediction task under the codebook, serves as a pipeline control: it confirms training stability and rules out infrastruc- ture failure as an explanation for the utilitarian result. The Utilitarian agent learned something more unsettling: human raters rewarded self-sacrifice over casualty minimization, and the model learned that preference faithfully. This divergence between what humans prescribe in theory and what they re- ward in practice suggests that RLHF does not learn ethics as philosophers define it, but as humans live it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ethical Decision Head (EDH)，一个基于深度强化学习的框架，将规范性伦理编码为可微奖励信号，并通过人类偏好反馈训练自动驾驶车辆在碰撞迫近场景中的道德驾驶行为。论文在 CARLA 对齐的状态表征下实例化并评估了功利主义（最小化总伤亡）与康德主义（将保持车道作为绝对命令）两种规范伦理框架。结果显示，人类标注者在实践中奖励自我牺牲而非伤亡最小化，说明 RLHF 学到的伦理更接近人类实际偏好而非哲学家定义的伦理。
Motivation: 当自动驾驶达到 L4/L5 级别时，车载决策系统不仅要处理安全关键的驾驶操作，还要承担相应的道德判断责任；现有方法缺少将规范伦理显式编码为可学习信号并用于策略梯度训练的机制。
Method: 将伦理推理编码为可微奖励信号，使用 Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) 训练策略；奖励来自基于 200 个碰撞迫近场景中成对人类偏好标注学到的 Bradley-Terry 奖励模型，并实例化功利主义与康德主义两种规范框架作为对照。
Result: 康德主义条件在编码本下退化为常数预测任务，作为流程控制验证了训练稳定性和基础设施；功利主义智能体则学到人类评分者实际奖励自我牺牲而非伤亡最小化的偏好，且模型忠实地学习了该偏好。
Conclusion: 摘要指出人类在理论上宣称的伦理与在实践中奖励的行为存在分歧，表明 RLHF 学习的不是哲学家定义的伦理，而是人类实际生活中的伦理。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MIRROR: Multimodal Intelligent Radiology Reasoning and Observation Reporter
papers.abstract_en: A radiologist reading a model's output faces two problems. The model returns a number and no reason, and any system that turns that number into readable prose can quietly add claims the model never made. MIRROR is a research prototype built to separate those failures. It chains a multi-label classifier, a Grad-CAM localizer that turns each positive finding into a named anatomical region, and a report writer that receives the labels, probabilities, and regions but never the image. Because the language layer cannot see pixels, it cannot assert a finding the classifier did not make. We are precise about what that buys: a MIRROR report's findings are auditable against the probability vector, while the sentences framing them are ordinary generated text, and we show one stating a cardiothoracic ratio the system never measured. One registry holds the taxonomy, anatomy, and phrasing for chest X-ray, brain MRI, and head CT, so adding a modality is a data change; all three are routed and tested, one is trained. On ChestMNIST that classifier reaches macro AUROC 0.729 and ranks better than chance on all 14 labels, at 1.6 to 6.8 times the precision a random ranker would get. Yet at the default 0.5 threshold it emits no positive prediction at all for 11 of them, and its excellent-looking Brier score of 0.045 sits beside the 0.047 earned by a predictor that ignores the image. The discrimination is real; the decisions are not. Under the class imbalance normal in radiology, aggregate metrics flatter models that do nothing, and should be reported against that floor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIRROR 是一个放射学报告生成研究原型，将多标签分类器、Grad-CAM 定位器和报告生成器串联；报告生成器只接收标签、概率和解剖区域而不接收图像，从而让语言层无法断言分类器未做出的发现。在 ChestMNIST 上，该分类器 macro AUROC 达到 0.729，但默认 0.5 阈值下 14 个标签中有 11 个没有正预测，且其 Brier 分数 0.045 与忽略图像的预测器的 0.047 几乎持平。作者以此论证在放射学常见的类别不平衡下，聚合指标会高估无所作为的模型。
Motivation: 放射科医生阅读模型输出时面临两个问题：模型只给出数值而没有理由，且将数值转成流畅文本的系统可能悄悄加入模型从未做出的声明。MIRROR 旨在把这两类失败分开，使发现可审计而措辞明确为生成文本。
Method: 提出一个链式原型：多标签分类器给出标签和概率，Grad-CAM 定位器把每个阳性发现映射到命名解剖区域，报告写入器只接收标签、概率和区域而看不到图像。一个统一注册表维护胸部 X 光、脑 MRI 和头 CT 的分类学、解剖和措辞，新增模态只需改数据；三种模态都完成路由和测试，其中一种完成训练。
Result: 在 ChestMNIST 上分类器 macro AUROC 为 0.729，全部 14 个标签的排序优于随机，精度达到随机排序器的 1.6 至 6.8 倍；但默认 0.5 阈值下它对 11 个标签不产生任何正预测。其 Brier 分数 0.045，与忽略图像输入的预测器得到的 0.047 几乎相同，文中还展示了一句报告声称系统从未实测过的心胸比（cardiothoracic ratio）。
Conclusion: 作者强调判别力（discrimination）是真实的，但决策（decision）并不可用；在放射学常见的类别不平衡条件下，聚合指标会美化不做出预测的模型，应把这种"什么都不做"的预测器作为报告基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Semantic Bandits: In-Context Exploration-Exploitation is Biased by Semantic Priors
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as decision-making agents in settings that require sophisticated environmental exploration. However, existing work has raised questions about how LLMs actually balance exploration and exploitation. Unlike classical agents, LLM agents engage with tasks through natural language, exposing them to semantic information with no formal counterpart in the task structure. We introduce the semantic bandit, an extension of the multi-armed bandit setting that explicitly considers the textual labels assigned to actions, and use it to study how semantic priors --- inductive biases arising from associations between language and expected reward learned during pre-training, shape LLM exploration behaviour. We find that semantically informative action labels reduce exploration in favour of exploitation, improving performance when aligned with the reward structure and severely degrading it when misaligned. We further find that negative rewards trigger substantially more exploration than equivalent positive rewards, consistent with an expected-scale bias induced by reward conventions common in pre-training data. Overall, we argue that the use of language to define the environment and rewards introduces unavoidable biases derived from the fact that the model is trained on word co-occurence, with implications for the reliability and robustness of LLM agents in real-world decision-making settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语义老虎机 (semantic bandit) 这一多臂老虎机扩展设定，显式考虑动作的文本标签，用以研究大语言模型 (LLM) 中由预训练语言关联产生的语义先验 (semantic priors) 如何塑造探索-利用行为。研究发现，语义信息丰富的动作标签会使模型减少探索、转向利用；当标签与奖励结构对齐时提升性能，错位时则严重损害性能。负奖励比等量正奖励引发显著更多的探索，作者将其归因于预训练数据中常见奖励约定所导致的期望尺度偏差。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地被部署为需要复杂环境探索的决策智能体，但现有工作对 LLM 如何平衡探索与利用仍有疑问；与经典智能体不同，LLM 通过自然语言接触与任务结构无形式对应的语义信息，这带来了未被充分研究的偏差来源。
Method: 引入语义老虎机 (semantic bandit)，即在经典多臂老虎机基础上显式考虑分配给每个动作的文本标签，并利用该设定测量来自预训练语言-奖励关联的语义先验如何影响 LLM 的探索行为。
Result: 摘要报告：语义信息丰富的动作标签会促使模型更多地利用而非探索，与奖励结构对齐时提升性能，错位时严重降低性能；此外，负奖励比等量正奖励引发更多探索，符合预训练数据奖励约定导致的期望尺度偏差 (expected-scale bias)。
Conclusion: 作者认为，用语言定义环境和奖励会引入由词共现训练 (word co-occurrence) 带来的不可避免的偏差，这对 LLM 智能体在现实决策场景中的可靠性和鲁棒性具有重要意义。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Unlearn: Machine Unlearning via Learning the Unlearning Behaviors
papers.abstract_en: Various machine unlearning techniques have been developed in response to privacy legislation requirements, enabling individuals to exercise their legal right to have their data $D_f$ removed from a machine learning model. This process is typically accomplished via the use of an unlearning function denoted as $U$. Existing methods focus on designing an intricate $U$ to unlearn $D_f \subset D$ from a previous model $A(D)$, so that the unlearned model performs as closely as possible to the retrained model $A(D \setminus D_f)$. However, these methods often suffer from high computational costs when dealing with massive training data, as the complex structures of $U$ become a bottleneck even for models with fewer parameters. Inspired by Learning to Optimize, we introduce the first learning-based model-agnostic approach, Learning-to-UnLearn (L2UL). Our core insight is to shift from manually designing $U$ to learning the unlearning behaviors from a distribution perspective, thereby acquiring a simple and efficient $U$ via learning. Our experimental results demonstrate that the accuracy achieved by L2UL is comparable to that of retraining while exhibiting impressive efficiency, particularly in data-intensive scenarios. Furthermore, we validate the performance and scalability of our method on larger models ResNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出学习式机器遗忘方法 L2UL (Learning-to-UnLearn)，将以往手工设计遗忘函数 U 的做法转变为从分布角度学习遗忘行为，从而获得简单高效的 U，使遗忘后的模型尽可能接近重训练模型。摘要报告该方法在准确率上与重训练相当，在数据密集型场景下效率显著，并在较大模型 ResNet 上验证了性能与可扩展性。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法依赖手工设计结构复杂的遗忘函数 U，在处理大规模训练数据时计算成本高，复杂结构本身成为瓶颈，即使参数较少的模型也受影响。
Method: 受 Learning to Optimize 启发，提出首个基于学习且模型无关 (model-agnostic) 的 L2UL 框架，核心是从分布角度学习遗忘行为而非人工设计 U，从而通过学习得到简单高效的遗忘函数。
Result: 实验表明 L2UL 的准确率与重训练相当，在数据密集型场景下展现出明显效率优势，并在更大模型 ResNet 上验证了性能与可扩展性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调从手工设计转向学习遗忘行为可以获得简单且高效的遗忘函数，为大规模数据下的机器遗忘提供了一条可行路径。
Relevance: 7

papers.title: Learning to Price with Persuasion
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by modern marketplaces, where the platform or the seller routinely gathers detailed user profiles, we study a novel learning theoretic model that simultaneously involves information and mechanism design. Specifically, we consider the economic setting recently introduced by Bergemann et al. (2022), where in addition to the menu of quality-price pairs, the seller offers information on the value of the match between product quality and buyer's taste via a signaling scheme. We relax the assumption that the seller knows the buyers' belief about the distribution of tastes and study the sample requirements of designing a revenue maximizing scheme. We consider both the batch setting where we have access to data from a set of i.i.d. buyers and an online demand query model where we observe the buyers' behaviors to seller's schemes. Despite the apparent non-convexity of the problem, we also give the first FPTAS to compute a scheme that maximizes the revenue within an arbitrarily small additive loss, which was left open by Bergemann et al. (2022). Overall, this brings a new learning perspective in asymmetric economic settings where buyers and sellers know different types of information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一个同时涉及信息设计与机制设计的学习理论模型，即在 Bergemann et al. (2022) 的价格-质量菜单基础上加入信号机制 (signaling scheme) 来传递产品质量与买家品味匹配度的信息。作者放宽卖家已知买家 taste 分布信念的假设，研究设计最大化收益方案所需的样本复杂度，并给出首个 FPTAS。
Motivation: 现代市场平台常收集详细用户画像，卖家可以同时设计价格菜单和信号方案；但已有工作假设卖家知道买家对 taste 分布的信念，这一假设在实践中不可得，因此需要研究有限的样本或查询能否支撑收益最大化方案的设计。
Method: 考虑两种数据获取模式：批量 (batch) 设置下访问一组 i.i.d. 买家的数据，以及在线需求查询 (online demand query) 设置下观察买家对卖家方案的行为反馈；在此框架下分析样本需求，并提出计算近似最优方案的 FPTAS 算法。
Result: 摘要报告该问题表面非凸，但作者给出首个 FPTAS，能够在任意小的加性损失内计算最大化收益的方案，回应了 Bergemann et al. (2022) 遗留的开放问题；同时刻画了批量与在线两种设置下的样本要求。
Conclusion: 该工作为买家与卖家拥有不同信息的不对称经济环境提供了新的学习视角。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.motivation: 现代市场平台常收集详细用户画像，卖家可以同时设计价格菜单和信号方案；但已有工作假设卖家知道买家对 taste 分布的信念，这一假设在实践中不可得，因此需要研究有限的样本或查询能否支撑收益最大化方案的设计。
summary_sections.method: 考虑两种数据获取模式：批量 (batch) 设置下访问一组 i.i.d. 买家的数据，以及在线需求查询 (online demand query) 设置下观察买家对卖家方案的行为反馈；在此框架下分析样本需求，并提出计算近似最优方案的 FPTAS 算法。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该问题表面非凸，但作者给出首个 FPTAS，能够在任意小的加性损失内计算最大化收益的方案，回应了 Bergemann et al. (2022) 遗留的开放问题；同时刻画了批量与在线两种设置下的样本要求。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为买家与卖家拥有不同信息的不对称经济环境提供了新的学习视角。

papers.title: FabriMAE I Trust Myself? Self-Evaluating VLA Action Generation with Markov Attention Entropy
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) integrate visual perception, language instruction, and action generation into end-to-end policies across heterogeneous architectures. However, enabling VLAs to self-evaluate their action generation reliability without external supervision remains a major challenge. Existing methods either rely on expert annotations or estimate uncertainty only from output statistics, largely ignoring internal signals. In this work, we observe that internal visual modality entropy exhibits consistent distinctions between successful and failed tasks across heterogeneous VLAs. Although VLAs' architectures differ in their action generation, we show that they share a common latent action generation abstraction evolving under visual perception, language instruction, and state input, which we formulate as a Conditional Generative Markov Chain. Based on this formulation, we propose MAE (Markov Attention Entropy), a self-evaluation framework that directly converts internal attention signals into architecture-aware reliability scores, and introduce LIBERO-Reflect, a 4,000-episode benchmark combining 2,000 standard episodes and 2,000 challenging episodes across four subsets. Extensive experiments across heterogeneous VLA architectures and diverse scenarios show that MAE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on AUPR, AUROC, and FPR@95. We further instantiate FabriMAE for verifier-free test-time action selection, showing that MAE-guided multiple sampling improves PI-family robustness on LIBERO-Plus with small observed runtime overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉-语言-动作模型 (Vision-Language-Action, VLA) 的自我评估问题，提出基于马尔可夫注意力熵 (Markov Attention Entropy, MAE) 的自评估框架，将内部注意力信号转换为架构感知的可靠性分数，并构建 LIBERO-Reflect 基准。摘要报告 MAE 在 AUPR、AUROC、FPR@95 上持续优于现有基线，且其 FabriMAE 实例在无验证器的测试时动作选择中提升了 PI 家族的鲁棒性。
Motivation: VLA 模型缺乏在无外部监督下自我评估动作生成可靠性的能力，现有方法要么依赖专家标注，要么仅从输出统计估计不确定性，忽略了模型内部信号。
Method: 作者观察到不同 VLA 架构中内部视觉模态熵在成功与失败任务间有稳定区分，并将动作生成过程形式化为条件生成马尔可夫链 (Conditional Generative Markov Chain)，据此提出 MAE 直接利用内部注意力信号生成架构感知可靠性分数，同时引入包含 2000 个标准与 2000 个挑战性 episode 的 LIBERO-Reflect 基准。
Result: 在异构 VLA 架构与多种场景下，MAE 在 AUPR、AUROC、FPR@95 三项指标上一致优于现有基线；基于 MAE 的 FabriMAE 在 LIBERO-Plus 上提升 PI 家族的多采样测试时选择鲁棒性，且运行时开销较小。
Conclusion: 摘要表明内部注意力熵信号可以作为 VLA 自评估的有效依据，MAE 框架具备跨架构泛化能力。

papers.title: UniTAC: Universal Task-Aware Compression via Weighted Distortion Measures
papers.abstract_en: Physical AI systems such as autonomous vehicles and robots rely on timely exchange of high-dimensional sensory signals under tight bandwidth, latency, and energy budgets. Because the task driving downstream decisions evolves over time, a task-specific codec is brittle and retraining one per task is infeasible in the field. We propose UniTAC, a single learned image codec spanning universal (task-agnostic) to task-specialized operation, re-targeted at runtime without retraining. The task is abstracted as a per-component importance vector, derived, e.g., from gradient attribution of any downstream model, and transmitted as low-overhead side information that conditions both encoder and decoder. Trained once over a broad, randomized family of such vectors against weighted-reconstruction distortion, UniTAC keeps a fixed backbone and a single human-viewable reconstruction whose fidelity is steered to the active task by swapping the injected vector. We analyze the underlying weighted rate-distortion problem, characterizing when a diagonal weighted distortion is task-consistent and how weights relate to task sensitivity. Guided by this, we design a Vision Transformer (ViT) codec whose token-level conditioning natively realizes this weight-driven code. On a localized task at 0.034 bpp, a single UniTAC model reaches 91.4% accuracy, only 1.9% below a task-based codec (93.3%) and above universal codecs (76.9%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniTAC，一个覆盖从通用（task-agnostic）到任务专用（task-specialized）操作范围的单一学习式图像编解码器，可在运行时无需重训练地重新定向目标任务。任务被抽象为逐分量重要性向量（例如由下游模型的梯度归因得到），作为低开销边信息同时条件化编码器和解码器；模型在广泛随机采样的重要性向量族上用加权重建失真训练一次。作者还分析了加权率失真问题，刻画对角加权失真何时与任务一致，并据此设计了基于 Vision Transformer (ViT) 的代码以实现 token 级条件化。
Motivation: 自动驾驶和机器人等物理 AI 系统需要在严格的带宽、延迟与能量预算下及时交换高维感知信号；由于驱动下游决策的任务随时间演变，任务专用编解码器缺乏鲁棒性，且为每个任务现场重训练不可行。
Method: 以逐分量重要性向量抽象任务，该向量可由任意下游模型的梯度归因推导，并作为低开销边信息同时调节编码器和解码器；模型在随机化的权重向量族上针对加权重建失真训练一次。理论上分析加权率失真问题，说明对角加权失真何时与任务一致以及权重如何对应任务敏感度；实际设计采用 ViT 编解码器，通过 token 级条件化天然实现这种权重驱动的编码。
Result: 在 0.034 bpp 的局部任务设定下，单个 UniTAC 模型达到 91.4% 准确率，比任务专用编解码器的 93.3% 仅低 1.9 个百分点，并高于通用编解码器的 76.9%。
Conclusion: 作者强调无需重训练即可在运行时将单一代码重新定向到不同任务，并给出加权失真与任务一致性关系的理论刻画；论文篇幅为 9 页。

papers.title: AnchorScore: A CLIP-Based Diagnostic of MLLM Annotation Difficulty
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are widely used for automated annotation, yet their per-class accuracy varies widely (e.g., 12%-98% across the 13 classes of three classroom sub-datasets) and is expensive to measure: evaluating one 27B MLLM on 5,416 validation images takes roughly 14 hours, whereas a frozen-CLIP pass over the same images completes in about 3 minutes. A low-cost signal for ranking classes by expected MLLM annotation difficulty a priori remains underexplored. Building on the AnchorProxy construct (per-class zero-shot CLIP accuracy) introduced in the companion study, this paper systematically evaluates its full-frame formulation, termed AnchorScore here, as an a priori diagnostic that flags the classes MLLMs are least likely to annotate reliably. On classroom behavior data (SCB5, 13 classes, 6 MLLMs), AnchorScore correlates with per-class MLLM accuracy (Spearman rho = 0.769, p = 0.002, n = 13). None of the alternative difficulty predictors (DINOv2, ResNet-50, SigLIP, or MLLM self-verbalized uncertainty) showed a significant class-level correlation at n = 13. A cross-model consensus control suggests AnchorScore primarily captures a shared class-difficulty factor rather than a CLIP-specific signal. An independent replication on Stanford40 Actions yields a nearly identical effect (rho = 0.817, p < 0.001); the association is strongest on activity-recognition data and attenuates on medical and satellite imagery. Three practical applications follow: a deployable hybrid CLIP/MLLM routing strategy (predicted-class routing: up to +23 pp over CLIP-only at roughly 44% MLLM cost savings), prompt disambiguation on hard classes (exploratory), and review-priority prediction for human verification. AnchorScore does not estimate exact MLLM accuracy; it provides a low-cost ranking signal that directs expensive MLLM evaluation to the classes where it is most informative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AnchorScore，一种基于 frozen-CLIP 每类零样本准确率（AnchorProxy 构造）的低成本先验信号，用于事先排序多模态大语言模型（MLLM）逐类标注的难度。在教室行为数据 SCB5（13 类、6 个 MLLM）上，AnchorScore 与逐类 MLLM 准确率的 Spearman rho 为 0.769（p=0.002, n=13），并在 Stanford40 Actions 上复现出近乎相同的效应（rho=0.817）。作者进一步展示了其在混合 CLIP/MLLM 路由、提示消歧和人工审核优先级预测中的实际用途。
Motivation: MLLM 被广泛用于自动标注，但逐类准确率差异很大（例如三个课堂子数据集的 13 类上从 12% 到 98%），而逐类评测昂贵：评估一个 27B MLLM 在 5,416 张验证图像上约需 14 小时，同一批图像用 frozen-CLIP 仅约 3 分钟。缺少一种先验的低成本信号来对期望的 MLLM 标注难度进行排序。
Method: 系统评估 AnchorScore（companion study 中 AnchorProxy 构造的全帧形式，即每类 zero-shot CLIP 准确率）作为先验诊断指标，并与 DINOv2、ResNet-50、SigLIP 以及 MLLM 自我表述的不确定性等替代难度预测器比较；通过跨模型共识控制检验 AnchorScore 是否主要捕获共享的类别难度因素，并在 Stanford40 Actions 上做独立复现。
Result: SCB5 上 AnchorScore 与逐类 MLLM 准确率显著相关（rho=0.769, p=0.002, n=13），而所有替代预测器在 n=13 时均无显著类别级相关；Stanford40 Actions 复现 rho=0.817（p<0.001）。相关性在活动识别数据上最强，在医学和卫星图像上减弱。实际应用中，predicted-class routing 相比 CLIP-only 最高提升 23 个百分点，同时节省约 44% 的 MLLM 成本。
Conclusion: AnchorScore 并不估计确切的 MLLM 准确率，而是提供低成本的类别排序信号，将昂贵的 MLLM 评测引导到信息量最大的类别上；它主要捕获共享的类别难度因素，而非 CLIP 特有的信号。

papers.title: Hide&Seek: Learning to Explain in an End-to-End Differentiable Network
papers.abstract_en: Instance-wise feature selection is a valuable tool for interpreting labeled data and the predictions of black-box models. In contrast to global feature selection techniques, instance-wise methods dynamically identify important features for each instance. A growing number of methods learn a selector, which identifies important features, and a predictor, which uses these to make predictions. However, these pioneering methods face challenges including information leakage and lack of differentiability, which can slow training. In this paper, we present Hide&Seek, an end-to-end differentiable model for instance-wise feature selection. We jointly learn feature selection and prediction under a single objective without information leakage. Hide&Seek outperforms existing state-of-the-art models across a range of experiments and is fast to train. We achieve this by reformulating feature removal as a differentiable operation where instead of discretely removing features, we replace a proportion of each feature. Training is further stabilized via a parsimony-weight annealing framework.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 12 figures, 16 tables. Accepted at ICML 2026 (PMLR 306). Code at https://github.com/talellinson/hide-and-seek-icml2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hide&Seek，一种端到端可微的实例级特征选择 (instance-wise feature selection) 模型，在单一目标下联合学习选择器 (selector) 与预测器 (predictor)，避免信息泄漏 (information leakage)。其核心是把特征移除重写为可微操作——不是离散地删除特征，而是替换每个特征的一部分比例，并借助 parsimony-weight annealing 稳定训练。摘要称该方法在多项实验中优于现有最先进模型，且训练速度快。
Motivation: 现有的实例级特征选择方法面临信息泄漏和缺乏可微性等问题，导致训练变慢或不稳定；本文针对这一不足提出端到端可微的替代方案。
Method: Hide&Seek 将特征选择与预测联合优化于同一目标函数中；通过按比例替换每个特征而非离散移除，使特征移除过程可微，同时使用 parsimony-weight annealing 框架进一步稳定训练。
Result: 摘要报告 Hide&Seek 在一系列实验中优于现有最先进模型，并且训练速度快。
Conclusion: 本文主张端到端可微、无信息泄漏的实例级特征选择方案能够同时取得良好性能与训练效率；摘要未提及明显局限。

papers.title: Bridging the Gap between Labeled and Unlabeled Data via Unified Flow with Feature Memory Bank
papers.abstract_en: Although semi-supervised semantic segmentation ($\text{S}^4$) utilizes abundant unlabeled data to reduce manual labeling burdens, independent training of labeled and unlabeled data causes the former to dominate, which severely degrades pseudo-label quality. To address this challenges, we propose a novel remote sensing (RS) $\text{S}^4$ method via unified flow with feature memory bank (UFFM). Specifically, UFFM comprises two key innovations: unified flow (UF) and feature memory bank (FMB). The UF is a new training flow that generates less biased pseudo-labels by combining an external visual foundation model (VFM) with an RS domain teacher, and jointly optimizes labeled and pseudo-labeled data under a unified training objective. The FMB is a novel memory module for $\text{S}^4$ that dynamically updates class-specific features during training and reduces the feature discrepancy between labeled and unlabeled data through class-feature alignment. To verify the effectiveness of our model, we conduct extensive experiments on RS datasets. The experimental results show the superiority of our method over SOTA $\text{S}^4$ methods. Moreover, the results demonstrate the effectiveness of our contributions in bridging the optimization and feature representation gap between labeled and unlabeled data. Our code is released at \href{https://github.com/wangshanwen001/RS-UFFM}{https://github.com/wangshanwen001/RS-UFFM}.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向遥感影像的半监督语义分割方法 UFFM，通过统一流 (unified flow) 和特征记忆库 (feature memory bank) 来缓解有标签与无标签数据独立训练导致的伪标签偏差问题。统一流结合外部视觉基础模型 (VFM) 与遥感领域教师生成偏差更小的伪标签，特征记忆库通过类特征对齐缩小两类数据间的特征差异。实验在遥感数据集上验证了该方法优于现有 SOTA 半监督语义分割方法，并公开了代码。

Result: 在遥感数据集上的大量实验显示，该方法优于现有 SOTA 半监督语义分割方法，并验证了其在弥合有标签与无标签数据之间优化与特征表示差距方面的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法通过统一流和特征记忆库有效弥合了有标签与无标签数据之间的优化和特征表示差距，并已发布代码。
