papers.title: Self-Supervised Noise2Noise-Enhanced Denoising for Continuous-Scan Air-Plasma THz Spectroscopy
papers.abstract_en: Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) based on air-plasma generation and balanced air-biased coherent detection offers gap-free broadband coverage, but individual continuous-scan traces are strongly affected by pulse-to-pulse fluctuations and electronic noise. Reaching a useful signal-to-noise ratio therefore requires averaging multiple traces, which directly increases measurement time. We propose a learned denoising approach that recovers high-quality THz waveforms from as few as one complete continuous delay sweep, referred to here as a single-scan trace. A compact one-dimensional residual U-Net is trained using two complementary strategies: a reference-supervised baseline that maps individual noisy traces to long-average reference waveforms, and a Noise2Noise approach that learns from pairs of independently acquired noisy traces without requiring a clean training target. Averaging the predictions of both models reduces systematic bias and yields a trace-reduction factor of approximately $5.4\times$ at $K=1$, meaning that one denoised trace achieves the reconstruction accuracy of averaging approximately five raw traces. The Noise2Noise model alone achieves $4.9\times$, outperforming both the reference-supervised baseline ($4.6\times$) and classical Wiener filtering ($3.2\times$). These results show that self-supervised learning from repeated noisy measurements can support faster continuous-scan THz-TDS without hardware modification.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于空气等离子体产生与平衡空气偏置相干探测的连续扫描太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS）中单次扫描轨迹受脉冲波动和电子噪声影响的问题，提出一种基于学习的去噪方法。作者用紧凑的一维残差 U-Net，结合参考监督（reference-supervised）和 Noise2Noise 两种训练策略，从单次连续延迟扫描中恢复高质量波形。摘要报告将两种模型预测平均后，在 K=1 时达到约 5.4× 的轨迹缩减因子。
Motivation: 连续扫描 THz-TDS 虽能提供无间隙宽带覆盖，但单次轨迹信噪比不足，通常需要多次平均，这会直接增加测量时间；现有信号处理手段如维纳滤波提升有限。
Method: 提出一个紧凑的一维残差 U-Net，训练时采用两种互补策略：一是参考监督基线，将单条含噪轨迹映射到长时间平均参考波形；二是 Noise2Noise 方法，使用独立采集的含噪轨迹对训练，无需干净目标。最终将两个模型的预测取平均以降低系统性偏差。
Result: 在 K=1 时，模型平均后的轨迹缩减因子约为 5.4×，即一条去噪轨迹的精度相当于平均约五条原始轨迹；Noise2Noise 单独达到 4.9×，优于参考监督基线（4.6×）和经典维纳滤波（3.2×）。
Conclusion: 作者认为从重复噪声测量中自监督学习可以在不改动硬件的情况下加速连续扫描 THz-TDS。

papers.title: Decadal wave reconstruction in the Mediterranean Sea with graph neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Accurate simulation and prediction of ocean waves are essential for coastal risk management and climate studies. Deep learning has shown promising results for wave modeling, but most approaches still operate on regular grids and on forecasting time scales, and do not generalize to unstructured discretization or to long time horizons. Here we present WaveGraph, a model based on Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) that emulates basin-scale wave dynamics directly on unstructured meshes with high resolution along the coasts (up to 2-3 km). Trained on bias-corrected simulation data over the Mediterranean Sea, WaveGraph uses a multiscale architecture combining the unstructured model mesh with a uniform graph, allowing simultaneous representation of local coastal interactions and large-scale wave dynamics. The model reconstructs the evolution of significant wave height, mean period, and mean direction, and is applied autoregressively for a continuous 17-year period without reinitialization or drift. Validation against buoy and satellite observations shows skill comparable to the input data set, and ablation experiments indicate that wind forcing drives most of the long-term stability while wave history improves swell-driven and basin-scale dynamics. These results show that GNNs can provide stable and efficient emulators of spectral wave models on unstructured domains, enabling decadal wave reconstructions.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 11+4+2 figures in main+appendix+supplemental material. This work has been submitted to Artificial Intelligence for the Earth Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WaveGraph，一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的波浪模拟器，直接在非结构化网格上模拟地中海盆地尺度的波浪演变，沿海分辨率最高达 2-3 km。模型使用多尺度架构，将非结构模型网格与均匀图结合，在偏差校正的模拟数据上训练，并自回归连续运行 17 年，无重初始化或漂移。验证和消融结果表明其技能可与输入数据集相比，且风强迫对长期稳定性贡献最大。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法大多在规则网格上以预报时间尺度开展波浪建模，难以推广到非结构化离散化和长时间跨度；同时沿海风险管理和气候研究需要高分辨率、长期稳定的波浪重建能力。
Method: WaveGraph 基于 GNN，直接在非结构网格上运行，并通过多尺度架构结合非结构模型网格与均匀图，以同时表征局地沿海相互作用和大尺度波浪动力学。模型输出有效波高、平均周期和平均方向，采用自回归方式应用于连续 17 年，并用消融实验检验风和波浪历史输入的作用。
Result: 摘要报告该模型对浮标和卫星观测的验证技能与输入数据集相当；消融实验表明风强迫主要驱动长期稳定性，而波浪历史可改善涌浪驱动的进程和盆地尺度动力学的重建。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果表明 GNN 能在非结构化域上提供稳定高效的谱波模型模拟器，支持年代际波浪重建，扩展了深度学习波浪建模的适用尺度。

papers.title: HaReCAP: Habitual-action Grounding for Recursive Large Language Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon embodied tasks require LLM agents to iteratively decompose high-level goals, revise plans in response to environmental feedback, and ground leaf-level subgoals into valid executable actions. Recursive context-management methods such as ReCAP improve planning stability through multi-level task decomposition and parent-node refinement, but still repeatedly invoke the LLM at leaf nodes to ground atomic subtasks into exact valid actions. We refer to this final grounding step as last-mile grounding redundancy, which accumulates into substantial LLM-call and token overhead during long-horizon execution. To mitigate this issue, we propose HaReCAP (Habitual-action Grounded ReCAP), a low-intrusion leaf grounding extension for ReCAP. HaReCAP extracts frequent leaf decisions from successful trajectories and compiles them offline into auditable and abstainable one-step leaf-reflex rules. At runtime, it skips the leaf LLM call only when a rule can uniquely determine a legal action in the current valid-action set; otherwise, it falls back to the original ReCAP. This design avoids repeatedly carrying the full recursive context into the LLM for routine leaf action grounding, while preserving the original recursive control flow. We evaluate HaReCAP on Robotouille and ALFWorld with Qwen3.5-27B as the main model. On tasks solved by both ReCAP and HaReCAP, HaReCAP reduces token consumption by 14.67%, 17.93%, and 20.08% on Robotouille synchronous, Robotouille asynchronous, and ALFWorld, respectively. The results show that HaReCAP can serve as a low-intrusion extension to ReCAP-style recursive context-management frameworks, reducing last-mile grounding redundancy across environments and models on commonly successful trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HaReCAP（Habitual-action Grounded ReCAP），作为 ReCAP 的低侵入式扩展，用于减少长 horizon 具身任务中 LLM agent 在叶子节点反复将子目标 grounding 为可执行动作的冗余。HaReCAP 从成功轨迹中离线抽取频繁叶子决策，编译为可审计且可弃权的单步叶子反射规则（leaf-reflex rules）；运行时仅在规则能唯一确定当前合法动作集中的一个动作时跳过叶子 LLM 调用，否则回退到原始 ReCAP。作者在 Robotouille 和 ALFWorld 上以 Qwen3.5-27B 为主模型进行评测。
Motivation: 长 horizon 具身任务中，递归上下文管理方法如 ReCAP 通过多层任务分解和父节点修正提升规划稳定性，但仍会在叶子节点反复调用 LLM 将原子子任务 grounding 为精确合法动作。作者称该最终 grounding 步骤为 last-mile grounding redundancy，会在长周期执行中累积为大量 LLM 调用和 token 开销。
Method: 提出 HaReCAP，从成功轨迹中提取频繁叶子决策并离线编译为可审计、可弃权（abstainable）的单步叶子反射规则；运行时仅当规则能唯一确定当前 valid-action set 中的合法动作时才跳过叶子 LLM 调用，否则回退原始 ReCAP。该设计避免为常规叶子动作 grounding 反复携带完整递归上下文，同时保留原始递归控制流。
Result: 摘要报告，在 ReCAP 和 HaReCAP 均求解的任务上，HaReCAP 使 token 消耗在 Robotouille 同步、Robotouille 异步和 ALFWorld 上分别降低 14.67%、17.93% 和 20.08%。
Conclusion: HaReCAP 可作为 ReCAP 风格递归上下文管理框架的低侵入扩展，在常见成功轨迹上减少跨环境和模型的 last-mile grounding 冗余。摘要强调其不改变递归控制流并具备可审计、可弃权的规则设计。

papers.title: Time to Reason: Scalable Neurosymbolic Learning for LTLf via Fuzzy Semantics
papers.abstract_en: Neurosymbolic (NeSy) Artificial Intelligence aims to integrate Deep Learning (DL) architectures with symbolic reasoning. While initial NeSy approaches have targeted mainly symbolic reasoning in propositional and first-order logics, recent works have started to address the construction of neurosymbolic frameworks for Temporal Logics, and in particular for LTLf. These approaches have established temporal NeSy as a promising research direction, laying the foundations for learning under temporal constraints. Nonetheless, they leave many questions unanswered. From a theoretical perspective, several differentiable semantics for interpreting LTLf have been proposed but have not yet been formally and systematically defined within a unified framework. Moreover, existing approaches commonly rely on automata to represent temporal knowledge, resulting in limited scalability. Motivated by this research gap, this paper provides the following contributions: (i) formally defining different fuzzy semantics for LTLf, and systematically analysing theoretical properties regarding equivalences and dualities of temporal operators; (ii) showing how these semantics can be directly integrated within a novel NeSy framework, called DiffLTLf, enabling flexible and scalable learning without relying on the usage of automata; and (iii) introducing a novel evaluation protocol of increased complexity of learning tasks w.r.t. existing benchmarks. Our results show that the choice of fuzzy semantics has a significant impact on predictive performance. Moreover, DiffLTLf achieves performance on par with, and sometimes superior to, state-of-the-art probabilistic approaches while substantially improving scalability. Taken together, these results establish direct fuzzy interpretations as a competitive and scalable alternative to existing temporal NeSy frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiffLTLf，一个基于模糊语义 (fuzzy semantics) 的神经符号 (neurosymbolic) 学习框架，用于在线性时序逻辑 LTLf (Linear Temporal Logic on finite traces) 约束下进行可扩展学习。作者形式化定义了多种 LTLf 模糊语义，系统分析时序算子的等价性与对偶性，并绕过自动机 (automata) 表示以提升可扩展性。实验表明模糊语义的选择显著影响预测性能，DiffLTLf 的性能与最先进概率方法相当或更优，同时大幅改善可扩展性。
Motivation: 现有神经符号方法主要面向命题逻辑和一阶逻辑，针对 LTLf 的可微语义缺乏统一且系统的形式化框架；同时已有方法普遍依赖自动机表示时序知识，导致可扩展性受限。
Method: 形式化定义 LTLf 的多种模糊语义，并系统分析其时序算子之间的等价与对偶性质；将这些语义直接集成到新框架 DiffLTLf 中，避免使用自动机；同时引入比现有基准复杂度更高的学习任务评测协议。
Result: 模糊语义的选择对预测性能有显著影响；DiffLTLf 在性能上与最先进的概率方法持平或部分超越，并显著提升可扩展性。
Conclusion: 摘要将直接模糊解释确立为现有时序神经符号框架的一种有竞争力且可扩展的替代方案。

papers.title: The Value of a Prompt: An LLM-Relative Kolmogorov-Complexity Approach
papers.abstract_en: In a world where valuable artifacts are increasingly created, completed, or processed by LLMs, the central economic question is not only what the LLM can produce, but what \emph{value} remains in the inputs (i.e., the prompts) we provide to it. Given a prompt, hint, critique, problem statement, or partial solution that helps an LLM produce an artifact $z$---a proof, program, design, or scientific hypothesis---how should we measure the value of that input? Intuitively, an input is valuable when it makes the target artifact easier for the model to generate: either by increasing its sampling probability, or by reducing the thinking time needed to find it. We propose a computational Levin--Kolmogorov complexity approach to this problem, by appropriately replacing the universal Turing machine in the classical definitions by the LLM itself. Concretely, we introduce an LLM-relative notion of \emph{probabilistic Levin--Kolmogorov complexity} $pKt$---treating the model's thinking as the random tape of the program, and charging logarithmically for it in Levin's manner---and define prompt value as algorithmic mutual information with respect to $pKt$. This captures the intuition above: a prompt having $b$ bits of value for an artifact $z$ makes $z$ $2^b$ times ``easier to obtain'', by multiplying the success probability by $2^b$, by dividing the required computation by $2^b$, or by any corresponding tradeoff between probability and computation. In contrast to the classical notion of algorithmic mutual information, ours is efficiently estimable. We additionally show that, under a natural reproduction experiment, a prompt value of \(b\) bits means that reproducing \(z\) without the prompt has median token cost \(2^b\) times that of reproducing it with the prompt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种LLM相对的概率Levin-Kolmogorov复杂度pKt，用于度量提示（prompt）对LLM生成目标产物z的价值。作者将模型自身的思考过程视为随机带，并按Levin方式对数计费，定义提示价值为相对于pKt的算法互信息；该定义使b比特价值的提示将产物的可获得难度降低2^b倍（可体现为成功概率倍增、所需计算量减半或二者的权衡）。摘要还证明该复杂度可被有效估计，并给出一个复制实验的理论结果。
Motivation: 在LLM日益参与创造和加工有价值产物的背景下，核心经济问题不仅在于模型能生成什么，还在于输入（提示、hint、critique等）本身保留了多少价值。经典算法互信息虽然符合直觉但不可有效估计，需要一种可计算的输入价值度量。
Method: 用LLM替换经典定义中的通用图灵机，构造概率Levin-Kolmogorov复杂度pKt：把模型思考当作程序的随机带，并用Levin方式对思考时间取对数计入复杂度。提示价值定义为关于pKt的算法互信息，从而统一刻画提示通过提升采样概率、减少计算量或两者折衷对生成难度的贡献。
Result: 摘要指出，与经典算法互信息不同，所提出的LLM相对复杂度可高效估计；在自然设计的复制实验中，b比特提示价值意味着无提示复制z的中位token成本是有提示时的2^b倍。
Conclusion: 该工作为提示的经济价值提供形式化且可计算的度量，把直觉上“提示使目标更容易获得”转化为概率与计算之间的量化折衷关系。

papers.title: Drive, Pack, Fly: The Travelling Thief Problem with Drone
papers.abstract_en: In collection operations, accumulating payload progressively slows the vehicle, imposing a cumulative penalty on routing efficiency. An onboard drone can offset this penalty by retrieving outlying items, thereby shortening the makespan and increasing operational profit. However, travel time remains load-dependent, and each item collected by the ground vehicle shifts the arrival times that govern the drone's launch and rendezvous points. This paper introduces the Travelling Thief Problem with Drone (TTP-D), which maximises the collected profit, net of a time-based rental cost, by jointly optimising item selection, vehicle routing, and flight synchronisation. We formulate a mixed-integer linear program that solves small instances to optimality, and develop both metaheuristics and an attention-based Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) policy for larger instances. We further propose a learner-initialised hybrid solver, in which the DRL policy constructs an initial solution that a short annealing run subsequently refines. On two benchmark sets, this hybrid recovers most of the metaheuristic baseline's quality at a fraction of its computational budget, although the largest instances still require the baseline at its full budget. Finally, a sensitivity analysis reveals that the rental ratio is the primary driver of profitability, whereas the fleet parameters affect profit only at the margin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出旅行小偷问题的一个新变体 TTP-D（Travelling Thief Problem with Drone），其中地面车辆载重增加会拖慢行驶，因此引入无人机收集外围物品以缩短 makespan 并提高利润，同时联合优化物品选择、车辆路径与飞行同步。作者建立了混合整数线性规划（MILP）求解小规模实例至最优，并为大规模实例开发了元启发式算法和基于注意力的深度强化学习（DRL）策略，还提出一种学习器初始化的混合求解器：先用 DRL 策略构造初始解，再由短程退火精化。
Motivation: 收集作业中携带的载荷会逐步降低车辆速度，对路径效率产生累积惩罚；无人机虽能通过收集外围物品抵消部分惩罚，但地面车辆收集每个物品后到达时间会改变，进而影响无人机的发射与会合点调度。现有研究缺乏对这种载荷依赖行驶时间与无人机飞行同步联合优化的建模。
Method: 将问题形式化为最大化净收益（总收集利润减去基于时间的租赁成本）的混合整数线性规划；针对大实例提出两类求解方法：元启发式算法和基于注意力的深度强化学习（DRL）策略。进一步设计学习器初始化的混合求解器，由 DRL 生成初始解后接短退火（annealing）精化。
Result: 在两个基准集上，混合求解器能以远低于元启发式基线的计算预算恢复其大部分解质量，但最大规模实例仍需基线在完整预算下运行。敏感性分析显示，租赁比例（rental ratio）是盈利能力的主要驱动因素，而车队参数对利润的影响仅为边际水平。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的混合求解器在多数实例上能兼顾解质量与效率，但超大规模实例仍依赖昂贵的元启发式基线；租赁成本结构比车队规模等因素对利润影响更关键。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Localized TabICLv2: Scaling Tabular In-Context Learning through k-NN
papers.abstract_en: Foundational models for tabular data have made significant progress in recent years, with TabICLv2 reporting state-of-the-art performance on several tabular classification tasks. However, full-context tabular ICL still suffers from attention cost that grows with the training-context size, which limits its ability to handle large datasets efficiently. Localized TabICLv2 introduces a method that reduces the inference cost of TabICLv2 by retrieving only the k nearest training neighbours for each test point, measured by similarity in the model's Stage 2 row-representation space, rather than using the full training context. This requires no architectural changes, and we show that accuracy retention can be improved through additional Stage 2 and Stage 3 fine-tuning. On TabArena classification tasks, the fine-tuned localized model retains 98.64% of Full TabICLv2 accuracy and it achieves a median 2.18$\times$ speedup in batch inference, and reaches approximately 249$\times$ median speedup in the single-query serving setting.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2nd ICML Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data (FMSD), ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Localized TabICLv2，通过在模型 Stage 2 的行表示空间中为每个测试点检索 k 个最近邻训练样本，而非使用完整训练上下文，来降低 TabICLv2 的推理成本。该方法无需改变架构，并可通过 Stage 2 和 Stage 3 的额外微调提升精度保留。在 TabArena 分类任务上，微调后的局部化模型保留 Full TabICLv2 的 98.64% 精度，批量推理中位加速 2.18 倍，单查询服务场景中位加速约 249 倍。
Motivation: 表格数据基础模型 TabICLv2 虽在多个分类任务上达到先进水平，但全上下文表格上下文学习 (in-context learning) 的注意力成本随训练上下文规模增长，限制了其高效处理大数据集的能力。
Method: 提出 Localized TabICLv2：对每个测试点，仅检索其与训练样本在模型 Stage 2 行表示空间中的 k 个最近邻作为上下文，替代完整训练集进行推理；不改变模型架构，并利用额外的 Stage 2 与 Stage 3 微调来提升精度保留。
Result: 在 TabArena 分类任务上，经过微调的局部化模型保留 Full TabICLv2 的 98.64% 精度，批量推理中位加速 2.18 倍，单查询 (single-query) 服务场景中位加速约 249 倍。
Conclusion: 作者表明通过 k 近邻检索实现局部化上下文可以在几乎不损失精度的情况下大幅降低表格 ICL 的推理成本。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Visualizing Uncertainty-to-Action Composition for Human Oversight
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence systems often disclose uncertainty, yet they rarely make clear what response that uncertainty should trigger. Most uncertainty visualizations encode uncertainty in model outputs, leaving users to discern the most appropriate course of action. A second region of the design space--uncertainty in the decision process itself, including how multiple uncertainty conditions compose into an oversight response-- remains comparatively underexplored. We address this gap with two coupled contributions. First, we introduce an uncertainty-to-action binding framework that composes multiple uncertainty conditions into a single oversight response under a precedence policy with a contextual safety modifier. That response concerns whether and how an AI-supported decision may proceed, not the substantive domain decision itself. Second, we present ActionCue, a process-transparency visualization that renders that composition explicit. We demonstrate the approach through a three-way comparison with confidence-only and data-level uncertainty displays, using worked cases from healthcare, credit assessment, and disaster forecasting. Together, the framework specifies how uncertainty conditions are resolved into an oversight response, and the visualization makes that resolution inspectable rather than implicit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AI 系统中不确定性可视化只关注模型输出、未澄清不确定性应触发何种监督响应的问题，提出 uncertainty-to-action 绑定框架与 ActionCue 过程透明可视化。该框架在优先级策略 (precedence policy) 和情境安全修正 (contextual safety modifier) 下将多个不确定性条件组合成单一监督响应，且该响应只决定 AI 支持决策能否推进及如何推进，而非领域实质决策本身。作者通过医疗、信贷评估和灾害预测三类工作示例，将 ActionCue 与仅置信度显示和数据级不确定性显示进行三方比较来演示方法。
Motivation: AI 系统常展示不确定性，却很少说明该不确定性应触发什么行动；现有不确定性可视化大多只编码模型输出的不确定性，用户仍需自行判断合适行动。作者指出决策过程本身的不确定性、以及多个不确定性条件如何组合成监督响应，是相对未被充分探索的设计空间。
Method: 提出 uncertainty-to-action 绑定框架，在优先级策略与情境安全修正下把多个不确定性条件组合为单一监督响应；并设计 ActionCue，一种过程透明可视化，把该组合过程显式呈现出来。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验指标；演示方式是通过医疗、信贷评估和灾害预测的工作示例，将所提方法与仅置信度显示和数据级不确定性显示进行三方比较。
Conclusion: 作者认为框架给出了不确定性条件如何被解析为监督响应的规范，ActionCue 使该解析过程可被检查而非隐含。

papers.title: ParaTempo: Efficient Parallel Reasoning via Temporal Confidence
papers.abstract_en: Parallel reasoning improves the accuracy and robustness of large reasoning models by exploring multiple solution paths, but its computational cost grows with reasoning depth and branch count. Existing methods for managing these parallel paths typically rely on final-answer consensus, local token confidence, or isolated intermediate probes. However, these signals are often delayed, weakly tied to actual reasoning progress, or too noisy for dynamic, branch-level control. To address these limitations, we introduce ParaTempo, a training-free asynchronous parallel reasoning framework. ParaTempo is driven by temporal confidence, a branch-local measure of answer-space convergence. Each branch is periodically probed for a tentative answer probability distribution, and temporal confidence quantifies how sharply the recent intermediate probes concentrate on a dominant answer. Once sufficient evidence has accumulated, ParaTempo drives its entire control process from this single signal: low-confidence branches are pruned, branches that persistently commit to their dominant answer are retired early, freed computation is reallocated by forking new branches, and generation stops globally once the confidence-weighted vote concentrates. Without requiring synchronization among reasoning trajectories, ParaTempo adaptively allocates computation based on branch-level convergence. Experiments on challenging mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks show that ParaTempo reduces average latency by 21.8-32.2% and total token usage by 18.1-30.3% while maintaining competitive accuracy. Moreover, temporal confidence exhibits stronger temporal stability and predictive power for future branch convergence than token-level and instantaneous signals.
papers.comment: Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/ScottZhang812/ParaTempo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ParaTempo 是一个无需训练的异步并行推理框架，用 temporal confidence（时间置信度）度量各分支的答案空间收敛程度，并据此进行剪枝、提前退役、分支分叉与全局停止控制。在数学与科学推理基准上，该方法在保持竞争力的准确率的同时，将平均延迟降低 21.8-32.2%，总 token 使用量降低 18.1-30.3%。
Motivation: 并行推理通过探索多条解题路径提升准确率，但计算成本随推理深度和分支数增长；已有的路径管理信号（最终答案共识、局部 token 置信度、孤立中间探针）往往延迟、与实际推理进度关联弱或噪声过大，难以用于动态分支级控制。
Method: ParaTempo 不依赖训练，采用异步并行推理框架。每个分支周期性地被探询暂定答案的概率分布，temporal confidence 量化近期中间探针在某个主导答案上的集中程度；当证据累积后，框架仅凭该信号驱动控制：剪枝低置信分支、提前退役持续承诺主导答案的分支、通过分叉新分支重新分配计算，并在置信加权投票集中时全局停止。
Result: 在具有挑战性的数学和科学推理基准上，ParaTempo 平均延迟降低 21.8-32.2%，总 token 使用量降低 18.1-30.3%，同时保持有竞争力的准确率；temporal confidence 在时间稳定性和对未来分支收敛的预测力上强于 token 级与瞬时信号。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，基于分支局部答案收敛的单信号控制机制可以在无需同步推理轨迹的情况下自适应分配计算，并以更低的推理开销维持准确率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在具有挑战性的数学和科学推理基准上，ParaTempo 平均延迟降低 21.8-32.2%，总 token 使用量降低 18.1-30.3%，同时保持有竞争力的准确率；temporal confidence 在时间稳定性和对未来分支收敛的预测力上强于 token 级与瞬时信号。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明，基于分支局部答案收敛的单信号控制机制可以在无需同步推理轨迹的情况下自适应分配计算，并以更低的推理开销维持准确率。

papers.title: Joint Flow Matching Enables Continuous Dose-Conditioned Cell Morphing
papers.abstract_en: Generative modeling has shown increasing promise for predicting cellular perturbation effects under chemical compound treatments. Existing approaches either model perturbation as a distribution-to-distribution mapping without explicit concentration handling, or treat concentration as a discrete class label, precluding continuous dose control. We introduce a joint flow matching approach that simultaneously models cell latents and drug concentration via a dual-timestep formulation, enabling dose-conditioned single-cell morphing through the invertibility of flow matching. The joint formulation induces a monotonic dose-response geometry in latent space and additionally supports concentration estimation from cell morphology. As proof of concept, we further demonstrate generalization to an unseen dose held out during training. Empirically, our method achieves competitive or improved per-concentration metrics on two compounds compared with representative baselines, while enabling capabilities structurally unavailable to discrete-class methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种联合流匹配 (joint flow matching) 方法，用于在化学药物处理下进行剂量条件化的单细胞形态生成。该方法通过双时间步长 (dual-timestep) 公式同时建模细胞隐变量与药物浓度，利用流匹配的可逆性实现连续的剂量控制，并支持从形态估计浓度。摘要报告该方法在两个化合物上的每浓度指标达到与基线相当或更优的结果，并能泛化到训练时未见的剂量。
Motivation: 现有生成模型预测细胞扰动效应时，要么只建模分布到分布的映射而未显式处理浓度，要么把浓度当作离散类别标签，无法实现连续的剂量控制。
Method: 提出联合流匹配方法，用双时间步长公式同时建模细胞隐变量和药物浓度，依赖流匹配的可逆性实现剂量条件化的单细胞形态变换，并在潜在空间中诱导单调的剂量-反应几何结构。
Result: 在两种化合物上的每浓度指标达到与代表性基线相当或更优的水平，并且证明了对训练中未见过剂量的泛化能力；此外还支持从细胞形态估计浓度，这是离散类别方法结构上无法实现的能力。
Conclusion: 摘要认为联合流匹配为连续剂量条件下的细胞形态生成提供了一种可行方案，其能力（如浓度估计与未见剂量泛化）超出了离散类别方法，但实验仅以两种化合物作为概念验证。

papers.title: Reasoning-supported Robustness Validation of Automotive E/E Components
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an ontology-supported approach to tackle the complexity of the Robustness Validation (RV) process of automotive electrical/electronic (E/E) components. The approach uses formalized knowledge from the RV process and stress, operating, and load profiles, so-called Mission Profiles (MPs). In contrast to the error-prone industrially established manual procedure, we show how component characteristics are formalized in OWL in order to form the foundation of an efficient automated analysis selection and decision support during the RV process. The proposed approach is based on the idea of mapping MPs to an OWL representation so to allow to perform semantic queries against MP data to improve their integration into the RV process. The resulting ontology-supported application framework has been applied to an industrial use-case from automotive power electronics. We present experimental results showing that the RV process can be significantly improved in terms of reduced design time and increased exhaustiveness by automating the analyses selection step and the provisioning of all the relevant data to be used.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于本体 (ontology) 的框架来支持汽车 E/E 组件的鲁棒性验证 (Robustness Validation, RV) 过程。作者将 RV 过程中的组件特性与任务剖面 (Mission Profiles, MPs) 用 OWL 形式化表示，通过对 MP 数据进行语义查询来辅助分析选择和数据准备。该框架在汽车电力电子的工业用例上验证，结果显示可缩短设计时间并提高验证的完备性。
Motivation: 工业上 E/E 组件的 RV 过程高度依赖人工规程，复杂且易出错；需要更系统的方式来处理来自应力、运行和负载剖面的知识，以提升分析选择的效率和集成度。
Method: 将任务剖面映射到 OWL 表示，把组件特性形式化，并基于语义查询对 MP 数据执行推理，从而在 RV 过程中提供自动化的分析选择与决策支持。
Result: 在汽车电力电子工业用例上的实验表明，自动化分析选择步骤并集中提供相关数据可以显著减少设计时间并提高验证的穷尽性 (exhaustiveness)。
Conclusion: 作者认为该本体支持的框架能够使 RV 过程更高效，重点在于用形式化知识替代易错的人工流程，并改善任务剖面数据在验证流程中的集成。

papers.title: PertMind: Eliciting Emergent Biological Reasoning in LLM via Reinforcement Learning on Cellular Perturbation Data
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can describe mechanisms, yet scalable post-training still depends on costly, manually curated biological reasoning traces. Here we show that cellular perturbation atlases can instead become reinforcement-learning environments, where measured gene responses provide computable rewards for biological reasoning. We introduce PertMind, which combines trusted-trajectory supervised initialization with gene-, pathway-, and format-level reinforcement signals. Trained only on forward perturbation-response prediction, PertMind improved response inference in unseen cellular contexts while retaining general language capabilities. It also transferred without task-specific post-training to reverse perturbation identification, double-perturbation reasoning, phenotypic-screen prioritization, and biological-process interpretation. PertMind further generated biological profiles that supported competitive gene, cell, and donor representations across multiscale downstream tasks. These results support the hypothesis that reinforcement on experimental endpoints can concentrate reusable biological strategies already accessible to pretrained models. More broadly, perturbation-derived reinforcement learning offers a scalable route for transforming expanding experimental atlases into training environments for general-purpose biological reasoning.
papers.comment: Project page: https://shapsider.github.io/PertMind/ Code: https://github.com/shapsider/PertMind Model: https://huggingface.co/tzcfly/PertMind
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PertMind，将细胞扰动图谱 (cellular perturbation atlases) 转化为强化学习环境，以实测基因响应作为可计算奖励来训练大语言模型的生物推理能力。模型先用可信轨迹监督初始化，再加入基因、通路和格式层面的强化信号；仅在正向扰动-响应预测上训练后，即可泛化到逆向扰动识别、双扰动推理、表型筛选等未见任务。作者认为这支持“对实验端点做强化学习可以集中预训练模型中已有的可复用生物策略”这一假设。
Motivation: 大语言模型能描述生物机制，但可扩展的后训练仍依赖昂贵且人工整理的生物推理轨迹 (reasoning traces)；缺乏从不断扩大的实验数据中规模化获得监督信号的训练环境。
Method: 提出 PertMind，把细胞扰动图谱作为强化学习环境，结合可信轨迹监督初始化 (trusted-trajectory supervised initialization) 与基因、通路、格式三个层面的强化信号，仅以前向扰动-响应预测作为训练任务。
Result: 摘要报告称该方法在未见细胞上下文中改善了响应推断，同时保留通用语言能力；无需任务特定后训练即可迁移到逆向扰动识别、双扰动推理、表型筛选优先级排序和生物过程解释；生成的生物 profiles 在多尺度下游任务中支持有竞争力的基因、细胞和供体表示。
Conclusion: 扰动来源的强化学习为将扩张中的实验图谱转化为通用生物推理训练环境提供了一条可扩展路线；作者强调其训练信号仅来自前向响应预测，跨任务迁移是在无任务特定后训练的情况下实现的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evolving Executable Pipeline Programs for AutoML with Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Automated machine learning (AutoML) systems search for pipelines within a space of preprocessing operators, learners, and hyper-parameters specified in advance: they can select and tune known components, but cannot produce structure outside that space. We present LACE, an AutoML framework that instead searches over complete executable pipeline programs: an evolutionary loop maintains a population of scikit-learn-compatible Python classes, and a large language model acts as the variation operator. To our knowledge, LACE is the first to formulate general tabular pipeline AutoML this way, evaluated on standardized OpenML tasks under a leakage-controlled protocol that withholds dataset identity from the generator. Because every candidate is ordinary Python, the returned pipeline and the search that produced it can be inspected and edited directly, rather than only through a framework's model objects. On 68 OpenML classification tasks, LACE with GPT-5.4-mini significantly outperforms auto-sklearn, H2O, and a fixed XGBoost baseline, with no detectable difference against AutoGluon, the strongest search-based system evaluated, while covering the full benchmark. Newer tabular foundation models are more accurate on the subset of tasks they support, but apply a fixed pretrained predictor rather than returning an editable task-specific program. LACE's contribution is therefore not raw accuracy but a search space defined by code: complete coverage, pipelines practitioners can reuse directly, and a component set extended by editing the prompt rather than the framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LACE，一个将 AutoML 搜索空间定义为完整可执行 pipeline 程序的框架：进化循环维护一组 scikit-learn 兼容的 Python 类，由大语言模型充当变异算子。作者称这是在通用表格 pipeline AutoML 上的首次此类形式化，并在 68 个 OpenML 分类任务上以隔离泄漏、不向生成器提供数据集身份的方式进行评估。LACE 返回的 pipeline 是普通 Python 代码，可直接检查与修改，其贡献被定位为代码定义的搜索空间而非原始精度。
Motivation: 现有 AutoML 系统只能在预先指定的预处理算子、学习器和超参数空间中选择与调优已有组件，无法产生该空间之外的结构。LACE 针对这一局限，希望直接搜索完整的可执行 pipeline 程序，从而获得更广的覆盖和可复用、可编辑的结果。
Method: LACE 采用进化循环维护一个由 scikit-learn 兼容 Python 类组成的种群，并用大语言模型作为变异算子生成新的候选 pipeline。评估采用泄漏控制协议，向生成器隐藏数据集身份；由于每个候选都是普通 Python 代码，用户可以直接检查、编辑返回的 pipeline，并通过修改 prompt 来扩展组件集，而不是修改框架本身。
Result: 在 68 个 OpenML 分类任务上，使用 GPT-5.4-mini 的 LACE 显著优于 auto-sklearn、H2O 和固定 XGBoost 基线，并与最强搜索式系统 AutoGluon 无可检测差异，同时覆盖完整基准。较新的表格基础模型在其支持的任务子集上更准确，但使用固定的预训练预测器，返回的是不可编辑的通用模型而非任务特定程序。
Conclusion: 作者强调 LACE 的贡献不是原始精度，而是由代码定义的搜索空间：完整的基准覆盖、可直接复用的机器学习 pipeline，以及通过编辑 prompt 而非框架完成的组件扩展。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Towards Risk-free AI Agent Deployment
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents are rapidly moving from research prototypes into the core business processes of organizations, but these agents pose deployment risks to security, compliance, and functionality. In this article, we argue that risk-free deployment must be grounded in the agent's trajectory: the recorded sequence of reasoning steps, tool invocations, and environmental observations. Trajectories are available for any agent, and many failures are visible only in the trajectory. To make agents deployable and sustainable, we advocate agent testing and debugging as a systematic research direction for detecting and mitigating these risks. This article begins with the challenges of testing agents, including the oracle problem, non-determinism, trajectory validation, and the absence of adequacy metrics. We then turn to debugging agents, from automated failure attribution to repair and self-evolution. We distill these directions into a practical deployment-readiness checklist covering the full deployment lifecycle. Finally, we identify open problems, i.e., formal adequacy metrics, root-cause attribution over long-horizon trajectories, and the reliability of self-evolving agents, that the community must address to enable trustworthy agent deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇观点/路线图文章，主张以智能体的轨迹（trajectory，即推理步骤、工具调用与环境观测的序列）为基础来实现 LLM 智能体的无风险部署。作者将智能体测试与调试（agent testing and debugging）提为系统性的研究方向，用于检测和缓解安全、合规与功能风险。文章梳理了测试中的 oracle 问题、非确定性、轨迹验证与充分性指标缺失，以及调试中的失败归因、修复与自演化，并给出部署就绪检查清单和开放问题。
Motivation: LLM 智能体正从研究原型快速进入组织核心业务流程，但在安全性、合规性和功能性上带来部署风险；许多失败只在轨迹中可见，而现有方法缺乏系统化的保障手段。
Method: 提出以轨迹为中心的研究框架：先分析智能体测试的挑战（oracle 问题、非确定性、轨迹验证、缺乏充分性度量），再转向调试（自动失败归因、修复与自演化），并将这些方向整理为覆盖部署全生命周期的部署就绪检查清单。
Result: 摘要未报告实证结果；本文属于研究议程与问题定义类工作，主要输出是概念框架、检查清单及对开放问题的识别。
Conclusion: 作者指出社区必须解决三个开放问题才能实现可信的智能体部署：形式化充分性度量、长时程轨迹上的根因归因，以及自演化智能体的可靠性。

papers.title: TRACE-CASH: Trial-History-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Configuration Exploration in Time-Series CASH
papers.abstract_en: Combined algorithm selection and hyperparameter optimization (CASH) searches a conditional space in which the selected model determines which hyperparameters are active. In time-series forecasting, temporal choices, chronological validation, and costly evaluations further complicate this search. Controlled comparisons of heterogeneous search methods under a shared time-series CASH (TS-CASH) evaluation protocol remain limited. Within this setting, we study TRACECASH, a task-local hybrid sequential optimizer combining grouped actor-critic candidate generation with fixed rules for model coverage, validation-guided exploitation, and exploration after stalled progress. A model actor proposes an initial forecasting model; three model-conditioned actors generate temporal, architectural, and training actions; and a modelspecific decoder constructs the configuration ultimately evaluated. We compare TRACE-CASH with six alternatives spanning random, Bayesian, evolutionary, multi-objective, and language-model-assisted search across 41 dataset-frequency task variants. TRACE-CASH has the lowest mean rank on both MASE and WQL. Descriptively, it also has the lowest window-averaged test-MASE rank in the predefined full and late windows. These results support the complete TRACECASH procedure as competitive among the evaluated methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究时间序列场景下的组合算法选择与超参数优化（CASH），提出 TRACE-CASH，一种将分组 actor-critic 候选生成与固定规则结合的任务局部混合序列优化器。摘要报告在 41 个数据集-频率任务变体上与六种搜索方法（随机、贝叶斯、进化、多目标、语言模型辅助）对比，TRACE-CASH 在 MASE 和 WQL 上平均秩最低，完整流程具有竞争力。
Motivation: 时间序列预测中的 CASH 面临条件搜索空间、时间性选择、时序验证和昂贵评估等困难，而现有异构搜索方法在统一时间序列 CASH（TS-CASH）评估协议下的受控对比仍然有限。
Method: TRACE-CASH 采用任务局部混合顺序优化：一个模型 actor 提出初始预测模型，三个模型条件 actor 分别生成时间、架构和训练动作，再由模型特定解码器构造最终评估配置；同时用固定规则保证模型覆盖、利用验证指导搜索并在停滞时进行探索。
Result: 与六种替代方法在 41 个数据集-频率任务变体上比较，TRACE-CASH 在 MASE 和 WQL 上取得最低平均秩；在预定义的完整窗口和晚期窗口中，其窗口平均 test-MASE 秩也最低。
Conclusion: 摘要认为结果支持完整的 TRACE-CASH 流程在被评估方法中具有竞争力，但未声称超越所有方法的绝对优势。

papers.title: SoftModel: A Neural Model That Grows Its Own Topology -- Governed Structural Growth for Continual In-Service Learning
papers.abstract_en: Today, a neural system is almost always used in two phases -- trained, then deployed -- and in that regime it freezes twice: training ends, and the topology itself was never a degree of freedom. We take the opposite premise as an axiom -- total plasticity: no part of a model, including its structure, is ever frozen -- and derive the governance a lifelong learner then requires. The design's target regime is continual, in-service learning: a long-lived model on a non-stationary stream, whose stability comes from governance rather than immobility and whose capacity follows demand. The result is a growable soft model: an algebra of structural operators (width, hierarchy, composition, input interface, grown cycles, attention heads), each exact at application, budgeted, and audited, with adoption decided solely by a held-out reality gate that treats parametric and structural change uniformly. A complete from-scratch system realizes the whole account; its factory surface is operated end-to-end by a production LLM. Two conclusions follow from the axiom by construction: stability under lifelong change becomes an audit property of the lifecycle, and structure that follows demand removes the silent cap a fixed topology places on later capability where the capacity floor binds. A third is measured: in the worlds where this was measured, the marginal value of new capacity was unobservable before adoption, so workable growth governance took its ex-post form. The same governance extends to evaluative signals, and the core method is evaluated on standard continual-learning benchmarks, where governed growth preserves the ability to keep learning along long task sequences. A pre-registered experimental program adjudicates the mechanism and value claims on the tested problems and reports its failures at full prominence; the map -- positive and negative -- is the contribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种拓扑可生长的软模型（SoftModel），以“完全可塑”为公理，主张模型的任何部分（包括结构）都不应冻结，并通过结构算子（宽度、层级、组合、输入接口、增长环、注意力头）和held-out现实门控（reality gate）来实现持续的在线学习。系统宣称由生产级LLM端到端操作，并在标准持续学习基准上评估受治理的增长对长任务序列学习能力的影响。
Motivation: 当前神经系统的典型范式是“先训练、后部署”，这导致模型两次冻结：训练结束和拓扑本身从未成为自由度。作者认为这种固定拓扑会在容量受限时对后续能力形成隐性上限，因此需要一种以治理而非静止来保证稳定性的终身学习机制。
Method: 提出增长式软模型：定义一套结构算子代数，每种算子在应用时精确、受预算约束且可审计；新增结构是否被采纳仅由独立的held-out现实门控决定，该门控统一对待参数变化和结构变化。系统从零构建，并由生产级LLM端到端操作其工厂表面。
Result: 摘要报告在标准持续学习基准上，受治理的增长保持了沿长任务序列继续学习的能力。此外，测量发现：在已测试的世界中，新容量的边际价值在采纳前不可观测，因此可行的增长治理采用事后（ex-post）形式。预注册实验程序同时报告成功与失败。
Conclusion: 作者从公理推出两个结论：终身变化下的稳定性成为生命周期的审计属性，结构随需求变化可移除固定拓扑对后期能力的容量上限。第三个结论是测量性的：增长治理需要事后形式。论文强调正负结果的全景图本身是贡献。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: POI Recommendation with LLM-Augmented Multi-Graph Learning and Contrastive Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Point-of-interest (POI) recommendation models based on graph neural networks achieve strong performance by propagating collaborative signals over user-item interactions, yet they struggle with the cold-start problem, where items with few or no interactions are not represented. In this paper, we propose LLM-augmented Multi-Graph Contrastive Learning (LLM-MGCL), a multi-graph neural network that uses semantic and spatial information about items to extend the LightGCN backbone with two auxiliary item-item graphs: a semantic graph constructed from sentence embeddings of LLM-generated photo summaries and keywords, and a geographic graph derived from Haversine distances between business locations. Item embeddings are propagated over all three graphs in parallel, fused additively, and aligned across views through a bidirectional InfoNCE contrastive objective that connects behavioral, semantic, and spatial representations of the same items. Experiments on the Yelp Multimodal Recommendation Dataset show that LLM-MGCL outperforms classical collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, and interaction-only graph neural network baselines. It improves Recall@20 by 52.0% and NDCG@20 by 64.8% over LightGCN while performing on par with the strongest contrastive baseline, Self-supervised Graph Learning (SGL), which is also affected by the cold-start problem. An ablation study reveals that the cross-view contrastive alignment (CA) is the primary driver of these gains, with the best performance achieved when all three graphs are combined. Our results suggest that externally grounded, LLM-derived item knowledge can effectively compensate for missing collaborative signal and mitigate the item cold-start problem in POI recommendation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LLM 增强的多图对比学习模型 LLM-MGCL，用于解决 POI 推荐的冷启动问题。该方法在 LightGCN 骨干上加入两个辅助 item-item 图：由 LLM 生成的图片摘要与关键词的句子嵌入构成的语义图，以及基于 Haversine 距离的地理图，并引入双向 InfoNCE 对比目标对齐行为、语义与空间表征。在 Yelp 多模态推荐数据集上，Recall@20 较 LightGCN 提升 52.0%，NDCG@20 提升 64.8%，并与同样受冷启动影响的强对比基线 SGL 表现相当。
Motivation: 基于图神经网络的 POI 推荐通过传播用户-物品交互上的协同信号取得强性能，但对交互极少或无交互的物品难以建模，存在物品冷启动问题。
Method: 提出 LLM-MGCL，将 LightGCN 扩展为多图结构：除行为图外，构造基于 LLM 生成摘要和关键词的句子嵌入的语义图，以及基于业务位置间 Haversine 距离的地理图；物品嵌入在三张图上并行传播后加性融合，并通过双向 InfoNCE 对比损失对齐同一物品在不同视图下的表示。
Result: 在 Yelp Multimodal Recommendation Dataset 上，LLM-MGCL 优于经典协同过滤、矩阵分解和仅用交互的 GNN 基线，Recall@20 较 LightGCN 提升 52.0%，NDCG@20 提升 64.8%；与最强对比基线 SGL 表现相当。消融研究表明跨视图对比对齐是增益的主要来源，三图组合时性能最佳。
Conclusion: 作者认为外部来源且由 LLM 推导的物品知识可以有效弥补缺失的协同信号，缓解 POI 推荐中的物品冷启动问题。

papers.title: Convergence Analysis of Statistical Inverse Problems on Reproducing Kernel Banach Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Statistical inverse problems have garnered significant attention in recent years due to the growing importance of statistical learning theory and functional analytic approaches in the fields of machine learning and artificial intelligence. In this paper, we investigate the stable approximation of the element $u^{\dagger}$ that satisfies the equation $Au = g$, where $A$ is a linear operator that maps a Banach space into an appropriate function space. The function $g$ is observed only through independently and identically distributed data points that are corrupted by noise and assumed to follow an unknown distribution $ρ$. We employ the Tikhonov regularization scheme, leveraging statistical learning techniques and the framework of reproducing kernel Banach spaces to estimate the solution. We establish convergence and derive the convergence rate of the estimated solution with respect to the true solution as the number of data points increases, with the rate expressed in probabilistic terms. The theoretical findings are further supported by numerical experiments that demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Complexity, Volume 95, 2026, 102050
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究统计逆问题中未知解的稳定逼近，考虑线性算子 A 将 Banach 空间映到函数空间、方程 Au=g 中的 g 仅能通过独立同分布且含噪的数据点观测的情形。作者在再生核 Banach 空间 (reproducing kernel Banach spaces) 框架下采用 Tikhonov 正则化并结合统计学习技术估计解，建立了随样本量增大时估计解收敛到真解的概率意义下的收敛性及收敛率，并用数值实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
Motivation: 统计逆问题在统计学习理论与函数分析视角下的机器学习/人工智能中日益重要，但基于含噪离散观测对 Banach 空间中的方程解进行稳定逼近并给出收敛保证仍值得深入研究。
Method: 采用 Tikhonov 正则化方案，以再生核 Banach 空间为框架，利用统计学习技术从独立同分布、带有噪声且服从未知分布 ρ 的观测数据中估计满足 Au=g 的解 u†，并在概率意义下分析估计解随样本量增加趋于真实解的收敛性。
Result: 摘要报告建立了估计解关于真实解的收敛性，并给出了以概率形式表述的收敛率；数值实验进一步展示了所提方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为统计逆问题在再生核 Banach 空间上的正则化估计提供了收敛性理论支持，并通过数值实验印证了理论结果。

papers.title: A Policy Algebra for Trust-Preserving Agentic AI Execution
papers.abstract_en: Large language model-based agentic frameworks primarily optimize capability: whether an agent can reason, retrieve information, call tools, delegate work, and complete a goal. Enterprise execution requires a stronger property. A successful result is not reliable if it was produced through unauthorized data access, widened delegated authority, unapproved side effects, unrecoverable budget consumption, or incomplete evidence. This paper defines reliable capability as a path property: an agent is reliably capable only when it completes a task through action events that remain admissible under identity, profile, tool, data, memory, budget, artifact, approval, and audit constraints. We propose a policy algebra that defines the reliability envelope within which agent capability may be exercised. Security profiles and runtime obligations compose through joins, intersections, budget narrowing, approval inheritance, and evidence accumulation; the resulting composition is both trust-preserving and the least restrictive state satisfying all governing inputs. The algebra also propagates restrictions across multi-agent calls and introduces cost-aware artifact materialization, which redirects open-ended execution toward a recoverable outcome as budget exposure grows. The evaluation is interpreted as a reliability-capability trade-off rather than a capability benchmark: the policy-algebra runtime intervenes on 94.8% of policy-violating events while retaining an 86.9% task-completion rate, eliminates the observed profile-monotonicity and zero-artifact-exhaustion violations, and increases audit completeness to 98.6%. The method provides researchers and practitioners with formal correctness conditions, executable decision semantics, and trace evidence for building agents that are not only capable, but reliably capable.

TL;DR: 本文针对基于大语言模型的智能体框架，提出将“可靠能力”定义为路径属性：只有当任务经由满足身份、配置、工具、数据、记忆、预算、工件、审批与审计约束的动作事件完成时，智能体才算可靠。作者提出一种策略代数 (policy algebra)，通过连接、交集、预算收窄、审批继承与证据累积等算子组合安全配置和运行时义务，得到既保持信任又最不严格的组合状态。评估以可靠性-能力权衡而非能力基准来解读，运行时对 94.8% 的策略违规事件进行干预，同时保持 86.9% 的任务完成率，并将审计完整性提升至 98.6%。

papers.title: Think Inside the Chunk: RegulaRAG for Regulation-Compliant Scenario Generation using LLMs: A Case Study of UN Regulation No. 152
papers.abstract_en: Generating regulation-compliant test scenarios is essential for validating safety-critical automotive systems, yet Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to ground outputs in long, hierarchical standards. We present RegulaRAG, a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline that couples SmartChunking, reference-aware enrichment of paragraphs and tables via graph traversal, with Smart Retrieve & Rerank over these enriched units. To test our system, we evaluate on a manually curated dataset covering all scenarios in UN Regulation No. 152 (AEBS). Our study comprises: (i) a three-step progressive search that identifies near-optimal retrieval parameters without exhaustive grid search; (ii) head-to-head comparisons against five baseline RAG systems; and (iii) a robustness stress test that scales the source corpus with distractor content. Outputs are evaluated using a customized penalized scoring metric. Across all experiments, RegulaRAG achieves the highest average Meta-Score (82.99), outperforming the next-best system by 43% (NoRAG: 57.94), while operating at 14k-25k tokens per query versus up to 500k for graphcentric baselines. It maintains strong performance, remaining stable even as the number of regulatory sources grows, whereas competing RAG systems degrade sharply in both quality and robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RegulaRAG，一个面向法规合规测试场景生成的检索增强生成 (RAG) 流水线，用 SmartChunking 结合参考感知的段落/表格图遍历增强，再经 Smart Retrieve & Rerank 从长层级标准中提取信息。在人工整理的 UN Regulation No. 152 (AEBS) 数据集上，RegulaRAG 平均 Meta-Score 达 82.99，优于五个基线 RAG 系统，且每次查询仅 14k-25k tokens，并在扩展干扰源时保持稳定。
Motivation: LLM 难以在长而分层的法规标准中对输出进行 grounding，导致生成法规合规的汽车安全测试场景（如 UN Regulation No. 152 的 AEBS 场景）困难，现有 RAG 系统在质量与鲁棒性上不足。
Method: 提出 RegulaRAG 流水线：用 SmartChunking 将段落和表格通过图遍历进行参考感知增强，再对增强后的单元执行 Smart Retrieve & Rerank；同时设计三步渐进式搜索近似最优检索参数，避免穷举网格搜索，并使用自定义惩罚评分指标评估生成输出。
Result: 在 UN Regulation No. 152 场景数据集上，RegulaRAG 取得最高平均 Meta-Score 82.99，比次优系统 NoRAG (57.94) 高 43%；每次查询处理 14k-25k tokens，而图中心基线最高达 500k；在增加干扰源时保持稳定，而对比的 RAG 系统在质量与鲁棒性上显著下降。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 RegulaRAG 在法规合规场景生成中兼顾质量与 token 效率，并在法规源规模增长时保持鲁棒；评估范围限于 UN Regulation No. 152 这一特定法规及人工整理的数据集。

papers.title: Ventor-QTest: Threat-Model-Driven Verification of Vendor-Hosted LLM APIs
papers.abstract_en: As large language models become increasingly widespread, third-party providers that deploy open-weight models have become an important part of the ecosystem. Auditing the quality of their inference APIs is therefore an open problem. We formalize hosted model routing as a stochastic process and propose \mbox{\textbf{Ventor-QTest}}, a composite black-box audit that requires no probability information from the target API. Its repeated-request component sends each frozen constrained context to the target multiple times, reconstructs a categorical output distribution from the returned text counts, and reports \emph{average fidelity loss} (AFL) as a null-bias-corrected, within-window mean coarsened-KL statistic. Its long-sequence component uses independent runs to report \emph{extreme fidelity loss} (EFL) through the empirical upper tail of a run-level reference-centered-surprisal statistic. Across three logprob-capable route conditions, AFL shows strong linear descriptive agreement with a logprob-derived coarsened-KL comparator. Across seven route snapshots, 20-run sequence probes reveal route-specific EFL variation. AFL and EFL have little detectable route-level association with GPQA-Diamond accuracy. In contrast, pronounced EFL coincides with a decline in Terminal-Bench pass rate as task exposure increases. This pattern may arise because correctness in long-horizon tasks is more sensitive to extreme fidelity loss. These results motivate reporting AFL and EFL jointly, particularly when auditing long-horizon agentic tasks. The open-source implementation is available at https://github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard/tree/main/services/api_checker/ventor_qtest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把托管模型路由 (hosted model routing) 形式化为随机过程，并提出 Ventor-QTest，一种无需目标 API 提供概率信息的复合黑盒审计方法。其重复请求组件通过多次发送冻结的受限上下文来重建类别输出分布，并报告平均保真度损失 (average fidelity loss, AFL)；长序列组件则基于独立运行的尾部统计量报告极端保真度损失 (extreme fidelity loss, EFL)。摘要报告 AFL 与基于 logprob 的 coarsened-KL 对照指标高度线性一致，且显著 EFL 与 Terminal-Bench 通过率随任务暴露增加的下降相对应。
Motivation: 部署开放权重模型的第三方提供商已成为大语言模型生态的重要组成部分，但审计其推理 API 质量仍是一个开放问题，尤其是当目标 API 不暴露概率信息时。
Method: 将托管模型路由形式化为随机过程，提出复合黑盒审计 Ventor-QTest。重复请求组件对每个冻结的受限上下文多次请求，由返回文本计数重建类别输出分布，并给出零偏校正、窗口内平均的 coarsened-KL 统计量 AFL；长序列组件使用独立运行，通过运行级 reference-centered-surprisal 统计量的经验上尾报告 EFL。
Result: 在三种支持 logprob 的路由条件下，AFL 与 logprob 导出的 coarsened-KL 对照指标呈强线性描述性一致；在七个路由快照上，20 次运行的序列探针显示出路由特定的 EFL 变化。AFL 与 EFL 与 GPQA-Diamond 准确率几乎没有路由级关联，但显著 EFL 与 Terminal-Bench 通过率随任务暴露增加而下降的现象同时出现。
Conclusion: 作者认为长时程任务的正确性可能对极端保真度损失更敏感，因此建议在审计长时程智能体任务时联合报告 AFL 与 EFL。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Counting Documents Is Not Counting Text: Unit Bias in Web-PDF Corpus Statistics
papers.abstract_en: PDF corpora advertise their size in tokens but compute every rate they publish (coverage, OCR routing, re-fetch recovery, language mix) per document, and none decomposes its token total. The two units diverge sharply. On CC-MAIN-2021-31-PDF-UNTRUNCATED (7.9M web PDFs, 32.6B tokens), 3.02% of text-bearing documents hold half the tokens (Gini 0.807); documents over 50 pages are 5.00% of the corpus but 53.53% of its text. The PDFs produced by a TeX{} toolchain are 1.66% of documents and 4.05% of the text. The clearest casualty is Common Crawl's truncation cap: it affected 23.06% of documents and 63.08% of the text. Reconstructing the truncated files and extracting both versions, two widely used libraries recover 11.4% and 1.4% of that text; between 72% and 97% of affected documents yield nothing; roughly 55--62% of the corpus's text is lost. Under the 5 MiB cap adopted in March 2025, 30.19% of tokens would still be truncated, and recovery on those documents rises only from 3.3% to 13.2%. We recommend that corpus statistics be reported in both units: documents and tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出网络 PDF 语料库在规模宣传与统计口径上存在单位不一致：总量按 token 计，而覆盖率、OCR 路由、重抓恢复率、语种分布等指标均按文档计。基于 CC-MAIN-2021-31-PDF-UNTRUNCATED（7.9M 网络 PDF、32.6B token）的分析显示两级分化严重，截断策略对文本损失的影响远超按文档占比的预期，并建议报告统计时同时给出文档和 token 两种单位。
Motivation: 现有 PDF 语料库统计普遍混用文档数与 token 数两种单位，导致语料规模与文本实际覆盖严重失真，尤其截断与恢复率等关键指标被按文档口径严重低估。
Method: 对 7.9M 网络 PDF、32.6B token 的语料做文档级与 token 级联合统计，重建 Common Crawl 截断文件并抽取截断前后两个版本，对比两个常用库的恢复能力，并评估 5 MiB 新上限对截断与恢复的影响。
Result: 3.02% 的文本文档占据一半 token（Gini 0.807）；50 页以上文档占 5.00% 但贡献 53.53% 文本；Common Crawl 截断影响 23.06% 文档却损失 63.08% 文本，两个库仅能恢复其中 11.4% 和 1.4%，72–97% 受影响文档无法恢复，语料约 55–62% 文本丢失；5 MiB 上限下仍截断 30.19% token，恢复率仅从 3.3% 升至 13.2%。
Conclusion: 建议语料库统计同时以文档和 token 为单位报告，否则规模指标会掩盖文本回收的真实情况。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mint-Agent: Introducing Finance-Native Agentic Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Financial agents must do more than recall domain knowledge: they must be both reliable, executing precise operations over grounded evidence, and executive, sustaining long-horizon research whose conclusions remain auditable. We present Mint-Agent, a family of finance-native agentic models designed around these two scales of financial intelligence. Mint-Agent is built upon three pillars: data, harness, and algorithm. Our data engine constructs clean, specialized tasks for atomic financial capabilities and long-horizon agentic execution from real-world financial sources. MintHarness enables stable interaction with open-ended environments and maintains auditable evidence trails across extended research trajectories. Our training recipe combines SFT, critical-step OPD, and RLVR to develop separate financial reasoning and agentic execution experts, which are then unified through model merging and multi-teacher on-policy distillation into compact, general-purpose financial agents. This pipeline yields two flagship models, Mint-Cu (9B) and Mint-Ag (27B). Across professional financial benchmarks, our models demonstrate two defining strengths: (1) Reliability: Mint-Ag achieves 98.33% on RFC-Bench, surpassing GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-4.8 by 3.66 and 3.00 points; and (2) Executability: Mint-Cu reaches 69.86% on FinSearchComp T2, outperforming Agents-A1-35B and Nex-N2-mini by 22.83 and 12.78 points, while Mint-Ag achieves 76.00% and 60.49% on FinanceAgentBench v1.1 and v2, respectively. papers.title: FETERS: Few-Shot Early Time-Series Classification via Effective Ratio Selection
papers.abstract_en: Early time-series classification (ETSC) aims to make accurate predictions from partially observed time series as early as possible. Although various stopping mechanisms and feature learning strategies have been developed for ETSC, most existing methods assume access to sufficient labeled training data, which may be unrealistic in applications with limited annotation. Under limited supervision, learning an additional sample-level stopping module and extracting effective classification features can both become challenging. In this paper, we propose FETERS, a few-shot ETSC framework that selects a dataset-level stopping ratio through class-wise leave-one-out (LOO) evaluation on the support set and uses a penalty-based reward function to manage the accuracy-earliness trade-off, thereby avoiding the need to train an additional stopping module. FETERS further combines Rocket-based features with frozen Chronos representations for classification. Extensive experiments on 69 public datasets spanning 14 domains show that FETERS achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in the 5-shot setting, with the highest average harmonic mean (HM) and the best HM on 38 datasets, while outperforming the current SOTA method on 44 datasets. FETERS also remains competitive in the full-shot setting, demonstrating its effectiveness in managing the accuracy-earliness trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FETERS，一个少样本早期时间序列分类（few-shot early time-series classification）框架，通过类别级留一法（class-wise leave-one-out）在支持集上选择数据集级停止比例，并用惩罚型奖励函数管理准确率-及时性权衡，从而无需训练额外停止模块。FETERS 结合 Rocket 特征与冻结的 Chronos 表示进行分类，在 69 个公共数据集（14 个领域）上的 5-shot 设置中取得平均 HM 最高，并在 38 个数据集上获得最佳 HM。
Motivation: 现有早期时间序列分类（ETSC）方法大多假设有充足标注训练数据，但在标注有限的应用中，同时学习样本级停止模块和有效分类特征都很困难。论文旨在解决少样本条件下 ETSC 的准确率与及时性权衡问题。
Method: FETERS 通过支持集上的类别级留一法评估，为数据集选择统一的停止比例，并使用惩罚型奖励函数（penalty-based reward function）管理准确率与及时性的权衡，避免训练额外的停止模块；特征方面结合 Rocket 基特征与冻结的 Chronos 表示用于分类。
Result: 在 69 个公共数据集、14 个领域的实验中，5-shot 设置下 FETERS 取得最高平均调和均值（HM），并在 38 个数据集上达到最佳 HM，同时在 44 个数据集上优于现有 SOTA 方法；在全样本（full-shot）设置下仍具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 FETERS 通过数据集级停止比例选择与惩罚奖励机制，在少样本条件下有效平衡准确率与及时性，且无需训练额外停止模块，实验表明其在 5-shot 与 full-shot 设置下均有效。

papers.title: Self-Routed Tensor Adapters for Parameter-Efficient Universal Visual Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Universal visual representations require adaptation mechanisms that adapt across heterogeneous domains without fragmenting knowledge into domain-specific modules. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts frozen visual foundation models efficiently, but standard low-rank adapters use a fixed subspace for all inputs, which can be restrictive when domains differ in style, background, and semantic context. MoE-based adapters improve specialization through multiple expert pathways, but often rely on external routers and large expert banks, adding parameters and separating routing from adaptation. We propose \textbf{Self-Routed Tensor Adapters}, a compact framework for multi-domain visual adaptation. SRTA projects each input into a low-rank space, computes routing weights from this representation using a learnable domain matrix, and uses these weights to blend slices of a shared Tucker core. This produces a sample-specific adaptation matrix without an external gating network, allowing shared visual factors to be reused while supporting domain-aware specialization. To strengthen pathway learning, we introduce a progressive depth-weighted routing objective that supervises routing decisions across adapter layers. Across five heterogeneous multi-domain visual classification benchmarks, SRTA achieves competitive or slightly stronger average accuracy than MoE-style PEFT baselines while using substantially fewer trainable parameters. At rank 64, SRTA uses 2.77M parameters in the 4-domain setting compared with 9.52M for MoLoRA, and 3.00M in the 6-domain setting compared with 14.31M. Overall, SRTA offers an effective accuracy-parameter trade-off for adapting visual foundation models toward universal multi-domain representations. \href{https://github.com/surajyadav-research/SRTA}{GitHub}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Self-Routed Tensor Adapters (SRTA)，一种用于多域视觉适应的参数高效微调框架。SRTA 将输入投影到低秩空间，用可学习域矩阵 (domain matrix) 计算路由权重，并用这些权重混合共享 Tucker core 的切片，从而生成样本特定的适应矩阵，无需外部门控网络。在五个异构多域视觉分类基准上，SRTA 以远少于 MoE 风格 PEFT 基线的可训练参数达到相当或略优的平均准确率。
Motivation: 标准低秩适配器 (low-rank adapter) 对所有输入使用固定子空间，在风格、背景和语义上下文差异较大的域间表现受限；而基于 MoE 的适配器依赖外部路由和大型专家库，增加参数并将路由与适应过程分离。
Method: SRTA 将每个输入投影到低秩空间，由可学习域矩阵计算路由权重，再以这些权重混合共享 Tucker core 的切片，得到样本特定的适应矩阵；作者还引入渐进式深度加权路由目标 (progressive depth-weighted routing objective) 来监督各适配器层的路由决策。
Result: 摘要报告在五个多域视觉分类基准上，SRTA 达到与 MoE 风格 PEFT 基线相当或略优的平均准确率，同时参数显著减少：rank 64 时 4 域设置用 2.77M 参数（MoLoRA 为 9.52M），6 域设置用 3.00M 参数（MoLoRA 为 14.31M）。
Conclusion: SRTA 在准确率与参数规模之间提供了有效的权衡，适用于将视觉基础模型适配为通用多域表示。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AstronOS: A Unified Execution Model and Runtime for Long-Horizon Agentic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agentic systems often organize execution and state around a single conversation, model invocation, or agent instance, even when real work spans many calls and stages. We introduce a unified execution model that maintains a work item's persistent identity and versioned authoritative state across calls. Each step receives input scoped to a specific state version and new material; a result advances state only after validation and recording. We implement selected paths of this model in AstronOS using Cases, Tasks, and Scenario Packs across central and local execution. We compare five complete strategies for carrying an established software-version update plan into a fresh model session: rereading original materials, replaying full history, deterministic text summary, deterministic JSON, and the AstronOS runtime-mediated handoff. Ten controlled tasks are run under all five strategies with three repetitions, yielding 150 included executions. On the single-stage reference family, strategies perform similarly. In the primary three-stage A-C batch, AstronOS passes the frozen scorer in 14 of 15 executions, compared with 0 of 15 for rereading and 2 of 15 for full-history replay; later non-interleaved summary and JSON batches each pass 0 of 15. AstronOS has lower attempt-accounted model-token cost per passing execution, while requiring more execution-window time per attempt. These results associate the complete AstronOS condition with higher end-to-end pass rates across fresh sessions in this benchmark, at a measurable time cost.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. Zhenhang Nie and Gui Zheng contributed equally; Gui Zheng and Bin Zhang are corresponding authors
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向长周期智能体系统 (long-horizon agentic systems) 的统一执行模型，强调跨多次调用的工作项持久身份与版本化权威状态。作者在 AstronOS 运行时的部分路径上实现了该模型，并通过五类策略对比实验评估将既有软件版本更新计划迁移到新会话的效果。结果显示，在三阶段基准批次中，AstronOS 运行时中介交接策略在 15 次执行中 14 次通过冻结评分器，而重读原材料与完整历史回放分别仅 0/15 和 2/15。
Motivation: 现有智能体系统常围绕单一对话、模型调用或智能体实例组织执行与状态，而真实工作往往跨越多次调用和多个阶段，缺乏对工作项持久身份和权威状态的统一管理。
Method: 提出统一执行模型，为工作项维护持久身份和带版本的权威状态；每次步骤接收限定到特定状态版本与新材料的输入，结果仅在验证和记录后推进状态。在 AstronOS 中通过 Cases、Tasks 和 Scenario Packs 在集中与本地执行中实现模型的部分路径，并比较五种跨会话交接策略：重读原始材料、完整历史回放、确定性文本摘要、确定性 JSON 摘要，以及运行时的交接。
Result: 在 150 次纳入执行（10 个受控任务 × 5 策略 × 3 次重复）中，单阶段基准家族上各策略表现相近；主三阶段 A-C 批次内，AstronOS 在 15 次执行中 14 次通过冻结评分器，相比之下重读为 0/15、完整历史回放为 2/15，后续非交错摘要批次与 JSON 批次均为 0/15。AstronOS 的按尝试计模型 token 成本更低，但每次尝试的执行窗口时间更长。
Conclusion: 摘要将这些结果视为：在本基准中，完整 AstronOS 条件与跨新会话更高的端到端通过率相关联，但付出可测量的时间成本。

papers.title: Synthetic Data Augmentation for Satellite-Based Analysis of Battle-Damaged Agricultural Fields in Ukraine
papers.abstract_en: Monitoring war-induced damage to agricultural land in Ukraine is important for understanding threats to food security, environmental stability, and post-war recovery. However, the development of computer-vision systems for satellite-based damage analysis is limited by the scarcity of labeled imagery, especially for damaged agricultural fields. This work investigates synthetic data augmentation as a method for improving classification under limited and imbalanced training data. We train class-conditional Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) architectures on real satellite images and use them to generate additional bombed and not-bombed agricultural-field samples. The generated images are used only for training augmentation, while all downstream evaluation is performed on an exclusively real test set. A Vision Transformer classifier is trained under multiple real and synthetic data configurations to measure the practical utility of each generative approach. The best configuration, based on balanced DDPM augmentation, improves accuracy from 84\% to 88\%, balanced accuracy from 67\% to 81\%, macro F1 from 65\% to 78\%, and recall for the underrepresented not-bombed class from 41\% to 69\%. These results demonstrate the potential of synthetic satellite imagery for data-scarce geospatial applications in war-affected regions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对乌克兰战争导致的农田卫星图像标注稀缺问题，研究用合成数据增强来提升受损农田分类。作者训练class-conditional GAN和DDPM在真实卫星图像上生成bombed和not-bombed农田样本，仅用于训练增强，所有下游评估在真实测试集上完成。最佳配置为平衡DDPM增强，将准确率从84%提升到88%，平衡准确率从67%提升到81%，macro F1从65%提升到78%，not-bombed类召回从41%提升到69%。
Motivation: 监测战争对乌克兰农业用地的损害对粮食安全、环境稳定和战后恢复很重要，但标记卫星图像稀缺且类别不平衡，限制了计算机视觉系统在该任务上的开发。
Method: 训练class-conditional GAN和Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM)在真实卫星图像上生成额外的bombed和not-bombed农田样本；用Vision Transformer在多种真实与合成数据配置下训练分类器，并仅在真实测试集上进行评估。
Result: 摘要报告的最佳配置（balanced DDPM增强）在真实测试集上显著改善：准确率84%→88%，balanced accuracy 67%→81%，macro F1 65%→78%，not-bombed类的召回从41%提高到69%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调合成卫星图像对数据稀缺的战争影响区域地理空间应用具有潜力，可用于缓解真实标注数据不足带来的分类性能瓶颈。

papers.title: Adaptive Post-Processing Drives Instance-Level Detection in Stroke Lesion Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Instance-level lesion detection has been an increasingly larger focal point in medical image segmentation besides the more standard voxel-level overlap. Still, most pipelines are trained and post-processed for voxel overlap alone. In particular, the mismatch is most pronounced for small lesions, where a near-miss prediction---substantial overlap that falls just short of the instance-matching threshold---scores the same as a complete miss. In our ISLES'26 submission, we found that closing this gap mattered far more in post-processing than in architecture design. Our Volume-Conditioned Adaptive Post-Processing (VCAP) scheme adjusts component-size thresholds to each case's predicted lesion burden, improving Lesion-F1 by 0.032 (unbiased cross-fold estimate)---approximately 6 times larger than any architectural change we tested. A resolution-aware attention architecture (Viola2Plus), designed for small-lesion segmentation, shows why the distinction matters: it left small-lesion Dice unchanged but raised small-lesion detection rate by 3.7\%, a real effect voxel-overlap metrics alone would have missed. Under 5-fold cross-validation on the 1,453-case training set, our post-processed two-architecture ensemble achieves Dice 0.651 and Lesion-F1 0.614, versus 0.644 and 0.573 for the unprocessed single-model baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 MICCAI ISLES'26 提交工作，针对卒中病灶分割中 voxel 重叠指标与实例级病灶检测之间的错配问题，提出 Volume-Conditioned Adaptive Post-Processing (VCAP) 方案。摘要报告 VCAP 将 Lesion-F1 提升 0.032（无偏交叉验证估计），约为任何架构改动带来增益的 6 倍；分辨率感知注意力架构 Viola2Plus 虽未改变小病灶 Dice，却将小病灶检测率提高 3.7%。在 1,453 例训练集上的 5 折交叉验证中，经过后处理的两架构集成达到 Dice 0.651 和 Lesion-F1 0.614，而未处理单模型基线分别为 0.644 和 0.573。
Motivation: 大多数分割流程仅按 voxel 重叠训练和后处理，而实例级病灶检测的重要性日益增加；尤其对小病灶，接近命中但略低于实例匹配阈值的预测与完全漏检得分相同，这种错配未被现有指标和后处理机制解决。
Method: 提出 Volume-Conditioned Adaptive Post-Processing (VCAP)，根据每个病例预测病灶负担动态调整组件尺寸阈值；同时介绍面向小病灶分割的分辨率感知注意力架构 Viola2Plus，用于展示重叠指标与检测指标之间的区别。
Result: VCAP 使 Lesion-F1 提升 0.032，约为任何所测架构改动的 6 倍；Viola2Plus 使小病灶检测率提高 3.7% 而小病灶 Dice 不变。5 折交叉验证下，后处理的两架构集成达到 Dice 0.651、Lesion-F1 0.614，优于未处理单模型基线的 0.644 和 0.573。
Conclusion: 作者强调相比架构设计，后处理对弥合 voxel 重叠与实例级检测之间的差距贡献更大，且检测率等指标能捕捉到 voxel 重叠指标无法反映的真实效果。

papers.title: Coverage-Maximizing Multinomial Subset Routing under Operational Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Multinomial Subset Routing (MSR), a new online routing framework over $K$ experts in which the learner keeps a multinomial routing policy instead of a deterministic subset of experts. At each round, the learner samples $M$ experts i.i.d. from the multinomial policy, and the resulting set of distinct sampled experts forms the routed subset. The reward depends only on the best-performing expert(s) in the routed subset. This reward structure arises naturally in routing across specialized models but is not captured by standard combinatorial bandits or subset-selection methods, which optimize deterministic subsets and typically assume additive rewards. We require the selection to satisfy several long-term, two-sided operational constraints under bandit feedback, observing only the winner's reward each round. We propose OMD-Approachability, combining online mirror descent with Blackwell's Approachability, and prove it achieves $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ regret in both reward and constraint violation. We ground the framework in practical application domains and validate it empirically on a real-world crowdsourcing dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Multinomial Subset Routing (MSR)，一种新的在线路由框架：学习者维护一个多项式路由策略而不是确定性专家子集，每轮从该策略中 i.i.d. 抽样 M 个专家，形成去重后的路由子集，奖励仅取决于子集中表现最好的专家。作者将在线镜像下降 (online mirror descent) 与 Blackwell 可逼近性 (Blackwell's Approachability) 结合，证明在仅观察获胜者奖励的 bandit 反馈下，奖励遗憾和约束违反均达到 O(1/√T)，并在真实众包数据集上做了实证验证。
Motivation: 标准组合老虎机或子集选择方法通常优化确定性子集并假设可加奖励，无法刻画“奖励仅取决于子集中最佳专家”的路由结构；同时实际路由问题还需满足长期、双侧的操作约束，现有框架难以统一处理。
Method: 提出 OMD-Approachability 算法，将在线镜像下降与 Blackwell 可逼近性相结合，在多样式路由策略空间中进行学习；每轮按策略采样 M 个专家形成路由子集，仅观测到获胜者的奖励，并通过可逼近性框架处理长期双侧约束。
Result: 理论分析证明该算法在奖励和约束违反两方面都达到 O(1/√T) 的遗憾界；摘要还报告在真实世界众包数据集上进行了实证验证。
Conclusion: 作者将该框架定位在跨专业模型路由等实际应用场景，并强调其能够处理基于最佳专家的奖励结构与长期操作约束。

papers.title: OceanDepths: A Global Dataset of Paired Subsurface and Surface Ocean Observations
papers.abstract_en: Despite comprising over 70\% of its surface, the world's oceans are critically underobserved compared to the land surface or the atmosphere.Understanding the global ocean requires jointly observing its surface and subsurface structure, yet no standardized, high-resolution dataset couples satellite surface fields to co-located \emph{in situ} depth profiles in an AI-ready format.Existing resources either consist of model-reconstructed gridded products rather than observations, cover only a single variable or basin, or operate at resolutions too coarse for mesoscale dynamics.We introduce \textsc{OceanDepths}, the first open, global, regridded AI-ready dataset that pairs satellite-derived sea surface temperature (SST), sea surface salinity (SSS), and sea surface height (SSH) L4 products with co-located EN4 subsurface temperature and salinity profiles, complemented by matched GLORYS12 ocean reanalysis data to support comparisons or multi-stage learning.The dataset spans 2000--2024 at \SI{0.1}{\degree}$\times$\SI{0.1}{\degree} spatial resolution and at weekly temporal resolution, covering the entire globe's sea surface and with over 9.5 million paired profiles interpolated to 50 standardized depth levels.We provide a configurable system to split the globe in equally sized spatial patches.The 4D multivariate structure, high resolution, long temporal extent, and extreme sparsity of subsurface observations (${\sim}$0.01\% per depth level) make \textsc{OceanDepths}a challenging testbed for novel AI methods.We demonstrate subsurface state reconstruction as an example task with simple baseline models, but also envision \textsc{OceanDepths}to support the development of observation-based forecast methods and other related tasks.\added{Available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ESA-philab/OceanDepths.}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OceanDepths，据称是首个开放、全球、重网格化的 AI-ready 海洋数据集，将卫星导出的海表温度 (SST)、海表盐度 (SSS) 和海表高度 (SSH) L4 产品与 EN4 次表层温盐廓线配对，并用 GLORYS12 再分析数据补充。数据集覆盖 2000—2024 年，空间分辨率 0.1°×0.1°、周时间分辨率，包含超过 950 万条配对廓线并插值到 50 个标准深度层。作者以次表层状态重建为例验证了简单基线模型，并指出次表层观测的极度稀疏性使其成为新 AI 方法的挑战性测试平台。
Motivation: 全球海洋面积超过地表 70%，但相比陆地表面和大气，观测严重不足；理解全球海洋需要同时观测表层与次表层结构，而现有资源要么是基于模型重建的网格化产品而非观测，要么只覆盖单一变量或海盆，要么分辨率不足以刻画中尺度动力学。
Method: 构建 OceanDepths：将卫星 SST、SSS、SSH L4 产品与同位置的 EN4 次表层温度、盐度剖面配对，并匹配 GLORYS12 再分析数据以支持对比或多阶段学习；提供可配置系统将全球划分为等尺寸空间块，数据以周为时间步长、0.1° 网格重排。
Result: 数据集覆盖全球海面，包含超过 950 万条配对廓线并插值到 50 个标准深度层；作者用简单基线模型展示了次表层状态重建示例任务，并强调 4D 多变量结构、高分辨率、长时间跨度以及每深度层约 0.01% 的极端稀疏性构成挑战性测试床。
Conclusion: 作者期望 OceanDepths 除重建外，还能支持基于观测的预测方法及其他相关任务；数据集已发布在 Hugging Face。摘要未讨论方法的局限，仅指出稀疏性是面向新 AI 方法的难点。

papers.title: What Does Context Compression Cost an Agent? Interaction Costs Unrevealed by Task-Completion Metrics
papers.abstract_en: Task completion is the standard metric for evaluating context compression, yet it is incomplete: compression can increase an agent's interaction cost by forcing it to reacquire dropped state while leaving completion statistically unchanged. We introduce a controlled runtime measurement protocol for reacquisition cost in a bounded-horizon tool-using agent. The agent acts in a deterministic planning environment under a fixed 24-turn horizon. We vary compression severity, compare a dropping operator with a fact-preserving operator, restore dropped state through controlled oracle interventions, and decompose tool calls into retrieval and execution. We evaluate three models across two task regimes. Retrieval calls increase in all six model-regime comparisons and account for almost all added interaction; five of six remain significant after Holm correction. At the prespecified 5x comparison point, completion changes are not significant in any cell. DeepSeek shows a significant completion drop only at 10x compression. GPT-5.5 is the clearest case: completion changes from 80% to 85% (p = 1.0) while retrieval increases from 21.0 to 63.9 calls (p = .002). Retention interventions further separate state quantity, state type, and content validity. Random selection is comparable to an offline hindsight oracle, while replacing retained D-state with semantically irrelevant content increases retrieval by 57% (p < .001) without a significant completion change. In a second environment, ALFWorld, sliding compression produces no retrieval surge, showing that the reacquisition signature is environment-dependent rather than intrinsic to shortening context. Overall, compression can impose hidden interaction costs when execution-relevant state becomes absent and must be reacquired, while completion alone may not expose those costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出任务完成率虽是评估上下文压缩 (context compression) 的标准指标，但并不完整：压缩可能迫使智能体重新获取被丢弃的状态，从而增加交互成本，而任务完成率在统计上保持不变。作者在固定 24 回合、确定性规划环境的工具使用智能体上提出一种受控运行时测量协议，用来量化重新获取成本 (reacquisition cost)。结果显示检索调用在所有六个模型-任务组合中均上升，而完成率在预设的 5 倍压缩点上无显著变化，说明压缩会带来完成率指标无法暴露的隐性交互成本。
Motivation: 现有评估上下文压缩的标准指标是任务完成率，但这一指标不完整：压缩可能移除与执行相关的状态，迫使智能体重新获取，从而增加交互成本，而完成率在统计上可能不变。作者希望量化这种被隐藏的成本。
Method: 在确定性的规划环境中，采用固定 24 回合边界的工具使用智能体，建立受控运行时测量协议。实验通过改变压缩强度、对比丢弃式算子 (dropping operator) 与保留事实的算子、用受控 oracle 干预恢复被丢弃的状态，并将工具调用分解为检索 (retrieval) 与执行 (execution) 两部分。共评估三个模型、两个任务场景，并在第二个环境 ALFWorld 中进行验证。

papers.title: Depth-Dominant Skeleton Detection for Natural Scenes
papers.abstract_en: To date, all natural scene skeleton detection follows the paradigm of taking RGB images as the sole input; despite notable progress, methods under this paradigm suffer significant performance degradation on complex-content images. We observe that depth images are inherently insensitive to color and texture, and can provide clear regional contours and inter-region spatial relationships, which naturally alleviates the difficulty of skeleton detection in complex scenarios. Motivated by this observation, this paper proposes for the first time a novel skeleton detection paradigm where depth images serve as the dominant modality and RGB images act as the auxiliary, and accordingly presents a model DDSkel (short for Depth-Dominant Skeleton Detection) under this paradigm. DDSkel employs an asymmetric encoder design to fuse RGB information into depth features, with the RGB modality branch having only 12% the parameters of the depth modality branch. DDSkel has a simple structure without intricate designs. Nevertheless, with only 36% of the trainable parameters of the current best method, DDSkel outperforms all state-of-the-art approaches on SymPASCAL, the most challenging dataset with a large volume of complex images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次提出一种以深度图像为主模态、RGB图像为辅助模态的自然场景骨架检测范式，并给出模型DDSkel。DDSkel采用非对称编码器设计，将RGB信息融合进深度特征，RGB分支参数量仅为深度分支的12%；总可训练参数仅为当前最优方法的36%，却在最具挑战性的SymPASCAL数据集上超越所有SOTA方法。
Motivation: 现有自然场景骨架检测均以RGB图像为唯一输入，在复杂内容图像上性能显著下降；深度图像对颜色和纹理不敏感，能提供清晰的区域轮廓和区域间空间关系，可自然缓解复杂场景下骨架检测的难度。
Method: 提出深度主导（depth-dominant）、RGB辅助的骨架检测范式，并以该范式构建模型DDSkel；模型采用非对称编码器设计，将RGB信息融合到深度特征中，RGB分支参数仅为深度分支的12%，结构简单。
Result: 在SymPASCAL这一包含大量复杂图像、最具挑战性的数据集上，DDSkel以当前最优方法36%的可训练参数，超越所有现有最优方法。
Conclusion: 摘要表明以深度图像为主模态、RGB为辅的范式能够提升复杂场景下的骨架检测性能，且模型参数高效、结构简洁；摘要未明确说明方法局限性。

papers.title: MELD: A Protocol for Merging Knowledge Across Distributed Agentic Memories
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents share a transport and can call each other's tools, but they cannot share what they know: no protocol lets two agents' memories reconcile a fact phrased two ways, link related facts held apart, or reconcile contradictory knowledge without silently discarding either claim. We present MELD, a self-managing coherence mechanism for a federation of agent memories whose run-time model is the knowledge graph itself. Each brain admits every incoming claim through a five-outcome procedure (insert, merge, relate, conflict, or reject), decided from three signals (scoped claim-key identity, embedding similarity, and a natural-language-inference verdict) under context and freshness gates, and acting through exactly one auditable, authenticated Patch, the only object that mutates state. A binding onto standard publish/subscribe transport with a per-claim status CRDT keeps sovereign brains coherent in claim status without a coordinator: self-healing after partitions and under lossy routing, and self-protecting against silent rewrite by a peer, under a benign-fault model. MELD does not adjudicate truth; a detected contradiction is preserved for later adjudication, never silently resolved. On HotpotQA distractor, distributed merge is recall-non-inferior to a centralized store under a pre-specified equivalence test and recall-superior to naive union at about 11% less live storage; the merge classifier separates at AUC 0.968 with a 0.013 false-merge rate on adjudicated candidate pairs; the status CRDT reconverges in 30/30 real partition-heal trials where last-writer-wins manages 11/30; and semantic routing delivers about 3x fewer messages at matched recall. We evaluate on a real computing continuum spanning an operator-grade 5G edge, national HPC, and a local tier, with empirically calibrated thresholds.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 3 figures, 1 table, plus an 11-page appendix (A-N). Code and experiment data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21878274
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MELD，一种面向分布式智能体记忆联邦的自管理一致性协议，以知识图谱本身作为运行时模型。每个智能体“大脑”通过五结果流程（insert、merge、relate、conflict、reject）接纳每条进入的声明，并仅通过可审计、可认证的 Patch 对象改变状态；并绑定到发布/订阅传输与每声明状态的 CRDT，使各主权记忆在无协调者情况下保持状态一致。摘要报告在 HotpotQA distractor 上分布式合并的召回率非劣于集中式存储、且优于朴素并集，并给出 CRDT 重收敛、语义路由降流量等实验结果。
Motivation: 自主智能体可以共享传输层并调用彼此的工具，但无法共享知识：没有协议能让两个智能体的记忆以两种措辞调和同一事实、链接分开存储的相关事实，或在不断言丢弃任一声明的前提下调和矛盾知识。
Method: MELD 是一个自管理的一致性机制，每条入站声明通过三个信号（scoped claim-key identity、embedding similarity、natural-language-inference verdict）在上下文与新鲜度门控下决定五个结果之一；状态变更只经唯一的 auditable、authenticated Patch 发生，并在标准发布/订阅传输上以 per-claim 状态 CRDT 绑定，使各大脑在声明状态上保持一致并在良性故障模型下自愈、自保护。
Result: 在 HotpotQA distractor 上，分布式合并通过预定义等价检验证明召回率不劣于集中式存储，且优于朴素并集约 11% 的实时存储；合并分类器在裁决候选对上 AUC 0.968、误合并率 0.013；状态 CRDT 在 30/30 次真实分区-恢复试验中重收敛（last-writer-wins 仅 11/30）；语义路由在召回率匹配下减少约 3 倍消息量。
Conclusion: MELD 不裁决真伪：检测到的矛盾会被保留以供后续裁决而非静默解决。摘要强调该方法在真实计算连续体（运营商级 5G 边缘、国家 HPC 与本地层）上使用经验校准阈值进行了评估。

papers.title: DriveCache: Action-Aware Caching for Driving World Model Inference
papers.abstract_en: Driving video generation models support autonomous-driving development by predicting controllable future scenes for simulation, planning evaluation, and offline data generation. Diffusion-based driving generators repeatedly evaluate large backbones across denoising steps, which limits generation throughput. Existing diffusion acceleration methods reduce this cost, but general-purpose designs omit driving signals available before generation, such as ego speed and planned trajectories. Experiments across driving motions show that cache tolerance varies with ego translation and rotation, denoising progress, and consecutive reuse length. We propose DriveCache, a training-free, action-aware controller that uses planned motion to allocate reuse across scenes and dynamic programming to place it across denoising steps under a calibrated response budget. A causal drift check refreshes features and replans the remaining schedule when generation departs from calibration. Across three generator configurations, DriveCache improves the overall fidelity-efficiency trade-off over evaluated cache methods. Our code will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DriveCache，一种无需训练、动作感知的缓存控制器，用于提升驾驶视频生成模型的推理吞吐量。它利用规划的运动信息在场景间分配特征重用，并通过动态规划在去噪步骤间安排重用，同时用因果漂移检查在生成偏离校准时刷新特征并重新规划调度。在三种生成器配置下，DriveCache 相比已有缓存方法改进了保真度与效率的整体权衡。
Motivation: 扩散式驾驶视频生成模型需要在多个去噪步骤中重复评估大型骨干网络，导致生成吞吐量受限。现有扩散加速方法多为通用设计，忽略了生成前即可获得的驾驶信号（如自车速度与规划轨迹）。
Method: 提出 DriveCache，一种训练无关 (training-free) 的动作感知控制器：利用规划运动在场景间分配缓存重用，并用动态规划 (dynamic programming) 在去噪步骤间放置重用，以符合校准的响应预算；当生成偏离校准时，因果漂移检查会刷新特征并重新规划剩余调度。
Result: 摘要报告，在三种生成器配置下，DriveCache 相对于所评估的缓存方法改善了整体保真度-效率权衡 (fidelity-efficiency trade-off)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，利用生成前可用的驾驶信号来指导缓存分配可以有效提升驾驶世界模型推理效率，并称代码将公开。

papers.title: HalluTracer: Hallucination Detection via Depth-Averaging Truth Signals
papers.abstract_en: Even well-aligned large language models confidently generate factually incorrect text, making hallucination a persistent reliability risk in high-stakes deployments. These models nonetheless carry linearly separable truthfulness signals in their internal representations. Existing white-box detectors, however, collapse this evidence to isolated components or a single depth, discarding discriminative information distributed across the full forward pass. We introduce HalluTracer, a detection framework that reads and aggregates truthfulness evidence across every layer of the forward pass before the model emits any answer token. A geometric analysis reveals that the per-layer signals are weakly correlated, so that simple depth averaging suppresses layer-specific noise and captures nearly all linearly accessible information. Across six open-source language models and five hallucination benchmarks, HalluTracer consistently outperforms matched white-box baselines, with gains ranging from one to fourteen points. Collectively, our work recasts hallucination detection from a layer-selection problem into a depth-aggregation problem governed by the geometric sparsity of the truthfulness signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HalluTracer，一个白盒幻觉检测框架，通过在前向传播的所有层上聚合真实性信号（truthfulness signal）来判断模型输出是否幻觉。几何分析表明逐层信号弱相关，简单的深度平均即可抑制层间噪声并捕获几乎全部线性可分信息。在六个开源语言模型和五个幻觉基准上，HalluTracer 持续优于匹配的白盒基线，提升幅度为 1 到 14 个百分点。
Motivation: 即使经过良好对齐的大语言模型仍会自信地生成事实错误文本，幻觉成为高风险部署中的持续可靠性风险。现有白盒检测器只从单一深度或孤立组件中提取内部真相信号，丢弃了分布在整个前向传播过程中的判别信息。
Method: HalluTracer 在模型输出任何答案 token 前，读取并聚合前向传播每一层的真实性证据。通过几何分析发现逐层信号弱相关，因此采用简单深度平均（depth averaging）来抑制层特定噪声，并捕获几乎全部线性可访问的真相信息。
Result: 在六个开源语言模型和五个幻觉基准上，HalluTracer 一致优于匹配的白盒基线，性能增益从 1 到 14 个百分点不等。
Conclusion: 本文将幻觉检测从层选择问题重构为深度聚合问题，其核心在于真实性信号在几何上的稀疏性。
