summary_sections.motivation: 即使经过良好对齐的大语言模型仍会自信地生成事实错误文本，幻觉成为高风险部署中的持续可靠性风险。现有白盒检测器只从单一深度或孤立组件中提取内部真相信号，丢弃了分布在整个前向传播过程中的判别信息。
summary_sections.method: HalluTracer 在模型输出任何答案 token 前，读取并聚合前向传播每一层的真实性证据。通过几何分析发现逐层信号弱相关，因此采用简单深度平均（depth averaging）来抑制层特定噪声，并捕获几乎全部线性可访问的真相信息。
summary_sections.result: 在六个开源语言模型和五个幻觉基准上，HalluTracer 一致优于匹配的白盒基线，性能增益从 1 到 14 个百分点不等。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文将幻觉检测从层选择问题重构为深度聚合问题，其核心在于真实性信号在几何上的稀疏性。

papers.title: AeroCopilotBench: A Two-Tier Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents as Aviation Copilots in an Interactive Virtual Cockpit Environment
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents may assist flight crews with complex decisions and task execution, but existing aviation evaluations centered on static knowledge do not support systematic testing of procedural execution and safety compliance in interactive environments. This paper presents the AeroCopilot Operational Environment (ACOE), a reproducible interactive virtual-cockpit test environment, and AeroCopilotBench, a two-tier aviation agent evaluation benchmark. Tier-1 evaluates aviation knowledge using 1,200 multiple-choice questions, while Tier-2 comprises 73 emergency and abnormal tasks derived from the manufacturers' Pilot's Operating Handbooks (POHs) and instantiated in ACOE. ACOE converts natural-language procedures into executable state transitions, final-state goal conditions, and hard safety constraints, enabling models to interpret cockpit state, diagnose faults, and operate aircraft systems through standardized tool interfaces. We establish a safety-gated evaluation framework in which a trajectory succeeds only when all task goals are achieved without violating any hard safety constraint, while safe goal progress and trajectory safety are measured separately. Across 12 models, the highest Tier-2 success rate is 72.6%, while static knowledge performance does not consistently translate into procedural execution. Analysis of 451 failed episodes from 3 representative models identifies recurring failures in procedural completeness, use of state feedback, and long-horizon execution management. These findings motivate state-aware agent orchestration, joint assessment of task completion and trajectory safety, and repeated regression testing. ACOE and AeroCopilotBench provide a reproducible foundation for testing knowledge application, interactive execution, and operational safety in aviation agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AeroCopilot Operational Environment (ACOE) 交互式虚拟驾驶舱测试环境与 AeroCopilotBench 两层级航空智能体评测基准。Tier-1 用 1200 道选择题考察航空知识，Tier-2 包含源自制造商 Pilot's Operating Handbooks 的 73 个紧急与异常任务。在 12 个模型上最高 Tier-2 成功率为 72.6%，且静态知识表现不能稳定转化为程序执行能力；对 451 个失败片段的分析归纳出程序完整性、状态反馈利用和长时程执行管理三类失败模式。
Motivation: 现有航空智能体评测集中于静态知识，无法在交互环境中系统测试程序执行（procedural execution）与安全合规，缺乏可复现的交互式测试基础。
Method: 构建 ACOE，将自然语言程序转换为可执行状态转移、最终状态目标条件和硬安全约束，并通过标准化工具接口让模型解读驾驶舱状态、诊断故障并操作系统。提出安全门控评估框架：轨迹仅在达成所有任务目标且不违反硬安全约束时判定成功，同时分别度量安全目标进展与轨迹安全性。
Result: 在 12 个模型上，最高 Tier-2 成功率为 72.6%，静态知识表现并未一致地转化为程序执行能力；对 3 个代表性模型的 451 个失败片段分析揭示了程序完整性、状态反馈使用和长时程执行管理方面的重复失败。
Conclusion: 作者认为需要状态感知的智能体编排、任务完成与轨迹安全的联合评估以及重复回归测试，ACOE 与 AeroCopilotBench 为航空智能体的知识应用、交互执行和运行安全测试提供了可复现基础。

papers.title: Architecture-Dependent Causal Transfer of Activation States Across Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Direct communication between AI systems relies on natural language as an intermediate layer, incurring encoding/decoding overhead, token cost, and latency. We ask whether internal activation states can instead be transferred causally between different large language model (LLM) architectures via a learned projection, evaluated at three levels: representational similarity, cross-model retrieval from projected states, and end-to-end causal transfer via activation injection during generation. Using four architecturally diverse open-weight models (Qwen2-0.5B, Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B, FLAN-T5-base), we find that representational alignment in trained models exceeds a random-initialization null baseline and is best captured by a rank-based metric (mutual k-nearest-neighbour alignment), more robust to activation-magnitude outliers than centered kernel alignment (CKA) or Procrustes analysis. A learned projection network retrieves the correct target-model representation from a held-out set well above chance for the three causal decoder-only model pairs (45-50% top-1 accuracy vs. 5% chance) but at chance level for the encoder-based FLAN-T5. Injecting projected activations into a target model during generation produces a statistically significant, pre-registered causal effect on retrieval-based output similarity for only one of the three decoder-only pairs (Qwen2-0.5B to Phi-3-mini: 23.3% vs. 0.0% under negative control, p=0.047, FDR-corrected); the two pairs targeting Mistral-7B show no such effect despite comparable representational alignment at the hidden-state level. We interpret these results as evidence for causal transfer of the representational vehicle, not of meaning, and conclude that end-to-end activation-state transfer between LLMs, as currently implemented, is architecture-dependent rather than universal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否通过学得的投影（learned projection）在不同LLM架构之间因果地转移内部激活状态，并分别在表征相似性、跨模型检索和生成时激活注入三个层面评估。使用四个架构不同的开源模型（Qwen2-0.5B、Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B、FLAN-T5-base），发现表征对齐高于随机初始化基线，但端到端因果转移仅在Qwen2-0.5B到Phi-3-mini这对模型上显著，其余并未表现出因果效应。作者将结果解释为转移的是表征载体（representational vehicle）而非意义，并认为当前实现的激活状态转移是架构依赖的而非普适的。
Motivation: AI系统之间的直接通信通常依赖自然语言作为中间层，带来编码/解码开销、token成本和延迟。作者想探究能否绕过自然语言，直接通过学得的投影在不同LLM架构间因果地传递内部激活状态。
Method: 提出一种学得的投影网络，将源模型的激活状态映射到目标模型的表示空间，并在三个层级评估：表征相似性（用互k近邻对齐、CKA、Procrustes分析）、从投影状态进行跨模型检索、以及生成过程中注入投影激活以测试端到端因果转移。实验使用四个架构多样的开源权重模型，并采用预注册的因果效应检验和负对照。
Result: 互k近邻对齐等秩基指标最能捕捉训练模型间的表征对齐，且对激活幅度离群值稳健；三个因果解码器模型对的检索top-1准确率达45-50%（随机水平5%），但基于编码器的FLAN-T5为随机水平。端到端因果转移仅在Qwen2-0.5B到Phi-3-mini这对模型上显著（23.3% vs. 负对照0.0%，p=0.047，FDR校正），两个以Mistral-7B为目标的对没有因果效应，尽管隐藏层表征对齐水平相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些证据表明当前实现的激活状态转移传递的是表征载体而非意义，端到端激活状态转移是架构依赖的而非普适的。

papers.title: Task-Anchored Representation Shaping for Pre-Trained Model-Based Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained models (PTMs) provide a strong foundation for continual learning by offering stable representations that facilitate lightweight adaptation to new tasks. However, adapting well to each task does not ensure reliable inference over all learned tasks. Since task boundaries are often artificial and semantically entangled, an input from an unknown task can remain ambiguous even with strong PTM features, making cross-task prediction a key bottleneck. We propose Task-Anchored Inference Latent Shaping (TAILS), a lightweight post-PTM module that can be integrated into diverse continual learners and optimized through a decoupled step. TAILS uses fixed task anchors as persistent references to accumulated knowledge. It interprets each sample's feature representation relative to these references, then composes relevant evidence across tasks into latent recall. Rather than selecting a task-specific path or adjusting classifier outputs, TAILS uses latent recall to directly correct the feature representation before prediction. It therefore resolves cross-task ambiguity at the representation level, while leaving the original PTM, method-specific modules, and classifier unchanged. Extensive experiments across multiple PTM-based continual learning paradigms show that TAILS can improve classification and task-inference performance with modest parameter overhead and negligible inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Task-Anchored Inference Latent Shaping (TAILS)，一种轻量级后置预训练模型模块，用于基于预训练模型 (PTM) 的持续学习。TAILS 使用固定任务锚点作为知识参考，在表征层面用潜在回忆 (latent recall) 修正特征表示，以解决跨任务预测的歧义，而不改动原 PTM、方法模块或分类器。实验表明该方法能在多种持续学习范式下提升分类与任务推断性能，且参数开销和推理成本都很小。
Motivation: 预训练模型提供稳定表征，但仅适配每个任务并不能保证对所有已学任务的可靠推断；任务边界经常是人为且语义纠缠的，即使 PTM 特征很强，未知任务的输入仍可能产生歧义，跨任务预测成为关键瓶颈。
Method: 提出 TAILS，一个可集成到不同持续学习器中的轻量级后 PTM 模块，通过解耦步骤优化。它用固定任务锚点作为累积知识的持久参考，将每个样本的表征相对于这些锚点进行解释，并把跨任务的相关证据组合成潜在回忆，在预测前直接修正特征表示，而非选择任务特定路径或调整分类器输出。
Result: 在多种基于 PTM 的持续学习范式上的大量实验表明，TAILS 能提升分类和任务推断性能，同时只引入适度的参数开销和可忽略的推理成本。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在表征层面解决跨任务歧义的思路有效，且该方法保持原 PTM、方法特定模块和分类器不变。

papers.title: LiD-GLM: Lipschitz-constrained Deep Generalized Linear Models
papers.abstract_en: The combination of traditional statistical models and neural network (NN) components into semi-structured hybrid models is an intriguing approach to construct models that, ideally, combine traditional interpretability with the unprecedented flexibility of NNs. In order to preserve interpretability, it is usually necessary to restrict the NN components to prevent them from dominating the model. However, existing methods that enforce structural constraints on their NN components severely limit their models' flexibility; in contrast, methods that only enforce weak, indirect constraints lose meaningful interpretability. The method we propose therefore leverages invertible residual neural networks (i-ResNets) to equip generalized linear models with both nonlinear parameter estimation and a flexible correction of their distributional assumptions while always retaining stochastic monotonicity of the modeled distribution in the (formerly linear) predictor. The i-ResNets correspond to a controlled deviation from identity and by constraining their Lipschitz constant one can rigorously limit and quantify how far the hybrid model deviates from its traditional counterpart. This enables a user-specifiable compromise between flexibility and interpretability without limiting the structure of nonlinear and interaction effects that can be learned. Furthermore, we develop specific inherent interpretation techniques for our model and enforce model identifiability through an adapted post-hoc orthogonalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LiD-GLM，一种将广义线性模型 (GLM) 与可逆残差神经网络 (i-ResNets) 结合的半结构化混合模型，使 GLM 具备非线性参数估计和对分布假设的灵活校正，同时保持原本线性预测子中的随机单调性。通过对 i-ResNets 施加 Lipschitz 常数约束，模型能够严谨地限制并量化混合模型相对于传统 GLM 的偏离程度，从而实现可由用户指定的灵活性与可解释性权衡。作者还开发了针对该模型的解释技术，并通过改进的后验正交化 (post-hoc orthogonalization) 保证模型可辨识性。
Motivation: 现有半结构化混合模型在对神经网络组件施加结构约束时要么严重限制灵活性，要么只施加微弱间接约束而失去有意义的可解释性；作者希望在不限制可学习的非线性和交互效应结构的前提下，提供一种可控的可解释性与灵活性折中方案。
Method: 利用可逆残差神经网络 (i-ResNets) 作为对恒等映射的可控偏离，并通过约束其 Lipschitz 常数来严格限制混合模型与传统 GLM 的偏差；同时提出专门的模型解释技术，并采用适配的后验正交化来强制模型可辨识性。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的定量实验结果或数据集，主要从方法性质上论证该模型能够保留随机单调性、严格量化模型偏离程度，并支持非线性及交互效应学习。
Conclusion: 该方法的要点是通过 Lipschitz 约束的 i-ResNet 组件，为混合 GLM 提供一种原则性的灵活性与可解释性权衡，并配套了相应的解释与可辨识性手段；摘要层面未给出实证评估细节。

summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告具体的定量实验结果或数据集，主要从方法性质上论证该模型能够保留随机单调性、严格量化模型偏离程度，并支持非线性及交互效应学习。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法的要点是通过 Lipschitz 约束的 i-ResNet 组件，为混合 GLM 提供一种原则性的灵活性与可解释性权衡，并配套了相应的解释与可辨识性手段；摘要层面未给出实证评估细节。

papers.title: SIGMA-Lane: Scale-pyramId Gated MAmba for Temporally Consistent Video Lane Detection
papers.abstract_en: Video lane detection requires predictions that remain stable across frames, yet severe vehicle occlusions can break temporal cues. In streaming recurrent models, corrupted observations may enter the hidden state and produce errors that persist into later frames. Existing occlusion-aware refinements usually provide obstacle masks as auxiliary inputs, so the state-update path is only indirectly protected. We propose SIGMA-Lane, which treats this failure mode as state contamination in State Space Model (SSM)-based temporal modeling. SIGMA-Lane places occlusion-aware gates on the SSM write and residual-fusion paths, controlling how current observations enter temporal memory and are fused back after temporal propagation. After coordinate-consistent affine alignment, the model combines two complementary paths: SSM-consistent dual-gating for temporal filtering and Structural Spatial Retrieval (SSR) for recovering missing lane structure from aligned historical priors. Experiments on VIL-100 and OpenLane-V show improved temporal stability under heavy occlusion, with competitive F1 and mIoU scores.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SIGMA-Lane，一种基于状态空间模型（State Space Model, SSM）的视频车道检测方法，针对严重车辆遮挡导致时间状态污染的问题。模型在 SSM 的写入和残差融合路径上加入遮挡感知门控，并结合结构空间检索（SSR）从对齐的历史先验恢复缺失车道结构。在 VIL-100 和 OpenLane-V 上的实验显示重遮挡下时间稳定性提升，F1 和 mIoU 达到有竞争力的水平。
Motivation: 视频车道检测要求预测跨帧稳定，但严重车辆遮挡会破坏时间线索；流式递归模型中，被污染的观测进入隐状态后会把误差传播到后续帧。现有遮挡感知方法通常只把障碍物掩码作为辅助输入，状态更新路径仅被间接保护，因此需要更直接地控制状态写入。
Method: 将上述失败模式建模为 SSM 时间记忆中的状态污染，在 SSM 写入路径和残差融合路径上放置遮挡感知门控，控制当前观测如何进入时间记忆以及传播后如何融合回来。经过坐标一致的仿射对齐后，模型结合两条互补路径：SSM 一致双门控（dual-gating）用于时间滤波，结构空间检索（SSR）从对齐的历史先验中恢复缺失的车道结构。
Result: 在 VIL-100 和 OpenLane-V 数据集上的实验表明，该方法在重遮挡场景下提升了时间稳定性，并取得具有竞争力的 F1 和 mIoU 分数。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过对 SSM 时间记忆与融合路径施加遮挡感知门控来避免状态污染，是提升视频车道检测时间稳定性的有效途径，但未在摘要中讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Binary Priorities: Multi-Tier SLA Scheduling for Large Language Model Serving
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM serving deployments must simultaneously satisfy heterogeneous service-level objectives (SLOs) across a diverse population of user tiers, ranging from latency-critical API calls to background batch processing. Llumnix introduced a dynamic, migration-capable multi-instance scheduler for LLM inference that achieves load balancing, defragmentation, prioritization, and auto-scaling through a unified "freeness" metric. However, Llumnix's priority model is restricted to two levels (high and normal), an abstraction too coarse to express the richer SLA classes common in production deployments. In this work, we extend Llumnix's priority model to support an arbitrary number of tiers and evaluate the effects of this extension under three realistic priority distributions (uniform, Gaussian, enterprise) using Vidur, a high-fidelity LLM inference simulator. We implement per-tier headroom with exponential decay, tier-aware dispatch ordering, and the full Llumnix migration pipeline inside Vidur's hierarchical scheduling framework. We compare our extended scheduler against INFaaS (global routing baseline), vLLM, Orca, and Sarathi-Serve (per-replica baselines), sweeping priority levels from 1 to 10. Our experiments demonstrate that four priority tiers yields the best cost-effectiveness tradeoff, achieving prefill mean speedups of up to 8.3x and end-to-end P99 speedups of up to 3.1x over INFaaS with cost-per-latency improvements of 46 to 68%, while preserving strong SLO differentiation across tiers. We further show that the system sustains these gains at 10 priority levels without tail latency collapse, with overhead concentrated in the prefill phase.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 推理服务中 SLA 类别多样但优先级模型过粗的问题，将 Llumnix 的两级优先级（high/normal）扩展为任意层级的 SLA 调度，并在高保真推理模拟器 Vidur 中实现逐层 headroom（指数衰减）、层级感知的调度顺序以及完整的 Llumnix 迁移流水线。实验覆盖三种优先级分布（uniform、Gaussian、enterprise），对比 INFaaS、vLLM、Orca 和 Sarathi-Serve，发现四层优先级在成本-延迟上最优，相较 INFaaS 可实现最高 8.3x 的 prefill 均速提升和 3.1x 的端到端 P99 加速，成本-延迟改善 46%–68%。
Motivation: 生产环境中的 LLM 服务需要同时满足从延迟敏感的 API 调用到后台批处理等异构 SLA 需求，而 Llumnix 的优先级模型仅支持高和普通两级，过于粗糙，无法表达更丰富的 SLA 类别。
Method: 扩展 Llumnix 的优先级模型以支持任意数量的优先级层级，并在 Vidur 的分层调度框架内实现了带指数衰减的逐层 headroom、层级感知的 dispatch 顺序以及完整的迁移流水线，同时用三种现实优先级分布进行仿真评估。
Result: 四层优先级取得最佳成本-延迟折中：prefill 平均加速最高 8.3x、端到端 P99 加速最高 3.1x（相对 INFaaS），成本-延迟改善 46%–68%；在 10 层优先级下仍能保持收益，未出现尾部延迟崩溃，额外开销主要集中在 prefill 阶段。
Conclusion: 作者认为多层级 SLA 调度能在保持各层 SLO 差异化区分的同时显著改善成本-延迟权衡；但结论基于 Vidur 模拟器，尚未涉及真实集群部署。

papers.title: Transfer Learning of Keystroke Dynamics for Cross-Device User Authentication
papers.abstract_en: Keystroke dynamics (typing patterns) can be used as a behavioural biometric modality for user authentication, with applications such as fraud prevention. While the modality has been shown to work well for single device authentication, its application to cross-device scenarios is more challenging. Dynamics learned on one device (eg., phone) may not be directly applicable to authentication on a secondary device with a different form factor (eg., tablet) due to changes in typing patterns that can lead to distribution drifts. To address this, we propose a cross-device user authentication system based on inductive transfer learning, where keystroke dynamics learned on one device are adapted to a secondary device. The adapted data is then combined with necessarily limited training data for the secondary device, which is used to robustly train a binary classifier. Furthermore, an extended set of keystroke features is used to better capture discriminative dynamics. Experiments on the BBMAS dataset show that proposed system achieves an equal error rate of 14.2% for the cross-device scenario, surpassing state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于归纳迁移学习（inductive transfer learning）的跨设备击键动态身份认证系统，将某一设备上学习到的击键动态模式适配到另一设备，并与目标设备有限的训练数据结合来训练二分类器。在 BBMAS 数据集上的跨设备场景中，系统达到 14.2% 的等错误率（EER），优于现有方法。
Motivation: 击键动态作为行为生物特征在单设备认证中表现良好，但跨设备场景下不同形态设备（如手机与平板）会导致打字模式变化和分布漂移，使源设备上学习的动态难以直接用于目标设备认证。
Method: 采用归纳迁移学习将源设备的击键动态适应到目标设备，将迁移后的数据与目标设备有限的训练数据合并，并使用扩展的击键特征集以更好地捕捉判别性动态，训练鲁棒的二元分类器。
Result: 在 BBMAS 数据集上的跨设备认证实验中，系统取得 14.2% 的等错误率（EER），超越了当前最先进的方法。
Conclusion: 摘要表明所提出的迁移学习方法能有效应对跨设备击键认证中的分布漂移问题；摘要未明确说明局限性或更广泛适用性。

papers.title: Step-Level On-Policy Distillation: Interpolating Between On-Policy Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) aligns a student model with a teacher's logit distribution on student-generated trajectories. This approach has achieved strong empirical gains and can often surpass conventional off-policy distillation with substantially less data. However, standard token-level OPD can provide only fragmented corrections along an erroneous student trajectory and cannot unfold a complete and correct repair path. Motivated by this limitation, we propose \emph{Step-Level On-Policy Distillation} (SOPD), which combines the long-horizon correction of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with the on-policy advantage of OPD to provide step-level supervision over complete student-generated trajectories. We show that, at different limits of step length, SOPD reduces to SFT or approximates OPD. Compared with SFT, the teacher responses in SOPD are conditioned on student trajectories and therefore align more closely with student-visited states; compared with OPD, SOPD provides longer-horizon corrections rather than fragmented token-level guidance. Across both reasoning and agent tasks, SOPD substantially outperforms conventional SFT and OPD. For example, on ALFWorld, SOPD improves the average success rate by 13.4 points over Vanilla OPD. We hope this work offers a new perspective for future research on distillation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Step-Level On-Policy Distillation (SOPD)，在完整的学生生成轨迹上提供 step 级监督，试图同时获得 SFT 的长程纠错能力与 OPD 的 on-policy 优势。理论分析表明，在不同 step 长度极限下 SOPD 可退化为 SFT 或近似 OPD；在推理与智能体任务上，SOPD 显著优于传统 SFT 与 OPD，例如在 ALFWorld 上平均成功率较 Vanilla OPD 提升 13.4 个百分点。
Motivation: 标准 token 级 on-policy distillation (OPD) 只能沿错误的学生轨迹提供碎片化修正，无法展开一条完整且正确的修复路径；而 SFT 虽具备长程修正能力，却缺乏 on-policy 对齐。该工作试图在这两者之间插值，兼顾长程纠错与 student-visited states 的一致性。
Method: 提出 SOPD：在完整的学生生成轨迹上施加 step 级监督，teacher 的响应以学生轨迹为条件，从而比 SFT 更贴近学生访问的状态；同时比 token 级 OPD 提供更长视界的修正。论文还论证了 SOPD 在 step 长度极限下退化为 SFT 或近似 OPD，构成 SFT 与 OPD 之间的插值。
Result: 在推理任务和 agent 任务上，SOPD 均大幅超过传统 SFT 和 OPD；具体地，在 ALFWorld 上，SOPD 的平均成功率比 Vanilla OPD 高 13.4 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SOPD 为蒸馏方法研究提供了新视角，其核心是把 SFT 的长程修正与 OPD 的 on-policy 优势结合为统一的 step 级蒸馏框架。

papers.title: Unlocking Motion in Expressions: Temporal Calibration for Referring Video Object Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Referring Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to segment referred objects at the pixel level in video sequences based on natural language descriptions. Existing methods typically introduce motion information within a unified cross-modal temporal modeling framework, where language cues are used for target localization and segmentation. However, the dependency of expressions on motion semantics is not explicitly modeled, making it difficult to adaptively adjust the use of motion information according to different semantic requirements. To address these issues, we propose an Expression-driven Motion Calibration (EMC) framework for RVOS that explicitly unlocks and leverages the motion semantics within expressions. The proposed method extracts interpretable motion control signals from expressions via a Motion Signal Processing (MSP) module, and employs a Motion Influence Calibration (MIC) module to adjust the contribution of motion cues during temporal decision making. In addition, a Semantic Temporal Stage Construction (STSC) module is introduced to build expression-relevant temporal stages, providing a compact temporal candidate space for motion calibration. Through extensive evaluation on six standard benchmarks, including Ref-YouTubeVOS, Ref-DAVIS17, MeViS (valid/valid$^u$), A2D-Sentences, and JHMDB-Sentences, the superiority of our method is validated. We will release the code on https://github.com/Jeven7/EMC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对指称视频对象分割（RVOS）中语言表达对运动语义的依赖未被显式建模的问题，提出表达驱动运动校准框架 EMC。该框架通过 Motion Signal Processing 模块从表达中提取可解释的运动控制信号，用 Motion Influence Calibration 模块调节运动线索在时序决策中的贡献，并用 Semantic Temporal Stage Construction 构建与表达相关的时序阶段。摘要称在 Ref-YouTubeVOS、Ref-DAVIS17、MeViS、A2D-Sentences、JHMDB-Sentences 等六个基准上验证了方法的优越性。
Motivation: 现有 RVOS 方法通常在统一的跨模态时序建模框架中引入运动信息，语言线索仅用于目标定位和分割，未显式建模表达对运动语义的依赖，因此难以根据不同的语义需求自适应调整运动信息的利用。
Method: 提出 EMC 框架，包含三个模块：MSP 从表达中提取可解释的运动控制信号；MIC 在时序决策中调整运动线索的贡献；STSC 构建与表达相关的时序阶段，为运动校准提供紧凑的时序候选空间。
Result: 在 Ref-YouTubeVOS、Ref-DAVIS17、MeViS (valid/valid^u)、A2D-Sentences 和 JHMDB-Sentences 六个标准基准上的广泛评估验证了方法的优越性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式解锁并利用表达中的运动语义可改进 RVOS 的时序决策，并计划在 GitHub 上发布代码。

papers.title: GRNEdit: Efficient General Video Editing from a New Binary-Evidence Perspective in Generative Refinement Networks
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-based general video editing seeks to unify diverse editing operations within a single, intuitive interface. Existing approaches often rely on resource-intensive conditioning, using either heavyweight branches or costly source concatenation. Is there any efficient way to model editing intent? Thus, we introduce GRNEdit, a lightweight two-stage framework. GRN inspires our approach by encoding visual semantics through combinations of bits. Through task-specific fine-tuning, we take this representation further and recast editing semantics as local retain-or-flip decisions over individual bits. Source information is consequently modeled as coordinate-wise evidence supporting the observed binary states, while the GRN backbone remains responsible for resolving their global composition into coherent generative semantics. In Stage I, a compact encoder translates discrete source codes into continuous evidence signals, which GRN assimilates throughout binary refinement. Inspired by null-prompt training for classifier-free guidance, we further assign the null condition an editing-specific meaning: an empty instruction denotes no edit and is supervised through source reconstruction. This identity pathway not only implicitly strengthens evidence utilization and content preservation in Stage I, but also produces a source-preserving state in the same representation space as the edited state. Stage II can therefore directly compare each edited state with its source-preserving counterpart and use their discrepancy to revise unresolved target-bit decisions. Trained on only 0.6M pairs with less than 3\% conditioning parameters, GRNEdit-2B and GRNEdit-8B achieve scores of 4.03 and 4.18 on OpenVE-Bench. The 2B model outperforms multiple 14B open-source editors, while the 8B model performs on par with leading open-source editors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GRNEdit，一个面向基于指令的通用视频编辑的轻量级两阶段框架。其核心思想受 GRN 启发，将编辑语义重新建模为对二进制位 (bits) 的局部保留或翻转决策，源信息被建模为逐坐标的证据信号，由 GRN 主干在二值精化过程中组合成连贯的生成语义。Stage I 用紧凑编码器将离散源编码转为连续证据，并将空指令赋义为不编辑、通过源重建进行监督；Stage II 直接比较编辑态与源保持态之间的差异，修正未解决的目标位决策。
Motivation: 现有基于指令的通用视频编辑方法依赖资源密集的条件建模，例如重型分支或昂贵的源拼接，缺乏高效的编辑意图建模方式。
Method: GRNEdit 采用两阶段轻量框架：Stage I 通过紧凑编码器将源信息编码为连续证据信号，并引入具有编辑特定含义的空条件（空指令表示不编辑）监督源重建；Stage II 利用编辑态与源保持态在相同表示空间中的差异来修订目标位决策。
Result: 仅用 0.6M 训练对和不到 3% 的条件参数，GRNEdit-2B 和 GRNEdit-8B 在 OpenVE-Bench 上分别取得 4.03 和 4.18 的分数；2B 模型超过多个 14B 开源编辑器，8B 模型与领先开源编辑器持平。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这种将编辑意图视为二值证据的方法能够以极低条件参数开销实现高效的通用视频编辑。

papers.title: LaGSplat: Inferring Physics-Governed Interactive Simulation from Monocular Video Using Latent Lagrangian Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: We present LaGSplat (Latent Lagrangian Gaussian Splatting), a framework that infers interactive, physics-governed dynamics from one or a few monocular videos. At inference it lets a user push on the filmed object, rigid or deformable, with an external force that was never measured, annotated, or seen during training. This is possible because a low-dimensional latent state $\mathbf{q} \in \mathbb{R}^d$ plays two roles at once: it is the generalised coordinate of a learned dissipative Lagrangian and the conditioning variable of a Gaussian Splatting decoder. The inductive bias of this decoder, whose primitives are explicit points $μ_i(\mathbf{q})$ that move with the object, is what lets a force $f$ applied in the image pull back into a latent generalised force $J(\mathbf{q})^\top f$ and enter the equations of motion, which pixel-space (CNN) or neural-field (NeRF) decoders cannot do. We validate LaGSplat on test cases of increasing difficulty, from rigid to deformable and from autonomous to forced real systems, combining monocular video and sensor measurements. We further demonstrate interactive use: forces of arbitrary magnitude and direction can be applied to the reconstructed object at any time, its response rendered in real time, in 2D or 3D. Assuming a dissipative Euler-Lagrange equation over a few generalised coordinates trades generality for a bounded, plausible response to unseen forces, where an unconstrained predictor diverges.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 11 figures, 4 tables. Project page with interactive demo: https://louenpottier.github.io/lagsplat.html
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LaGSplat（Latent Lagrangian Gaussian Splatting），从单个或少量单目视频中推断受物理控制的交互式动力学。推理时用户可以对拍摄的刚体或可变形物体施加训练中从未出现过、也未被测量或标注的外力，物体响应可实时渲染。低维潜状态同时充当耗散拉格朗日量的广义坐标和高斯溅射解码器的条件变量，从而让外力能够进入运动方程。
Motivation: 像素空间的 CNN 或神经场（NeRF）解码器无法将图像中施加的力拉回为潜空间的广义力，因此不能对未见过的外力产生物理上合理的交互响应。
Method: 用一个低维潜状态 q∈R^d 同时作为学习到的耗散拉格朗日量（dissipative Lagrangian）的广义坐标和高斯溅射（Gaussian Splatting）解码器的条件变量。解码器的基元是随物体运动的显式点 μ_i(q)，这使得图像中施加的力 f 能通过 J(q)^T f 映射为潜空间广义力并进入运动方程。
Result: 在难度递增的测试上验证了该方法，涵盖刚体到可变形、自主到受迫的真实系统，并混合使用单目视频与传感器测量；还展示了任意大小和方向的外力可在任意时刻施加，并以 2D 或 3D 形式实时渲染响应。
Conclusion: 作者指出，假设少数广义坐标上的耗散欧拉-拉格朗日方程是以通用性换取对未见外力有界且合理的响应，而无约束的预测器会发散。

papers.title: Predicting, Evaluating, and Explaining Top Misinformation Spreaders via Archetypal User Behavior
papers.abstract_en: The spread of misinformation on social networks poses a significant challenge to online communities and society at large. Not all users contribute equally to this phenomenon: a small number of highly effective individuals can exert outsized influence, amplifying false narratives and contributing to significant societal harm. This paper seeks to mitigate the spread of misinformation by enabling proactive interventions, identifying and ranking users according to key behavioral indicators associated with harmful content dissemination. We examine three user archetypes -- amplifiers, super-spreaders, and coordinated accounts -- each characterized by distinct behavioral patterns in the dissemination of misinformation. These are not mutually exclusive, and individual users may exhibit characteristics of multiple archetypes. We develop and evaluate several user ranking models, each aligned with a specific archetype, and find that super-spreader traits consistently dominate the top ranks among the most influential misinformation spreaders. As we move down the ranking, however, the interplay of multiple archetypes becomes more prominent. Additionally, we demonstrate the critical role of temporal dynamics in predictive performance, and introduce methods that reduce data requirements by minimizing the observation window needed for accurate forecasting. Finally, we demonstrate the utility and benefits of explainable AI (XAI) techniques, integrating multiple archetypal traits into a unified model to enhance interpretability and offer deeper insight into the key factors driving misinformation propagation. Our findings provide actionable tools for identifying potentially harmful users and guiding content moderation strategies, enabling platforms to monitor accounts of concern more effectively.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究社交媒体中错误信息传播者的识别与排名，提出放大器（amplifiers）、超级传播者（super-spreaders）和协调账户（coordinated accounts）三类用户原型，并开发与各原型对齐的排名模型。结果发现超级传播者特征在最具影响力的错误信息传播者中持续占据排名顶部，而排名下降后多原型交互更为突出；时间动态对预测性能至关重要，并可通过缩短观察窗口减少数据需求。文章还引入可解释AI（XAI）将多原型特征整合为统一模型以提升可解释性。
Motivation: 错误信息在社交网络中的扩散中，少数高影响力用户能不成比例地放大虚假叙事并造成社会危害，因此需要主动干预和基于关键行为指标的用户排名，以支持平台的内容审核与监控。
Method: 针对三类用户原型分别构建用户排名模型，分析预测性能中的时间动态，提出最小化观察窗口以降低数据需求的方法，并利用可解释AI（XAI）将多个原型特征整合进一个统一且可解释的模型。
Result: 摘要报告超级传播者特征在最有影响力的错误信息传播者排名中持续占主导，而排名较低处多种原型特征的交织更明显；时间动态对预测性能具有关键作用，且缩短观察窗口的方法可减少数据需求。
Conclusion: 本文为识别潜在有害用户和指导内容审核策略提供了可操作的工具，能够帮助平台更有效地监控值得关注的账户。

papers.title: StreamOPD: A Post-Training Recipe with Spatio-Temporal Cue Gating for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video understanding demands direct responses from the causally observed prefix of an unfolding video. Existing systems add inference-time memory, retrieval, and compression, yet a training-free sliding-window baseline already matches them. We therefore fix a memory-free recent-window protocol and ask how far post-training alone can go. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards fits this regime poorly, encouraging long ``think-then-answer'' generations, while on-policy distillation (OPD) supplies dense token-level teacher supervision on student trajectories but is stable only when both models train in thinking mode. These observations lead to \textsc{StreamOPD}, a recipe combining verifiable streaming-video data, thinking-mode OPD, and instruct-mode deployment. It raises StreamingBench from $77.9\%$ to $83.9\%$---within $0.3$ points of the 9B teacher---and improves OVO-Bench excluding its hallucination-detection subtask (HLD) by $9.1$ points under unchanged inference. As a teacher-privilege extension, \emph{Spatio-Temporal CueGate (ST-CueGate)} aggregates cue-versus-no-cue teacher likelihood ratios into a group-relative response score that reweights OPD. It reaches $71.9\%$ on OVO-Bench (excluding HLD) and $64.9\%$ on Video-MME, and is the only variant that stays above the base model on all four benchmarks. Replacing the teacher with a frozen copy of the student's initial policy---on-policy self-distillation---retains most of these gains and lifts HLD to $57.0\%$, above both the untrained student and the 9B teacher, so abstention loss is not intrinsic to the recipe. We provide a transparent and reproducible reference for open-source streaming-video research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StreamOPD，一种面向流式视频理解的后训练方案。作者发现无训练滑窗基线已能匹配现有系统，于是固定无记忆近期窗口协议，仅靠后训练提升性能。方法结合可验证流式视频数据、思维模式 OPD (on-policy distillation) 与指令模式部署，将 StreamingBench 从 77.9% 提升到 83.9%，并在 OVO-Bench（排除 HLD）上提升 9.1 点。
Motivation: 流式视频理解需要在因果观察前缀上直接响应；现有系统依赖推理时记忆、检索和压缩，但无训练滑窗基线已能匹配它们。作者因此追问仅靠后训练能走多远，并发现可验证奖励的强化学习在该场景下不佳，而 OPD 只有在两模型都处于思维模式训练时才稳定。
Method: 提出 StreamOPD 配方，包含可验证的流式视频数据、思维模式 OPD 和指令模式部署；作为教师特权扩展，提出 Spatio-Temporal CueGate (ST-CueGate)，将 cue 与 no-cue 教师似然比聚合成组相对响应分数来重加权 OPD。还探索用学生初始策略的冻结副本替换教师（on-policy self-distillation）。
Result: StreamOPD 将 StreamingBench 从 77.9% 提升到 83.9%，距 9B 教师仅 0.3 点，并在未改变推理的 OVO-Bench（排除 HLD）上提升 9.1 点。ST-CueGate 在 OVO-Bench（排除 HLD）达 71.9%、Video-MME 达 64.9%，且是唯一在所有四个基准上都保持高于基线的变体；自蒸馏变体保留大部分收益并将 HLD 提升到 57.0%，高于未训练学生和 9B 教师。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作为开源流式视频研究提供了透明且可复现的参考基准；自蒸馏实验表明 abstention loss 并非该配方固有的问题。

summary_sections.motivation: 流式视频理解需要在因果观察前缀上直接响应；现有系统依赖推理时记忆、检索和压缩，但无训练滑窗基线已能匹配它们。作者因此追问仅靠后训练能走多远，并发现可验证奖励的强化学习在该场景下不佳，而 OPD 只有在两模型都处于思维模式训练时才稳定。
summary_sections.method: 提出 StreamOPD 配方，包含可验证的流式视频数据、思维模式 OPD 和指令模式部署；作为教师特权扩展，提出 Spatio-Temporal CueGate (ST-CueGate)，将 cue 与 no-cue 教师似然比聚合成组相对响应分数来重加权 OPD。还探索用学生初始策略的冻结副本替换教师（on-policy self-distillation）。
summary_sections.result: StreamOPD 将 StreamingBench 从 77.9% 提升到 83.9%，距 9B 教师仅 0.3 点，并在未改变推理的 OVO-Bench（排除 HLD）上提升 9.1 点。ST-CueGate 在 OVO-Bench（排除 HLD）达 71.9%、Video-MME 达 64.9%，且是唯一在所有四个基准上都保持高于基线的变体；自蒸馏变体保留大部分收益并将 HLD 提升到 57.0%，高于未训练学生和 9B 教师。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该工作为开源流式视频研究提供了透明且可复现的参考基准；自蒸馏实验表明 abstention loss 并非该配方固有的问题。

papers.title: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel and RPI
papers.abstract_en: This first release of Prior Labs in relational learning shows our continued commitment to open science. We open-source three pieces of software that we expect to accelerate research in the field towards meaningful real-world impact. We aim to steer further development based on feedback from, and in collaboration with, the community. Given the early stage of development, our $α$-release targets researchers and early-adopting practitioners. Over the past years, a variety of datasets and tasks for relational learning have emerged, but the community has not converged on a reliable, reproducible way to compare different methods on these tasks. Our $α$-release, RelArena-$α$, provides a unified framework for running and comparing baselines on RelBench v1 by standardizing data loading, evaluation protocols, tuning regimes, and support for systems with custom tuning, inspired by established tabular benchmarks such as TabArena. We plan to work with the research community to further develop RelArena-$α$ into a catalyst for progress in the relational learning community. We release the initial version of TabPFN-Rel, a purpose-built relational harness for TabPFN-3. Currently ranked first among models on RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel makes key improvements upon RDBLearn. Beyond its ranking, TabPFN-Rel serves as a strong baseline, adding to the growing evidence that flattening a relational database into a single table remains competitive with specialized relational architectures on real-world tasks. To facilitate adoption of relational learning methods in research and industry, we release an initial $α$-version of our Relational Predictive Interface, RPI, an open-source, model-agnostic interface that enables early adopters to easily define problems on new databases and apply any model implemented in RelArena-$α$, including TabPFN-Rel, to these problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 Prior Labs 在关系学习 (relational learning) 领域的首个开源发布，包含三个软件组件：统一基准框架 RelArena-α、基于 TabPFN-3 的关系学习工具 TabPFN-Rel，以及模型无关的关系预测接口 RPI。作者称这些工具旨在为关系学习研究提供可复现的比较方式，并希望借助社区反馈继续发展。
Motivation: 关系学习领域出现了多种数据集和任务，但社区尚未就如何可靠、可复现地比较不同方法达成共识，这阻碍了研究进展。
Method: 发布 RelArena-α，统一 RelBench v1 上的数据加载、评估协议、调优机制，并支持自定义调优的系统；发布 TabPFN-Rel 作为 TabPFN-3 的关系学习 harness，改进了 RDBLearn；发布 RPI，一个开源、模型无关的接口，方便在新数据库上定义问题并应用 RelArena-α 中的任意模型。
Result: TabPFN-Rel 目前在 RelArena-α 上排名第一，并作为强基线进一步印证：将关系数据库扁平化为单表在真实任务上仍可与专门的关系架构竞争。
Conclusion: 这是早期 α 版本，面向研究人员和早期采用者；作者将其视为持续开放科学承诺的一部分，计划根据社区反馈推进 RelArena-α 的进一步开发。

papers.title: Revisiting the Performance of Generative Artificial Intelligence on Introductory Object-Oriented Programming Assessments: Insights from 2026
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) have substantially improved the ability of large language models (LLMs) to generate and explain source code. However, their performance on authentic object-oriented programming (OOP) assessments remains insufficiently understood. This study evaluates five widely used GenAI systems, ChatGPT-5.2, DeepSeek-V3, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and M365 Copilot, using programming tests and examination tasks from an introductory university OOP course. The generated solutions were assessed using the same grading criteria applied to students and compared with historical student results from the same course, as well as findings from the previous year. Common errors were also analyzed to identify recurring limitations across models. All evaluated GenAI systems achieved higher scores than the average student cohort and frequently obtained full marks on longer programming tasks. Nevertheless, they occasionally produced non-compiling code and continued to struggle with advanced OOP concepts, particularly interfaces, abstract classes, and certain inheritance-related tasks. Performance was also limited on graphics-related questions involving image interpretation. Compared with the previous year, the evaluated systems demonstrated noticeable improvements across most assessments while exhibiting several recurring error patterns. The findings provide an updated evaluation of the capabilities and limitations of contemporary GenAI systems on authentic introductory OOP assessments. They also offer evidence that can inform the design of programming assessments, the responsible integration of GenAI tools into software engineering education, and future studies evaluating the evolution of AI-assisted programming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了五种主流生成式人工智能 (GenAI) 系统（ChatGPT-5.2、DeepSeek-V3、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.5 和 M365 Copilot）在一门入门级大学面向对象编程 (OOP) 课程考试与编程任务上的表现。所有系统均使用与学生相同的评分标准，并与历史学生成绩及前一年度结果对比。结果表明所有 GenAI 系统得分高于学生平均水平，在较长编程任务上常获满分，但仍存在非编译代码、对接口、抽象类及部分继承相关任务理解不足等问题。
Motivation: 大型语言模型生成和解释源代码的能力显著提升，但它们在真实面向对象编程评估中的表现仍未被充分理解，需要更新评估以指导编程考核设计和 AI 辅助教学。
Method: 使用入门级大学 OOP 课程的编程测试和考试题目，对五种主流 GenAI 系统生成解决方案，采用与学生相同的评分标准进行评分，并与同课程历史学生成绩及上一年度结果对比，同时分析常见错误。
Result: 所有被评估的 GenAI 系统得分高于学生平均 cohort，并常在较长编程任务上获得满分；但它们偶尔生成无法编译的代码，在接口、抽象类和部分继承相关任务上仍有困难，且对涉及图像解释的图形学问题表现受限。与上一年相比，系统在多数评估中显示明显进步，但仍存在若干重复出现的错误模式。
Conclusion: 研究提供了当代 GenAI 系统在真实入门级 OOP 评估中能力与局限的最新证据，可辅助设计编程考核、负责任地整合 GenAI 到软件工程教育中，并为未来 AI 辅助编程演化研究提供参考。

papers.title: Deep Thought Alignment: Trajectory-Level Latent Distillation for Video Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) for video reasoning have long been hindered by the high computational cost of processing vast amounts of visual information. This dilemma motivates the transfer of the reasoning capabilities of large models to smaller, more efficient ones. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers a promising solution by matching output-token distributions along student-generated trajectories. However, video reasoning often depends on evidence accumulated across multiple frames. In this context, output-level supervision only captures information expressed through token predictions and does not directly constrain the latent representations formed during reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Latent-OPD, which augments OPD with trajectory-level latent distillation. Specifically, our method focuses on the position at the end of each trajectory, where hidden states effectively summarize the accumulated visual evidence and reasoning context. Furthermore, we introduce a progressive teacher-lookahead strategy, which aligns middle-to-late student layers with increasingly deeper teacher layers. Experiments on six video reasoning benchmarks show that Latent-OPD consistently outperforms output-only OPD. Notably, the improvements are particularly pronounced in scenarios with limited frames, long videos, or tasks requiring complex evidence aggregation. These results establish Latent-OPD as a highly effective approach to frame-efficient video reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent-OPD，在面向视频推理的大多模态模型（LMM）蒸馏中，用轨迹级潜在蒸馏（trajectory-level latent distillation）增强现有的 On-Policy Distillation (OPD)。方法在每条轨迹末尾位置对齐学生与教师的隐状态，并引入 progressive teacher-lookahead 策略，使学生的中后期层逐渐对齐更深的教师层。在六个视频推理基准上，Latent-OPD 一致优于仅输出级监督的 OPD，在帧数受限、长视频或需要复杂证据聚合的场景下提升尤为明显。
Motivation: 视频推理常依赖跨多帧累积的证据，而 OPD 的输出级监督只约束最终 token 预测所表达的信息，无法直接约束推理过程中形成的潜在表示。
Method: Latent-OPD 在 OPD 基础上增加轨迹级潜在蒸馏，聚焦每条轨迹结束位置（该处隐状态能有效汇总累积的视觉证据与推理上下文）；同时提出 progressive teacher-lookahead 策略，把学生中后期层与逐渐加深的教师层对齐。
Result: 在六个视频推理基准上，Latent-OPD 持续优于仅输出级 OPD；在帧数有限、长视频或复杂证据聚合任务中改进尤为突出。
Conclusion: 摘要将 Latent-OPD 确立为一种高效的帧高效视频推理方法，未提及明显局限性。

papers.title: Correlation Clustering with Random Partial Information
papers.abstract_en: Correlation clustering is a fundamental unsupervised learning problem. On complete graphs, both the min-disagreement and min-max objectives admit constant-factor approximations, yet on general (non-complete) graphs, the best guarantees blow up to $O(\log n)$ and $O(\sqrt{n})$. This gap between the two regimes motivates the following question: are there classes of incomplete graphs that circumvent the lower bounds on general graphs and admit approximation guarantees approaching those attainable on complete graphs? We study a natural class of graphs obtained by randomly subsampling a complete signed graph $G$, where each edge is independently deleted with probability $q$. For such graph instances both for the min-max and the min-disagreement objectives, we prove approximation guarantees (depending on $q$) that are substantially better than the bounds achievable for general graphs. We supplement our theoretical results with experiments that also suggest that the approximation ratios of our algorithm are close to those of the complete graph and better than the worst-case bounds for general (non-complete) graphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究相关聚类（correlation clustering）在随机部分信息下的近似保证：考虑由完全符号图随机子采样得到的图类，其中每条边以概率 q 独立删除。作者针对 min-disagreement 和 min-max 两个目标，证明了依赖于 q 的近似比，显著优于一般（非完全）图上的已知界，并用实验表明这些近似比接近完全图情形。
Motivation: 完全图上的相关聚类已有常数因子近似，而一般图上的最好保证退化为 O(log n) 与 O(sqrt n)。作者试图寻找既能规避一般图下界、又接近完全图可逼近性的不完全图类。
Method: 提出一类由完全符号图随机删除每条边（概率 q）得到的图实例，并在此类图上分析 min-max 与 min-disagreement 两个目标的近似算法，给出与 q 相关的近似比上界。
Result: 摘要报告，在随机子采样图类上，两个目标的近似保证都明显优于一般图的最坏情形界；实验进一步显示算法得到的近似比接近完全图情形。
Conclusion: 随机部分信息构成一类可绕过一般图下界的不完全图，其近似表现接近完全图；作者以理论保证加实验验证支持这一结论。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cross-View Urban Sensing: Mapping Subjective Streetscape Perception via AlphaEarth Embeddings and Urban Context
papers.abstract_en: Residents' perception of the urban streetscape is an important factor in public health, active mobility, and social wellbeing. Street view imagery (SVI) has emerged as a widely used data source for assessing these perceptual qualities, yet its uneven coverage and irregular updating limit large-scale measurement. Here, we present CVLNet, a Cross-View Learning Network that predicts street-level perception from AlphaEarth embeddings and multi-source urban contextual data without requiring SVI at inference. CVLNet applies per-task adaptive gating to jointly model five perceptual dimensions, using labels from the pretrained SVI-Percept model as ground truth. The proposed method is evaluated across four Southeast Asian cities: Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Jakarta, and Manila. CVLNet achieves a median road-segment-level Adjusted $R^{2}$ of 0.76 and consistently outperforms the baseline models, with gains ranging from 5.9--11.3% across the five perceptual dimensions. Ablation experiments show that AlphaEarth features and urban contextual features contribute complementary information. We further produce citywide road-level streetscape perception maps for five subjective perceptual dimensions across all four cities, extending perception estimation from the 13--31% of the road network directly covered by available SVI to the complete road network of each city. Integrating these maps with WorldPop gridded population data, we quantify exposure inequality across population-density, demographic, and land-use groups using the Deficit Palma Ratio. These results demonstrate that remote sensing can serve as a scalable alternative to SVI for citywide streetscape perception mapping, enabling a more comprehensive assessment of urban environmental inequality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CVLNet（Cross-View Learning Network），利用 AlphaEarth 遥感嵌入与多源城市上下文数据预测街道级主观街景感知，推理时无需街景影像（SVI）。该网络采用逐任务自适应门控联合建模五个感知维度，并以预训练 SVI-Percept 模型的标签作为监督。在 Singapore、Kuala Lumpur、Jakarta、Manila 四个东南亚城市的评估中，CVLNet 取得中位路段级 Adjusted R² 0.76，并持续优于基线模型。作者还将感知估计从 SVI 直接覆盖的 13–31% 路段扩展到各城市完整路网，并与 WorldPop 人口数据结合量化暴露不平等。
Motivation: 街景影像（SVI）常用于评估居民对城市街道的感知质量，但其覆盖不均且更新不规则，限制了大范围测量。本文旨在用遥感嵌入和多源上下文数据替代 SVI，实现城市级、无需推理时街景影像的街道感知制图。
Method: 提出 CVLNet，一种跨视角学习网络：输入 AlphaEarth 嵌入与多源城市上下文特征，通过逐任务自适应门控（per-task adaptive gating）联合建模五个感知维度，并以预训练 SVI-Percept 模型给出的标签作为监督信号进行训练。

Conclusion: 摘要认为遥感影像可作为 SVI 的可扩展替代方案，用于城市级街景感知制图，并借助人口数据进一步评估城市环境不平等。

papers.title: Static Pruning Across Sparse Retrieval Regimes: What Transfers, What Breaks, and What Still Helps
papers.abstract_en: Static pruning is widely used to accelerate sparse neural retrieval, yet existing studies each validate their conclusions within a single custom pipeline, leaving it unclear which findings transfer to modern engines with different index organizations and dynamic pruning mechanisms. We present the first cross-engine pruning portability study, evaluating static pruning strategies across three engines - a controlled C++ pipeline (exhaustive inverted index), BMP (block-max pruning), and SEISMIC (clustered inverted indexes) - on two benchmarks (MS MARCO, Natural Questions) with two encoders spanning opposite query-density regimes (SPLADE: 44 avg. query terms; V3-GTE: 7 avg. query terms), totaling 1,140 experimental configurations, with an additional deep-judgment validation on TREC DL 2019/2020. We find that index-side pruning (document and posting-list) is portable: it consistently reduces latency (1.2-6.6$\times$) and index size (18-82%) across all engines because sparse retrieval is memory-bound - a conclusion we support with cache-miss, TLB, and IPC profiling. In contrast, query pruning is already internalized by modern engines: it yields 4-11$\times$ speedup on the exhaustive pipeline but is subsumed by BMP's $β$ and SEISMIC's query_cut. Static pruning complements dynamic pruning: on BMP, combining document and query reduction yields 2.5$\times$ speedup with NDCG@10 within 0.003 of the exact baseline. Finally, NDCG@10 saturates while Recall@10 is still in the ${\sim}$85-95% range across all three engines, providing a portable stopping criterion: practitioners can push pruning to this knee without visible ranking degradation. Together, these findings answer what transfers (index-side pruning), what breaks (query pruning), and what still helps (static atop dynamic pruning).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次进行跨引擎的静态剪枝（static pruning）可移植性研究，在三种稀疏检索引擎（穷举倒排索引的C++管线、BMP 块级最大剪枝、SEISMIC 聚类倒排索引）上，结合两个基准（MS MARCO、Natural Questions）和两种编码器（SPLADE、V3-GTE）共进行1140个实验配置，并在 TREC DL 2019/2020 上做了深度判定验证。摘要指出索引侧剪枝在所有引擎上可移植，而查询侧剪枝已被现代引擎内化。
Motivation: 现有静态剪枝研究各自在单一定制管线中验证结论，导致哪些发现能迁移到索引组织和动态剪枝机制不同的现代引擎上不明确。
Method: 设计跨引擎剪枝可移植性实验，对比穷举倒排索引、BMP 和 SEISMIC 三种引擎，测量延迟、索引大小，并用 cache-miss、TLB 和 IPC 剖析说明稀疏检索受内存带宽限制。
Result: 索引侧剪枝（文档与倒排列表）稳定带来1.2-6.6倍延迟降低和18-82%的索引缩小；查询剪枝在穷举管线上有4-11倍加速但在 BMP 和 SEISMIC 上被内部机制取代；在 BMP 上叠加文档与查询剪枝得到2.5倍加速且 NDCG@10 与精确基线相差不超过0.003；NDCG@10 饱和而 Recall@10 仍在约85-95%区间。
Conclusion: 摘要总结为：可迁移的是索引侧剪枝，失效的是查询剪枝，仍有价值的是在动态剪枝之上叠加静态剪枝，并给出以 NDCG 饱和点为依据的可移植剪枝停止准则。

papers.title: PosterText: Towards Unified Visual Text Generation and Editing for E-commerce Poster
papers.abstract_en: Automated e-commerce poster design requires both high-quality poster generation and flexible editing of existing designs. However, most existing methods either target end-to-end poster generation or follow multi-stage design pipelines, with limited capability for flexible and precise editing of existing posters. To enable unified generation and editing of e-commerce posters, we introduce Text Patch Generation and Editing, a unified task formulation that treats text patches as atomic units and covers four operations: poster generation, patch addition, patch deletion, and patch modification, with optional reference-guided style control. Based on this, we propose PosterText, a unified model trained with a four-stage curriculum, including text rendering pretraining, instruction-following training, reinforcement learning for preference alignment, and spatial guidance self-distillation for execution refinement. We further construct a large-scale dataset with patch-level annotations and a comprehensive benchmark for evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PosterText achieves competitive performance against existing generation and editing approaches, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PosterText，一个面向电商海报的统一视觉文本生成与编辑模型。作者将任务建模为文本补丁生成与编辑（Text Patch Generation and Editing），以文本补丁为原子单元，覆盖海报生成、补丁添加、删除和修改四种操作，并支持可选的参考图风格控制。模型采用四阶段课程训练，并构建了带补丁级标注的大规模数据集与评测基准。实验表明 PosterText 在生成与编辑任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 现有电商海报自动化方法要么做端到端生成，要么走多阶段设计流程，对已有海报的灵活、精确编辑能力有限，缺少统一的生成与编辑框架。
Method: 提出统一任务形式 Text Patch Generation and Editing，将文本补丁视为原子单元，涵盖生成、添加、删除、修改四种操作；在此基础上提出 PosterText 模型，采用四阶段课程训练：文本渲染预训练、指令跟随训练、用于偏好对齐的强化学习、以及用于执行细化的空间引导自蒸馏（spatial guidance self-distillation）。
Result: 在构造的大规模补丁级标注数据集和综合基准上的广泛实验显示，PosterText 在现有生成与编辑方法对比中取得有竞争力的性能，验证了框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将文本补丁作为原子单元的统一任务建模与四阶段训练方案，可以同时支撑高质量海报生成和灵活编辑。

papers.title: SCALE: State-Calibrated Latent Embeddings for JEPA Planning in the Right Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding predictive world models plan by scoring predicted terminal embeddings against a goal embedding using a cost defined on the representation itself. Two prominent strategies for obtaining non-collapsed representations are to inherit a pretrained feature space, as in DINO-WM, and to learn an embedding end to end with anti-collapse regularization, as in LeWorldModel (LeWM) with SIGReg. These strategies show complementary strengths across tasks. Although task-relevant state is decodable from the full embeddings of both models, DINO-WM's leading principal components usually retain substantially more state information than LeWM's. Because Euclidean planning costs are dominated by high-variance directions, this difference affects how strongly state can influence candidate selection. We propose SCALE (State-CAlibrated Latent Embeddings) to give the end-to-end LeWM representation the favorable geometric property observed in DINO-WM. SCALE induces this property by correlating sampled pairwise latent distances with distances in a standardized task-relevant state space, without replacing LeWM's learned encoder. Across five tasks, three planning solvers, and five compute budgets, SCALE improves every task--solver average over LeWM. A latent-to-state regression control matches or exceeds SCALE's full-embedding decodability yet leaves latent--state distance alignment essentially unchanged and yields less consistent planning gains. SCALE adds a single lightweight training-time regularizer and no planning-time overhead. These results show that planning depends not only on whether task-relevant information is present, but also on whether it shapes the geometry consumed by the planner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCALE（State-Calibrated Latent Embeddings），一种轻量训练时正则化方法，用于让端到端学习的 LeWorldModel（LeWM）表征获得类似 DINO-WM 的几何性质，即潜空间主成分保留更多任务相关状态信息。摘要报告在五个任务、三种规划求解器和五种计算预算下，SCALE 在每个 task-solver 平均上都优于 LeWM，且不增加规划时开销。
Motivation: 联合嵌入预测世界模型（JEPA）在表征上定义规划代价，而 DINO-WM 继承预训练特征、LeWM 端到端学习并配合反坍缩正则，两者优势互补但几何性质不同。由于欧氏规划代价受高方差方向主导，LeWM 表征中任务相关状态对候选选择的影响较弱，规划性能因此受限。
Method: SCALE 通过将采样的成对潜变量距离与标准化任务相关状态空间中的距离相关联，使端到端 LeWM 表征具有 DINO-WM 中观察到的有利几何属性；该方法不替换 LeWM 的学习编码器，仅在训练时增加一个轻量正则项。
Result: 在五个任务、三种规划求解器、五种计算预算的设置下，SCALE 对每个 task-solver 平均表现均优于 LeWM。对照实验表明，latent-to-state 回归控制达到或超过 SCALE 的完整嵌入可解码性，但几乎不改变潜变量与状态的距离对齐，规划增益也较不稳定。
Conclusion: 结果表明，规划不仅取决于任务相关信息是否存在，还取决于这些信息如何塑造规划器所消费的潜空间几何结构；SCALE 以极小的训练侧改动获得一致的规划改进。

papers.title: Audio-Visual Segmentation via Depth-Guided Collaborative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Audio-Visual Segmentation (AVS) is a fundamental task in multimodal perception that performs pixel-level segmentation of sounding objects in videos by leveraging both visual and audio cues. It has broad applications in video understanding, human-computer interaction, and autonomous driving. However, most existing AVS methods do not explicitly model geometric cues such as relative distance and occlusion, thereby limiting the robustness of cross-modal alignment. In human perception, spatial structure is naturally integrated with audio-visual evidence to accurately localize sounding objects. Motivated by this, we incorporate estimated depth as a spatial structural cue for AVS and propose DGCM-AVS, a tri-modal framework that jointly models audio, visual, and depth information. Specifically, we design a Depth-Aware Dynamic Modulator to improve the separation of adjacent objects while preserving intra-object feature consistency. Furthermore, we propose Depth-Guided Progressive Fusion, which uses depth as an intermediate bridge to progressively align audio cues with visual features. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, DGCM-AVS achieves relative improvements of 10.2 percent in M_J and 8.7 percent in M_F on the AVSS dataset. We believe our study highlights depth as a promising yet underexplored modality for AVS and may encourage further research in this direction.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Multimedia, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对音视频分割（Audio-Visual Segmentation, AVS）任务提出 DGCM-AVS，一个联合建模音频、视觉与深度信息的三模态框架。作者将估计深度作为空间结构线索，设计深度感知动态调制器（Depth-Aware Dynamic Modulator）改善相邻物体分离并保持物体内部特征一致性，并提出深度引导渐进融合（Depth-Guided Progressive Fusion），以深度为中间桥梁渐进对齐音频与视觉特征。在 AVSS 数据集上，相比现有方法，DGCM-AVS 在 M_J 和 M_F 上分别获得 10.2% 和 8.7% 的相对提升。
Motivation: 现有大多数 AVS 方法没有显式建模相对距离、遮挡等几何线索，限制了跨模态对齐的鲁棒性；而人类感知中空间结构会与音视频证据自然整合，用于精确定位发声物体。
Method: 提出三模态框架 DGCM-AVS，在音频、视觉之外引入估计深度作为空间结构线索；通过深度感知动态调制器增强相邻物体分离并保持物体内部一致性，并通过深度引导渐进融合利用深度作为中间桥梁，将音频线索与视觉特征逐步对齐。
Result: 在 AVSS 数据集上，与当前最先进方法相比，DGCM-AVS 在 M_J 上取得 10.2% 的相对提升，在 M_F 上取得 8.7% 的相对提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为深度是 AVS 中一个有前景但尚未充分探索的模态，并希望该工作能鼓励后续研究朝这一方向发展。

summary_sections.method: 提出三模态框架 DGCM-AVS，在音频、视觉之外引入估计深度作为空间结构线索；通过深度感知动态调制器增强相邻物体分离并保持物体内部一致性，并通过深度引导渐进融合利用深度作为中间桥梁，将音频线索与视觉特征逐步对齐。
summary_sections.result: 在 AVSS 数据集上，与当前最先进方法相比，DGCM-AVS 在 M_J 上取得 10.2% 的相对提升，在 M_F 上取得 8.7% 的相对提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为深度是 AVS 中一个有前景但尚未充分探索的模态，并希望该工作能鼓励后续研究朝这一方向发展。

papers.title: TransAnyText: Translating Arbitrary Text in E-commerce Images via Structured Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: Cross-border e-commerce image translation is essential for global retail, where product images, banners, and detail pages need to be produced in different languages. Existing methods struggle to achieve accurate translation, faithful visual identity preservation, and easy-to-edit outputs, simultaneously. To address these challenges, we introduce TransAnyText, a structured visual code framework that reformulates image text translation as generating renderable HTML patches from source images and target languages. Our framework decouples semantic generation from pixel rendering: a vision-language model (VLM) handles visual understanding, cross-lingual translation, and structured visual generation, while a diffusion model performs background inpainting and pixel-level refinement, followed by deterministic rendering to synthesize the final image. Based on this formulation, we develop a three-stage post-training framework, where supervised fine-tuning (SFT) establishes the image-to-code mapping, privilege-gap weighted self-distillation (PWSD) improves the learning of style and layout tokens, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) further optimizes task-level performance. We further introduce TransAnyDataset and TransAnyBench, a multilingual dataset and benchmark for e-commerce image translation. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive performance against cascaded pipelines, open-source end-to-end models, and closed-source image editing systems, providing an effective, controllable, and editable solution for cross-border e-commerce image translation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TransAnyText，一个面向跨境电商图片中的文字翻译的结构化视觉代码框架，将图像文字翻译重新定义为从源图像和目标语言生成可渲染 HTML 补丁 (renderable HTML patches) 的任务。框架将语义生成与像素渲染解耦：视觉语言模型 (VLM) 负责视觉理解、跨语言翻译和结构化生成，扩散模型负责背景修复与像素级细化，再由确定性渲染合成最终图像。作者还构建了多语言数据集 TransAnyDataset 和基准 TransAnyBench，实验显示其性能可与级联流程、开源端到端模型及闭源图像编辑系统竞争。
Motivation: 跨境电商图片翻译需要在产品图、横幅和详情页中生成多语言版本，但现有方法难以同时满足翻译准确、忠实保持视觉身份以及输出易于编辑这三个要求。
Method: 提出结构化视觉代码框架 TransAnyText，将语义生成（由 VLM 完成）与像素渲染（扩散模型加确定性渲染）解耦，并开发三阶段后训练流程：监督微调 (SFT) 建立图像到代码的映射，特权差距加权自蒸馏 (PWSD) 改进风格与布局 token 的学习，带可验证奖励的强化学习 (RLVR) 进一步优化任务级性能。
Result: 在自建的多语言电商图像翻译数据集 TransAnyDataset 和基准 TransAnyBench 上，摘要报告该方法在与级联流程、开源端到端模型和闭源图像编辑系统的对比中取得具有竞争力的表现。
Conclusion: 摘要将该方案定性为跨境电商图片翻译的一种有效、可控且可编辑的解决方案，强调其在准确翻译与视觉身份保持之间的平衡。

papers.title: Decoupled Temporal Encoding for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Positional encoding is a fundamental component of Transformer-based generative recommendation models, where user histories are modeled as autoregressive item sequences. Most positional encoding methods are inherited from natural language processing and mainly represent discrete item order. However, recommendation sequences go beyond ordered lists, as timestamps and temporal effects also shape item relations. Our work is motivated by a real-world food delivery and instant retail recommendation system, where user behavior exhibits multi-level temporal regularities, including recency effects, meal-time peaks, weekday-weekend shifts, and promotion-driven traffic bursts. Existing methods partially address this issue through timestamp features, interval embeddings, decay functions, or attention biases, but they usually inject heterogeneous temporal signals through a unified representation or a single modeling pathway, making it difficult to distinguish broad temporal dynamics from local order cues. To address this limitation, we propose Decoupled Temporal Encoding, a lightweight framework for generative recommendation. DTE separates temporal dynamics from order information through two complementary modules: a personalized macro-temporal module that injects compact temporal primitives into item embeddings, and a time-gated micro-sequential module that introduces relative-order bias only when interactions are temporally dense. DTE is also parameter-efficient and deployment-friendly, allowing easy integration into existing systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向基于Transformer的生成式推荐模型，提出解耦时间编码（Decoupled Temporal Encoding, DTE）框架，将时间动态与顺序信息分离。DTE由个性化宏观时间模块与时间门控微观顺序模块组成，前者将紧凑时间基元注入物品嵌入，后者仅在交互时间密集时引入相对顺序偏置。摘要强调其轻量、参数高效且易于集成到现有系统，但未报告定量实验结果。
Motivation: 现有位置编码大多继承自NLP，主要表示离散物品顺序，而推荐序列中时间戳和时序效应同样影响物品关系。真实外卖与即时零售场景存在多级时间规律，已有方法通过时间戳特征、区间嵌入、衰减函数或注意力偏置处理，但往往用统一表示或单一路径注入异质时间信号，难以区分宏观时间动态与局部顺序线索。
Method: 提出解耦时间编码DTE，包含两个互补模块：个性化宏观时间模块将紧凑时间基元注入物品嵌入，捕获用餐高峰、工作日周末差异、促销流量爆发等宏观规律；时间门控微观顺序模块仅在交互时间密集时引入相对顺序偏置，从而将时间动态与顺序信息分开建模。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的量化实验结果，仅说明该方法在生成式推荐框架下实现时间动态与顺序信息的解耦，并强调其轻量、参数高效和部署友好等属性。
Conclusion: 作者认为将异构时间信号从统一表示中解耦、按时间密度动态注入顺序偏置，是一种有效且易集成的生成式推荐建模思路。摘要未提及该方法的局限或失败案例。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Foresight-England: Development of a National-Scale Generative AI Model of Electronic Health Records for Medical Event Prediction across the COVID-19 Pandemic
papers.abstract_en: Foresight-England (Foresight-E) is the first national-scale generative foundation model of electronic health records (EHRs), developed as a research pilot strictly for COVID-19 research. We evaluated its ability to model the direct and indirect effects of the pandemic. Trained from scratch entirely within the NHS England Secure Data Environment, Foresight-E is a 243-million-parameter transformer decoder. It was trained and evaluated on de-identified, longitudinal EHRs of approximately 61 million individuals, integrating primary/secondary care, death registrations, and COVID-19 data. Training and validation used a 90% subset (54.9 million) spanning November 2018 to December 2022; the remaining 10% (6.1 million) was held out for evaluation. Foresight-E models patient timelines autoregressively, predicting the next medical event given their prior history. At inference, it operates zero-shot, predicting any concept in its ~40,000-code vocabulary without task-specific training. Our tokenisation scheme retains the clinical granularity of ICD-10, OPCS-4, and SNOMED CT codes, jointly representing absolute and relative timing. We designed an evaluation framework for 30-day COVID-19 hospitalisation and mortality, including subgroup analyses by demographic factors and vaccination status. To assess generalisation to unseen future data and the pandemic's indirect effects, we tested the model on medical events from 2023 (beyond its training period), benchmarking against logistic regression and XGBoost. As detailed in the Project Status section, NHS England has paused access to data for the Foresight-E project, meaning quantitative results are currently unavailable. Instead, we share our strategy for tokenisation, architecture, training, inference, and evaluation as a methodological template and case study in the challenges of building population-scale EHR foundation models.
papers.comment: Methodology and evaluation framework for Foresight-England. As detailed in the Project Status section, NHS England has paused access to data for the Foresight-E project, meaning quantitative results are not currently available. On behalf of the CVD-COVID-UK/COVID-IMPACT Consortium
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Foresight-England (Foresight-E) 是首个全国规模的电子健康记录 (EHR) 生成式基础模型，作为严格限于 COVID-19 研究的研究试点，在 NHS England 安全数据环境中从零训练。该模型为 2.43 亿参数的 Transformer decoder，基于约 6100 万人的去标识化纵向 EHR（整合初级/次级医疗、死亡登记和 COVID-19 数据），以自回归方式预测下一个医疗事件，并在约 4 万个代码的词汇表上零样本运行。由于 NHS England 已暂停该项目的数据访问，定量结果目前不可用，论文转而给出 tokenisation、架构、训练、推理和评估的方法学模板。
Motivation: 大规模 EHR 数据蕴含丰富的纵向医疗事件序列，但此前缺乏全国尺度、可零样本预测任意医疗概念的生成式基础模型，也缺少针对疫情直接与间接影响建模的评估框架。
Method: 提出 Foresight-E，一个 2.43 亿参数的 Transformer decoder，以自回归方式建模患者时间线；tokenisation 保留 ICD-10、OPCS-4 和 SNOMED CT 的临床粒度，并联合表示绝对与相对时间。训练和验证用 90% 子集（5490 万人，2018 年 11 月至 2022 年 12 月），保留 10%（610 万）用于评估；评估框架针对 30 天 COVID-19 住院和死亡，含人口学因素与疫苗接种状态的亚组分析，并用 2023 年事件检验泛化能力，基线为 logistic regression 和 XGBoost。
Result: 摘要明确说明 NHS England 已暂停 Foresight-E 项目的数据访问，因此定量结果目前不可用；论文提供的是方法学模板和构建人口规模 EHR 基础模型所遇挑战的案例研究。
Conclusion: 作者将这项工作定位为方法学与评估框架的共享，而非实证结果报告；强调在全国尺度 EHR 基础模型开发中面临的数据访问暂停等现实约束，可作为后续研究的模板。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Efficient Coreset Selection via K-Nearest Neighbor Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Coreset selection reduces the cost of model training by replacing a large training set with a small representative subset. Existing gradient-approximation coreset methods such as CRAIG and cluster-based variants can preserve model accuracy. Still, their selection stages often rely on dense pairwise distances or large item-cluster bound matrices, leading to high time and memory costs on large datasets. This paper proposes KNNG-CS, a lightweight coreset selection method based on a $K$-nearest neighbor graph. KNNG-CS exploits local neighborhood structures to estimate the importance of each data item and greedily selects representative nodes without maintaining a quadratic distance matrix. The method requires only linear storage in the number of edges. Experiments on four real-world datasets show that KNNG-CS achieves accuracy comparable to representative gradient-approximation coreset methods, while reducing selection time by $2.3\times$-$41.2\times$ and peak memory to $0.3\%$-$7.5\%$ of the baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KNNG-CS，一种基于 K 近邻图 (K-nearest neighbor graph) 的轻量级核心集选择 (coreset selection) 方法，用于在模型训练前用小型代表性子集替代大型训练集。KNNG-CS 利用局部邻域结构估计每个数据项的重要性，并以贪心方式选择代表性节点，避免维护二次距离矩阵，存储开销与边数成线性关系。在四个真实数据集上，KNNG-CS 在保持与代表性梯度近似核心集方法相当精度的同时，将选择时间降低 2.3 倍至 41.2 倍，峰值内存降至基线的 0.3% 至 7.5%。
Motivation: 现有的梯度近似核心集方法（如 CRAIG 和基于聚类的变体）能够保持模型精度，但其选择阶段通常依赖密集的成对距离或大型 item-cluster 边界矩阵，导致在大数据集上的时间和内存成本很高。
Method: 提出 KNNG-CS，基于 K 近邻图进行核心集选择。该方法利用局部邻域结构估计每个数据项的重要性，并贪心选择代表性节点，无需维护二次距离矩阵，仅需与边数成线性关系的存储。
Result: 在四个真实数据集上的实验表明，与代表性梯度近似核心集方法相比，KNNG-CS 在精度相当的情况下，选择时间减少 2.3 倍至 41.2 倍，峰值内存降至基线的 0.3% 至 7.5%。
Conclusion: KNNG-CS 表明，利用局部邻域结构可以显著降低核心集选择阶段的时间和内存开销，同时保持模型精度。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在四个真实数据集上的实验表明，与代表性梯度近似核心集方法相比，KNNG-CS 在精度相当的情况下，选择时间减少 2.3 倍至 41.2 倍，峰值内存降至基线的 0.3% 至 7.5%。
summary_sections.conclusion: KNNG-CS 表明，利用局部邻域结构可以显著降低核心集选择阶段的时间和内存开销，同时保持模型精度。

papers.title: Domain-Agnostic Neural Topic Modeling with Contextual Token-Level Semantic Graph Representation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in neural topic models with pre-trained language models (PLMs) have achieved strong performance by leveraging general-domain pre-training, yet their topic interpretability often degrades on specialized corpora. This limitation primarily stems from the geometry of the embedding space, where domain-specific terms unseen during pre-training collapse into an indistinguishable region, and neither domain-specific re-training, word-level graph enrichment, nor parameter-efficient fine-tuning can restructure this space without inheriting the capacity ceiling of the underlying encoder. Our key insight is that a learnable graph layer operating on token-level PLM embeddings can acquire corpus-specific semantic structure that the frozen encoder lacks, because token-level graphs preserve document-local context that word-level representations discard and joint optimization with the topic objective reshapes embedding geometry directly from target-domain evidence. We instantiate this insight as DARTopic, a domain-agnostic framework that constructs token-level semantic graphs from frozen PLM embeddings and jointly trains a GNN encoder with topic inference. Across three benchmarks spanning general, biomedical, and legal domains, DARTopic consistently outperforms strong baselines in topic coherence and document clus- tering without any encoder fine-tuning, while demonstrating robustness to PLM choice and favorable runtime efficiency over fine-tuning based alternatives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DARTopic，一个领域无关 (domain-agnostic) 的神经主题模型框架：从冻结的预训练语言模型 (PLM) 的 token 级嵌入构建语义图，并与主题推断联合训练 GNN 编码器。摘要在通用、生物医学和法律三个基准上报告，DARTopic 在不做任何编码器微调的情况下，在主题连贯性 (topic coherence) 和文档聚类上持续超过强基线，且对 PLM 选择具有鲁棒性，运行效率优于基于微调的替代方案。
Motivation: 基于 PLM 的神经主题模型在通用语料上表现良好，但在专业领域语料上主题可解释性下降，原因是预训练未见过的领域专有词在嵌入空间中坍缩到难以区分的区域；领域重训练、词级图增强或参数高效微调都受制于底层编码器的容量上限，无法重构该空间。
Method: 核心思路是可学习的图层作用于 token 级 PLM 嵌入，能够获取冻结编码器缺乏的语料特有语义结构；token 级图保留词级表示丢弃的文档局部上下文，且与主题目标联合优化能直接依据目标领域证据重塑嵌入几何。具体实现为 DARTopic：从冻结 PLM 嵌入构建 token 级语义图，并联合训练 GNN 编码器与主题推断。
Result: 在通用、生物医学和法律三个基准上，DARTopic 在主题连贯性和文档聚类上均一致优于强基线，且无需编码器微调；同时表现出对 PLM 选择的鲁棒性，并在运行效率上优于基于微调的方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调只需在冻结编码器之上学习 token 级图结构，即可在领域迁移下实现领域无关的主题建模，避免编码器微调带来的开销与容量限制。

papers.title: CoM$^3$eT: A foundation model for medical image analysis through federated, multidimensional context integration
papers.abstract_en: Medical foundation models improve generalization when training AI models with limited labeled data, but remain confined to a single specialty, such as pathology or radiology, and to either sparse or dense outputs, such as classification or segmentation. Here, we present CoM$^3$eT (Co-representation Multidimensional Multitask Medical Transformer), a medical vision foundation model that unifies pathology and radiology, sparse and dense predictions, and two- and higher-dimensional inputs by modeling multidimensional context with attention. CoM$^3$eT outperformed other medical foundation models in an open competition spanning five tomographic, four whole-specimen, and three two-dimensional datasets, covering sparse and dense prediction tasks as well as report generation. When adapted across diverse clinical applications, training fewer than 2.5% of parameters achieved performance comparable to full fine-tuning, enabling research without access to high-performance GPU clusters. Applied to federated learning across hospitals, this approach achieved performance comparable to pooled-data training over internet connections and with consumer-grade hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoM$^3$eT（Co-representation Multidimensional Multitask Medical Transformer），一个用注意力机制建模多维上下文、统一病理与放射影像、稀疏与密集预测以及二维与高维输入的医学视觉基础模型。在跨越多个数据集和任务的开放竞赛中，它优于其他医学基础模型；仅微调少于 2.5% 的参数即可达到与全量微调相当的性能，并在联邦学习跨医院场景中取得与集中式数据训练相近的结果。
Motivation: 现有医学基础模型大多局限于单一专科（如病理学或放射学）和单一输出类型（如分类或分割），缺乏能够跨专科、跨任务类型、跨输入维度的统一模型。
Method: 提出 CoM$^3$eT，通过注意力机制对多维上下文进行建模，将病理与放射、稀疏与密集预测、二维与更高维输入统一到一个视觉 Transformer 框架中，并结合参数高效微调与联邦学习适配。
Result: 在包含五个断层成像、四个全标本和三个二维数据集的开放竞赛中，该模型在稀疏/密集预测任务及报告生成上均优于其他医学基础模型；在多种临床应用中，训练少于 2.5% 的参数即取得与全量微调相当的性能；在互联网连接和消费级硬件下开展的跨医院联邦学习也达到与集中式池化数据训练相当的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要认为统一的多维上下文建模与参数高效微调能使医学基础模型跨专科泛化，并显著降低算力门槛，同时也能在联邦学习设置下保持性能。

papers.title: Seeing Before Answering: Training-Free Visual Layer Profiling for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: LLaVA-style Vision-Language Models (VLMs) pass visual tokens from a fixed late layer of the vision backbone, typically the penultimate one, to the language model. We first show that this hidden convention is fragile: across 2 VLMs and 7 image and video benchmarks, the default layer is sub-optimal in 13 of 14 model-task pairs, and the best layer shifts with both task and visual backbone. Finding that layer by exhaustive layer-wise inference is prohibitively expensive, and no better fixed default exists. We therefore ask whether layer usefulness can instead be predicted from representation geometry. We study matrix-based entropy, introduced for unimodal layer analysis, which we compute over sample-level visual embeddings as Visual Dataset Entropy (VDE); and Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) distance, introduced for encoder-level VLM model selection, which we repurpose as a layer-wise visual--language alignment signal. Transferring these to LLaVA-based models is not obvious a priori: the vision tower is frozen while the multimodal projector is trained, so we profile both sides of the projector. We find that VDE transfers, and GW does not. Computed from 100 unlabeled task samples without downstream inference, pre-projector VDE tracks layer-wise accuracy and its top-ranked layers cover the oracle best layer on every task for the SigLIP-based LLaVA-Video, while giving region-level guidance for the CLIP-based Video-LLaVA. Post-projector profiles show that the projector reshapes visual geometry but does not erase the performance-relevant trend, leaving $\mathrm{VDE}_{\mathrm{pre}}$ the stronger signal. GW instead flattens after projection and is best read as an alignment diagnostic rather than a selector. VDE thus offers an interpretable, training-free policy that narrows the visual-layer search to a handful of candidates for limited downstream verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLaVA 类视觉语言模型 (VLM) 中视觉主干层选择的问题。作者首先指出默认使用倒数第二层视觉 token 的做法在 2 个 VLM、7 个图像/视频基准上往往次优，随后提出用表示几何信号预测层的有用性：将基于矩阵的熵迁移为视觉数据集熵 (VDE)，并尝试用 Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) 距离作为逐层视觉-语言对齐信号。结果表明 VDE 可迁移、GW 不可迁移，且用于 SigLIP 基 LLaVA-Video 时 VDE 能在每个任务上覆盖 oracle 最优层。
Motivation: VLM 从视觉主干固定晚期层传递视觉 token 给语言模型的惯例并不稳健，默认层在 13/14 的模型-任务组合上非最优，且最优层随任务和视觉主干变化；穷举逐层推理代价过高，也不存在更好的固定默认层。
Method: 提出免训练 (training-free) 的视觉层画像方案：对样本级视觉嵌入计算矩阵熵作为视觉数据集熵 (VDE)，并将 Gromov-Wasserstein 距离改造为逐层视觉-语言对齐信号；由于视觉塔冻结而多模态投影器可训练，作者分别对投影器两侧进行画像。
Result: 在 100 个无标注任务样本上，不进行下游推理即可发现：投影器前的 VDE 能跟踪逐层准确率，其顶层候选在 SigLIP 基 LLaVA-Video 的每个任务上覆盖 oracle 最优层，对 CLIP 基 Video-LLaVA 提供区域级指导；GW 在投影后趋于平坦，适合作为对齐诊断而非层选择器。
Conclusion: VDE 提供可解释的免训练策略，可将视觉层搜索缩小到少量候选以进行有限的下游验证；投影器会重塑视觉几何但未消除与性能相关的趋势，使得投影前的 VDE 成为更强信号。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Defake-o3: From Speculative Rationales to Verifiable Evidence for Explainable AIGI Detection
papers.abstract_en: The rapid progress of image generation models calls for AI-generated image (AIGI) detectors that are not only accurate but also explainable and reliable. While MLLM-based detectors can provide natural language explanations, existing methods often generate speculative rationales: they rely on vague or hallucinated artifacts, miss subtle localized flaws from the latest generators, and fail to provide evidence that can be visually verified. We present Defake-o3, an explainable AIGI detector that moves from speculative rationales to verifiable evidence. It combines interactive visual search with verifier-guided evidence alignment: the model iteratively zooms into suspicious regions to inspect fine-grained details, while an Evidence Verifier, trained from human verification annotations, provides reinforcement learning rewards that favor grounded evidence and penalize baseless claims. To support this objective, we construct GroundFake, a dataset designed for grounded explainable detection, with localized bounding-box evidence, human verification based on visual grounding and artifact specificity, corrected reasoning trajectories, and valid/invalid evidence supervision. We further introduce FakeFrontier, an out-of-distribution benchmark built from real images and outputs of 10 recent generators, together with an MLLM-based protocol for evaluating evidence quality and persuasiveness. Experiments on GroundFake, FakeFrontier, and additional out-of-distribution benchmarks show that Defake-o3 improves both detection accuracy and explanation quality, producing more localized, verifiable, and persuasive evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Defake-o3，一个可解释的 AI 生成图像 (AIGI) 检测器，目标是让检测依据从推测性理由转向可验证证据。该方法结合交互式视觉搜索，让模型迭代放大可疑区域检查细节，并由基于人工验证标注训练的 Evidence Verifier 提供强化学习奖励来鼓励有依据的证据、惩罚无根据的断言。作者还构建了 GroundFake 数据集和 FakeFrontier 基准，实验显示该方法在检测准确率和解释质量上均有提升，产出更局部化、可验证且有说服力的证据。
Motivation: 现有基于 MLLM 的检测器虽然能给出自然语言解释，但常依赖模糊或幻觉性伪影，生成推测性理由，难以捕捉最新生成模型带来的细微局部缺陷，也无法提供可被视觉验证的证据。
Method: 提出 Defake-o3，将交互式视觉搜索与验证器引导的证据对齐相结合：模型迭代缩放可疑区域以检查细粒度细节，同时由基于人类验证标注训练的 Evidence Verifier 提供强化学习奖励。为此构建 GroundFake 数据集，包含局部化边界框证据、基于视觉依据与伪影特异性的验证、修正后的推理轨迹以及有效/无效证据监督；并引入 FakeFrontier 分布外基准，由真实图像和 10 个近期生成模型的输出构成，配以基于 MLLM 的证据质量与说服力评估协议。
Result: 在 GroundFake、FakeFrontier 及其他分布外基准上的实验表明，Defake-o3 同时提升了检测准确率与解释质量，生成的证据更加局部化、可验证且具有说服力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Defake-o3 将可解释 AIGI 检测从推测性理由推进到可验证证据，其核心在于以人类验证标注指导证据对齐，并借助交互式视觉搜索提高证据的局部化与可检验性。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 Defake-o3 将可解释 AIGI 检测从推测性理由推进到可验证证据，其核心在于以人类验证标注指导证据对齐，并借助交互式视觉搜索提高证据的局部化与可检验性。

papers.title: SCOUT: Semantic Concept Discovery for Open-Vocabulary Editing of face Recognition Templates
papers.abstract_en: Face recognition templates are compact identity representations, yet they also encode rich semantic information about facial appearance. Prior work has shown that templates can be inverted to images or indirectly manipulated through image-editing pipelines, but direct semantic editing in template space remains largely unexplored. Existing interpretability methods for face recognition often rely on manual neuron inspection or predefined attribute labels, limiting scalability and semantic flexibility. To address this gap, we propose SCOUT (Semantic Concept Discovery for Open-VocabUlary Editing of Face Recognition Templates), an end-to-end framework for discovering and directly manipulating semantic concepts in face recognition templates using mechanistic interpretability. SCOUT learns sparse template representations, generates semantic hypotheses for latent features from natural-language descriptions, and validates their stability. The resulting features act as controllable semantic directions for direct editing, avoiding costly edit--re-encode pipelines. Experiments with face recognition models using CNN, ViT, and Swin backbones show that SCOUT discovers interpretable concepts beyond standard attribute labels and enables controllable, identity-aware template manipulation with negligible impact on identity matching. We further show that edited templates can subsequently be decoded with independent inversion models for visualization and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCOUT（Semantic Concept Discovery for Open-VocabUlary Editing of Face Recognition Templates），一个端到端框架，利用机制可解释性（mechanistic interpretability）在人脸识别模板中直接发现并操控语义概念。该方法学习稀疏模板表示，从自然语言描述生成潜在特征的语义假设并验证其稳定性，得到的特征作为可控语义方向直接编辑模板，避免编辑-再编码（edit–re-encode）流程。实验在 CNN、ViT 和 Swin 骨干的人脸识别模型上进行，显示能发现超出标准属性标签的可解释概念，实现身份感知的模板操控，且对身份匹配影响很小。编辑后的模板还可被独立反演模型解码，用于可视化和评估。
Motivation: 人脸识别模板是紧凑的身份表示，但也编码丰富的面部外观语义；已有工作要么将模板反演为图像、要么通过图像编辑流程间接操控，而模板空间的直接语义编辑仍基本未被探索。现有可解释性方法多依赖人工神经元检查或预定义属性标签，限制了可扩展性和语义灵活性。
Method: 提出端到端的 SCOUT 框架：先学习稀疏模板表示，再从自然语言描述为潜在特征生成语义假设，并验证这些假设的稳定性。获得的特征作为可控语义方向直接在模板空间中编辑，无需昂贵的编辑-再编码管线。
Result: 在采用 CNN、ViT 和 Swin 骨干的人脸识别模型上的实验表明，SCOUT 能发现超出标准属性标签的可解释概念，并支持可控、身份感知的模板操控，对身份匹配的影响可忽略。编辑后的模板可被独立反演模型解码，用于可视化和评估。
Conclusion: 摘要强调机制可解释性可用于人脸识别模板的开放词汇语义编辑，同时保持身份匹配性能；但未报告具体量化数值，且验证范围限于人脸识别模板场景。

papers.title: SAUL: Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning in Large Language Models (LLMs) faces a critical trade-off between erasing target knowledge and preserving general utility. We propose SAUL (Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning), which formulates unlearning as a constrained minimization problem following the principle of "forget enough, but no more than necessary." At its core, SAUL formulates forgetting as an explicit constraint with a prescribed satisfaction criterion, whereas prior unlearning methods typically specify the desired level of forgetting implicitly through optimization objectives. An augmented Lagrangian controller adaptively adjusts forget-side pressure according to constraint violation and can eventually deactivate the forget-side update as the prescribed criterion remains satisfied. Sharpness-aware updates on both retain and forget objectives, together with a dual-optimizer design that maintains role-separated states, further stabilize the resulting unlearning dynamics. We evaluate SAUL on the TOFU, WMDP, and MUSE benchmarks, demonstrating favorable forgetting-utility trade-offs over representative sharpness- and perturbation-based baselines under benchmark-specific forgetting criteria. Beyond the complete SAUL framework, we further show on TOFU that applying the augmented-Lagrangian controller as a drop-in modifier to representative baselines improves their post-forgetting utility, demonstrating the practical value of explicit forgetting control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAUL（Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning），一种针对大语言模型（LLM）的机器遗忘方法，将遗忘公式化为带约束的极小化问题，遵循“忘记足够多，但不超过必要”的原则。SAUL 的核心是把遗忘建模为具有预定满足准则的显式约束，并通过增广拉格朗日控制器自适应调整遗忘侧压力，在准则满足时逐步停用遗忘更新。作者在 TOFU、WMDP 和 MUSE 基准上评估，展示了优于代表性的基于锐度与扰动基线的方法，并证明增广拉格朗日控制器可作为即插即用修改器提升基线方法的遗忘后效用。
Motivation: LLM 机器遗忘面临擦除目标知识与保持通用能力之间的关键权衡，而先前方法通常通过优化目标隐式指定期望的遗忘程度，缺乏显式的遗忘控制。
Method: 将遗忘建模为带预定满足准则的显式约束，用增广拉格朗日控制器根据约束违反程度自适应调节遗忘侧压力，并在准则持续满足时最终停用遗忘更新；同时结合保留与遗忘目标上的锐度感知更新以及保持角色分离状态的双优化器设计。
Result: 在 TOFU、WMDP、MUSE 基准上，SAUL 在各自基准的遗忘准则下相较代表性的基于锐度和扰动的基线取得更优的遗忘-效用权衡；此外，在 TOFU 上把增广拉格朗日控制器作为即插即用修改器应用于代表性基线，能改善其遗忘后效用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式遗忘控制的实际价值，认为增广拉格朗日控制器不仅能作为独立框架的核心，也能作为通用模块改善现有遗忘方法的实用性。
Relevance: 0
