papers.title: CompoSkill: Compositional Skill Chain Attacks from Individually Scanner-Passing LLM Agent Skills
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous AI agents tackling Long Horizon Tasks depend on marketplace skills that are certified one at a time: a scanner returns a safety verdict for each skill and declares the ecosystem safe if every package passes. We show that this assumption fails under skill composition. A skill may pass the per-skill scanner individually yet participate in a risky composition when an agent connects its outputs, capabilities, or side effects with those of other scanner-passing skills. This makes skill composition risk a path level property rather than a node level property, explaining why existing skill scanners that inspect individual packages achieve limited interception. To study this threat, we present CompoSkill, a framework that constructs skill composition attacks through a dual attacker system. The white-box attacker knows the victim's installed skill pool and directly injects explicit skill-id sequences; the black-box attacker knows only a role profile, downloads the top marketplace skills for that scenario, builds a Skill Composition Graph, and searches for high risk chains whose implicit lures never name skill identifiers. We further construct CompoSkill-Bench, a benchmark of 1,140 records built from long-horizon professional workflows across five threats and six scenarios on OpenClaw and Nanobot. CompoSkill achieves risk Chain Formation Rates (CFR) up to 83.3% in the white box setting and 80.6% in the black box setting, while existing skill scanners block only a limited fraction of the risky compositions. Finally, we observe a bridge-bonus-then-hop-decay pattern: a bridge skill can increase attack success, but Attack Success Rate (ASR) decreases once additional hops make the risk chain longer than three skills. These results expose a systematic gap in single skill certification for autonomous AI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CompoSkill，一个针对自主 AI 智能体技能组合攻击的框架。作者指出当前技能市场对单个技能逐一扫描并判定安全，但多个各自通过扫描的技能在组合后可能产生风险链，使组合风险成为路径级而非节点级属性。基于白盒和黑盒两类攻击者，CompoSkill 在 CompoSkill-Bench 上达到最高 83.3%（白盒）和 80.6%（黑盒）的风险链形成率。
Motivation: 现有安全扫描器逐个检查技能包，无法拦截技能组合产生的风险；技能组合风险是路径级属性，导致单技能认证存在系统性漏洞。
Method: 提出双攻击者框架：白盒攻击者已知受害者安装的技能池并直接注入显式技能 ID 链；黑盒攻击者仅凭角色画像下载该场景下排名靠前的市场技能，构建技能组合图（Skill Composition Graph）并搜索高风险的隐式诱饵链。同时基于 OpenClaw 和 Nanobot 上的长时程专业工作流构建包含 1,140 条记录、五种威胁和六个场景的 CompoSkill-Bench 基准。
Result: CompoSkill 在白盒设定下达到最高 83.3% 的风险链形成率（CFR），黑盒设定下为 80.6%，而现有技能扫描器只能拦截有限比例的风险组合。还观察到桥接技能能够提升攻击成功率，但链长超过三个技能后攻击成功率（ASR）下降。
Conclusion: 实验结果揭示单技能认证机制对自主 AI 智能体存在系统性安全缺口，组合风险需要在路径层面而非单节点层面进行审查。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Trade-off Between Covariate Dependence and Latent Structure in Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Disentangled representation learning seeks latent representations whose indicidual dimensions each align with a distinct covariate. Unsupervised approaches typically target latent dimension independence, yet this gives no guarantee that the resulting dimensions align with semantically meaningful covariates. Supervised approaches structure the latent space using observed covariates, but under correlated covariates they cannot simultaneously control one-to-one latent-covariate alignment and latent independence. We introduce a unified, supervised framework that couples latent dimension-covariate dependence with constraints on the latent structure. Within this framework, we show an inherent trade-off, where enforcing latent independence or exclusive one-to-one latent-covariate dependence comes at a provable cost in latent-covariate alignment. We prove that the resulting disentanglement regimes are ordered by the strength of that alignment. Each regime admits a closed-form transformation of the latent space. We apply these transformations post-hoc to realign the representations of pretrained models such as CLIP, DINOv2, and ViT, and we fold them into the inference of informed factor analysis (iFA), a probabilistic model with covariate-informed factors. On simulated and real multi-omics data, we show that both post-hoc alignment and iFA enable controllability of structured latent representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的有监督表示学习框架，将潜在维度与协变量之间的依赖关系同潜在结构约束耦合起来，研究解纠缠表示学习中的内在权衡。作者证明，强制潜在独立性或独占的一对一潜在-协变量依赖会以可证明的代价损害潜在-协变量对齐，且由此产生的解纠缠体系可按对齐强度排序，每一体系都存在潜空间的闭式变换。摘要报告，将这种变换后验地应用于预训练模型（CLIP、DINOv2、ViT）并融入有协变量信息的因子分析（informed factor analysis, iFA）推理后，在模拟数据和真实多组学数据上实现了对结构化潜在表示的可控性。
Motivation: 无监督解纠缠只追求潜在维度独立，无法保证维度与语义上有意义的协变量对齐；而有监督方法在协变量彼此相关时，无法同时控制一对一潜在-协变量对齐与潜在独立性。需要一个统一框架来刻画并解决这一权衡。
Method: 提出统一的有监督框架，把潜在维度-协变量依赖与潜在结构约束耦合在一起；证明不同解纠缠体系按对齐强度排序，并给出每个体系对应的潜空间闭式变换。这些变换被后验地应用于预训练模型的表示重对齐，也被并入informed factor analysis (iFA) 的推理过程。
Result: 在模拟数据和真实多组学数据上，后验重对齐与 iFA 均能实现对结构化潜在表示的可控性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，强制潜在独立性或独占一对一依赖会以可证明的代价降低潜在-协变量对齐；所提出的框架和变换为预训练模型及概率模型提供了可控的结构化表示手段。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在模拟数据和真实多组学数据上，后验重对齐与 iFA 均能实现对结构化潜在表示的可控性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，强制潜在独立性或独占一对一依赖会以可证明的代价降低潜在-协变量对齐；所提出的框架和变换为预训练模型及概率模型提供了可控的结构化表示手段。

papers.title: Convolution-Free Holistic Multivariance Decomposition Layer for Efficient Hyperspectral Image Classification Tensor Networks
papers.abstract_en: Feature extraction for hyperspectral image classification is conventionally addressed using rigid tensor decompositions that fail to capture complex spatio-spectral interdependencies, or heavily parameterized convolutional neural networks that are computationally expensive. To overcome these limitations, this work introduces the Holistic Multivariance Decomposition (HMD) framework as a novel, end-to-end differentiable neural network layer. By explicitly separating independent single mode variations from cooperative higher dimensional interactions via learnable, matrix valued supports, the proposed HMD-0, HMD-1 and HMD-2 approximants are optimized jointly with a downstream classifier via backpropagation. Comprehensive evaluations across three benchmark HS datasets demonstrate that the higher level HMD layers achieve superior classification accuracy compared to classical learnable tensor baselines, including Tucker, Canonical Polyadic, and Tensor Train decompositions. Furthermore, HMD-1 and HMD-2 achieve a generalization capacity and training stability comparable to standard 2D and 3D-CNNs while requiring significantly fewer feature extractor parameters. These results demonstrate that the HMD framework provides a structurally robust substitute for traditional convolution in multidimensional HS image classification, offering high parameter efficiency and stability throughout the optimization process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Holistic Multivariance Decomposition (HMD) 框架，作为一种端到端可微分的高光谱图像分类网络层。HMD 通过可学习的矩阵值支撑显式分离独立单模态变化与高阶协同交互，提出 HMD-0、HMD-1、HMD-2 三种近似，并与下游分类器联合反向传播优化。在三个基准高光谱数据集上，高阶 HMD 层优于 Tucker、Canonical Polyadic、Tensor Train 等可学习张量基线，且参数效率更高。
Motivation: 传统高光谱特征提取要么使用刚性张量分解，难以捕捉复杂的光谱-空间相互依赖；要么使用参数庞大的卷积神经网络，计算代价高。作者希望提供一种在结构鲁棒性和参数效率上都能替代传统卷积的方案。
Method: 引入 HMD 框架作为新型端到端可微分网络层，通过可学习的矩阵值支撑将独立单模态变化与高阶协同交互分离，提出 HMD-0、HMD-1、HMD-2 三种近似，并与下游分类器通过反向传播联合优化。
Result: 在三个基准高光谱数据集上，高阶 HMD 层相比 Tucker、Canonical Polyadic、Tensor Train 等经典可学习张量基线取得更高分类精度；HMD-1 和 HMD-2 的泛化能力与训练稳定性接近标准 2D 和 3D-CNN，但所需特征提取参数显著更少。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 HMD 框架可作为传统卷积在多维高光谱图像分类中的结构稳健替代，兼具高参数效率和优化过程中的稳定性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Optimizing Multi-Market Participation of Battery and Electrolyser Systems Based on Field Performance
papers.abstract_en: The increasing share of renewable energy in power systems creates a need for fast-response and flexible resources to maintain system stability. With the expansion of electricity markets and ancillary service products, opportunities arise to stack revenues across multiple services. Long-term Power-to-X (PTX) electrolysers and short-term battery energy storage systems (BESS) are prevalent flexible resources, yet most studies neglect real hardware behavior, such as ramp limits, efficiency, and setpoint-tracking accuracy. This work presents experimental and modeling results for a 55 kW/79 kWh BESS and an electrolyser comprising three 2.4 kW units. Key characteristics are identified through measurements and embedded into a price-driven optimization framework for participation in the Danish electricity and ancillary service markets, utilizing real market data from 2022 to 2025. The optimized daily profits for multi-market participation are 1,749.27 DKK and 289.46 DKK for the BESS and electrolyser, respectively. With the demonstrated business cases for BESS and PTX systems, this work highlights the importance of incorporating experimental performance when evaluating participation across multiple markets and years.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE Power and Energy Society General Meeting (PESGM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对可再生能源占比提升带来的灵活性需求，基于实测硬件特性研究电池储能系统（BESS）与 Power-to-X (PTX) 电解槽的多市场收益优化。作者对 55 kW/79 kWh BESS 和由三个 2.4 kW 单元组成的电解槽进行实验建模，将爬坡限制、效率与设定点跟踪精度等特性嵌入价格驱动优化框架，并使用丹麦 2022-2025 年真实市场数据分析多市场参与。优化结果显示 BESS 日利润为 1,749.27 DKK，电解槽为 289.46 DKK。
Motivation: 电力市场与辅助服务产品不断扩展，为跨服务叠加收入提供了机会，但多数研究忽略实际硬件行为（如爬坡限制、效率和设定点跟踪精度），导致对多市场参与潜力的评估可能失真。
Method: 对 BESS 与多单元电解槽开展实验测量并建立模型，识别关键硬件特性并将其嵌入价格驱动的优化框架，用于丹麦电力和辅助服务市场的多市场参与，使用 2022 至 2025 年的真实市场数据。
Result: 摘要报告优化后的多市场日利润分别为 BESS 1,749.27 DKK、电解槽 289.46 DKK，并演示了 BESS 与 PTX 系统的可行商业用例。
Conclusion: 作者强调在评估跨多个市场和年份的参与时，将实验测得的硬件性能纳入优化与评估的重要性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Software Engineering for AI-driven Building Operation
papers.abstract_en: Building operations are energy-inefficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI)-driven control systems promise benefits through optimization and predictive control, but deploying them in real buildings reveals a significant software engineering (SE) challenge. SE for AI practices assume digital environments where failures mean poor user experience. Buildings are different. A bad control decision wastes energy irreversibly, violates occupant comfort, or accelerates equipment wear. Although actual safety-critical failures are rare, as real building automation systems are inherently fault-tolerant, the physical and lasting nature of even minor failures fundamentally changes SE4AI requirements. Rooted in two interdisciplinary research projects in civil engineering and computer science that target the AI-driven optimization of building operations, we identify the missing perspectives in SE4AI that currently stymie the successful deployment of AI-based systems for building operations. We further share lessons learned and best practices, and discuss broader implications for engineering AI-driven building operations and cyber-physical systems more generally. Our work proposes a foundation for SE4AI in systems where failure has physical consequences - one the research agenda below will need to validate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从软件工程视角讨论 AI 驱动的楼宇自动化控制部署问题。作者基于两个土木工程与计算机科学的跨学科项目，指出 SE4AI 的既有假设在建筑场景下失效：控制决策的失误会造成不可逆的能源浪费、影响 occupant comfort 或加速设备磨损，即使在容错机制下罕见安全关键故障。文章识别出当前 SE4AI 缺失的视角，分享经验教训与最佳实践，并提出面向物理后果性失败的 SE4AI 基础框架与待验证的研究议程。
Motivation: 楼宇运行能耗效率低下，AI 驱动的优化与预测控制虽有潜力，但实际部署面临显著软件工程挑战。与数字环境不同，建筑中的糟糕控制决策会不可逆地浪费能源、损害 occupant comfort 或加速设备磨损，因此 SE4AI 的需求发生了根本变化。
Method: 依托两个面向建筑运行 AI 优化的跨学科研究项目，作者审视现有 SE4AI 实践，识别其缺失视角，并综合经验教训与最佳实践，讨论对 AI 驱动楼宇运行及更广泛 cyber-physical systems 的启示，提出一个用于物理后果性失效场景的 SE4AI 基础框架。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验结果；主要成果是识别出阻碍 AI 系统在楼宇运行中成功部署的 SE4AI 缺失视角，并给出经验教训、最佳实践以及有待后续研究议程验证的 SE4AI 基础框架。
Conclusion: 作者提出，对于失效具有物理后果的系统，SE4AI 需要一个专门的基础框架，并指出该框架需要由后续研究议程验证；其讨论也推广到更一般的 cyber-physical systems。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Privacy Study of Sparse Collaborative Inference
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative inference (CI) splits a model between an edge device and a server, whereby the client computes an intermediate activation, transmits it, and the server completes the computation. This raises two concerns, the communication cost of the transmission and the risk that it reveals private information about the input. Recent work reduces this cost by sparsifying activations and entropy-coding the result. Sparsity has also been argued to improve privacy, on the intuition that transmitting fewer values reveals less about the input. We test this claim by decomposing the sparse activation into the retained values and the set of positions they occupy, and by reconstructing inputs from each component in isolation. We find that sparsification reduces the leakage far less than it reduces the transmission cost, and that the remaining risk shifts to the positions, which prior analyses treat as side information for decoding. Across natural-image and face datasets, the positions alone constitute a serious privacy risk, enabling high-fidelity reconstructions and re-identification of individuals. The leakage from the positions persists even when both the transmission cost and the task utility are low. We conclude that the positions of sparse activations should be treated as sensitive transmitted data and audited carefully in the context of collaborative inference. Code is available at https://github.com/an7123/Privacy-Study-Sparse-CI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究协作推理 (collaborative inference, CI) 中稀疏化激活值的隐私泄漏问题。作者将稀疏激活分解为保留值 (retained values) 和位置集合 (positions)，并分别从各分量重建输入，发现稀疏化对泄漏的降低远小于对传输成本的降低，隐私风险主要转移到位置信息上。在自然图像和人脸数据集上，仅凭位置即可实现高保真重建和个体再识别，且泄漏在传输成本和任务效用都很低时依然存在。
Motivation: 协作推理中客户端向服务器传输中间激活值，既带来通信开销，也带来输入隐私泄漏风险。近期工作通过稀疏化激活来降低成本，并直觉上认为发送更少的值会泄露更少，但这一隐私收益声称尚未被严格检验。
Method: 作者将稀疏激活分解为保留数值和其位置索引两部分，并分别仅依据每一部分重建原始输入，以隔离评估各自的隐私泄漏。实验覆盖自然图像和人脸数据集，并考察不同传输成本和任务效用水平下的泄漏。
Result: 摘要报告：稀疏化减少泄漏的幅度远小于减少传输成本的幅度；仅凭位置信息就能高保真重建输入并实现人脸再识别；即使传输成本和任务效用都低，位置泄漏依然存在。
Conclusion: 作者总结认为，稀疏激活的位置应被视为敏感传输数据，并应在协作推理的上下文中被仔细审计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GaussianDWM++: Language-Grounded 3D Gaussian Driving World Model for Unified Scene Understanding, Editing, and Multi-Modal Generation
papers.abstract_en: Driving World Models (DWMs) have recently advanced rapidly with generative models, yet most existing methods mainly focus on conditional scene generation and lack explicit 3D scene understanding, language-grounded reasoning, and controllable 4D editing capabilities. Moreover, commonly used point cloud, occupancy, or BEV representations make it difficult to achieve fine-grained alignment between textual information and the underlying 3D scene structure. To address these limitations, we propose a foundation-feature Gaussian driving world model that unifies scene understanding, language-grounded reasoning, controllable 4D editing, and multi-modal generation within a single framework. Specifically, we introduce a foundation-feature Gaussian tokenizer that directly distills Qwen/SigLIP visual-language features into 3D Gaussian primitives, building a compact open-vocabulary Gaussian semantic field. We further design a geometry-aware Gaussian adapter that combines importance-aware hierarchical selection with text-conditioned Perceiver-style cross-attention to aggregate dense Gaussian primitives into compact world tokens. To improve representation compatibility, we introduce a KL-based Gaussian--image distribution alignment objective that aligns Gaussian world tokens with foundation image tokens. Based on the aligned Gaussian representation, our framework further supports instruction-controllable scene editing, including weather-conditioned generation and dynamic vehicle manipulation. Extensive experiments on broader driving benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across scene understanding, visual grounding, planning-oriented reasoning, and controllable 4D generation tasks. We will release the code and datasets publicly on Github.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GaussianDWM++，一个基于基础特征的高斯驾驶世界模型 (Gaussian driving world model)，在单一框架内统一场景理解、语言接地推理 (language-grounded reasoning)、可控 4D 编辑与多模态生成。方法引入 foundation-feature Gaussian tokenizer，将 Qwen/SigLIP 视觉语言特征蒸馏到 3D 高斯基元，形成开放词汇的语义场；并设计 geometry-aware Gaussian adapter 与基于 KL 的 Gaussian-图像分布对齐目标，将高斯基元聚合成紧凑 world tokens。实验在多个驾驶基准上声称在场景理解、视觉定位、规划导向推理和可控 4D 生成任务上达到当前最优。
Motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型 (DWM) 大多侧重条件式场景生成，缺乏显式的 3D 场景理解、语言接地推理和可控的 4D 编辑能力；同时常用的点云、占用 (occupancy) 或 BEV 表示难以实现文本信息与底层 3D 场景结构之间的细粒度对齐。
Method: 提出 foundation-feature Gaussian tokenizer，直接把 Qwen/SigLIP 的视觉语言特征蒸馏到 3D 高斯基元中，构建紧凑的开放词汇 Gaussian 语义场；设计几何感知的 Gaussian adapter，结合重要性感知的层次化选择与文本条件的 Perceiver 式交叉注意力，把稠密高斯基元聚合成 world tokens；并引入基于 KL 的 Gaussian-图像分布对齐目标，使 Gaussian world tokens 与 foundation image tokens 兼容。该框架还支持指令可控的场景编辑，包括天气条件生成和动态车辆操作。
Result: 在多个驾驶基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在场景理解、视觉定位、规划导向推理和可控 4D 生成任务上均达到当前最优性能。摘要未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作用一个统一框架同时覆盖场景理解、语言推理、4D 编辑与多模态生成，并计划在 GitHub 上公开代码和数据集；摘要未提及明显的局限性。

papers.title: A cross-modal generative model for incomplete and degraded prostate MRI with multicentre clinical validation
papers.abstract_en: Missing or degraded sequences can limit prostate multiparametric MRI. We developed MSCNet, a sequence-conditioned cross-modal generative framework for reconstructing unavailable contrasts and restoring degraded acquisitions. Across ten completion tasks, task-specific MSCNet achieved mean structural similarity of 0.818 versus 0.798 for the strongest task-matched comparators; matched-capacity analyses showed larger differences in lesion fidelity and boundary preservation. In a blinded 1,000-case reader study, overall image quality met the prespecified non-inferiority criterion for DWI, ADC and T2W completion, but not T1W. In a separate 200-case diagnostic assessment, AUCs for clinically significant cancer were 0.860 with acquired images, 0.841 with MSCNet and 0.797 with baseline-generated images. A locked 186-case three-hospital cohort supported multicentre transportability. These retrospective results support quality-controlled cross-modal reconstruction as an adjunct to acquired prostate MRI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MSCNet，一种序列条件跨模态生成框架 (sequence-conditioned cross-modal generative framework)，用于重建前列腺多参数 MRI 中缺失的对比序列并修复退化采集。在十项补全任务中，任务特化 MSCNet 的平均结构相似性为 0.818，强于最强任务匹配对照的 0.798；盲法 1000 例读片研究中，DWI、ADC 和 T2W 补全达到预设非劣效标准，T1W 未达到。另在 200 例诊断评估中，临床显著癌症的 AUC 分别为 0.860（采集图像）、0.841（MSCNet）和 0.797（基线生成图像），并有一个 186 例三家医院队列支持多中心可迁移性。
Motivation: 前列腺多参数 MRI 常因缺失或退化的序列而受限，影响临床可用性与诊断价值，需要能重建缺失对比度并恢复退化采集的生成方法。
Method: 提出 MSCNet 序列条件跨模态生成框架，针对十种不同补全任务训练任务特化模型，并通过匹配容量分析考察病灶保真度与边界保留；随后进行 1000 例盲法读片研究、200 例诊断效能评估以及 186 例三家医院外部队列验证。
Result: 十项补全任务中平均结构相似性为 0.818，对照为 0.798；读片研究中 DWI、ADC 和 T2W 补全满足非劣效标准，T1W 未满足。诊断评估中 MSCNet 生成图像的 AUC 为 0.841，接近采集图像的 0.860，并高于基线生成图像的 0.797。
Conclusion: 这些回顾性结果支持将质量控制下的跨模态重建作为采集前列腺 MRI 的辅助手段，但作者未将其定位为替代采集图像。

papers.title: PCT-Prompt: A Prompt-Guided Transformer Framework for Dense Prediction Tasks in Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: Standard Transformers have proven effective in point cloud object classification, but their performance in dense prediction tasks within complex scenes is often hindered by weak prior assumptions. To address this challenge, we propose PCT-Prompt, a novel framework that enhances standard Transformers by introducing a prompt-guided feature branch to improve performance in dense prediction tasks. The standard Transformer branch leverages pre-trained models for global feature extraction from point cloud data, serving as the backbone for processing high-level features. Meanwhile, the prompt-guided feature branch consists of two key components: a fine-grained feature extraction block that captures multi-scale geometric features using geometry-sensitive abstraction layer, along with the PnP-3D layer to integrate local context with global regularization. The second component, the prompt-refined feature learning block generates prompt tokens, which are subsequently refined through cross-attention mechanisms. Additionally, we introduce a prompt drop mechanism that progressively removes prompt information across Transformer layers, balancing local details and global consistency. Experimental results on the ShapeNetPart, S3DIS, and DALES datasets demonstrate that PCT-Prompt significantly improves the adaptability of standard Transformers to dense prediction tasks, achieving strong performance in real-world scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PCT-Prompt，一个面向点云密集预测任务的提示引导 Transformer 框架。标准 Transformer 分支利用预训练模型提取全局特征，提示引导分支包含细粒度特征提取块（采用几何敏感抽象层与 PnP-3D 层）和提示精炼特征学习块（通过交叉注意力生成并精炼 prompt token），并引入 prompt drop 机制在 Transformer 层间逐步移除提示信息以平衡局部细节与全局一致性。实验在 ShapeNetPart、S3DIS 和 DALES 数据集上验证了该方法对标准 Transformer 在密集预测任务中适应性的提升。
Motivation: 标准 Transformer 在点云物体分类上有效，但在复杂场景的密集预测任务中常因先验假设较弱而表现受限。
Method: 提出双分支框架：标准 Transformer 分支使用预训练模型进行全局特征提取；提示引导分支包含基于几何敏感抽象层的多尺度细粒度特征提取块和 PnP-3D 层，以及通过交叉注意力精炼 prompt tokens 的提示精炼特征学习块，并采用逐步移除提示信息的 prompt drop 机制。
Result: 在 ShapeNetPart、S3DIS 和 DALES 数据集上的实验表明，PCT-Prompt 显著提升标准 Transformer 对密集预测任务的适应性，并在真实场景中取得强性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为引入提示引导特征分支和 prompt drop 机制可以增强标准 Transformer 在点云密集预测任务中的表现。

papers.title: STAIR: Semantic-Temporal Automaton for Interpretable Reasoning in Temporal Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: By leveraging large-scale pretraining, LLMs can interpret diverse temporal expressions and question formulations without task-specific training. However, existing prompt-based neuro-symbolic systems continue to rely on LLMs for both semantic interpretation and exact temporal inference. Consequently, discrete decisions regarding intervals, time anchors, and ordered states remain vulnerable to probabilistic errors and difficult to verify. We present STAIR, a \textbf{S}emantic-\textbf{T}emporal \textbf{A}utomaton for \textbf{I}nterpretable \textbf{R}easoning. STAIR separates semantic interpretation from precise temporal inference: an answer-free LLM adapter maps complex question formulations to normalized temporal intents, while a deterministic temporal automaton with finite control and guarded transitions executes the corresponding policies over canonicalized evidence. Following a rule-first design, STAIR resolves standard questions without invoking an LLM and applies semantic adaptation only when the rule path fails to produce an executable intent. This approach reduces free-form reasoning, making temporal decisions verifiable and interpretable. Specifically, guarded execution supports precise point-time containment and before/after selection, while semantic adaptation handles non-exact intervals and time-anchored queries. Across the TimeQA-Easy, TimeQA-Hard, TempReason-L2, and TempReason-L3 datasets, STAIR consistently outperforms strong baselines in the TQA task using matched model settings, achieving average F1 improvements of 16.57\% and 3.10\% when utilizing the Qwen2.5-7B and GPT-4o-mini models, respectively. Furthermore, ablations and diagnostic analyses demonstrate that STAIR excels at handling both boundary-sensitive and order-sensitive queries, while its guarded execution and semantic adaptation ensure precise point-time reasoning and inexact intervals, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STAIR，一个用于时间问答（TQA）的语义-时间自动机，将语义解释与精确时间推断分离：无答案的 LLM 适配器把复杂问题表述映射为归一化时间意图，而一个带有限控制与守卫转移的确定性时间自动机在规范化证据上执行相应策略。规则优先设计使标准问题无需调用 LLM，仅当规则路径无法产生可执行意图时才引入语义适配。在 TimeQA-Easy、TimeQA-Hard、TempReason-L2 和 TempReason-L3 上，STAIR 在使用 Qwen2.5-7B 和 GPT-4o-mini 时分别获得平均 F1 提升 16.57% 和 3.10%。
Motivation: 现有基于提示的神经符号系统仍依赖 LLM 同时完成语义解释和精确时间推断，导致关于区间、时间锚点和有序状态的离散决策容易受到概率性错误影响，且难以验证。
Method: STAIR 将语义解释与时间推理解耦：一个无答案的 LLM 适配器将复杂问题表述归一化为时间意图，一个确定性的时间自动机通过有限控制和守卫转移在规范化证据上执行策略。采用规则优先设计，标准问题不调用 LLM，仅当规则路径失败时才进行语义适配；守卫执行支持点时间包含与先/后选择，语义适配处理非精确区间和时间锚定查询。
Result: 在 TimeQA-Easy、TimeQA-Hard、TempReason-L2 和 TempReason-L3 数据集上，使用匹配的模型设置，STAIR 在 TQA 任务上持续优于强基线：基于 Qwen2.5-7B 平均 F1 提升 16.57%，基于 GPT-4o-mini 平均 F1 提升 3.10%。消融与诊断分析表明其在边界敏感和顺序敏感查询上表现突出。
Conclusion: STAIR 通过减少自由形式推理，使时间决策可验证、可解释；守卫执行与语义适配分别负责精确点时间推理和非精确区间处理。

papers.title: HiPHI: A Large-Scale Benchmark for High-Precision Human Motion and Object-Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid intelligence requires learning over an extremely diverse space of whole-body motions and physically grounded interactions. However, existing embodied datasets remain fundamentally limited: internet-scale video data lack precise physical states and interaction grounding, while laboratory motion datasets provide high fidelity but only narrow behavioral coverage. This mismatch creates a critical bottleneck for scalable humanoid policy learning. We present HiPHI, a 600+ hour scale high-fidelity whole-body human motion dataset designed to systematically maximize coverage of the human motion and interaction manifold. HiPHI is theoretically guided by FrameNet, a linguistic framework organizing human primitives. Created using an optical motion capture pipeline, HiPHI provides sub-millimeter spatial marker tracking accuracy for full-body human motion and mesh-level object trajectories. We further introduce a benchmark suite evaluating motion-space diversity, interaction grounding, object consistency, and physical AI applications. Our analyses demonstrate that HiPHI significantly expands motion coverage compared to existing motion datasets while maintaining high-fidelity interaction quality, and establishes a scalable data foundation for training, evaluating, and generalizing humanoid policies in real-world embodied tasks, where similar extensions are also applicable to motion prior models in computer graphics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiPHI，一个 600 小时以上规模的高保真全身人体运动与物体交互数据集，用于缓解现有具身数据集在物理状态精度与行为覆盖范围之间的矛盾。数据集以 FrameNet 语言框架组织运动原语，采用光学动捕流程，提供亚毫米级空间标记精度与网格级物体轨迹，并附带评测基准套件。作者的分析表明 HiPHI 相比现有运动数据集显著扩展了运动覆盖，同时保持高保真交互质量，为训练、评估和泛化人形策略提供数据基础。
Motivation: 现有具身数据集存在根本性局限：互联网规模的视频数据缺乏精确物理状态与交互锚定，而实验室运动数据集虽精度高但行为覆盖窄，这种不匹配成为可扩展人形策略学习的关键瓶颈。
Method: 构建 HiPHI 数据集，通过 FrameNet 语言学框架系统地最大化人体运动与交互流形的覆盖；使用光学运动捕捉管线采集全身运动与网格级物体轨迹，并引入涵盖运动空间多样性、交互锚定、物体一致性与物理 AI 应用的基准套件。
Result: 摘要报告 HiPHI 显著扩大了相比现有运动数据集的运动覆盖范围，同时保持高保真的交互质量。
Conclusion: HiPHI 为真实世界具身任务中的人形策略训练、评估与泛化建立了可扩展的数据基础，并同样适用于计算机图形学中的运动先验模型。

papers.title: SingDance: Compositional Zero-Shot Singing-and-Dancing Video Generation with Role-Aware Audio Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Generating personalized dance videos from a reference image, text prompt, and audio track requires music-conditioned body motion. Singing-and-dancing adds a second requirement: the visible subject must also articulate the vocals. Existing music-conditioned methods focus primarily on choreography, while speech-driven models generally assume that the visible subject produces the input voice, leaving this combined setting largely underexplored. We introduce SingDance, a unified video diffusion framework that formulates controllable vocal articulation as a semantic role: the visible subject is either the source, who produces the vocal signal, or the listener, who receives it from an off-screen performer. Hard-compact routing selects task-relevant speech, music, and role conditions, which are composed through frame-wise joint audio injection; source and listener retain the same speech pathway. Training uses asymmetric supervision: on-screen speaking and curated off-screen conversational-response videos establish role control, while instrumental and song-based dancing-only videos establish music-conditioned body motion. The target Song/Source configuration is never observed during training. At inference, assigning the source role to a song composes separately learned articulation and song-conditioned dance capabilities, enabling compositional zero-shot singing-and-dancing. Experiments demonstrate strong motion--beat alignment and visual fidelity, reliable paired switching of vocal articulation while preserving music-aligned body motion, and highly competitive lip synchronization with substantially fewer generation-time parameters than the strongest speech-driven baseline evaluated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SingDance 提出统一视频扩散框架，从参考图像、文本提示和音频轨道生成既歌唱又舞蹈的个性化视频。它将可见主体的发声控制建模为语义角色（source 或 listener），通过 hard-compact routing 选择任务相关的语音、音乐和角色条件，并采用帧级联合音频注入。训练使用不对称监督，从未在训练中见过目标 Song/Source 配置，推理时将 source 角色赋予歌曲即可组合已分别学习的口型与舞蹈能力，实现组合式零样本歌唱舞蹈生成。
Motivation: 现有音乐条件方法主要关注编舞，而语音驱动模型一般假设可见主体就是输入语音的产生者，歌唱与舞蹈结合的场景尚未被充分探索。
Method: 引入 SingDance 统一视频扩散框架，把可控的发声动作形式化为语义角色：可见主体要么是产生语音信号的 source，要么是接收离屏表演者语音的 listener；hard-compact routing 选择任务相关的语音、音乐和角色条件，并通过帧级联合音频注入组合这些条件。训练采用不对称监督：屏幕上说话和离屏对话回应视频建立角色控制，器乐和歌曲舞蹈视频建立音乐条件身体运动。
Result: 实验显示该方法具有强 motion-beat 对齐和视觉保真度，能可靠地在保持音乐对齐身体运动的同时切换发声角色，并且在与最强语音驱动基线相比时，以明显更少的生成期参数取得极具竞争力的唇形同步效果。
Conclusion: 通过将歌曲赋予 source 角色这一组合式推理，SingDance 实现从未在训练中出现的歌唱舞蹈零样本生成，表明角色感知音频条件与不对称监督是有效路径。

papers.title: Beyond Peak Backlog: Conditional Energy and Temporal Geometry in Capacity-Constrained Delayed Bandit Optimization
papers.abstract_en: What is the right delay complexity when a learner can track only $C$ pending feedback items and discarded feedback is permanently lost? Existing one-point bandit convex optimization guarantees in this model pay $\sqrt{Tσ_{\max}}$, where $σ_{\max}$ is the peak backlog, although unlimited tracking admits the sharper $\sqrt{d_{\mathrm{tot}}}$ dependence on total delay. We introduce a scheduler-side conditional-energy interface that separates rate adaptation from the one-point perturbation filtration and handles the dependent importance weights created by randomized admission. Under the same semi-clairvoyant oracle and pathwise hard-capacity contract, this yields an untuned learner whose delay term scales as $O(\sqrt{E_C d_{\mathrm{tot}}})$, with only an explicit restart factor $E_C$; a public constant-factor peak bound removes this factor while $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$ remains unknown. Under strong convexity, the same interface yields the temporal cost $H_A(d)=\sum_t σ_t/(A+t)$. Two delay vectors with identical delay multisets, $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$, $σ_{\max}$, and capacity can nevertheless have polynomially different minimax regret, showing that timing matters under curvature even when aggregate delay summaries agree. Finally, a continuous hard family converts tracking capacity into a zeroth-order query budget and gives a complementary capacity-starvation lower endpoint. The upper bounds require $C\ge \ln T+1$ and do not constitute a complete capacity minimax characterization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究容量受限的延迟 bandit 凸优化问题：学习者最多只能跟踪 C 个待反馈样本，被丢弃的反馈永久丢失。作者提出一个调度器侧的条件能量接口 (conditional-energy interface)，将速率自适应与 one-point 扰动滤过分离，并处理随机准入带来的依赖重要性权重。摘要报告在相同的半先知 oracle 和路径级硬容量约束下，未调参学习器的延迟项为 O(√(E_C d_tot))，且在强凸情形下得到时间成本 H_A(d)=∑_t σ_t/(A+t)，并证明相同聚合延迟摘要下时序仍会导致多项式级别的 minimax regret 差异。
Motivation: 现有 one-point bandit 凸优化在该容量约束模型下的保证是 √(T σ_max)，其中 σ_max 是峰值积压 (peak backlog)；而无限跟踪情形下存在更优的 √(d_tot) 总延迟依赖。作者希望缩小这一差距，找到容量受限下正确的延迟复杂度。
Method: 引入调度器侧的条件能量接口，把速率自适应与 one-point 扰动滤过分离开，并处理随机准入 (randomized admission) 产生的依赖重要性权重。在该接口下构造未调参学习器，其延迟项含显式重启因子 E_C；在强凸条件下给出时间成本 H_A(d)，并用一个连续硬族把跟踪容量转化为 zeroth-order 查询预算。
Result: 摘要报告延迟项从 √(T σ_max) 改进为 O(√(E_C d_tot))；当存在公开常数因子的峰值界时可去掉 E_C，但 d_tot 仍未知。强凸情形下得到时间成本 H_A(d)，且两个具有相同延迟多重集、d_tot、σ_max 和容量的延迟向量仍可有多项式级不同的 minimax regret。最后给出容量匮乏 (capacity-starvation) 的互补下界端点。
Conclusion: 摘要明确说明上界要求 C ≥ ln T + 1，并且该结果不构成完整的容量 minimax 刻画。作者强调时序 (timing) 在曲率条件下即便聚合延迟摘要一致也会影响 regret，但整体仍是特定契约下的部分刻画。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Process-Constituted Intelligence: A Shared Criterion for Humans and Machines
papers.abstract_en: Intelligence is constituted by \textit{process} (iterative activity through which output emerges), not in the output itself. Generative AI (GenAI) is trained on \textit{traces} (textual and visual residues of human cognitive processes), reproducing samples from a distribution of those traces. Its outputs resemble reasoning, problem-solving, and creativity, yet the activity that produces such outputs in humans remains largely absent. Current GenAI is, therefore, weakly equivalent to the cognition it imitates, matching outputs while process stays absent or opaque. The cognitive sciences have long distinguished between weak and strong equivalence. Here, we define \textit{strong} equivalence across seven process features, assessable against human and machine cognition. Our process-based account addresses a symmetric risk: GenAI tools that outsource a person's generative processes may leave critical capacities unbuilt. We specify design principles for GenAI that instantiate more process and preserve rather than erode human judgment and creativity, and outline process audits that make strong equivalence testable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出智能由过程（process）构成而非由输出构成：生成式 AI（GenAI）基于人类认知过程的痕迹（traces）训练，能生成看似推理、问题求解和创造的输出，但产生这些输出的人类式活动基本缺失，因此只与所模仿的认知弱等价。作者借鉴认知科学中弱/强等价的区分，定义了跨七个过程特征的强等价标准，并给出让 GenAI 实例化更多过程的设计原则以及使强等价可检验的过程审计（process audits）。
Motivation: 现有 GenAI 在输出层面模仿人类认知，但缺少产生输出所需的过程，导致评估与构建智能时只关注结果；同时存在对称性风险，即用 GenAI 外包人的生成过程可能使关键能力得不到发展。
Method: 作者提出在七个过程特征上定义人与机器都可评估的强等价（strong equivalence），并据此给出 GenAI 应实例化更多过程的设计原则，以及一套使强等价可检验的过程审计方案。
Result: 摘要未报告实证结果，主要贡献是概念性框架：以过程特征为共同判据区分弱/强等价，并提出可操作的设计原则与审计方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调应从输出导向转向过程导向来评估智能，当前 GenAI 只能达到弱等价，需要让工具保留并增强而非侵蚀人的判断与创造力，并通过过程审计使强等价具有可检验性。

papers.title: Quantifying the Gap Between Laboratory Battery Test Patterns and Field Duty Profiles
papers.abstract_en: Laboratory battery tests provide the main empirical basis for battery performance and degradation studies, but their operating patterns do not directly represent field duty profiles. This paper quantifies the gap by comparing six accessible evidence sources covering controlled cycling, drive-cycle testing, dynamic cycling, NMC811 laboratory ageing, a real electric-vehicle charging trace, and fleet-scale electric-vehicle state-of-health (SOH) data. The analysis combines usage frequency, usage intensity, usage C-rate, and a duty-structure index (DSI) based on normalized current dispersion and ramping. The representative single-segment DSI ranges from 0.630 for the field source trace and 0.699 for NASA to 2.936 for Oxford and 2.855 for Imperial, while usage C-rate ranges from 0.14-0.40 for Imperial, NASA, Stanford, and Hyundai to 2.00 for Oxford. Long-term ageing also differs: the 80 percent retention region occurs near 351 NASA cycles, 6292 Oxford checkpoints, and 1019 Stanford cycles. In chemistry-aligned NMC/NCM evidence, Imperial retains 0.813 under standard cycling and 0.865 under drive-cycle ageing, while the field source has median SOH 0.889 with visible dispersion. Field operation further shows a median use intensity of 137.2 km/day and 56.9 percent of charges ending at or above 95 percent SOC. These results show that battery performance metrics are conditional on the duty pattern that generated them; application-oriented studies should report explicit duty-profile descriptors together with chemistry, capacity, and ageing metrics.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to ECCE Europe 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文量化实验室电池测试模式与现场工况曲线（duty profile）之间的差距，比较六个证据源：受控循环、驾驶循环测试、动态循环、NMC811实验室老化、真实电动汽车充电轨迹和车队级SOH数据。作者引入使用强度、使用C-rate和基于归一化电流离散度与爬坡速率的Duty-Structure Index（DSI），显示各来源的DSI和C-rate差异显著，且长期老化行为不同。结论是电池性能指标以产生它的工况模式为条件，应用导向研究应报告明确的工作曲线描述符。
Motivation: 实验室电池测试是电池性能和退化研究的主要经验基础，但实验室运行模式不能直接代表现场实际工况。论文针对这一测试模式与真实使用之间的系统性差距进行量化，指出当前研究缺少统一、可比较的工作曲线描述指标。
Method: 比较六类证据源，使用使用频率、使用强度、使用C-rate，以及基于归一化电流离散度和爬坡的DSI统一描述不同测试来源。研究还对NMC/NCM化学体系进行对齐，并估计各来源达到80%容量保持率所需的循环数/检查点数，同时报告现场数据的中位使用强度与充电SOC分布。
Result: 代表单段DSI从现场源轨迹的0.630和NASA的0.699到Oxford的2.936和Imperial的2.855；使用C-rate从Imperial、NASA、Stanford、Hyundai的0.14-0.40到Oxford的2.00。80%保持区域出现在NASA约351循环、Oxford 6292检查点和Stanford 1019循环；Imperial在标准循环下保留0.813、驾驶循环老化下保留0.865，现场源中位SOH为0.889且有可见离散。现场运行中位使用强度为137.2 km/day，56.9%的充电结束SOC不低于95%。
Conclusion: 电池性能指标是条件性的，取决于产生这些指标的工作模式（duty pattern）；应用导向研究应将明确的工作曲线描述符与化学组成、容量和老化指标一并报告。

summary_sections.motivation: 实验室电池测试是电池性能和退化研究的主要经验基础，但实验室运行模式不能直接代表现场实际工况。论文针对这一测试模式与真实使用之间的系统性差距进行量化，指出当前研究缺少统一、可比较的工作曲线描述指标。
summary_sections.method: 比较六类证据源，使用使用频率、使用强度、使用C-rate，以及基于归一化电流离散度和爬坡的DSI统一描述不同测试来源。研究还对NMC/NCM化学体系进行对齐，并估计各来源达到80%容量保持率所需的循环数/检查点数，同时报告现场数据的中位使用强度与充电SOC分布。
summary_sections.result: 代表单段DSI从现场源轨迹的0.630和NASA的0.699到Oxford的2.936和Imperial的2.855；使用C-rate从Imperial、NASA、Stanford、Hyundai的0.14-0.40到Oxford的2.00。80%保持区域出现在NASA约351循环、Oxford 6292检查点和Stanford 1019循环；Imperial在标准循环下保留0.813、驾驶循环老化下保留0.865，现场源中位SOH为0.889且有可见离散。现场运行中位使用强度为137.2 km/day，56.9%的充电结束SOC不低于95%。

papers.title: BaT: Towards Self-Evolving Medical Research Agent with Stage Rubrics
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents are beginning to automate complete workflows that produce code, reports, and research artifacts. Medical imaging workflows are multi-stage and data-sensitive, while expert trajectories remain scarce and difficult to share. Structured benchmarks can localize failures through stage-level rubrics, but standard post-training discards these diagnostics before the next training round. We present Benchmark-as-Teacher (BaT), a recursive self-improvement system for agent post-training. BaT contains two linked components: the asynchronous Stage Bank data pipeline and BiCuRL (Bilevel Curriculum Reinforcement Learning), its self-improving post-training method. Stage Bank synthesizes content-isolated training states outside the policy-update loop. BiCuRL uses a fixed held-out evaluation to select the next stage curriculum, verifies rollouts with task rubrics, updates the policy with GRPO, and returns the candidate checkpoint to evaluation. On AutoMedBench-Lite, BaT-4B and BaT-9B more than double the Overall scores of their Qwen Instruct baselines. BaT-9B Agent reaches 79.6 Overall, exceeding Claude Opus 4.6 with Claude Code at 77.5.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Benchmark-as-Teacher (BaT)，一种用于医学研究智能体后训练的递归自改进系统，包含异步 Stage Bank 数据管道和 BiCuRL（Bilevel Curriculum Reinforcement Learning）方法。在 AutoMedBench-Lite 基准上，BaT-4B 和 BaT-9B 的 Overall 分数相比各自的 Qwen Instruct 基线翻倍以上，其中 BaT-9B 达到 79.6，超过配合 Claude Code 的 Claude Opus 4.6 的 77.5。
Motivation: 医学影像工作流是多阶段且数据敏感的，专家轨迹稀缺且难以共享；标准后训练过程会在进入下一轮训练前丢弃来自阶段级评估 (stage-level rubrics) 的诊断信息，导致无法利用结构化基准来定位失败并持续改进。
Method: BaT 包含两个关联组件：Stage Bank 在策略更新循环之外异步合成内容隔离的训练状态；BiCuRL 使用固定的留出评估集选择下一步阶段课程，用任务 rubrics 验证生成轨迹，通过 GRPO 更新策略，并将候选检查点返回评估环节形成闭环迭代。
Result: 在 AutoMedBench-Lite 上，BaT-4B 和 BaT-9B 的 Overall 分数均超过其 Qwen Instruct 基线一倍以上；BaT-9B Agent 达到 79.6 Overall，超过使用 Claude Code 的 Claude Opus 4.6（77.5）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过递归复用基准中的阶段 rubrics，BaT 可以实现医学研究智能体的自演进式后训练，无需额外的人类专家轨迹；其有效性在医学影像代理基准上得到验证。

papers.title: Conditional Evaluation of Language Models with Cheap Auxiliary Signals
papers.abstract_en: Aggregate accuracy hides where models succeed and fail. Estimating conditional performance profiles from gold labels alone is expensive, while cheap auxiliary signals such as LLM-judge scores, pairwise comparisons, confidence scores, and judge-disagreement features can be collected for every benchmark item but are often biased or miscalibrated. We propose LACE (Local Augmented Control-Variate Evaluation), a semi-supervised estimator for conditional LLM evaluation. The key step is local centering: after subtracting the conditional mean of a cheap signal within the target profile region, any linear augmentation has zero conditional mean and therefore cannot change the estimand. The augmentation coefficient is used only for efficiency, and a local ridge control variate combines a gold-label residual mean from the labeled subset with a cheap-signal mean from the full item pool. We prove calibration-free identification, unbiasedness for grouped profiles, local oracle optimality within centered linear augmentations, and first-order adaptivity to the estimated coefficient. The resulting gain formula is governed by a population local $R^2$, which characterizes how the efficiency attainable from the cheap signals varies across profile values. We also derive corresponding estimators for direct paired model gaps and deployment-weighted scores. We empirically evaluate the primary performance-profile estimator on MATH-500, ScienceQA, MMLU, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, GSM8K, and ARC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LACE (Local Augmented Control-Variate Evaluation)，一种用于条件 LLM 评估的半监督估计器，利用廉价辅助信号（如 LLM-judge 分数、成对比较、置信度和 judge 分歧特征）提高条件性能估计的效率。核心步骤是局部中心化 (local centering)：在目标 profile 区域内减去廉价信号的条件均值后，任何线性增广的条件均值都为零，因此不改变估计目标；局部岭控制变量 (local ridge control variate) 将带标签子集的黄金标签残差均值与全量项目池的廉价信号均值结合。摘要给出校准无关可识别性、分组无偏性、局部 oracle 最优性与一阶自适应性等理论结果，并在 MATH-500、ScienceQA、MMLU、WinoGrande、HellaSwag、TruthfulQA、GSM8K、ARC 上进行实证。
Motivation: 聚合准确率掩盖了模型在哪些条件下成功或失败；仅靠黄金标签估计条件性能成本高昂，而廉价辅助信号虽然可以为每个基准项目收集，却往往有偏或校准不良。
Method: 提出 LACE 半监督估计器：通过局部中心化使线性增广不再影响估计目标，增广系数仅用于提升效率；局部岭控制变量将带标签子集的黄金标签残差均值与全项目池的廉价信号均值结合起来。
Result: 证明了校准无关的可识别性、分组 profile 的无偏性、中心化线性增广内的局部 oracle 最优性以及估计系数的一阶自适应性；效率增益由总体局部 R^2 刻画。实证在 MATH-500、ScienceQA、MMLU、WinoGrande、HellaSwag、TruthfulQA、GSM8K 和 ARC 上评估了主性能 profile 估计器。
Conclusion: 摘要强调廉价辅助信号可以在不改变估计目标的前提下提高条件 LLM 评估的效率，并给出了直接配对模型差距和部署加权得分的相应估计量。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Competing at Every Price Point with Agentic Evolution over a Menu of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Consider a firm that surveys its competition for a particular agentic task and seeks to offer superior accuracy at every competitor price point. A firm that Pareto-dominated its competitors would leave no rational customer a reason to buy elsewhere. This paper shows a path to this kind of capability via agentic evolution over a menu of LLMs, from training pools of at most 100 examples. Given a priced menu of nine LLM endpoints; brief documentation of the task, objective, and API; a simple seed agent; and an operator-chosen per-problem cost target - usually set at an incumbent's own price - RoboPhD, an evolutionary meta-agent, evolves complete agent programs that attack the public frontiers of two semantically dissimilar tasks point by point: DS-1000 (execution-checked code generation) and PaperFindingBench (LLM-judged scientific document retrieval). Our officially scored submissions hold every Pareto-frontier slot but one on the two tasks' leaderboards, including Pareto domination of both the top-scoring and the lowest-cost competing points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RoboPhD，一个进化式元智能体 (evolutionary meta-agent)，在定价的 LLM 端点菜单上进化出完整智能体程序，以在多个价格点上同时获得比竞争对手更高的准确率。作者用最多 100 个样本的训练池，针对 DS-1000（执行检查的代码生成）和 PaperFindingBench（LLM 评判的科学文献检索）两个任务进行官方评测，其提交在两张排行榜上占据除一个位置外的全部 Pareto 前沿槽位。
Motivation: 企业希望针对某个智能体任务在每一个竞争对手的价格点上提供更优准确率，从而在 Pareto 意义上主导竞争对手，使理性客户没有理由转向别处。
Method: 给定九个定价的 LLM 端点菜单、任务/目标/API 的简要文档、一个简单种子智能体以及操作者选择的每问题成本目标（通常设为现有竞争者的价格），RoboPhD 通过智能体进化 (agentic evolution) 迭代生成完整智能体程序，逐点攻击两个语义不同任务的公开前沿。
Result: 官方打分的提交在 DS-1000 和 PaperFindingBench 的排行榜上占据除一个以外的全部 Pareto 前沿槽位，并且同时 Pareto 支配了得分最高与成本最低的竞争方案。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，借助 LLM 菜单上的智能体进化，即使在训练样本极少（最多 100 个）的条件下，也可能实现对各价格点的竞争性能力覆盖。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Multi-Granularity Sentiment Integration for LLM-Based Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to predict sentiment polarity and intensity from heterogeneous inputs such as text, audio, and vision. While large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic priors for MSA, effectively incorporating audio and visual signals effectively remains challenging. A key challenge is that audio and visual sentiment cues evolve over different temporal scales, yet many LLM-based methods compress these signals through shallow projection or coarse pooling before fusing them with text, which can weaken cross-modal alignment and erase fine-grained affective information. We propose MGSI, a multi-granularity sentiment integration framework for LLM-based MSA. MGSI first encodes audio and visual streams at short-, medium-, and long-range temporal scales, preserving both local variations and global affective trends. It then refines non-text features through text-guided alignment, and applies polarity- and intensity-aware enhancement to better handle ambiguous and near-neutral samples. The resulting multimodal representation is finally compressed into a small set of pseudo-tokens for efficient conditioning of a frozen LLM. Experiments on four public benchmarks show that MGSI substantially outperforms frozen-LLM baselines and remains competitive with strong multimodal methods. Further ablation and sensitivity analyses support the effectiveness of multi-granularity temporal modeling, text-guided refinement, and adaptive sentiment calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MGSI，一个用于基于LLM的多模态情感分析（Multimodal Sentiment Analysis, MSA）的多粒度情感整合框架。MGSI在短、中、长三个时间尺度上编码音频和视觉流，通过文本引导对齐精炼非文本特征，并应用极性/强度感知增强处理模糊和近中性样本，最后将多模态表示压缩为少量伪token以条件化冻结的LLM。在四个公开基准上，MGSI显著优于冻结LLM基线，并与强多模态方法竞争力相当。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的MSA方法通常用浅层投影或粗池化压缩音视频信号，导致跨模态对齐被削弱并丢失细粒度情感信息；而音视频情感线索本身在不同时间尺度上演化，因此需要多粒度建模来保留局部变化和全局情感趋势。
Method: MGSI先以短、中、长三种时间尺度编码音频和视觉流，保留局部变化与全局情感趋势；继而通过文本引导对齐精炼非文本特征；再应用极性感知与强度感知增强（polarity- and intensity-aware enhancement）处理模糊和近中性样本；最终将多模态表示压缩为少量伪token，用于高效条件化冻结的LLM。
Result: 实验在四个公开基准上进行，MGSI大幅优于冻结LLM基线，并与强多模态方法保持竞争力；消融和敏感性分析验证了多粒度时间建模、文本引导精炼以及自适应情感校准的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为多粒度时间建模、文本引导对齐和自适应情感校准是提升LLM-based MSA性能的关键组件，但未报告具体数值或局限性说明。

papers.title: Picking the Right Image to Classify: Reliable-Input Selection in Teledermatology
papers.abstract_en: Dermatology models face distribution shifts in teledermatology settings, where submitted images differ from the training data in lighting, angle, distance, focus, and framing. These test-time images are ordinary clinical photographs, but some fall outside the model's training conditions, leading the model to often misclassify them due to shifts in acquisition between training and deployment. When multiple images of the same case exist (several photos of one patient or lesion), a natural way to improve accuracy is therefore to select the image the model is most likely to classify correctly. We call this task reliable-input selection. An oracle that, for each case, selects a correctly classified image when one exists raises weighted F1 by about 20 percentage points on average across six dermatology datasets and nine frozen backbones. This oracle is an upper bound that sees the labels, whereas a selector must choose blindly. Capturing this gain in practice is hard. A selector that needs no pretraining data applies to any frozen model, including those whose data is not public. It must judge reliability from quantities the model exposes at inference: its embeddings, their norms, and its confidence. We benchmark four such training-data-free selectors: the embedding norm, the neighborhood consensus among a case's images, the stability of the prediction under small perturbations, and the model's own confidence. No training-data-free selector substantially narrows this oracle gap. The best of them is the model's own confidence, but it recovers only a small part of the gap on the clinical datasets. A small labeled reference set does not help either: the best selector overall, a fusion of confidence and Mahalanobis distance, still leaves most of the gap. To our knowledge, this is the first study to introduce and benchmark reliable input selection, a clinically important, unsolved task.

TL;DR: 本文首次提出并系统评测了远程皮肤病学中的“可靠输入选择”（reliable-input selection）任务：在同一个病例的多张临床照片中，选出模型最可能正确分类的那一张，以缓解训练与部署间采集条件带来的分布偏移。基于六个皮肤科数据集和九个冻结骨干网络，oracle 选择（能看到标签的黄金上界）平均可将加权 F1 提升约 20 个百分点；但无需训练数据的各类选择器（嵌入范数、邻域一致性、预测稳定性、模型置信度）均难以大幅缩小这一差距，最佳选择器置信度也只能恢复临床数据集上很小一部分。
Motivation: 远程皮肤病学中，用户提交的图像在光照、角度、距离、对焦和取景等方面与训练数据存在分布偏移，导致模型容易误分类。当同一病例有多张图像时，自然会产生“选哪张图给模型分类”的问题；此前没有研究正式定义和评测这一任务，而临床中该任务具有实际价值。
Method: 将任务形式化为 reliable-input selection：对每个病例的多张图像，选择模型最可能正确分类的一张。作者使用冻结模型在推理时暴露的量（嵌入、嵌入范数、置信度）构造无需训练数据的选择器，包括嵌入范数、病例图像间的邻域一致性（neighborhood consensus）、小扰动下预测稳定性以及模型自身置信度；还评测了在小型标注参考集上训练的融合选择器（置信度与 Mahalanobis 距离的融合），并与能看见标签的 oracle 上界对比。
Result: Oracle 选择器使加权 F1 在六个数据集、九个冻结骨干上平均提升约 20 个百分点。所有无需训练数据的选择器都只收回了很小一部分 oracle 差距，其中模型自身置信度表现最好；小型标注参考集上的最佳整体选择器（置信度与 Mahalanobis 距离融合）仍留下大部分差距未被恢复。
Conclusion: 作者认为 reliable-input selection 是一个临床重要但尚未解决的任务，并公开了首个基准；现有无需训练数据的选择器以及带小型参考集的选择器都无法实质性地接近 oracle 上界，说明该问题仍需进一步研究。

papers.title: Beyond Asking: A Pipeline for Personalized Game Generation that Reads Players from Behavior
papers.abstract_en: Personalized game generation requires inferring a player's abilities and behavioral style from how they play. Large language models have made this inference more attainable than ever: an LLM can read a raw gameplay transcript and produce a fluent, plausible profile of the player. Plausible, however, is not verified, and verification is precisely what the field lacks: latent traits are unobservable; questionnaires provide noisy proxies and become circular when self-reports are used to validate behavior-based inference; and behavior itself is ambiguous without context -- a player who never collects an item may not want it, or may never have had the chance. We address both problems. First, we construct a synthetic player population whose traits are ground truth by construction: each trait is an explicit bot parameter, accepted only after controlled manipulation produces consistent, trait-specific behavioral change. Unlike prior parameter-recovery work that inverts a known decision model, our benchmark evaluates policy-agnostic inference from behavioral transcripts alone. Second, we introduce an opportunity-aware decision-moment representation that disentangles preference from the chance to express it; ablating it selectively degrades opportunity-dependent traits. On this benchmark, few-shot LLM inference outperforms embedding- and rule-based baselines on most traits, though feature-based supervised regressors remain stronger overall. Finally, we close the loop: inferred profiles drive difficulty adaptation, evaluated against ground-truth references and mismatched-profile controls, and an exploratory human study examines whether these findings transfer to real players.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Includes technical appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个个性化游戏生成流水线，从玩家的实际行为记录中推断其能力与行为风格。作者构建了一个合成玩家群体，其特质由显式bot参数构成并经过受控操纵验证，作为可验证的基准；同时引入一种机会感知的决策时刻表示（opportunity-aware decision-moment representation），将偏好与表达机会分开。结果表明，少样本LLM推断在大多数特质上优于嵌入与规则基线，但基于特征的监督回归器整体更强；最后用推断出的玩家画像驱动难度自适应，并进行了初步真人研究。
Motivation: 个性化游戏生成需要从行为中推断玩家特质，但该领域缺乏验证：潜在特质不可观测，问卷只是有噪声的代理且用自我报告验证行为推断会形成循环，而行为本身在缺乏上下文时具有歧义。
Method: 构造一个特质即bot参数的合成玩家群体，通过受控操纵产生一致且特质特定的行为变化来保证地面真值；提出机会感知的决策时刻表示以区分偏好与表达机会；在该基准上比较少样本LLM推断与嵌入、规则及特征监督基线，并用推断画像驱动难度自适应。
Result: 少样本LLM推断在大多数特质上优于嵌入和规则基线，但特征监督回归器整体更强；消融机会感知表示会选择性损害依赖机会的特质；难度自适应在真实玩家上的初步研究被作为探索性评估。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工作同时解决了可验证基准与行为歧义两个问题，并闭环到难度自适应；真人研究仍是探索性的，结论向真实玩家的迁移程度有限。

papers.title: Baseline-Relative Counterfactual Refinement for Bit-Aware Visual Token Communication
papers.abstract_en: Generative visual-token communication reduces transmission load by sending only selected discrete tokens and reconstructing missing content at the receiver. However, existing token-selection criteria based on local uncertainty, importance, or diversity do not directly determine whether changing the current selection improves the final reconstruction under the same packet budget. To address this problem, we propose Gated Counterfactual Refinement for Communication (GCR-C), a rollout-style correction layer over Local-MDL. GCR-C constructs a compact diversified candidate set, evaluates each candidate through matched full-budget Local-MDL continuation, and replaces the baseline action only when a positive baseline-relative reconstruction gain is obtained. Experiments on CIFAR-10, STL-10, a coded 5G-LDPC link, and a limited high-resolution Kodak transfer show that GCR-C consistently improves reconstruction quality at active low- and medium-rate operating points without increasing the realized packet rate, while remaining effective across changes in dataset, channel condition, resolution, token grid, and tokenizer. The results also reveal a clear quality--computation tradeoff due to the additional encoder-side counterfactual evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Gated Counterfactual Refinement for Communication (GCR-C)，一种在 Local-MDL 之上的 rollout 式修正层，用于生成式视觉 token 通信。GCR-C 构造紧凑多样化的候选集，通过匹配完整预算的 Local-MDL 延续评估每个候选，仅在获得正的基线相对重建增益时替换基线动作。实验表明该方法在低、中速率工作点一致改善重建质量，且不增加实际数据包速率。
Motivation: 现有视觉 token 选择准则基于局部不确定性、重要性或多样性，无法直接判断在相同数据包预算下改变当前选择是否改善最终重建效果，缺乏以最终重建为目标的决策依据。
Method: 提出 GCR-C，在 Local-MDL 准则上增加反事实细化层：构造紧凑多样化候选集，对每个候选执行匹配完整预算的 Local-MDL 延续评估，并仅当 baseline-relative 重建增益为正时才替换基线动作。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10、STL-10、编码 5G-LDPC 链路和受限高分辨率 Kodak 传输上，GCR-C 在低、中速率工作点持续提升重建质量且不提高实际包速率，并对数据集、信道条件、分辨率、token 网格和 tokenizer 的变化保持稳健；同时存在由编码端反事实评估引入的质量-计算权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基线相对的反事实细化能有效改进视觉 token 通信，但代价是额外的编码端计算开销，形成清晰的质量-计算权衡。

papers.title: Beyond Clear Skies: Synthetic Seasonal and Weather Variations for Real-World Drone Detection
papers.abstract_en: Reliable drone detection under real-world deployment conditions requires training data that spans the full operational design domain, including adverse weather and seasonal appearance variation. However, acquiring and annotating such data at scale remains highly resource-intensive, as adverse-weather conditions are inherently difficult to control, reproduce, and sample systematically. Existing datasets therefore typically provide only limited coverage of such conditions. Conversely, synthetic data offers a scalable alternative: environmental variation becomes controllable, while modern game-engine-based pipelines provide realistic rendering and automatic annotations. Leveraging this potential, we introduce SynDroneVision-Weather (SDV-W), an systematic extension of SynDroneVision (SDV) targeting adverse-weather and seasonal domain shifts in urban drone detection. SDV-W comprises 55,187 annotated high-resolution images from three urban environments, rendered across three seasonal configurations and diverse weather conditions, including rain, snow, and fog at multiple severity levels. By preserving SDV's scene and trajectory configuration, SDV-W enables matched clean-adverse comparisons and quantification of condition-specific detector degradation. Across representative YOLO models and real-world datasets, we show that SDV-W improves detector reliability under adverse appearance shifts, reduces missed detections and false alarms, and is most effective as a complement to general-purpose synthetic drone-detection data. SDV-W will be publicly released upon paper acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SynDroneVision-Weather (SDV-W)，一个针对无人机检测在恶劣天气和季节变化下鲁棒性的合成数据集扩展。SDV-W 包含 55,187 张高分辨率图像，覆盖三个城市场景、三种季节配置以及雨、雪、雾等多严重等级天气条件，并保留原有 SynDroneVision 的场景与轨迹配置以支持干净-恶劣天气的匹配对比。基于代表性 YOLO 模型和真实世界数据集的实验表明，SDV-W 能改善检测器在恶劣外观变化下的可靠性，减少漏检和虚警，并最适合作通用合成无人机检测数据的补充。
Motivation: 真实世界部署中的无人机检测需要覆盖完整运行设计域的训练数据，但恶劣天气条件的采集和标注成本高且难以系统化控制；现有数据集对这类条件覆盖有限。
Method: 利用基于游戏引擎的合成数据管线，构建 SDV-W：在三个城市场景中渲染三种季节配置和多种天气（雨、雪、雾，含多个严重程度等级），并沿用 SDV 的场景与轨迹设置以便进行匹配的干净-恶劣对比。
Result: 在代表性 YOLO 模型和真实世界数据集上，SDV-W 改善了检测器在恶劣外观偏移下的可靠性，降低了漏检和虚警，并且在作为通用合成无人机检测数据的补充时最为有效。
Conclusion: 作者强调 SDV-W 是一种可扩展的恶劣天气与季节域偏移数据来源，将随论文录用后公开；其设计支持对条件特定检测器退化的量化。

papers.title: Decorrelation Is Not Complementarity: Skill, Not Lineage, Governs Trusted-Monitor Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: Trusted monitoring has a cheap, trusted model score a stronger untrusted model's actions, and a diverse ensemble of them beats a single stronger monitor at matched cost. They are built by minimising average pairwise correlation, and that paper's twelve monitors shared one base model, leaving open what supplies the diversity. We study 24 open-weight monitors spanning nine pretraining lineages and a 29x range of detection skill (pAUC at 10 percent FPR, 0.028 to 0.803) on backdoored code. The metric used to build panels does not predict what a panel is for, and we can say why. Agreement on attack items splits into a shared-detectability signal component and an idiosyncratic error component, which predict ensemble gain with opposite sign (Spearman -0.25 and +0.26), so their sum, the metric actually used, predicts it barely at all (+0.05); the cancellation holds in 7 of 8 evaluations. Skill acts on signal (+0.53) while error stays flat (-0.01), which is why a monitor's own skill predicts its agreement with the pool (Spearman 0.84, n = 24, permutation p below 0.0001). Pretraining lineage is the obvious way to buy decorrelation, and it does not pay. At matched member capability, cross-lineage panels detect no better (permutation p = 0.13), and lineage barely moves the metric either (+0.064, p = 0.18). We report that against ourselves: on our own 22-monitor pool the same test read +0.104 at p = 0.037 until two monitors were added. An earlier pool topping out at pAUC 0.23 had already invalidated another analysis. Such a quantity is a property of the pool assembled. Panel gain over the best member falls monotonically with panel skill (-0.66 at k = 2, -0.70 at k = 3), and no correlation-weighted selection beats picking the single best monitor out of sample. Across six attacker models the gain result holds in all six, the agreement and cancellation results in five of six.
papers.comment: AI control, trusted monitoring, ensemble diversity, scalable oversight, backdoor detection, capability control
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究可信监控（trusted monitoring）中集成多样性的真正来源。作者使用跨越 9 个预训练谱系（pretraining lineage）的 24 个开源权重监控模型（pAUC 0.028–0.803）在带后门代码上测试，发现构建面板所用的平均成对相关性指标几乎无法预测面板的实际增益。原因是监控器对攻击项的同意度可分解为共享可检测性信号与特异错误两部分，二者对集成增益的预测方向相反（Spearman -0.25 与 +0.26），相互抵消；预训练谱系并不能有效购买去相关带来的收益。
Motivation: 此前的可信监控集成工作通过最小化平均成对相关性来构建多样化面板，但其 12 个监控器共享同一个基础模型，多样性到底由什么提供仍是开放问题。
Method: 对 24 个开源权重监控模型在带后门代码上进行评估，将监控器对攻击项的同意度分解为共享可检测性信号成分和特异错误成分，并分析这两个成分与集成增益、监控器自身技能、预训练谱系之间的关系。
Result: 同意度两成分对集成增益的预测符号相反且相互抵消，导致实际使用的相关性指标几乎无预测力（+0.05）；技能主要作用于信号成分（+0.53）而错误成分平坦（-0.01），监控器自身技能与其对池的同意度 Spearman 相关系数为 0.84（n=24，置换检验 p<0.0001）。跨谱系面板在匹配成员能力下并无更好检测（p=0.13），谱系对指标影响也很小（+0.064，p=0.18）；面板增益随面板技能单调下降（k=2 时 -0.66，k=3 时 -0.70）。增益结果在 6 个攻击者模型上全部成立，同意度与抵消结果在 5/6 成立。
Conclusion: 作者指出去相关（decorrelation）不等于互补性（complementarity），预训练谱系不是获得多样性的有效途径。论文还自我报告了脆弱性：在自己的 22 监控器池上加入两个监控器后，同一检验结果从 +0.104（p=0.037）发生改变，说明这类指标是所组装池子的具体属性，解读需谨慎。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Securing AI-Generated Code: A Just-in-Time Vulnerability Detection and Remediation Pipeline
papers.abstract_en: AI-assisted development tools generate vulnerable code at significant rates, yet few automated mechanisms exist to detect, enrich, fix, and verify security issues at development velocity, particularly ones that ground remediation in real-world threat context. This paper presents an automated security evaluation pipeline that generates Python code from LLMSecEval prompts, scans for vulnerabilities using CodeQL and Bandit in parallel with an independent Code Validator LLM, enriches the Code Validator findings with MITRE ATT&CK techniques, CWE Observed Examples, and Python best practice guidelines, generates fixes via the Code Generation LLM, and re-scans with CodeQL and Bandit to verify outcomes. Two pipeline configurations were evaluated: Pipeline 1 (P1), using enriched Code Validator findings only, and Pipeline 2 (P2), where it additionally receives the initial CodeQL and Bandit findings. Both configurations were run across four Claude models: Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6, Sonnet 5, and Haiku 4.5, producing 80 runs against 26 LLMSecEval prompts covering 9 CWE categories. P1 reduced static analyzer findings across all four models, ranging from -9% (Opus 4.8) to -54% (Sonnet 5). P2 deepened these reductions further, ranging from -29% (Opus 4.8) to -69% (Haiku 4.5), with P2 outperforming P1 for every model. Verdict consistency averaged approximately 81% modal agreement across all configurations, with P2 marginally more stable than P1. Remediation introduced new vulnerabilities in 15-22% of cases: roughly 70% involved a single new finding, and P2 reduced churn for three of four models, with Sonnet 5 as the sole exception. Notably, the best Code Generation LLM (Opus 4.8) was not the best pipeline performer, as Sonnet 4.6 produced the lowest residual findings and highest pass rate after P2 remediation, suggesting that pipeline effectiveness and first-draft security are distinct properties.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 8 tables, 2 figures. Georgia Institute of Technology Master's final practicum project. Code: https://github.com/Droidsurikov/securing-ai-generated-code
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自动化安全评估流水线，用于生成、扫描、增强、修复并重新验证AI生成的Python代码。流水线用CodeQL和Bandit并行扫描漏洞，结合Code Validator LLM的发现并加入MITRE ATT&CK、CWE Observed Examples和Python最佳实践上下文，再由Code Generation LLM生成修复并重新扫描。在四种Claude模型和26个LLMSecEval提示上评估了两个配置（P1、P2），P2在减少静态分析发现方面对所有模型均优于P1。
Motivation: AI辅助开发工具以较高比例生成含漏洞的代码，但缺乏能在开发速度下自动检测、增强、修复并验证安全问题的机制，尤其是缺少基于真实威胁上下文（如MITRE ATT&CK、CWE实际示例）的修复支撑。
Method: 提出由六个环节组成的安全评估流水线：用LLMSecEval提示生成Python代码；用CodeQL和Bandit并行扫描；由独立的Code Validator LLM分析漏洞；用MITRE ATT&CK技术、CWE Observed Examples和Python最佳实践指南增强发现；由Code Generation LLM生成修复；最后用CodeQL和Bandit重新扫描验证。评估了两个配置：P1只使用增强后的Code Validator发现，P2额外接收初始CodeQL和Bandit发现。
Result: P1将静态分析发现减少-9%（Opus 4.8）到-54%（Sonnet 5），P2进一步减少-29%（Opus 4.8）到-69%（Haiku 4.5），且P2在每个模型上都优于P1。判定一致性约为81%模态一致，P2略更稳定。修复在15-22%的案例中引入新漏洞，其中约70%只引入一个新发现。值得注意的是，最佳代码生成模型Opus 4.8并非最佳流水线表现者，Sonnet 4.6在P2修复后残留发现最低、通过率最高。
Conclusion: 摘要强调流水线有效性与初稿安全性是两种不同属性，且加入初始静态扫描信息的P2配置比仅依赖LLM增强结果更稳健。该工作为Georgia Institute of Technology硕士实践项目，规模为80次运行、26个LLMSecEval提示、9个CWE类别。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LENS: In-Context Search via Latent Evidence Exploration over Dynamic Raw Documents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly answer questions over dynamic raw-document collections, where files may change before preprocessing, and relevant evidence (spans, sections, pages, or tables) is query-dependent. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches pre-materialize evidence via fixed chunking, embeddings, or persistent indexes: effective for lookup, yet costly, stale-prone, and committed to a granularity before the query is known. We formulate in-context search as Budgeted Evidence Localization over a latent evidence space induced by dynamic raw documents and propose LENS (Latent Evidence Exploration and Search), an index-free framework. Instead of pre-materializing the evidence space, LENS maintains a query-conditioned belief over candidate units, iteratively selecting candidates via complementary lexical, local, and exploratory proposal policies, updating the belief via an LLM relevance oracle, and narrowing toward high-posterior regions under a controllable budget. Evidence is consolidated into compact, source-grounded regions of interest and compressed into self-organizing knowledge clusters reused across related queries. On a controlled 500-question evaluation with matched corpus snapshots, LENS reaches 62.4% exact match and 84.8% evidence recall vs. 65.2% exact match but 50.4% evidence recall for a ReAct-style baseline. Across scales, LENS gives the strongest supporting-fact localization and answer grounding. On a fixed 150-question fullwiki subset over the raw Wikipedia dump with zero indexing, LENS and ReAct are nearly tied in official answer quality (43.3% vs. 42.7% EM), with LENS grounding more answers in retrieved evidence (84.0% vs. 70.7%). A no-retrieval Closed-Book reference highlights the contribution of model memory. LENS is query-ready after corpus changes, needs no preprocessing or persistent index, and preserves source-grounded evidence localization throughout.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LENS，一个无索引框架，将 LLM agent 在动态原始文档集合上的上下文检索建模为预算约束的证据定位问题。它维护查询条件下的信念分布，通过互补的提议策略迭代选择候选证据，并用 LLM 相关性 oracle 更新信念，在可控预算下收敛到高后验区域。在 500 题受控评估中，LENS 达到 62.4% 精确匹配和 84.8% 证据召回，而 ReAct 风格基线为 65.2% 精确匹配但仅 50.4% 证据召回；在 150 题全维基子集上两者答案质量接近，但 LENS 的证据接地率更高。
Motivation: 现有检索增强方法通过固定分块、嵌入或持久索引预先物化证据，代价高、易过期，且在查询已知前就固定了粒度。动态原始文档环境下，相关证据（跨度、章节、页、表）是查询依赖的，需要一种无需预处理和索引的在线定位方法。
Method: 将上下文检索形式化为预算约束的证据定位，提出 LENS 框架。LENS 维护查询条件下的候选单元信念，通过词法、局部和探索性提议策略迭代选择候选，使用 LLM 相关性 oracle 更新信念，并将证据压缩为自组织的知识簇供相关查询复用，全程无需索引。
Result: 在 500 题受控评估中，LENS 精确匹配 62.4%、证据召回 84.8%，对比 ReAct 风格基线 65.2% EM 但 50.4% 证据召回；在不同规模下，LENS 的支撑事实定位和答案接地最强。在 150 题全维基原始转储零索引子集上，LENS 与 ReAct 官方答案质量几乎持平（43.3% vs 42.7% EM），但证据接地更高（84.0% vs 70.7%）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LENS 在语料变化后立即可查询，无需预处理或持久索引，并始终保持基于源证据的定位。无检索的 Closed-Book 参照表明模型记忆的贡献。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding and Stabilizing Deep Q-Learning via Controlled Bootstrapping and Regulated Value Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Deep Q-learning (DQL) has achieved remarkable empirical success in reinforcement learning, yet its training process remains notoriously unstable. Existing studies often attribute instability to isolated factors such as overestimation bias or representation learning issues, lacking a unified understanding of how different sources of instability interact during recursive value estimation. In this work, we provide a systematic analysis of instability in deep Q-learning from three complementary perspectives: operator-level bias in Bellman bootstrapping, estimator-level sensitivity of greedy action selection to regression noise, and parameter-dynamics imbalance under aggressive data reuse. We identify a reward-triggered self-reinforcing trap and characteristic parameter spike dynamics, then derive stabilization principles for controlled bootstrapping, ensemble quantile estimation, and spike-based parameter regulation. Experiments on Atari-100K and Procgen demonstrate competitive performance and improved training stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从三个互补视角系统分析深度 Q 学习（deep Q-learning）训练不稳定的来源：Bellman 自举（bootstrapping）中的算子级偏差、回归噪声下贪心动作选择的估计器级敏感性，以及激进数据复用下的参数动态失衡。作者识别出奖励触发的自强化陷阱和特征性参数尖峰动态，并提出受控自举、集成分位数估计和基于尖峰的参数调节等稳定化原则。在 Atari-100K 和 Procgen 上的实验表明该方法具有竞争力的性能和更好的训练稳定性。
Motivation: 现有研究常将深度 Q 学习的不稳定性归因于过估计偏差或表示学习等孤立因素，缺少对不同不稳定来源在递归价值估计中如何交互的统一理解。
Method: 提出从算子级、估计器级和参数动态三个层面系统分析不稳定性，并据此推导稳定化原则：受控自举（controlled bootstrapping）、集成分位数估计（ensemble quantile estimation）和基于尖峰的参数调节（spike-based parameter regulation）。
Result: 在 Atari-100K 和 Procgen 基准上的实验表明该方法取得有竞争力的性能，并改善了训练稳定性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将受控自举、集成分位数估计与基于尖峰的参数调节结合起来，可在保持竞争性能的同时提升深度 Q 学习的训练稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MUSE: An Interactive Meta-Agent for Understanding and Steering LLM-powered Data Science Systems
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models have enabled a new class of agentic data science systems that allow users to complete complex data science workflows through natural language. Although these systems can significantly reduce manual effort, it remains difficult to diagnose their behavior and steer the reasoning process when failures or unexpected outputs occur. We present MUSE, an interactive meta-agent that enhances user understanding and control of agentic data science systems by (1) dynamically restructuring low-level execution traces into multiple semantic levels that support navigation from high-level overviews to low-level implementation details; (2) enabling users to reference specific workflow steps in context to ask grounded questions, provide feedback, and revise problematic steps without manually locating relevant execution history; and (3) supporting mixed-initiative steering by surfacing suspicious steps for inspection, scaffolding the repair process, and translating user repair intent into contextualized instructions for the underlying agent. In a between-subjects study (n = 15), MUSE improved task efficiency and increased users' confidence in understanding and steering agentic data science workflows.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 MUSE，一个交互式 meta-agent，用于帮助用户理解和引导基于 LLM 的 agentic 数据科学系统。MUSE 将低层执行轨迹动态重构为多个语义层级，支持用户在上下文中引用具体工作流步骤来提问、反馈和修订，并通过混合主动方式辅助修复可疑步骤。一项 n=15 的被试间实验显示，MUSE 提升了任务效率并增强了用户理解和引导此类工作流的信心。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的 agentic 数据科学系统虽然能用自然语言完成复杂流程，但在失败或产生意外输出时，用户难以诊断系统行为并引导其推理过程。
Method: MUSE 通过三种机制实现：(1) 将低层执行轨迹动态重构为从高层概览到低层实现细节的多语义层级；(2) 允许用户引用特定工作流步骤进行上下文内的提问、反馈和步骤修订；(3) 支持混合主动 steering，包括标出可疑步骤、搭建修复流程，并将用户的修复意图转化为底层 agent 可执行的上下文指令。
Result: 摘要报告在 between-subjects 研究（n=15）中，MUSE 提高了任务效率，并增加了用户对理解和引导 agentic 数据科学工作流的信心。
Conclusion: 摘要认为交互式 meta-agent 方法能增强用户对 agentic 数据科学系统的理解和控制；未提及具体局限性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Demystifying Oversmoothing in Sheaf Neural Networks: An Index-Theoretic Criterion
papers.abstract_en: To combat oversmoothing in Graph Convolutional Networks, Sheaf Neural Networks (SNNs) were proposed as a generalization by equipping the graph with a sheaf structure and replacing the graph Laplacian with a sheaf Laplacian $\mathcal{L}$. Existing analyses connect sheaf diffusion to oversmoothing via the harmonic space ($\ker\mathcal{L}$), taking its absolute dimension as an indicator of anti-oversmoothing capacity. However, absolute dimension alone is not a reliable measure: certain sheaf configurations inflate $\dim \ker \mathcal{L}$ while their harmonic sections remain entirely constant, without enriching discriminative capacity. We instead introduce the first relative, geometric approach, yielding a precise characterisation of anti-oversmoothing capacity. Under natural conditions on stalk transportation and global sheaf structure, we establish an index-theoretic comparison criterion showing that one sheaf's harmonic space genuinely contains another's beyond trivial inflation. We illustrate this with a concrete instance and further introduce \textit{GyroSheaf}, a sheaf with curved gyrovector-space stalks, extending the criterion to the non-linear setting via local tangent-space linearization. Experiments across ten models confirm the theoretical criterion: sheaf models violating the criterion collapse despite possessing index jumps, while compliant models maintain depth-stable representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Sheaf 神经网络 (SNN) 中的过平滑问题，提出首个相对、几何的抗过平滑能力刻画。作者指出仅以调和空间绝对维度 $\dim \ker \mathcal{L}$ 作为指标不可靠，因为某些 sheaf 配置会虚增维度而调和截面仍完全恒定；在 stalk 传输与整体 sheaf 结构的自然条件下，他们建立了一个 index-theoretic 比较判据，并引入 GyroSheaf 将判据推广到非线性情形。十个模型的实验验证了该判据：违反判据的 sheaf 模型即使存在 index jump 也会坍缩，满足判据的模型则保持深度稳定的表示。
Motivation: 现有分析将 sheaf 扩散与过平滑的联系归结为调和空间绝对维度，但绝对维度会被不增加判别能力的 sheaf 配置虚增，无法可靠度量抗过平滑能力。
Method: 提出相对、几何的判据：在 stalk 传输和全局 sheaf 结构的自然条件下，建立 index-theoretic 比较判据，用于判断一个 sheaf 的调和空间是否真正包含另一个调和空间而非仅发生平凡膨胀；同时引入 GyroSheaf，以弯曲 gyrovector-space stalks 通过局部切空间线性化把判据推广到非线性设定。
Result: 在十个模型上的实验证实理论判据：违反判据的 sheaf 模型尽管出现 index jump 仍发生表示坍缩，而满足判据的模型保持深度稳定的表示。
Conclusion: 摘要强调绝对维度不是可靠指标，相对几何判据能更精确地刻画抗过平滑能力，并通过 GyroSheaf 将判据扩展到非线性情形。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Agent-Native Telemetry: Verifiable State-Delta Evidence for Autonomous Operations
papers.abstract_en: Operational telemetry is predominantly engineered for human reading: systems repeatedly serialize verbose prose, static keys, and redundant context across billions of log lines. As autonomous AI agents become primary operational consumers, feeding them traditional logs wastes scarce context capacity parsing lexical syntax rather than reasoning over system state changes -- all while lacking cryptographic guarantees of provenance or collection completeness. This paper introduces agent-native telemetry, an operational evidence architecture for autonomous machine operators founded on verifiable state deltas rather than human prose. We present the Agent Telemetry Protocol (ATP) and the State-Delta Evidence Ledger, an implementation that structures operational facts into four core evidence primitives (Transitions, Observations, Relations, and State Checkpoints) governed by content-addressed schemas, while isolating uncurated text as digest-verified opaque references. Producers sign and hash-chain batches for atomic collector append. Verified records feed two parallel agent access paths: a stateless protocol decoder emitting compact positional rows, and a stateful semantic gateway serving bounded graph capsules. We prove an information-preservation lower bound and formalize a ledger-relative verified negative theorem for provable event non-occurrence. On distributed microservice benchmarks (AIOpsLab and OpenTelemetry Astronomy Shop), ATP reduces raw wire payload and modeled cloud query scan costs by 96.4% relative to OpenTelemetry JSON, reduces LLM context tokens by 88.8% and query operations by 66.2%, detects all 500 tested adversarial storage mutations, and yields zero successful prompt injections across 50 adversarial trials per ATP configuration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 agent-native telemetry，一种面向自主 AI 智能体的可验证运维证据架构，核心是用可验证的状态增量 (state delta) 取代为人类阅读而设计的日志文本。作者给出 Agent Telemetry Protocol (ATP) 与 State-Delta Evidence Ledger 实现，将运维事实组织为四种证据原语，并通过内容寻址 schema、签名与哈希链保证来源与完整性。在分布式微服务基准上，该方案相对 OpenTelemetry JSON 大幅降低传输开销、LLM 上下文 token 与查询开销，并抵御存储篡改与提示注入攻击。
Motivation: 现有运维遥测主要为人类阅读而设计，大量序列化冗长文本、静态键与冗余上下文；当自主 AI 智能体成为主要消费方时，这些日志浪费稀缺的上下文容量去解析词法语法，且缺乏对来源 (provenance) 与采集完整性的密码学保证。
Method: 提出 ATP 与 State-Delta Evidence Ledger：将运维事实结构化为四种证据原语 (Transitions、Observations、Relations、State Checkpoints)，由内容寻址 schema 约束，未整理的文本被隔离为摘要验证的不透明引用；生产者对批次签名并哈希链式追加以实现原子采集。验证记录经由两条并行访问路径：无状态协议解码器输出紧凑位置行，有状态语义网关提供有界图胶囊；作者还证明了信息保持下界，并形式化了一个相对账本的可验证否定定理 (verified negative theorem)。
Result: 在 AIOpsLab 和 OpenTelemetry Astronomy Shop 分布式微服务基准上，ATP 相对 OpenTelemetry JSON 将原始线上负载与建模云查询扫描成本降低 96.4%，LLM 上下文 token 减少 88.8%，查询操作减少 66.2%；检测出全部 500 个对抗性存储突变，并在每个 ATP 配置的 50 次对抗试验中实现零成功提示注入。
Conclusion: 摘要将可验证状态增量而非人类文本作为自主运维遥测的组织原则，并强调其信息保持下界与可证明的事件未发生性 (provable event non-occurrence) 是形式化基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Measuring Obedience to Authority Across Large Language Models with the Milgram Paradigm
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that operate equipment, execute instructions, and act inside institutional hierarchies, raising a question social psychology answered for humans six decades ago: how far will an agent escalate a harmful action when a legitimate authority insists? We port Milgram's obedience paradigm to LLMs as a standardized, fully scripted, replicable probe: the model plays the Teacher, a deterministic harness plays Experimenter and Learner from paraphrased Milgram scripts (30 shock levels, 15-450 V; graded protests; the four standardized prods), and the outcome of a session is the breakoff voltage. Following the census methodology of single-token fingerprinting studies, we measure obedience profiles (empirical breakoff distributions over a battery of six conditions) for 42 models from 19 families. We find that (i) obedience is highly heterogeneous: baseline full-obedience rates span 0-100% (census mean 42.9%; human anchor 65%), with 5 models delivering the maximum shock in every session and 11 never doing so; (ii) profiles are model-specific and stable: split-half verification separates same-model from cross-model comparisons with AUC 0.885 (0.949 under an ordinal-aware distance); (iii) situational sensitivity is selective: peer defiance shifts obedience in the human direction, learner proximity only weakly, and removing the authority's physical presence (the strongest human lever) has no detectable effect; (iv) declaring the scenario fictional raises obedience (median +17.2 V), whereas moving the decision to a native tool call lowers it sharply (-53.0 V), as does a 1,024-token deliberation budget (-38.2 V); and (v) obedience profiles do not recover model lineage (leave-one-out family accuracy 8.3% vs. 3.7% chance): obedience identifies the checkpoint, not its ancestry, consistent with safety post-training overwriting lineage priors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将 Milgram 服从权威实验范式移植到大语言模型 (LLM) 上，构造了一个完全脚本化、可复现的测量探针：模型扮演 Teacher，确定性 harness 扮演 Experimenter 和 Learner，会话结果为 breakoff voltage（30 个电击等级，15-450 V）。作者对 19 个家族的 42 个模型在六种条件下测量服从分布，发现服从行为高度异质、模型特定且稳定，并受情境设置影响。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地作为代理在机构层级中操作设备、执行指令，因此需要回答社会心理学六十年前为人类回答的问题：当合法权威坚持时，代理会把有害行为升级到什么程度。
Method: 基于改写后的 Milgram 脚本构建标准化探针，模型扮演 Teacher，系统自动执行 Experimenter 和 Learner 的固定对白，包括渐进抗议和四个标准提示 (prods)；借鉴单 token 指纹识别的普查式方法，在包含六种条件的测试组上测量 42 个模型的服从曲线与 breakoff 分布，并用 split-half 验证和 leave-one-out 家族分类进行分析。
Result: 基线完全服从率在 0-100% 之间，普查均值为 42.9%，人类锚点为 65%；5 个模型每次会话都给出最大电击，11 个模型从未如此。分裂半验证区分同模型与跨模型的 AUC 为 0.885（序数感知距离下为 0.949）。情境效应有选择性：同伴违抗使行为向人类方向偏移，学习者接近度影响弱，移除权威物理在场无显著效果；声明场景为虚构使服从中位数提高 +17.2 V，改为原生工具调用使服从大幅下降 -53.0 V，1024-token 的 deliberation 预算使其下降 -38.2 V。留一法家族分类准确率为 8.3%（随机水平 3.7%），即服从曲线无法恢复模型谱系。
Conclusion: 作者认为服从行为标识的是具体 checkpoint 而非其家族来源，这与安全后训练覆盖了谱系先验的解释一致；研究把 Milgram 范式变成标准化探针，可用于刻画 LLM 代理在社会层级中的服从倾向。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: QUMem: Personalized Memory for Query-Conditioned User-State Inference in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use external memory systems to support personalization by drawing on long and evolving interaction histories, in which user preferences may be distributed across time, change with context, and conflict with earlier evidence. However, existing systems face three limitations: fixed-turn, fixed-token, or session-based boundaries can mix unrelated dialogue or split an event from its causes, decisions, and outcomes; storing multiple pieces of user information from the same interaction as a single memory binds together items that serve different functions and should be independently retrievable; and treating the current task as a single top-$k$ retrieval query can return fragments that are individually relevant but fail to jointly capture preference evolution, temporal validity, and contextual applicability. We introduce \textsc{QUMem}, a structured memory framework for query-conditioned user-state inference. \textsc{QUMem} first segments interaction histories into variable-length episodes according to semantic continuity, then decomposes each episode into independently retrievable factual, preference, and transferable insight memories while preserving temporal positions and source evidence. At inference time, three sequential agents identify task-specific information needs, plan multi-query retrieval over the typed memory stores, and jointly infer a temporally and contextually valid user state for downstream response generation. \textsc{QUMem} achieves state-of-the-art performance on both PersonaMem and KnowU-Bench, demonstrating the effectiveness of query-conditioned user-state inference for long-term personalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QUMem，一个用于 LLM 智能体查询条件用户状态推断 (query-conditioned user-state inference) 的结构化记忆框架。QUMem 先将交互历史按语义连续性切分为可变长度片段，再把每个片段分解为可独立检索的事实、偏好和可迁移洞察记忆，同时保留时间位置与来源证据。推理时，三个顺序智能体分别识别任务相关信息需求、规划对类型化记忆存储的多查询检索，并联合推断时间与上下文有效的用户状态。摘要报告其在 PersonaMem 和 KnowU-Bench 上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有外部记忆系统存在三点局限：固定轮数、固定 token 或基于会话的边界会混入无关对话，或把事件与其因果、决策和结果拆开；同一次交互中的多条用户信息被合并为单一记忆，导致功能不同的条目无法独立检索；把当前任务当作单一 top-k 检索查询，返回的片段单独相关，却无法联合捕捉偏好演化、时间有效性与上下文适用性。
Method: QUMem 首先按语义连续性将交互历史分割为可变长度片段，然后对每个片段进行分解，产生事实、偏好、可迁移洞察三类可独立检索的记忆，并保留时间位置与来源证据。推理阶段由三个顺序智能体协作：识别任务特定的信息需求、规划类型化记忆库上的多查询检索，以及联合推断时间与上下文有效的用户状态以支持下游回复生成。
Result: 摘要报告 QUMem 在 PersonaMem 和 KnowU-Bench 两个基准上均达到最先进性能，验证了查询条件用户状态推断对长期个性化的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过片段化记忆分解与多查询联合推断，可以同时处理偏好演化、时间有效性和上下文适用性，从而改善 LLM 智能体的长期个性化表现。摘要未明确讨论该方法在可扩展性或跨任务泛化方面的局限。
Relevance: 0
