papers.title: mR$^2$AG: Multimodal Retrieval-Reflection-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Based VQA
papers.abstract_en: Advanced Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle with recent Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (VQA) tasks, such as INFOSEEK and Encyclopedic-VQA, due to their limited and frozen knowledge scope, often leading to ambiguous and inaccurate responses. Thus, multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (mRAG) is naturally introduced to provide MLLMs with comprehensive and up-to-date knowledge, effectively expanding the knowledge scope. However, current mRAG methods have inherent drawbacks, including: 1) Performing retrieval even when external knowledge is not needed. 2) Lacking of identification of evidence that supports the query. 3) Increasing model complexity due to additional information filtering modules or rules. To address these shortcomings, we propose a novel generalized framework called \textbf{m}ultimodal \textbf{R}etrieval-\textbf{R}eflection-\textbf{A}ugmented \textbf{G}eneration (mR$^2$AG), which achieves adaptive retrieval and useful information localization to enable answers through two easy-to-implement reflection operations, preventing high model complexity. In mR$^2$AG, Retrieval-Reflection is designed to distinguish different user queries and avoids redundant retrieval calls, and Relevance-Reflection is introduced to guide the MLLM in locating beneficial evidence of the retrieved content and generating answers accordingly. In addition, mR$^2$AG can be integrated into any well-trained MLLM with efficient fine-tuning on the proposed mR$^2$AG Instruction-Tuning dataset (mR$^2$AG-IT). mR$^2$AG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art MLLMs (e.g., GPT-4o) and mRAG-based MLLMs on INFOSEEK and Encyclopedic-VQA, while maintaining the exceptional capabilities of base MLLMs across a wide range of Visual-dependent tasks.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多模态检索-反射-增强生成框架 mR^2AG，用于提升知识型视觉问答（Knowledge-based VQA）中多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的表现。框架通过 Retrieval-Reflection 判断查询是否需要外部检索，并通过 Relevance-Reflection 引导模型定位检索内容中的有效证据，从而避免不必要的检索调用、弥补证据识别不足，并保持较低模型复杂度。作者称该方法在 INFOSEEK 和 Encyclopedic-VQA 上显著优于 GPT-4o 等现有 MLLM 及多模态 RAG 方法，同时保留基础 MLLM 在多种视觉依赖任务上的能力。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 的知识范围有限且冻结，导致在 INFOSEEK、Encyclopedic-VQA 等知识型 VQA 任务上回答含糊或不准确；而当前多模态 RAG 方法存在三个缺陷：不需要外部知识时仍进行检索、缺乏对支持查询证据的识别、额外信息过滤模块或规则增加了模型复杂度。
Method: 提出通用框架 mR^2AG，包含两个易实现的反射操作：Retrieval-Reflection 用于区分用户查询并避免冗余检索调用，Relevance-Reflection 用于指引 MLLM 定位检索内容中的有益证据并据此生成答案。该框架可集成到任意训练好的 MLLM，并通过所构建的 mR^2AG Instruction-Tuning 数据集（mR^2AG-IT）进行高效微调。
Result: 摘要报告 mR^2AG 在 INFOSEEK 和 Encyclopedic-VQA 基准上显著优于最先进的 MLLM（如 GPT-4o）和基于 mRAG 的 MLLM，同时保持基础 MLLM 在广泛视觉依赖任务上的原有能力。
Conclusion: 作者强调 mR^2AG 通过两个轻量反射操作同时实现自适应检索与有用信息定位，避免高模型复杂度，并能以高效微调方式适配任意已训练 MLLM。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantum Large Language Models via Tensor Network Disentanglers
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a framework for seamlessly integrating quantum computing into pretrained large language models (LLMs). The key idea is to construct a hybrid quantum-classical representation that exactly reproduces the original model, providing a principled starting point from which quantum resources can only improve performance. Our approach replaces the weight matrices in self-attention and multilayer perceptron layers with two variational quantum circuits coupled to a matrix product operator (MPO). Tensor network disentanglers transfer much of each layer's information into the quantum circuits, enabling the remaining tensor network to be compressed to a bond-dimension-one MPO with over three orders of magnitude fewer classical parameters (in our experiments, from 110,592 to approximately 36 for the replaced layer) and less than a 0.3\% increase in perplexity. Training an added unitary adapter on top of this representation then surpasses the original model, reducing perplexity by up to 1.6\%. Finally, we validate the hybrid architecture on a real quantum processor, demonstrating a practical route towards quantum-enhanced language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个将量子计算无缝集成到预训练大语言模型 (LLM) 中的框架：构建一个能精确复现原模型的混合量子-经典表示，把自注意力和 MLP 层中的权重矩阵替换为两个变分量子电路 (variational quantum circuits) 与一个矩阵乘积算子 (MPO) 的组合。张量网络解纠缠器 (tensor network disentanglers) 将层内信息大量转移到量子电路中，使剩余张量网络可压缩为键维为一的 MPO，参数从 110,592 降到约 36，困惑度仅增加不到 0.3%。在此基础上训练一个酉适配器 (unitary adapter) 即可超越原模型，困惑度最多降低 1.6%，并在真实量子处理器上验证了该混合架构。
Motivation: 现有工作缺乏将量子计算整合进预训练 LLM 的原则性方案，通常难以保证量子部分不损害已有模型性能。作者希望从能精确复现原模型的表示出发，使量子资源的加入只能改进而不能退化性能。
Method: 提出混合量子-经典表示：用两个变分量子电路耦合一个 MPO 来替换自注意力和 MLP 层的权重矩阵；通过张量网络解纠缠器把每层大部分信息转移到量子电路中，从而把 MPO 压缩到键维为一；再在表示之上训练一个酉适配器以提升性能。
Result: 在实验中，被替换层的经典参数从 110,592 压缩到约 36，压缩超过三个数量级，困惑度增加小于 0.3%；训练酉适配器后困惑度最多降低 1.6%；该混合架构还在真实量子处理器上得到验证。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架提供了一条通往量子增强语言模型的实用路径：精确复现原模型后再利用量子资源进行改进，压缩与性能提升可同时实现。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Limits to scalable evaluation at the frontier: LLM as Judge won't beat twice the data
papers.abstract_en: High quality annotations are increasingly a bottleneck in the explosively growing machine learning ecosystem. Scalable evaluation methods that avoid costly annotation have therefore become an important research ambition. Many hope to use strong existing models in lieu of costly labels to provide cheap model evaluations. Unfortunately, this method of using models as judges introduces biases, such as self-preferencing, that can distort model comparisons. An emerging family of debiasing tools promises to fix these issues by using a few high quality labels to debias a large number of model judgments. In this paper, we study how far such debiasing methods, in principle, can go. Our main result shows that when the judge is no more accurate than the evaluated model, no debiasing method can decrease the required amount of ground truth labels by more than half. Our result speaks to the severe limitations of the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm at the evaluation frontier where the goal is to assess newly released models that are possibly better than the judge. Through an empirical evaluation, we demonstrate that the sample size savings achievable in practice are even more modest than what our theoretical limit suggests. Along the way, our work provides new observations about debiasing methods for model evaluation, and points out promising avenues for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究前沿模型评估中，用强模型作为裁判（LLM-as-a-judge）并通过少量高质量标签去偏的极限。核心理论结果表明，当裁判模型不比被评估模型更准确时，任何去偏方法最多能将所需的真实标签（ground truth labels）量减少一半；实证评估显示实际能达到的样本量节省比这一理论极限还要有限。
Motivation: 高质量标注日益成为机器学习生态中的瓶颈，用现有强模型替代昂贵标签的规模化评估方法受到关注，但模型作裁判会引入自偏好（self-preferencing）等偏差。去偏工具宣称可以用少量高质量标签修正大量模型判断，本文想从原理上回答这类方法究竟能走多远。
Method: 通过理论分析刻画去偏方法在裁判准确率不高于被评估模型时的样本复杂度下界，并结合实证评估考察现实中去偏方法能实现的样本量节省。
Result: 主要结果是：当裁判不比被评估模型更准确时，没有任何去偏方法能把所需真实标签量减少超过一半；实证评估表明，实际可达到的样本节省比该理论极限更为保守。此外，论文还提供了关于模型评估中去偏方法的新观察。
Conclusion: 作者认为LLM-as-a-judge范式在评估前沿（即新发布模型可能优于裁判）时存在严重局限，并指出了未来有希望的研究方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Macroeconomic Forecasting with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a comparative analysis evaluating the accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs) against traditional macro time series forecasting approaches. In recent times, LLMs have surged in popularity for forecasting due to their ability to capture intricate patterns in data and quickly adapt across very different domains. However, their effectiveness in forecasting macroeconomic time series data compared to conventional methods remains an area of interest. To address this, we conduct a rigorous evaluation of LLMs against traditional macro forecasting methods, using as common ground the FRED-MD database. Our findings provide valuable insights into the strengths and limitations of LLMs in forecasting macroeconomic time series, shedding light on their applicability in real-world scenarios
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对大型语言模型（LLM）与传统宏观经济时间序列预测方法进行对比分析，以 FRED-MD 数据库为共同基准，评估两类方法在宏观预测任务上的准确性。摘要未给出具体数值结果，而是总结了 LLM 在宏观时间序列预测中的优势与局限，并讨论其在实际场景中的适用性。
Motivation: LLM 因能捕捉复杂数据模式并快速适应不同领域而越来越多地被用于预测，但其在宏观经济时间序列上相比传统方法是否有效仍不明确，作者旨在通过严格对比填补这一空白。
Method: 以 FRED-MD 宏观数据库作为公共测试基准，对 LLM 与传统宏观预测方法进行系统的准确性比较评估。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值指标，仅称研究获得了关于 LLM 在宏观经济时间序列预测中优势与局限的洞察。
Conclusion: 作者强调结果有助于理解 LLM 在现实宏观预测场景中的适用性，但未在摘要中给出明确的最优方法结论或局限讨论。

papers.title: Assessing AI-Generated vs. Human-Authored Spear Phishing SMS Attacks: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: Personalized phishing is difficult to defend against because messages can be tailored to a target's work, interests, and social context. Large language models may make such tailoring faster and easier, but it remains unclear whether messages produced from simple prompts are more convincing than those written by people. This 25-target pilot study compared personalized smishing messages generated by GPT-4 with messages written by novice student authors working under time constraints. Using the proposed Threshold Ranking Approach for Personalized Deception (TRAPD), participants ranked 12 messages written for them, indicated the point at which they would intend to click, explained their reasoning, and judged whether each message was authored by GPT-4 or a human. GPT-4-generated messages elicited an intention to click more often than student-authored messages (28% versus 21%), although the difference was uncertain. More broadly, our findings suggest that a simple prompt can produce personalized messages that participants found comparably convincing within the uncertainty of this pilot study. Job-related messages were significantly more likely to elicit an intention to click than hobby- or social-media-related messages. When asked whether a message was written by a human or generated by AI, participants identified the source no more accurately than chance, although the two study-specific message sets remained computationally distinguishable based on their text. Together, these findings suggest that accessible AI-assisted personalization may increase the practical scale of social-engineering threats, while also demonstrating both the value and current limitations of TRAPD for controlled and ethical comparison.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一项 25 名受试者的小规模试点研究，比较 GPT-4 生成的个性化钓鱼短信（smishing）与新手学生在时间限制下撰写的信息。研究提出了阈值排序个性化欺骗方法（Threshold Ranking Approach for Personalized Deception, TRAPD），让参与者对为其编写的 12 条消息排序、指出其意图点击的阈值、解释理由并判断每条消息的来源。结果显示 GPT-4 消息引发点击意图的比例略高于学生消息（28% 对 21%），但差异不确定；参与者判断来源的准确率不优于随机猜测，而两组消息在文本上仍可被计算区分。
Motivation: 个性化钓鱼难以防御，因为消息可以针对目标的工作、兴趣和社交背景定制；大语言模型可能使这种定制更快更容易，但尚不清楚简单提示生成的消息是否比人类撰写的更具说服力。
Method: 提出 TRAPD 方法，用于在受控且符合伦理的条件下比较 AI 生成与人类撰写的个性化欺骗消息；研究采用 25 名受试者的试点设计，参与者对 12 条个性化消息排序并给出点击意图阈值。
Result: GPT-4 生成的消息引发点击意图的比例为 28%，学生消息为 21%，差异在统计上不确定；与爱好或社交媒体相关的消息相比，与工作相关的消息显著更可能引发点击意图；参与者识别来源的准确率不高于随机水平，但两个消息集在文本上仍可被计算区分。
Conclusion: 易于获取的 AI 辅助个性化可能扩大社会工程威胁的实际规模；同时研究表明 TRAPD 在受控和伦理比较方面既有价值也存在当前局限。

papers.title: TIMA: Text-Image Mutual Awareness for Balancing Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness and Generalization Ability
papers.abstract_en: Achieving zero-shot adversarial robustness without sacrificing generalization remains challenging for foundation models such as CLIP, especially under large adversarial perturbations. Through empirical analyses, we identify three critical yet overlooked issues: (1) Logit margins exhibit a stable offset between small and large adversarial perturbations, suggesting that explicitly adjusting margins could improve robustness against unseen large perturbations. (2) A significant negative correlation exists between logit margin and inter-class semantic similarity, indicating that semantic structures are insufficiently leveraged by existing methods. (3) Existing methods for adjusting text embeddings disrupt the intrinsic semantic consistency established by pre-trained models, undermining generalization capability. Motivated by these findings, we propose a novel Text-Image Mutual Awareness (TIMA) framework, including a Text-Aware Image (TAI) tuning module with an Adaptive Semantic-Aware Margin (ASAM) to explicitly calibrate logit margins, and an Image-Aware Text (IAT) tuning module with Semantic Consistent Minimum Hyperspherical Energy (SC-MHE) to preserve semantic consistency. Comprehensive experiments validate that TIMA significantly outperforms existing approaches by effectively addressing the identified limitations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 CLIP 等基础模型在零样本对抗鲁棒性与泛化能力之间难以兼得的问题，提出 Text-Image Mutual Awareness (TIMA) 框架。作者通过经验分析指出三个被忽视的问题：logit margin 在小扰动与大扰动之间存在稳定偏移、logit margin 与类间语义相似度显著负相关、现有文本嵌入调整会破坏预训练模型建立的语义一致性。TIMA 据此设计文本感知图像调优与图像感知文本调优两个模块，摘要称其在零样本对抗鲁棒性上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 零样本对抗鲁棒性通常以牺牲泛化能力为代价，尤其在较大对抗扰动下问题更为突出；作者识别出 margin 偏移、margin 与语义相似度负相关、以及文本嵌入调整破坏语义一致性这三个被忽视的局限，认为它们是限制现有方法性能的关键。
Method: 提出 TIMA 框架，包含 Text-Aware Image (TAI) 调优模块并引入 Adaptive Semantic-Aware Margin (ASAM) 显式校准 logit margin；同时包含 Image-Aware Text (IAT) 调优模块，采用 Semantic Consistent Minimum Hyperspherical Energy (SC-MHE) 保持文本嵌入的语义一致性。
Result: 摘要报告在多个实验设置下 TIMA 显著优于现有零样本对抗鲁棒性方法，但未给出具体数值或基准细节。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过显式校准 logit margin 并保持预训练语义一致性，可以有效提升面对未见大扰动时的零样本对抗鲁棒性，同时避免泛化能力下降。

papers.title: DirMixE: Harnessing Test Agnostic Long-tail Recognition with Hierarchical Label Variations
papers.abstract_en: This paper explores test-agnostic long-tail recognition, a challenging long-tail task where the test label distributions are unknown and arbitrarily imbalanced. We argue that the variation in these distributions can be broken down hierarchically into global and local levels. The global ones reflect a broad range of diversity, while the local ones typically arise from milder changes, often focused on a particular neighbor. Traditional methods predominantly use a Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) approach, targeting a few fixed test label distributions that exhibit substantial global variations. However, the local variations are left unconsidered. To address this issue, we propose a new MoE strategy, DirMixE, which assigns experts to different Dirichlet meta-distributions of the label distribution, each targeting a specific aspect of local variations. Additionally, the diversity among these Dirichlet meta-distributions inherently captures global variations. This dual-level approach also leads to a more stable objective function, allowing us to sample different test distributions better to quantify the mean and variance of performance outcomes. Building on this idea, we develop a general Latent Skill Finetuning (LSF) framework for parameter-efficient finetuning of foundation models. We provide implementations based on LoRA and Adapter. Theoretically, we derive upper bounds on the generalization error for both standard learning and PEFT. Under mild assumptions, we show that the variance-based regularization helps tighten these bounds. Furthermore, we prove that the covering number of the PEFT hypothesis class scales with the number of trainable parameters. Finally, extensive experiments on CIFAR-10-LT, CIFAR-100-LT, ImageNet-LT, and iNaturalist validate the effectiveness of DirMixE.
papers.comment: Conference version: Zhiyong Yang, Qianqian Xu, Zitai Wang, Sicong Li, Boyu Han, Shilong Bao, Xiaochun Cao, and Qingming Huang. Harnessing Hierarchical Label Distribution Variations in Test Agnostic Long-tail Recognition. ICML, 56624-56664, 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究测试标签分布未知且任意不平衡的测试无关长尾识别 (test-agnostic long-tail recognition)。作者认为测试标签分布的变化可分层为全局变化与局部变化,并提出 DirMixE 这一 MoE 策略:将不同专家分配到不同 Dirichlet 元分布,每个元分布针对局部变化的特定方面,而元分布间的多样性自然捕获全局变化。文章还提出用于基础模型参数高效微调的 Latent Skill Finetuning (LSF) 框架,并给出基于 LoRA 和 Adapter 的实现,同时从理论上推导了标准学习与 PEFT 的泛化误差上界。
Motivation: 传统长尾识别方法多采用 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 方式,仅针对少数具有显著全局变化的固定测试标签分布建模,忽略了通常较平缓且集中于特定邻近分布的局部变化,导致在测试标签分布未知且任意不平衡时性能受限。
Method: 提出 DirMixE 的 MoE 策略,将专家分配给标签分布的不同 Dirichlet 元分布 (Dirichlet meta-distributions),每个元分布捕捉特定的局部变化,元分布之间的多样性则覆盖全局变化;在此基础上构建 Latent Skill Finetuning (LSF) 参数高效微调框架,并提供基于 LoRA 和 Adapter 的实现。理论部分推导了标准学习与 PEFT 的泛化误差上界,证明在温和假设下方差正则化有助于收紧界,并证明 PEFT 假设类的覆盖数随可训练参数数量缩放。
Result: 实验在 CIFAR-10-LT、CIFAR-100-LT、ImageNet-LT 和 iNaturalist 上验证了 DirMixE 的有效性;摘要未给出具体数值提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为这种双层级 Dirichlet 元分布设计能同时处理全局与局部标签分布变化,并带来更稳定的目标函数,从而更好地对不同测试分布采样、量化性能的均值与方差;LSF 框架则为基础模型的参数高效微调提供了泛化保证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EquiPocket: an E(3)-Equivariant Geometric Graph Neural Network for Ligand Binding Site Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting the binding sites of target proteins plays a fundamental role in drug discovery. Most existing deep-learning methods consider a protein as a 3D image by spatially clustering its atoms into voxels and then feed the voxelized protein into a 3D CNN for prediction. However, the CNN-based methods encounter several critical issues: 1) defective in representing irregular protein structures; 2) sensitive to rotations; 3) insufficient to characterize the protein surface; 4) unaware of protein size shift. To address the above issues, this work proposes EquiPocket, an E(3)-equivariant Graph Neural Network (GNN) for binding site prediction, which comprises three modules: the first one to extract local geometric information for each surface atom, the second one to model both the chemical and spatial structure of protein and the last one to capture the geometry of the surface via equivariant message passing over the surface atoms. We further propose a dense attention output layer to alleviate the effect incurred by variable protein size. Extensive experiments on several representative benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our framework to the state-of-the-art methods.
papers.comment: This paper has been withdrawn by the authors. After further internal evaluation, we find that the technical elaboration and experimental design in the current manuscript require substantial restructuring and revision. The authors will comprehensively optimize the technical framework and reorganize the manuscript before future public release
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EquiPocket 是一个用于配体结合位点预测的 E(3)-等变图神经网络 (GNN)，旨在替代基于体素化蛋白质和 3D CNN 的现有方法。论文已由作者撤回，撤回说明指出当前稿件的技术阐述和实验设计需要大幅重构与修改，作者计划在后续公开版本中优化技术框架。
Motivation: 现有基于 CNN 的深度学习方法将蛋白质视为 3D 图像并按体素聚类原子，存在四个关键缺陷：难以表示不规则的蛋白质结构、对旋转敏感、不能充分刻画蛋白质表面、以及未考虑蛋白质尺寸变化。
Method: 提出 EquiPocket，包含三个模块：第一个为每个表面原子提取局部几何信息，第二个建模蛋白质的化学与空间结构，第三个通过表面原子间的等变消息传递 (equivariant message passing) 捕获表面几何；此外提出一个密集注意力输出层以缓解蛋白质尺寸变化带来的影响。
Result: 摘要在多个代表性基准上的广泛实验表明该框架优于现有最先进方法，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者已撤回该论文，认为当前版本的技术阐述和实验设计需要实质性重构与修改，将在优化技术框架并重组稿件后重新公开发布。

papers.title: Doubly robust nearest neighbors in factor models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce and analyze an improved variant of nearest neighbors (NN) for estimation with missing data in latent factor models. We consider a matrix completion problem with missing data, where the $(i, t)$-th entry, when observed, is given by its mean $f(u_i, v_t)$ plus mean-zero noise for an unknown function $f$ and latent factors $u_i$ and $v_t$. Prior NN strategies, like unit-unit NN, for estimating the mean $f(u_i, v_t)$ relies on existence of other rows $j$ with $u_j \approx u_i$. Similarly, time-time NN strategy relies on existence of columns $t'$ with $v_{t'} \approx v_t$. These strategies provide poor performance respectively when similar rows or similar columns are not available. Our estimate is doubly robust to this deficit in two ways: (1) As long as there exist either good row or good column neighbors, our estimate provides a consistent estimate. (2) Furthermore, if both good row and good column neighbors exist, it provides a (near-)quadratic improvement in the non-asymptotic error and admits a significantly narrower asymptotic confidence interval when compared to both unit-unit or time-time NN.

TL;DR: 本文提出并分析潜在因子模型（latent factor models）中缺失数据估计的改进最近邻（nearest neighbors, NN）方法。在矩阵补全设定下，观测项为未知函数 f(u_i, v_t) 加零均值噪声；作者构造的估计量对行邻居或列邻居的缺失具有双稳健性（doubly robust），并给出非渐近误差与渐近置信区间的理论保证。
Motivation: 已有的 unit-unit NN 依赖存在行因子 u_j 接近 u_i 的相似行，time-time NN 依赖存在列因子接近的相似列；当相似行或相似列不可得时，这些策略表现很差。论文希望弥补这一缺陷，使估计在任一侧邻居不足时仍能保持一致估计。
Method: 提出一种改进的最近邻估计量，同时利用行邻居与列邻居信息；只要存在好的行邻居或好的列邻居即可获得一致估计，若两者同时存在则进一步获得更好的收敛性质。分析框架基于潜在因子模型下的矩阵补全问题。
Result: 摘要报告，所提估计在仅有好行邻居或仅有好列邻居时保持一致估计；当两类邻居都存在时，非渐近误差相对 unit-unit NN 和 time-time NN 有（近）二次改进，且渐近置信区间显著更窄。
Conclusion: 作者论证双稳健设计可同时缓解相似行与相似列缺失带来的估计失效，适用于潜在因子模型下的一般缺失数据估计问题。

papers.title: From Monte Carlo to neural networks approximations of boundary value problems
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we study probabilistic and neural network approximations for solutions to Poisson equation subject to Holder data in general bounded domains of $\mathbb{R}^d$. We aim at two fundamental goals. The first, and the most important, we show that the solution to Poisson equation can be numerically approximated in the sup-norm by Monte Carlo methods, and that this can be done highly efficiently if we use a modified version of the walk on spheres algorithm as an acceleration method. This provides estimates which are efficient with respect to the prescribed approximation error and with polynomial complexity in the dimension and the reciprocal of the error. A crucial feature is that the overall number of samples does not not depend on the point at which the approximation is performed. As a second goal, we show that the obtained Monte Carlo solver renders in a constructive way ReLU deep neural network (DNN) solutions to Poisson problem, whose sizes depend at most polynomialy in the dimension $d$ and in the desired error. In fact we show that the random DNN provides with high probability a small approximation error and low polynomial complexity in the dimension.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一般有界域中带 Hölder 数据的 Poisson 方程的概率与神经网络逼近。作者证明该方程的解可以在 sup-范数下用 Monte Carlo 方法高效数值逼近，并采用改进的 walk on spheres 算法加速，得到关于维数和误差倒数的多项式复杂度估计。进一步，该 Monte Carlo 求解器以构造方式给出 ReLU 深度神经网络解，网络尺寸关于维数 d 和期望误差多项式增长。
Motivation: 针对一般有界域中 Poisson 方程的数值求解，目标是在 sup-范数下获得高效且与维数、误差相关的复杂度估计，并建立从概率求解器到深度神经网络求解器的构造性转换。
Method: 使用 Monte Carlo 方法逼近 Poisson 方程解，以修正的 walk on spheres 算法作为加速手段；基于所得 Monte Carlo 求解器构造 ReLU 深度神经网络，并分析随机 DNN 的误差与复杂度。
Result: 摘要报告在 sup-范数下可实现高效的 Monte Carlo 逼近，总样本数不依赖于执行逼近的空间点；构造出的 ReLU DNN 尺寸关于维数 d 和期望误差呈多项式增长，且以高概率获得小逼近误差和低多项式复杂度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调对 Hölder 数据的 Poisson 方程在一般有界域中，可同时获得高效的 Monte Carlo 逼近和构造性的 ReLU 神经网络逼近，复杂度关于维数与误差均为多项式。

papers.title: CM-MAE: A Physics-Guided Cross-Modal Self-Supervised Learning Framework for Vision-Wireless Applications
papers.abstract_en: Synchronized camera and wireless measurements observe the same scene through different physical channels. The central difficulty is that a representation learned in one deployment can fail when viewpoint, traffic, illumination, and propagation geometry change. This paper presents CM-MAE, a self-supervised vision--wireless pretraining framework for cross-scenario representation transfer. The evaluated real-data model uses only RGB frames and the measured 64-beam received-power vector available in DeepSense 6G; it does not use ray-traced paths, calibrated depth, or beam-index labels during pretraining. Its central pretraining term is a \emph{soft contrastive alignment loss}. Instead of making the synchronized image--wireless pair the only positive pair, this loss builds a target distribution from similarities between measured beam-power profiles, so nonidentical samples with similar directional responses are not forced apart as false negatives. A masked joint decoder provides the complementary local objective by reconstructing hidden visual patches and wireless angular clusters under modality dropout. After pretraining, a differential-rate fine-tuning rule lets a new fusion head adapt quickly while the encoders move slowly. Under a sequence-disjoint DeepSense 6G protocol, adding the soft alignment loss improves a matched linear-probe transfer average from 24.88\% to 29.49\%. Mild fusion fine-tuning reaches 77.38\% Top-1 accuracy on unseen Scenarios 6--8, and optional transductive normalization adaptation reaches 78.69\%. Since the fusion setting uses the contemporaneous 64-beam power vector at inference, these results should be read as representation-transfer diagnostics, not as proactive beam-prediction or reduced-sweeping claims.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CM-MAE，一个面向视觉-无线跨场景表示迁移的自监督预训练框架，输入仅用 RGB 帧和 DeepSense 6G 的 64 波束接收功率向量，不使用射线追踪路径、校准深度或波束索引标签。其核心预训练项是软对比对齐损失 (soft contrastive alignment loss)，并配合带模态丢弃的掩码联合解码器；在序列不相交的 DeepSense 6G 协议下，软对齐损失将匹配线性探针迁移平均准确率从 24.88% 提升到 29.49%。作者明确强调，由于推理时融合设置使用同时刻 64 波束功率向量，结果应视为表示迁移诊断，而非主动波束预测或减少扫描的声明。
Motivation: 同步的相机与无线测量通过不同物理通道观测同一场景，核心难点在于某一部署场景中学到的表示会在视角、交通、光照和传播几何变化时失效，需要跨场景的表示迁移能力。
Method: 提出软对比对齐损失：不再将同步图像-无线对作为唯一正样本对，而是根据波束功率分布之间的相似度构建目标分布，避免把方向响应相似的非相同样本当作假负样本；同时用掩码联合解码器在模态丢弃下重建隐藏视觉块和无线角度簇；预训练后采用差分速率微调规则，让新融合头快速适应而编码器缓慢更新。
Result: 在序列不相交的 DeepSense 6G 协议下，加入软对齐损失使匹配线性探针迁移平均从 24.88% 提高到 29.49%；温和融合微调在未见过的 Scenario 6–8 上达到 77.38% Top-1 准确率，可选的转导归一化适应达到 78.69%。
Conclusion: 由于融合推理使用同时刻 64 波束功率向量，这些数值应被解释为表示迁移诊断结果，而非主动波束预测或减少扫描的性能声明。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Limits of Binding in Dual Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Dual-encoder models such as CLIP score an image-caption pair by a single inner product of two independently computed unit vectors, and fail at binding, often scoring near chance when asked to distinguish "a red car and a blue dog" from "a blue car and a red dog". We give a mathematical account of when this failure is necessary and when it is contingent. Working within the ideal-encoder framework proposed by Kang et al., we first show the relevant axioms are satisfiable, so every impossibility must enter through an added, checkable hypothesis. We then prove three such obstructions. Depth: for recursive role-binding codes the swap margin obeys an exact law $m(D) = 2b^{-D}$ in the nesting depth D, with a finite-dimension version holding up to one explicitly flagged concentration estimate; the resolvable depth grows only logarithmically in the dimension and is single-digit at CLIP scale, the nesting depth of ordinary language. Objective: architecture-free throttle theorems showing that the contrastive objective's entire reward for binding is bounded by the rate at which training contrasts a caption against its own swap, a rate that vanishes at web scale, and that exactly reversed binding costs only that rate times the mean binding margin; both are verified in simulation. Geometry: a tight smoothness-binding frontier: the closer the two swap-related captions must embed to a shared paraphrase anchor, the smaller the binding margin can be, with an exact constant. Measuring its text-only diagnostic across 18 deployed text encoders, every model sits at roughly 25-35% of its ceiling, and the induced per-item ceiling tracks SugarCrepe's subset difficulty at r = 0.99. Binding failure in deployed dual encoders is thus not a dimension or smoothness limit today, but an incentive and code-structure limit, with a proved depth ceiling that remains once those are fixed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在理想编码器框架下分析双编码器（dual encoder，如 CLIP）的角色绑定（binding）失败，证明三类数学障碍：深度、目标和几何。摘要报告绑定失败在部署模型中并非维度或平滑性限制，而是激励与代码结构限制，并给出即使修复后仍存在的深度上限。
Motivation: 双编码器模型如 CLIP 通过两个独立单位向量的内积对图像-文本对打分，在区分“红车蓝狗”与“蓝车红狗”这类交换颜色角色的表述时接近随机；论文要厘清这种失败何时是必然的、何时是偶然的。
Method: 采用 Kang 等人提出的理想编码器框架，先证明相关公理可满足，再证明三类障碍：递归角色绑定编码下交换边界满足精确定律 m(D) = 2b^{-D}；对比学习目标中绑定奖励受训练对比自身交换样本速率约束的架构无关定理；以及平滑性与绑定边界之间的紧致前沿。
Result: 可解析深度随维度对数增长，在 CLIP 尺度仅为个位数；受目标约束的速率在网络规模下趋于零。18 个部署文本编码器的文本诊断仅达到其天花板的约 25-35%，且逐项天花板与 SugarCrepe 子集难度相关 r = 0.99；目标相关定理在模拟中得到验证。
Conclusion: 作者认为当前部署双编码器的绑定失败不是维度或平滑性限制，而是激励（incentive）与代码结构限制；即使修复这些问题，深度上界依然存在。

papers.title: BagShift: Measuring How Patch Selection Changes the Evidence Seen by Whole-Slide MIL
papers.abstract_en: Whole-slide multiple-instance learning (MIL) observes only the patches admitted by its selector. Deployment can alter this selector through compute limits, tissue masking, or regional workflows, even when the patch count is unchanged. We introduce BagShift, a paired protocol that changes the selector for the same case while holding its features and predictor fixed, thereby isolating selector response from case mix. With equal 128-patch budgets, sampling across the tissue or concentrating around one coordinate exposes markedly different evidence: on PANDA, the two views reduce quadratic weighted kappa by 1.57 and 17.96 points, respectively (QWK reported on the $\times100$ scale). On CAMELYON16, lesion annotations withheld from model development show that localized views retain tumor in only 10.0\% of micrometastatic observations, and matched exposure does not consistently recover the loss. The same fixed-count stressor produces a much smaller response on external lung subtyping, although differences in relative coverage make cross-task severity descriptive. When repeated localized observations are available, unioning their patches before one nonlinear MIL pass improves PANDA QWK by 7.87 points over averaging regional predictions. Patch count specifies computation, not observed evidence; deployment evaluations should report both what a selector preserves and how repeated observations are aggregated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BagShift，一种成对协议 (paired protocol)，用于在固定病例、特征和预测器的情况下改变补丁选择器，从而将选择器响应与病例分布变化分离。在 PANDA 上，等量 128 补丁预算下两种选择视图使二次加权 kappa 分别下降 1.57 和 17.96 点；在 CAMELYON16 上，局部化视图在微转移观测中仅保留 10.0% 的肿瘤区域，且匹配曝光不能一致恢复损失。作者指出补丁数量规定计算量而非实际观测证据，部署评估应同时报告选择器保留内容和重复观测的聚合方式。
Motivation: 全切片多实例学习 (MIL) 只观察其选择器允许进入的补丁，部署时的计算限制、组织掩膜或区域工作流可能改变此选择器，即使补丁数量不变也会改变模型实际看到的证据，而现有评估未隔离这一选择器效应。
Method: 提出 BagShift 协议：对同一病例在保持特征和预测器固定时更改选择器，以分离选择器响应与病例混合效应；并研究重复局部观测时的聚合策略，如先对多次局部补丁取并集再进行一次非线性 MIL 传递。
Result: 在 PANDA 上，两种 128 补丁视图使 QWK 降低 1.57 和 17.96 点（×100 尺度）；CAMELYON16 上局部视图仅保留 10.0% 的微转移肿瘤观测，且匹配曝光不能一致恢复损失；外部肺亚型分类对同一固定计数压力响应较小。当重复局部观测可用时，补丁并集再加单次 MIL 在 PANDA QWK 上比平均区域预测高 7.87 点。

papers.title: A Banach-Space Theory of Markovian Halpern Iteration for Non-Expansive Maps
papers.abstract_en: We study stochastic approximation of fixed points of a non-expansive operator when the oracle samples originate from a continuing Markovian trajectory. A direct block-minibatch implementation of Halpern iteration attains an expected last-iterate residual of order $O(\log N/N)$, but accrues a substantive complexity of $\tilde O(ε^{-5})$ Markovian samples. We therefore introduce a variance-reduced Markovian PAGE-Halpern method whose refresh and same-state difference blocks are analyzed through the Poisson equation. In Hilbert spaces, the cocoercivity of $I-T$ results in an $O(ε^{-3})$ sample complexity. Our main result extends this construction to a general finite-dimensional Banach space. A displacement-level Halpern bound replaces the Hilbert-space potential and yields $\tilde O(ε^{-3})$ sample complexity in the original non-expansiveness norm. We also establish a high-probability guarantee with the same leading accuracy dependence by measuring the estimator in an auxiliary smooth norm. Non-smooth sup and block-sup geometries are covered through norm smoothing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究当 oracle 样本来自持续马尔可夫轨迹 (continuing Markovian trajectory) 时，非扩张算子不动点的随机逼近问题。直接的分块小批量 (block-minibatch) Halpern 迭代能达到期望最后迭代残差 O(log N/N)，但需要 Õ(ε^-5) 的马尔可夫样本复杂度；作者引入方差缩减的马尔可夫 PAGE-Halpern 方法，在 Hilbert 空间中利用 I-T 的余强制性 (cocoercivity) 得到 O(ε^-3) 样本复杂度，并将该构造推广到一般有限维 Banach 空间，得到同阶的 Õ(ε^-3) 样本复杂度。
Motivation: 现有随机 Halpern 迭代的分析通常假设独立同分布采样或 Hilbert 空间结构，而实际在线学习中 oracle 样本常来自相关的马尔可夫轨迹，且优化环境可能是一般 Banach 空间；该文试图填补相关采样与非欧几何下的样本复杂度分析缺口。
Method: 提出方差缩减的马尔可夫 PAGE-Halpern 方法，其 refresh 与 same-state difference 块通过 Poisson 方程分析；在 Hilbert 空间使用 I-T 的余强制性，在一般有限维 Banach 空间用位移层面的 Halpern 界 (displacement-level Halpern bound) 替代 Hilbert 空间势能，并借助辅助光滑范数建立高概率估计，通过范数平滑 (norm smoothing) 覆盖非光滑 sup 与 block-sup 几何。
Result: 摘要报告直接分块小批量 Halpern 迭代的样本复杂度为 Õ(ε^-5)；所提 PAGE-Halpern 在 Hilbert 空间达到 O(ε^-3) 样本复杂度，在一般有限维 Banach 空间达到 Õ(ε^-3) 样本复杂度（按原始非扩张范数衡量），并给出相同主精度依赖的高概率保证。
Conclusion: 作者的核心结论是将马尔可夫采样下方差缩减 Halpern 迭代的复杂度分析从 Hilbert 空间推广到一般有限维 Banach 空间，并通过范数平滑处理非光滑几何；摘要未涉及实验验证或该理论框架之外的应用。

papers.title: Beat the Counter First: A Baseline for Temporal-Graph Anomaly Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Progress in streaming, edge-level graph anomaly detection (GAD) has been marked by increasingly elaborate architectures, from count-min-sketch chi square tests to memory-augmented attention networks. Yet the empirical gains attributable to this added complexity have not been systematically evaluated. We propose SimpleCount, a reference with no parameter fitting that selects one scalar feature per dataset from a fixed pool of counts, recencies, first-occurrence indicators, and count-derived transforms. We compare SimpleCount with two temporal-graph detector models and an IsoForest control fitted to the complete feature vector across five public datasets and one synthetic dataset. SimpleCount matches or exceeds SLADE on three of six datasets and exceeds IsoForest on all six. We report paired statistical tests and five-seed SLADE evaluations. SLADE requires 23 to 133x more wall-clock time than SimpleCount. On Synth-Triangle and an additional Synth-Quad probe, pre-event structural scores recover the planted signal at AUC up to 0.955, while all evaluated detector models remain near random. The benefit of complexity is dataset-dependent, and every claimed gain should be reported against a strong one-feature reference together with its compute cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑流式边级图异常检测 (graph anomaly detection, GAD) 中日益复杂架构的实际收益，提出 SimpleCount——一个无需参数拟合的参考方法，从固定标量池（计数、近因 (recency)、首次出现指示及计数衍生变换）中为每个数据集选一个特征。作者在五个公开数据集与一个合成数据集上对比两个时序图检测器模型和基于完整特征向量的 IsoForest 控制，报告 SimpleCount 在六个数据集中三个达到或超过 SLADE，并在全部六个上超过 IsoForest。SLADE 的墙钟时间比 SimpleCount 高 23–133 倍；在合成三角形与四边形探针上，事件前结构分数以最高 0.955 的 AUC 恢复植入信号，而所有被评估的检测器模型接近随机。
Motivation: 流式边级图异常检测领域不断堆叠复杂架构，但新增复杂度带来的经验增益没有被系统评估；作者认为需要以一个强的一特征参考和计算成本作为对照，检验复杂模型的真实贡献。
Method: 提出 SimpleCount 基线：无参数拟合，从固定特征池中为每个数据集挑选单个标量特征，并比较两个时序图检测器模型以及拟合至完整特征向量的 IsoForest 控制；同时报告配对统计检验和五种子 (five-seed) 的 SLADE 评估。
Result: SimpleCount 在六个数据集中三个达到或超过 SLADE，并在全部六个数据集上超过 IsoForest；SLADE 比 SimpleCount 慢 23–133 倍；在 Synth-Triangle 和 Synth-Quad 探针上，事件前结构评分以最高 0.955 的 AUC 恢复植入信号，而所有检测器模型接近随机。
Conclusion: 摘要强调复杂度的收益是数据集依赖的，任何声称的增益都应同时报告强的一特征参考和相应计算成本。

papers.title: LLMs Get Smarter from Targeted Synthetic Multilingual Data
papers.abstract_en: Language-specific competency (LSC) is the phenomenon of a language model performing better or worse depending on the language of the prompt. In other words, a language model outputs different (and potentially incorrect) responses to the same semantic query when prompted in different languages. Prior work attributes this to an internal misalignment of semantic representation across languages. Currently, there are two main approaches to address LSC in the literature: (1) routing all queries through English, improving performance, but limiting language expressivity to English; or (2) training on language-balanced data, equalizing model performance across languages, but reducing overall performance. In this work, we take a data centric perspective and introduce HOTFIXR: Hardness Optimized Training data For Improving X-Lingual Reasoning. It is a data generation framework that uses models to probe and learn a student model's multilingual weaknesses, and generates data to mitigate them. HOTFIXR can generate multilingual synthetic training data that can improve multilingual performance. We evaluate on three in-distribution tasks, three out-of-distribution tasks, and four out-of-distribution languages. On average, HOTFIXR (1) improves in-distribution performance by 6.2%, (2) reduces catastrophic forgetting (induced by fine-tuning) on OOD tasks by 3.7%, and (3) on OOD languages by 7.1%. Overall, as many real-world applications requires multilingual LLMs, our work contributes to the efforts of making LLMs multilingually proficient. We will release code upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型的语言特定能力（LSC）现象（同一语义查询在不同语言下可能得到不同或错误答案），提出数据生成框架 HOTFIXR。该框架用模型探测并学习学生模型的多语言弱点，再生成针对性多语言合成训练数据以缓解这些弱点。作者在三个分布内任务、三个分布外任务和四种分布外语言上评估，报告 HOTFIXR 平均提升分布内性能 6.2%、减少微调引发的灾难性遗忘（OOD 任务上 3.7%、OOD 语言上 7.1%）。
Motivation: 现有解决 LSC 的方法主要有两类：将所有查询路由到英语（提升性能但限制语言表达性）或在语言平衡数据上训练（拉平跨语言性能但降低整体表现）。本文采用数据为中心的视角，希望在不牺牲整体性能的前提下针对性改进模型的多语言弱点。
Method: 提出 HOTFIXR（Hardness Optimized Training data For Improving X-Lingual Reasoning），一种数据生成框架：先使用模型探测学生模型在多种语言上的薄弱环节，再生成合成训练数据来弥补这些弱点，从而改善多语言推理能力。
Result: 在三个分布内任务、三个分布外任务和四种分布外语言上评估，HOTFIXR 平均将分布内性能提升 6.2%，将微调导致的灾难性遗忘在 OOD 任务上降低 3.7%、在 OOD 语言上降低 7.1%。
Conclusion: 作者指出许多真实应用需要多语言 LLM，并认为该工作有助于提升 LLM 的多语言熟练度；代码将在论文录用后发布。

papers.title: SEER: Long-Context Reasoning via Selective Visual-Text Compression
papers.abstract_en: Long-context reasoning remains computationally expensive for large language models due to the quadratic complexity of attention over text tokens. Visual-text compression offers a promising alternative by rendering text into images and processing them with vision-language models, often reducing token usage. However, existing approaches apply uniform compression regardless of query relevance, potentially sacrificing precision where detailed extraction is required. We present SEER, a framework that learns to select query-relevant images through visual scanning and retrieve textual content only where needed, combining the efficiency of visual compression with the precision of text-based reasoning. Through supervised fine-tuning on tool-interaction trajectories, SEER learns adaptive tool invocation for selection and retrieval. Experiments on long-context benchmarks show that SEER improves extraction precision through selective text retrieval while retaining average prompt-token savings relative to full-text baselines. On LongBench, SEER achieves 51.11% average accuracy, outperforming the visual-text baseline Glyph-9B by 2.33 points and Qwen3-8B by 3.49 points. Code can be accessed at https://github.com/jiaweixu98/SEER
papers.comment: COLM 2026, Third Conference on Language Modeling
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SEER，一个通过视觉扫描选取与查询相关的图像、并仅在需要处检索文本内容的框架，以兼顾视觉压缩的效率与文本推理的精度。通过工具交互轨迹上的监督微调，SEER 学会自适应调用选择和检索工具。在 LongBench 上，SEER 平均准确率达 51.11%，比视觉文本基线 Glyph-9B 高 2.33 个百分点，比 Qwen3-8B 高 3.49 个百分点，同时相对全文基线保持平均 prompt token 节省。
Motivation: 长上下文推理中，注意力随文本 token 呈二次复杂度，计算代价高昂；视觉文本压缩虽能减少 token 使用，但现有方法对图像进行与查询无关的均匀压缩，在需要精确抽取的场景下可能损失精度。
Method: SEER 是一个学习型框架：通过视觉扫描选择与查询相关的图像，并在需要处检索文本内容，将视觉压缩的效率与基于文本的推理精度结合；利用工具交互轨迹进行监督微调，学习自适应工具调用来完成选择和检索。
Result: 在 LongBench 上，SEER 达到 51.11% 的平均准确率，超过视觉文本基线 Glyph-9B 2.33 个百分点、超过 Qwen3-8B 3.49 个百分点，同时相对全文基线保留了平均 prompt token 节省。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，选择性文本检索可以提升抽取精度，同时保持视觉压缩带来的 token 节省；代码已公开在 GitHub。

papers.title: Solvable Sokoban Without a Solver via Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Deciding whether a Sokoban puzzle is solvable is PSPACE-complete (Culberson, 1997): solutions can be exponentially long and there is no short certificate to check. Solvability is also a fragile property, since even a single misplaced wall can silently render an entire puzzle unsolvable. In this work, we show that a transformer-based discrete diffusion model trained purely on tile completion, with no access to solvers, rewards, or solvability labels, achieves a solvability rate of 77.4%, with 94.5% of the remaining failures rendered solvable by removing a single wall. In other words, a global, search-heavy property follows from a local training objective: trained only to fill in masked cells, the model inherits solvability it was never trained on. An autoregressive model factorizes as $p(c_k \mid c_1 \dots c_{k-1})$, meaning a fixed order, always conditioned on a prefix. Masked diffusion does not: it hides a random subset of cells and learns $p(c_k \mid \text{any subset})$, so at generation time it can reveal cells in any order, each one conditioned on everything already placed, wherever it sits on the board. A puzzle's difficulty comes from exactly this kind of non-local interaction, a decision in one part of the grid constraining what will work somewhere else entirely. A generator that is not locked into a single fixed order is therefore a better structural match for the problem than one that is. The training pipeline is adapted from MD4 (Shi et al., 2024) and the dataset is DeepMind's Boxoban (Guez et al., 2019). The trained model and instructions for generating puzzles are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Sokoban 谜题的可解性生成问题，证明一个仅以瓦片补全为目标训练的 Transformer 离散扩散模型（不接触求解器、奖励或可解性标签）能达到 77.4% 的可解率，且剩余失败样例中 94.5% 只需移除一堵墙即可变为可解。作者认为掩码扩散按任意顺序、基于任意已放置子集来补全网格，比固定顺序的自回归模型更匹配这类需要非局部交互的谜题结构。
Motivation: 判断 Sokoban 是否可解是 PSPACE-complete 问题，解可能指数长且无短证书；可解性还是脆弱属性，单个错放的墙就能让整个谜题不可解。固定顺序的自回归生成与谜题中跨网格区域相互约束的非局部结构不匹配。
Method: 采用 MD4 (Shi et al., 2024) 的训练流程，在 DeepMind Boxoban (Guez et al., 2019) 数据集上训练仅做瓦片补全 (tile completion) 的离散扩散模型，不使用任何求解器、奖励或可解性标签。
Result: 摘要报告该模型在训练后达到 77.4% 的可解率，且剩余失败的 94.5% 通过移除单堵墙即可变可解。
Conclusion: 作者认为掩码扩散随机隐藏单元格并学习 p(c_k | any subset) 的任意顺序生成方式，是比固定前缀自回归更好的结构性匹配，从而使全局、搜索密集型性质从局部训练目标中涌现；训练好的模型和生成指令已公开。

papers.title: Navigation-Informed Embeddings: Dense-Retriever Adaptation from Agent Search Traces
papers.abstract_en: Agentic retrieval workflows produce query, retrieval, and stopping traces as a byproduct of answering questions. We study how these traces can adapt a deployed dense retriever to changing workflow distributions without new relevance labels, synthetic queries, or LLM judgments. We introduce Navigation-Informed Embeddings (NIE), a family of trace-derived objectives. NIE-Stop turns the stopping document into a soft positive; NIE-Path additionally uses preceding path documents as hard comparisons and imposes ordinal constraints with geometric decay. A BGE encoder adapted from retained source trajectories improves support Recall@20 on an independent target benchmark from 72.2 to 78.0 overall. NIE-Stop reaches 76.9 overall and 52.3 on long paths; NIE-Path raises long-path performance to 55.4, compared with 46.7 for the unadapted encoder. A shuffled-order control under the full path objective loses 3.2 points. Without public-benchmark training, the same adapter also improves nDCG@10 by 1.9 points on standard BEIR HotpotQA. NIE therefore provides a lightweight adaptation channel for settings where trajectories are already retained, with zero incremental labeling cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用智能体检索工作流（agentic retrieval）中产生的查询、检索和停止轨迹（traces）来适配已部署的稠密检索器（dense retriever），且不需要新的相关性标签、合成查询或 LLM 判断。作者提出 Navigation-Informed Embeddings (NIE) 系列轨迹派生目标：NIE-Stop 将停止文档作为软正例，NIE-Path 额外使用路径文档作为硬比较并施加几何衰减的序数约束。实验表明，用保留的源轨迹适配 BGE 编码器后，独立目标基准上的 support Recall@20 从 72.2 提升到 78.0，NIE-Path 在长路径上达到 55.4（未适配编码器为 46.7），并能在无公开基准训练的情况下使 BEIR HotpotQA 的 nDCG@10 提升 1.9 点。
Motivation: 智能体检索工作流会随分布变化而变化，但通常缺乏新相关性标签、合成查询或 LLM 判断来重新适配部署中的稠密检索器；作者希望利用工作流本身产生的轨迹作为零标注成本的适配信号。
Method: 提出 Navigation-Informed Embeddings (NIE)，一类从检索轨迹派生的训练目标。NIE-Stop 把停止文档视为软正例；NIE-Path 额外把路径上先前的文档用作硬比较，并施加带几何衰减的序数约束（ordinal constraints）。
Result: 在独立目标基准上，适配后的 BGE 编码器使总体 support Recall@20 从 72.2 提升到 78.0；NIE-Stop 总体达到 76.9、长路径 52.3，NIE-Path 将长路径性能提高到 55.4（未适配编码器为 46.7）。完整路径目标下的乱序控制（shuffled-order control）损失 3.2 点；无公开基准训练时，BEIR HotpotQA 的 nDCG@10 提升 1.9 点。
Conclusion: NIE 为已经保留轨迹的场景提供了一种轻量级适配渠道，增量标注成本为零。

papers.title: Functional anatomy of Pythia-Herwig differences with Kolmogorov-Arnold networks
papers.abstract_en: Differences between high-energy event generators can arise at several stages of the collision simulation, from the hard scattering through parton showering and hadronization to the final event. These differences are usually summarized using observable distributions or global classifier scores. While these quantify the disagreement, they do not reveal which observable-level structures carry it or whether those structures persist through different stages of event generation. In this work, we formulate this problem as a staged functional analysis of generator-model differences. Following the same hard dijet events through Pythia and Herwig at shower-only, hadronized, and full-generator levels, we use an additive Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) representation of the classifier-derived log density ratio to decompose the learned discrepancy into explicit one-dimensional observable responses that can be isolated, recomposed, and transported between generator stages. Within the same eight-observable jet representation, the Pythia-Herwig difference is driven mainly by multiplicity at shower level, shifts toward jet mass and shape after hadronization, and develops a mixed shape-multiplicity driven structure in the full-generator configuration. Transporting the individual shower-level functional components downstream shows that shower-level multiplicity information can retain its reweighting power, whereas the corresponding shape responses need not do so even though shape becomes important again at later stages. The jet-mass factors, meanwhile, are limited by poor statistical support. This KAN-based framework therefore provides a functional anatomy of generator-model dependence, exposing both persistent structures and support failures that are hidden inside a single global classifier-derived reweighting function.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用加性 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（KAN）表示分类器导出的对数密度比，对 Pythia 与 Herwig 两个高能事件生成器之间的差异进行分阶段功能解剖。作者将相同的硬双喷注事件在 shower-only、强子化后和完整生成器三个层面分别跟踪，分解出差别的显式一维观测响应。摘要显示喷注多重度在 shower 层面主导差异，强子化后转向喷注质量与形状，完整生成器则为形状-多重度混合结构，并发现不同功能组件的可迁移性和统计支持不同。
Motivation: 事件生成器之间的差异通常只用观测量分布或全局分类器分数概括，这些方法能量化分歧却无法揭示哪些观测量层面的结构在承载差异，也不清楚这些结构是否在不同生成阶段持续存在。
Method: 将生成器模型差异表述为分阶段功能分析：在相同的八观测喷注表示下，用加性 KAN 表示分类器导出的对数密度比，把学习到的差异分解为可隔离、可重组并可在生成阶段之间迁移的显式一维观测响应。
Result: 在相同八观测喷注表示下，Pythia-Herwig 差异在 shower 层面主要由多重度驱动，强子化后转向喷注质量与形状，完整生成器配置中呈现形状-多重度混合结构；将 shower 层面功能组件向下游迁移时，多重度信息能保持其重要性权重能力，而形状响应未必如此；喷注质量因子受统计支持不足限制。
Conclusion: 该基于 KAN 的框架提供了生成器模型依赖的功能解剖，能够暴露隐藏在单一全局分类器导出的 reweighting 函数内部的持久结构与支持不足问题。

papers.title: ReliaGate: Reliability Routing for Low-Stakes Wearable Stress Prediction
papers.abstract_en: We study when a wearable stress system should surface a prediction rather than change it. In low-stakes reflection and summary settings, aggregate accuracy is insufficient because withholding can reduce error while leaving some people with little or no information. We formulate fixed-label reliability routing: after a locked classifier emits a protocol-defined stress/non-stress label, a post-hoc gate surfaces that unchanged label or withholds it as unavailable. ReliaGate assembles established confidence, signal-quality/trust, agreement, train-standardized atypicality, and train-fitted geometry cues into a post-hoc correctness score. We evaluate four wearable datasets using subject-disjoint folds, validation-selected routing, paired held-out-subject intervals, and pooled and per-subject analyses. WESAD point estimates favored ReliaGate, UBFC-Phys primary coverage/risk intervals favored ReliaGate, and E4 checks were mixed. ReliaGate provides an operational framework for studying surfaced-label error, output availability, and accepted-output distribution across subjects, without revising labels or providing clinical or finite-sample risk guarantees.
papers.comment: Accepted at WellComp 2026, held with UbiComp/ISWC 2026. 7 pages, 4 tables, and 1 figure. To appear in UbiComp Companion '26. ACM DOI: 10.1145/3798063.3841770
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究低风险可穿戴压力预测中系统应在何时展示一个预测而非修改它。作者提出固定标签可靠性路由的框架，在已锁定的分类器输出协议定义的应激/非应激标签后，由一个事后门控决定是原样展示该标签还是将其保留为不可用。ReliaGate 将置信度、信号质量/信任、一致性、训练标准化非典型性和训练拟合的几何线索整合为事后正确性评分，并在四个可穿戴数据集上用受试者不相交折进行评估。
Motivation: 在低风险的反思与总结场景中，仅看聚合准确率是不够的，因为隐藏预测可以降低错误，却会让一部分人几乎得不到任何信息，因此需要显式研究系统何时应当展示预测。
Method: 提出 ReliaGate：在固定分类器输出标签后，通过事后门控决定是否展示该未改变的标签。门控使用多类线索构造一个事后正确性评分，包括置信度、信号质量/信任、一致性与几何特征等，并在验证集上选择路由。
Result: 在四个可穿戴数据集上使用受试者不相交折、验证集选择路由、配对留出受试者区间以及合并与逐受试者分析；WESAD 的点估计倾向支持 ReliaGate，UBFC-Phys 的主要覆盖/风险区间支持 ReliaGate，E4 检查结果则好坏参半。
Conclusion: ReliaGate 为研究表面标签错误、输出可用性以及跨受试者的被接受输出分布提供了一个操作性框架，但不修改标签，也不提供临床或有限样本下的风险保证。

papers.title: Ask to Be Sure: Informative Interactions for Confident Multi-Turn LLM Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled their use as conversational recommender systems (CRS), demonstrating strong recommendation accuracy and natural dialogue. However, guiding multi-turn interactions to elicit user preferences effectively remains challenging. Existing approaches either use separate reinforcement learning agents with templated interactions or optimize for interactivity judged by another LLM, without measuring how much useful information is actually gained. We propose a new approach that quantifies the effectiveness of each interaction by the reduction in the assistant's uncertainty, measured via entropy over recommendations. We apply this entropy reduction as a reward---without relying on ground-truth recommendations, which are often unavailable in real-world scenarios---to fine-tune the LLM, enabling strategic interaction generation. Empirical results with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO) on the INSPIRED and ReDial datasets show that our method improves both recommendation quality and conversational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多轮对话推荐系统（CRS）中如何引导交互以高效获取用户偏好的问题，提出以推荐熵（entropy over recommendations）的下降来量化每轮交互带来的助手不确定性减少，并将其作为奖励信号；该奖励不依赖真实推荐标签，用于微调LLM以生成更具信息量的交互。在INSPIRED和ReDial数据集上的实验表明，结合SFT和DPO，所提方法同时改进推荐质量与对话效率。
Motivation: 现有多轮CRS方法或用带模板交互的独立强化学习智能体，或用另一个LLM来评判交互是否自然，但没有直接度量每轮交互究竟带来了多少有用信息；而在真实场景中通常没有ground-truth推荐可作监督信号。
Method: 将每条交互的有效性定义为助手在推荐分布上熵的降低，并把这一定义的熵减作为奖励，避免依赖真实推荐；随后用该奖励通过SFT与DPO对LLM进行微调，使其学会生成有策略的追问型交互。
Result: 在INSPIRED和ReDial数据集上，相较基准方法，该方法同步提升了推荐质量和对话效率（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于推荐熵减的奖励能够在不借助真实推荐标签的情况下，指导LLM生成更有效的多轮交互，并可与SFT、DPO等常见对齐方法结合。

papers.title: The Null Token Knows: Reducing Message-Free Hallucination in ASR and NMT
papers.abstract_en: Modern encoder-decoder systems can produce fluent text even when their input contains no recoverable message. We study this failure in ASR and NMT through the models' reserved null tokens, asking whether the score for ending generation already carries a usable abstention signal. Across speech recognizers and translation models, we audit native null-token scores and scalar logit shifts. In Whisper, we additionally probe decoder states and compare supervised row edits with conventional external gates. The evaluated models often expose a useful abstention signal, but stock decoding does not reliably act on it. Raising the null-token score can sharply suppress fabrication, but aggressive intervention also deletes valid speech or shortens legitimate translations. These findings turn the null token into a diagnostic lens on hallucination and motivate evaluating abstention methods by both suppression and deletion costs, rather than by hallucination reduction alone.
papers.comment: Submitted to the Thirty-Ninth AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI-27)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 ASR 与 NMT 中模型在输入不含可恢复信息时仍生成流畅文本的幻觉问题，提出用模型预留的 null token（结束生成标记）分数作为弃权 (abstention) 信号。作者在语音识别器和翻译模型上审计原生 null-token 分数与标量 logit 偏移，并在 Whisper 中额外探测解码器状态、比较监督式 row edits 与外部 gate。摘要报告称许多模型确实暴露了可用的弃权信号，但标准解码并未可靠地利用它；提高 null-token 分数能大幅抑制虚构，却也会删除有效语音或缩短合法翻译。
Motivation: 现代 encoder-decoder 系统在输入没有可恢复消息时仍可能生成流畅但虚构的文本，现有方法缺少一个统一的诊断视角，且评估弃权机制时往往只关注幻觉减少而忽略有效内容被删除的代价。
Method: 利用模型自带 null token 的得分作为 abstention 信号，在 ASR 和 NMT 模型上审计原生分数与标量 logit 偏移；在 Whisper 上进一步探测 decoder 状态，并将监督式 row edits 与常规外部 gate 进行对比。
Result: 被评估模型经常暴露出可用的弃权信号，但标准解码不能可靠地据此停止生成；提高 null-token 分数可显著压制虚构，但激进干预会删除有效语音或缩短合法翻译。
Conclusion: 作者主张将 null token 作为研究幻觉的诊断视角，并建议用抑制与删除两种代价共同评估 abstention 方法，而不是只看幻觉降低幅度。

papers.title: Augmenting Text to Increase Translation Difficulty
papers.abstract_en: As state-of-the-art machine translation models saturate standard benchmarks, the field needs more challenging evaluations to distinguish between models of varying quality. We propose augmenting existing benchmarks to increase translation difficulty by combining adversarial optimization with a differentiable translation difficulty estimator. Our Adversarial Translation Optimization (ATO) uses gradients from a combined difficulty and fluency objective to iteratively replace tokens. Because each step branches over candidate substitutions at every position, optimization becomes a tree search problem, which we address with Beam Search. ATO offers a gradient-based alternative to LLM-based dataset creation without LLM prompting, expensive human curation, or task-specific model training. Our ATO-modified benchmark lowers average translation quality (xCOMET) from 0.93 to 0.82, compared to 0.88 for paraphrasing and 0.86 for a zero-shot baseline. Human evaluation shows the modified texts are somewhat less natural than the baselines but remain reasonably grammatical and plausible while being substantially harder to translate. We release two datasets of 350 English texts each, generated by our methods, as well as the code.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables. William Kalikman and Šimon Sukup contributed equally. Published in EAMT 2026. Code: https://github.com/BreakingMT/ATO. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/wskal/ATO-datasets
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对抗式翻译优化 (Adversarial Translation Optimization, ATO)，利用可微的翻译难度估计器对现有基准文本进行对抗式修改，以生成更难翻译的评测集。ATO 将难度与流畅度目标合并，通过梯度迭代替换 token，并将每步对所有位置候选替换的分支建模为树搜索、用 Beam Search 求解。修改后的基准将平均翻译质量 (xCOMET) 从 0.93 降到 0.82，文本仍保持合理语法与可信度，但明显更难翻译。作者同时发布了代码以及两个各含 350 个英文文本的数据集。
Motivation: 最先进的机器翻译模型在标准基准上逐渐饱和，需要更具挑战性的评测来区分不同质量模型之间的差异。
Method: 结合对抗优化与可微的翻译难度估计器，使用来自组合难度和流畅度目标的梯度迭代替换 token；由于每一步在所有位置的候选替换上分支，优化被形式化为树搜索问题，并用 Beam Search 求解。ATO 提供一种基于梯度的替代方案，无需 LLM prompting、昂贵的人工整理或任务专用模型训练。
Result: 摘要报告 ATO 修改后的基准把平均翻译质量 (xCOMET) 从 0.93 降至 0.82，低于改写 (paraphrasing) 的 0.88 和零样本基线的 0.86；人工评估显示修改后的文本自然度略低于基线，但保持合理的语法和可信度，且翻译难度显著提高。
Conclusion: ATO 可作为一种无需 LLM prompt、人工整理或任务专用训练的基准增强手段；作者发布两个各含 350 个英文文本的数据集及代码，供社区复现与使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UI-Mate: Advancing Open-Weight Foundation GUI Agents with In-Context Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: Foundation GUI agents can automate complex digital tasks, but deployment is hindered by scarce and biased training data, ambiguous prompts, and unreliable execution. Routine workflows rely on user-specific tools and tacit conventions, so unstated instructions can produce arbitrary variations across runs. We present UI-Mate, a foundation GUI agent that integrates an environment-grounded training stack with in-context demonstration learning. UI-Mate makes three contributions: A Scalable Environment-Grounded Training Stack: A closed-loop data engine automates task generation, environment construction, rollout, filtering, capability balancing, SFT, and online RL across massively parallel environments via unified task-verifier bundles. In-Context Demonstration Learning: A mechanism that transforms multimodal demonstrations into flexible subtask-level workflows, follows relevant demonstrated steps, and re-plans from the live interface. OSWorkerBench Benchmark and Insights: A benchmark of 100 long-horizon office tasks across 41 applications that supports instruction-only and demonstration-guided evaluation. Its demonstration resources separate a 33-task self-demo setting, built from successful strong-agent rollouts of the same targets, from a 45-task variant-demo setting, built from human recordings of related but non-identical tasks. Experiments show that UI-Mate-27B sets a new open-weight state of the art on general computer-use benchmarks, scoring 77.0% on OSWorld-Verified and 66.2% on WindowsAgentArena. On OSWorkerBench, it reaches 41.0% strict success and 76.9% progress, outperforming its Qwen3.6-27B base by 17.7 and 24.5 points. On the 33-task self-demo subset, one demonstration raises strict success from 17.2% to 35.4% and progress from 67.9% to 81.1%, substantially improving long-horizon reliability. Project page: https://ui-mate.github.io.
papers.comment: UI-Mate Technical Report. Project page: https://ui-mate.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UI-Mate，一个开源权重的基础 GUI 智能体，结合环境接地训练栈（environment-grounded training stack）与上下文演示学习（in-context demonstration learning）。其贡献包括闭环数据引擎、将多模态演示转化为子任务级工作流并在实时界面中重新规划，以及包含 100 个长时办公任务的 OSWorkerBench 基准。UI-Mate-27B 在 OSWorld-Verified 上达到 77.0%，在 WindowsAgentArena 上达到 66.2%，并在 OSWorkerBench 上显著超过其基座模型。
Motivation: 基础 GUI 智能体的部署受限于稀缺且有偏的训练数据、模糊的提示词和不可靠的执行；日常流程依赖用户特定工具和隐性约定，未言明的指令会在不同运行间产生任意差异。
Method: 提出可扩展的环境接地训练栈：闭环数据引擎在并行环境中自动化任务生成、环境构建、rollout、过滤、能力平衡、SFT 与在线 RL，并通过统一任务验证器（task-verifier bundles）驱动。上下文演示学习机制将多模态演示转化为灵活的原子子任务级工作流，遵循相关演示步骤并根据实时界面重新规划。此外构建 OSWorkerBench 基准，支持仅指令与演示引导两种评测。
Result: UI-Mate-27B 在通用计算机使用基准上刷新开源权重模型 SOTA，OSWorld-Verified 得分 77.0%，WindowsAgentArena 得分 66.2%；在 OSWorkerBench 上严格成功率为 41.0%、进度 76.9%，比 Qwen3.6-27B 基座分别高出 17.7 和 24.5 个百分点。在 33 个自演示任务子集上，单条演示将严格成功率从 17.2% 提升到 35.4%，进度从 67.9% 提升到 81.1%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调演示引导能显著提升长时程任务的可靠性，并指出 UI-Mate 作为开源权重模型刷新了通用计算机使用基准成绩；OSWorkerBench 提供的自演示与变体演示两种设置可用于研究演示资源对性能的影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unified Pedestrian Path Prediction Using Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Pedestrian path prediction is crucial for enhancing the safety of autonomous vehicles and advanced driver-assistance systems. Previous studies explored different learning-task formulations for pedestrian path prediction and compared these formulations using shallow neural networks, but did not extend this analysis to more complex deep-learning models. This paper adapts the Spatial-Temporal Graph Attention Network (STGAT) to a unified pedestrian path prediction framework and introduces state and action definitions specific to STGAT. The resulting formulations support deterministic and stochastic policies, one-time and sequential decision-making, and reinforcement-learning algorithms including REINFORCE and proximal policy optimization. The proposed learning-task formulations improve prediction performance across the selected benchmark datasets compared with the standard supervised-learning formulation. These results demonstrate that reformulating the decision process and training objective can improve an advanced pedestrian trajectory prediction architecture and may provide a path toward improving other graph-based prediction models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把逆强化学习 (inverse reinforcement learning) 引入行人路径预测，将空间-时间图注意力网络 (STGAT) 适配为一个统一的学习任务框架，并定义了针对 STGAT 的状态与动作。该框架支持确定性与随机策略、单步与顺序决策，以及 REINFORCE 和近端策略优化 (PPO) 等强化学习算法。摘要报告，在所选基准数据集上，所提出的学习任务公式相比标准监督学习公式提升了预测性能。
Motivation: 以往研究只使用浅层神经网络比较不同学习任务公式对行人路径预测的影响，没有把这一分析推广到更复杂的深度学习模型。作者希望验证重新表述决策过程与训练目标能否改进高级轨迹预测架构。
Method: 将 STGAT 改造为统一的行人路径预测框架，引入适用于 STGAT 的状态与动作定义；该框架涵盖确定性和随机策略、一次性与顺序决策，并兼容 REINFORCE 与近端策略优化等强化学习算法。
Result: 在选定的基准数据集上，提出的学习任务公式相比标准监督学习公式提高了预测性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为重新表述决策过程和训练目标可以改进先进的行人轨迹预测架构，并可能为改进其他基于图的预测模型提供思路。

papers.title: Information Geometry of Message Passing
papers.abstract_en: We show that the natural-gradient stationary condition of variational inference has an edge-local form on a Forney-style factor graph. We start from the Bethe free energy and constrain a selected edge marginal to an exponential family. At a stationary point, the natural parameter of that edge equals the sum of two projected messages, one from each incident factor. Each projected message is the natural-gradient projection of the exact belief-propagation log-message at the current receiving marginal, or equivalently, the gradient of its expectation in the so-called mean coordinates. We call the resulting scheme natural-gradient message passing (NGMP). The rule is local; each edge may carry its own exponential family, and the message a factor sends depends on the marginal that receives it. Compared with variational message passing, NGMP keeps the part of the exact message that the receiving family can represent instead of averaging the factor under the neighboring beliefs. The two coincide when the uncertainty on the edges entering a non-conjugate factor vanishes, and NGMP is more accurate when that uncertainty persists, for example, along a partially observed latent chain or when parameters are filtered through successive data batches. Experiments on Poisson smoothing, heteroskedastic regression, and hourly ETTh forecasting confirm this and show that the gain appears mainly in uncertainty calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从信息几何角度研究因子图上的消息传递，提出自然梯度消息传递（NGMP）。作者从 Bethe 自由能出发，将选定的边边缘约束到指数族，证明在驻点处该边的自然参数等于两个来自相邻因子的投影消息之和，每个投影消息是精确置信传播对数消息在当前接收边际上的自然梯度投影。NGMP 是局部规则，每条边可承载自己的指数族，且因子发送的消息依赖于接收它的边际，相比变分消息传递保留了接收族能表示的精确消息部分。
Motivation: 变分消息传递（VMP）在非共轭因子上将因子在相邻信念下平均化，会丢失精确消息中接收族不可表示的部分，导致近似精度下降。
Method: 从 Bethe 自由能出发，约束选定边的边际属于某个指数族，并推导出 NGMP 的更新规则：每个因子发送的消息是该因子精确 BP 对数消息在当前接收边际上的自然梯度投影，等价于其在均值坐标下的期望梯度。
Result: 实验在泊松平滑、异方差回归和每小时 ETTh 预测上验证，NGMP 相比 VMP 更准确，增益主要体现为不确定性校准的提升。
Conclusion: NGMP 在进入非共轭因子的边存在不确定性时（如部分观测的隐链或参数经连续数据批次过滤）优于 VMP；当这些不确定性消失时两者一致。

papers.title: $S^3$: A Smooth Simulation Surrogate for Optimizing Discrete Abstractions of Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Intelligent systems are increasingly deployed in safety-critical settings with black-box controllers, including neural networks. The properties and behaviors of these end-to-end systems can be studied with abstraction-based methods that replace them with simpler finite models. Constructing such abstractions requires balancing the soundness of over-approximating the dynamical system against conservatism, which manifests as spurious or excessive nondeterministic behaviors. Bi-simulation theory provides principled metrics for characterizing these relationships, but does not prescribe how to construct sound abstractions with minimal conservatism. We fill this gap with a smooth simulation surrogate ($S^3$) --- a differentiable objective that approximates the reverse simulation metric used to quantify conservatism. Combined with Taylor model-based reachability, $S^3$ enables gradient-based optimization of abstraction parameters while preserving soundness by construction. We evaluate this optimization pipeline on three case studies. Our results show that $S^3$ is strongly correlated with the reverse simulation metric, is computationally faster, and serves as an effective objective for reducing abstraction conservatism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对带有黑箱控制器（如神经网络）的安全关键动态系统，提出一种平滑仿真代理（$S^3$），即可微的目标函数，用于近似衡量保守性的反向仿真度量（reverse simulation metric）。该方法与基于 Taylor 模型的可达性分析结合，能够在构造上保持可靠性（soundness）的同时，对抽象参数进行基于梯度的优化。三个案例研究显示，$S^3$ 与反向仿真度量强相关、计算更快，并能有效降低抽象保守性。
Motivation: 基于抽象（abstraction）的方法用更简单的有限模型替代端到端系统，但构造抽象时需要在过近似的可靠性与保守性之间权衡，保守性表现为虚假或过多的非确定性行为。双仿真理论（bi-simulation）提供了度量关系的原则性指标，却没有给出如何构造保守性最小的可靠抽象，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 提出平滑仿真代理 $S^3$，它是一个可微目标函数，用于近似用于量化保守性的反向仿真度量；将其与 Taylor 模型可达性分析结合，从而在保持可靠性（soundness）的前提下对抽象参数进行梯度优化。
Result: 在三个案例研究上，$S^3$ 与反向仿真度量强相关，计算速度更快，并且作为目标函数能有效降低抽象保守性。
Conclusion: 本文通过引入可作为优化目标的 $S^3$，弥合了双仿真理论与可靠抽象构造之间的缺口，展示了在保持可靠性的同时减少保守性的可行性。

papers.title: Noesis: Bidirectional Graph-RAG with Adaptive Parallelism and Cross-Knowledge-Base Semantic Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation over knowledge graphs (Graph-RAG) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for grounding large language models in domain-specific corpora. However, existing systems face persistent limitations: (1) static chunking fragments long documents, losing cross-section semantic connections; (2) ingestion pipelines do not scale adaptively; and (3) multi-domain deployments require either a monolithic knowledge base that dilutes retrieval precision or manual user routing. We present Noesis, a decoupled Graph-RAG architecture addressing these limitations through four algorithms: (a) Bidirectional Graph Traversal with a Graph-Feedback Context Resolver simulating human reading with degrading memory; (b) an AIMD Concurrency Controller adapted from TCP congestion control, achieving 23x speedup with zero OOM events; (c) Moesis, domain-aware selective quantization for MoE models achieving 6.3x speedup on 12 GB consumer GPUs; and (d) Mesh, cross-KB semantic routing with runtime structural discovery enabling small on-premises models to perform multi-hop cross-domain reasoning. On HotpotQA (1,000 questions), Noesis achieves 59.5 EM / 74.7 F1, surpassing GraphRAG by +27.8 EM while using a 35B on-premises model for graph construction rather than GPT-4o. Source text verification on a 193-page document confirms 90% precision on long-range causal edges inaccessible to chunk-independent extraction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Noesis，一种解耦的 Graph-RAG 架构，针对知识图谱检索增强生成中的静态分块、摄取不可扩展扩展和跨域知识库路由问题。系统包含四个算法：双向图遍历与图反馈上下文解析器 (Graph-Feedback Context Resolver)、借鉴 TCP 拥塞控制的 AIMD 并发控制器、面向 MoE 模型的领域感知选择性量化 Moesis，以及跨知识库语义路由 Mesh。摘要报告在 HotpotQA 上达到 59.5 EM / 74.7 F1，并用 35B 本地模型在图形构建上超过使用 GPT-4o 的 GraphRAG。
Motivation: 现有 Graph-RAG 系统存在三个持续限制：静态分块破坏文档跨章节语义连接、摄取管道无法自适应扩展、多领域部署需要单一知识库（稀释检索精度）或人工路由。
Method: Noesis 采用解耦的 Graph-RAG 架构，提出四个核心算法：双向图遍历配合模拟人类阅读记忆衰减的图反馈上下文解析器；从 TCP 拥塞控制改造而来的 AIMD 并发控制器；面向 MoE 模型的领域感知选择性量化 Moesis；以及支持运行时结构发现的跨知识库语义路由 Mesh。
Result: 摘要报告 AIMD 并发控制器实现 23 倍加速且零 OOM 事件；Moesis 在 12 GB 消费级 GPU 上实现 6.3 倍加速；在 HotpotQA（1000 题）上达到 59.5 EM / 74.7 F1，比 GraphRAG 高 27.8 EM，且图形构建使用 35B 本地模型而非 GPT-4o；对 193 页文档的源文本验证显示，在分块独立抽取无法覆盖的长程因果边上达到 90% 精确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为解耦架构结合自适应并行与跨知识库语义发现，能让小型本地模型执行多跳跨域推理。摘要未明确讨论局限，但提到专利待审批。

papers.title: Pre-training Visual Dexterity in Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale pre-training has made robot policy fine-tuning increasingly data-efficient, but this progress has largely been driven by datasets and embodiments built around simple parallel-jaw grippers. Dexterous, multi-fingered hands remain comparatively data-starved because real teleoperation is costly to scale, while human hand video is off-embodiment and requires lossy pose estimation and retargeting. We introduce Simulation Pre-training for Dexterity (SPD), a pre-training framework for dexterous manipulation that uses data entirely collected in simulation. In SPD, humans manipulate virtual objects inside a VR headset, enabling on-embodiment trajectories and robot-free collection. With the help of five operators, we collect 75 hours of multi-task dexterous manipulation over one week, and use it to pre-train a causal transformer on a sequence modeling objective. We study the benefits of simulation pre-training on real-world tasks by fine-tuning on 1-2 hours of physical demonstrations on a 56-DoF bimanual dexterous setup. We find that our approach outperforms training behavior cloning policies from scratch, showing that simulation teleoperation is a viable pre-training source for real-world dexterous manipulation. We perform ablation studies, measuring the benefits of history conditioning and short action chunks for reactive control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Simulation Pre-training for Dexterity (SPD)，一个完全在仿真中收集数据、用于灵巧操作的预训练框架。人类操作者在 VR 头显中操控虚拟物体，从而获得本体感受轨迹且无需真实机器人；五名操作员在一周内收集了 75 小时多任务灵巧操作数据，用于预训练一个因果 Transformer 的序列建模目标。随后在 56 自由度 (DoF) 双臂灵巧平台上用 1-2 小时真实演示微调，摘要报告该方法优于从头训练的行为克隆策略。
Motivation: 大规模预训练已使机器人策略微调更高效，但现有数据与载体多围绕简单平行夹爪；多指灵巧手的真实遥操作成本高难以扩展，而人类手部视频存在异构体 (off-embodiment) 问题且需要有损的姿态估计和重定向。灵巧操作因此缺乏可扩展的预训练数据来源。
Method: SPD 使用 VR 头显让人类操作虚拟物体，直接收集与机器人本体一致的轨迹且不需要真实机器人。利用 75 小时多任务数据预训练因果 Transformer 的序列建模目标，再在真实世界任务上以 1-2 小时物理演示进行微调。
Result: 在 56-DoF 双臂灵巧设置上，SPD 预训练加微调显著优于从零训练的行为克隆策略。消融研究显示历史条件 (history conditioning) 和短动作块 (short action chunks) 对反应式控制有益。
Conclusion: 摘要认为仿真遥操作是真实世界灵巧操作可行的预训练来源，能够提升策略微调的数据效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Comprehensive Benchmarking of Deep Learning Architectures for Lung Cancer Histopathology
papers.abstract_en: Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, while histopathological diagnosis is often affected by inter-observer variability and the substantial workload associated with manual slide examination. Although deep learning has shown considerable potential in computational pathology, comprehensive benchmarks that integrate tissue classification and region segmentation within a unified analytical framework remain limited. This study presents a two-stage deep learning framework for multi-class tissue classification and pixel-level histopathological region segmentation, accompanied by a systematic comparison of state-of-the-art architectures at each stage. For tissue classification, six models, a custom convolutional neural network, VGG16, DenseNet, MobileNetV3, a custom Vision Transformer, and YOLO11, are evaluated on a combined dataset of 39,000 images derived from LC25000 and LungHist700. The models distinguish between adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and normal lung tissue. YOLO11 achieves the best classification performance, with an accuracy of 98.38%, a five-fold cross-validation accuracy of 98.21 +/- 0.35%, and a macro F1-score of 0.98. For region segmentation, U-Net, ResNet-encoder U-Net, DeepLabV3+, and YOLO11-seg are evaluated using the GlaS gland segmentation benchmark. DeepLabV3+ obtains the highest Intersection over Union of 0.80 and a Dice score of 0.89, while YOLO11-seg achieves a comparable Intersection over Union of 0.79 using approximately 14x fewer parameters. The best-performing classification and segmentation models are subsequently integrated into an end-to-end framework, providing an accurate, computationally efficient, and reproducible baseline for automated histopathological image analysis.
papers.summary_zh:

Result: YOLO11 取得最佳分类性能，准确率 98.38%，五折交叉验证准确率 98.21% ± 0.35%，宏 F1 为 0.98；分割方面 DeepLabV3+ 的 IoU 最高为 0.80、Dice 为 0.89，而 YOLO11-seg 以约 14 倍更少的参数取得可比的 0.79 IoU。

papers.title: CLARA: Clip-Level Multimodal Alignment with VLM-Derived Rationales for Hateful Video Detection
papers.abstract_en: Hateful video detection has become increasingly important with the rapid growth of video-centric social media platforms, given the serious risks that hate speech poses to both individual well-being and social cohesion. Compared with text or static multimodal content, hateful video detection remains underexplored and significantly more challenging, as hateful meaning often arises from complex interactions among multimodal cues, including speech, audio, and visual content. Moreover, such signals are often brief, implicit, and temporally dependent, making them difficult to capture using conventional video-level representations. In this work, we propose CLARA, a clip-level multimodal framework for hateful video detection. Instead of treating a video as a single instance, CLARA models it as a sequence of fine-grained clips, enabling more precise capture of temporally localized hateful signals. We introduce a Mixture-of-Experts clip encoder for adaptive multimodal alignment, a local-global segment contrastive objective to jointly model short-term cues and long-range temporal dependencies, and VLM-derived rationales integrated via a gated Transformer to provide high-level semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on three hateful video datasets demonstrate that CLARA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Further ablation studies and parameter analyses validate the effectiveness of each component.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLARA，一个面向仇恨视频检测的 clip 级多模态框架。与将视频视为单一实例的做法不同，CLARA 将视频建模为细粒度 clip 序列，以捕捉时间上局部化的仇恨信号；框架包含 Mixture-of-Experts clip 编码器、局部-全局片段对比目标以及通过门控 Transformer 融合的 VLM 派生 rationale。实验在三个仇恨视频数据集上一致优于现有方法。
Motivation: 仇恨视频检测比文本或静态多模态内容更具挑战性，因为仇恨含义常来自语音、音频与视觉内容之间的复杂交互，且这些信号往往短暂、隐式并具有时间依赖性，传统视频级表示难以捕捉。
Method: CLARA 将视频视为细粒度 clip 序列，使用 Mixture-of-Experts clip 编码器进行自适应多模态对齐，引入局部-全局片段对比目标（local-global segment contrastive objective）以联合建模短期线索与长期时间依赖，并通过门控 Transformer 集成 VLM-derived rationales 提供高层语义指导。
Result: 在三个仇恨视频数据集上的大量实验表明 CLARA 一致优于最先进方法；消融研究和参数分析验证了各组件（MoE 编码器、对比目标、rationale 融合）的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 clip 级建模结合多模态对齐、局部-全局对比与 VLM 语义指导能有效提升仇恨视频检测性能；摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。

papers.title: Layers Matter: Why Continual Learning Regularization Should Be Layer-Adaptive
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning regularizers like EWC fight forgetting by penalizing changes from previous-task parameters with per-parameter importance, typically diagonal Fisher values. Per-parameter looks more flexible than per-layer, but each layer's diagonal Fisher is a weak summary of its actual curvature, missing the top-eigenvalue information that controls forgetting. Adversarial bit-flip attacks and Hessian-spectrum studies show that this missing per-layer sensitivity spans orders of magnitude in neural networks. Under a block-diagonal Hessian assumption, the layer-level analogue of EWC's existing diagonal assumption, we prove three things. Forgetting decomposes as a sum of per-layer terms weighted by each layer's top Hessian eigenvalue. Diagonal-Fisher weights cannot recover this eigenvalue. For instance, two layers with identical Fisher averages can have top eigenvalues differing by a factor as large as the layer width. For the same level of forgetting, uniform regularization loses new-task performance by an amount scaling with the layer condition number. Our theoretical analysis leads to a simple recipe: protect early layers strongly, let deeper layers move. We apply this recipe to EWC and SLCA and show clear improvements in average performance and forgetting metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究持续学习 (continual learning) 中正则化项应当逐层自适应的问题。作者在块对角 Hessian 假设下证明，遗忘可以分解为按每层最大 Hessian 特征值加权的逐层项之和，而对角 Fisher 权重无法恢复该特征值信息；两个 Fisher 均值相同的层，其最大特征值可能相差一个与层宽度同量级的因子。据此提出简单策略：强保护浅层、允许深层移动，并将该策略应用于 EWC 和 SLCA，在平均性能与遗忘指标上取得明显改进。
Motivation: 现有正则化方法如 EWC 采用逐参数重要性（通常是对角 Fisher）来惩罚参数变化，但每层对角 Fisher 只是该层真实曲率的弱汇总，缺失了控制遗忘的最大特征值信息；对抗性位翻转攻击与 Hessian 谱研究表明这种逐层敏感性差异可在神经网络中跨越多个数量级，因此需要逐层自适应的正则化。
Method: 在块对角 Hessian 假设下（即 EWC 现有对角假设的逐层类比），给出三条理论证明：遗忘分解为按每层最大 Hessian 特征值加权的逐层项；对角 Fisher 权重无法恢复该特征值；在相同遗忘水平下，统一正则化带来的新任务性能损失按层条件数 (condition number) 缩放。由此得到简单规则：强正则化早期层、放松深层，并将该规则应用于 EWC 和 SLCA。
Result: 摘要报告将逐层自适应正则化策略应用于 EWC 和 SLCA 后，平均性能与遗忘指标均有明显改进；理论上还指出两个 Fisher 平均值相同的层，其最大特征值可相差高达层宽度量级的倍数。
Conclusion: 作者强调持续学习正则化不应只做逐参数加权，而应考虑逐层曲率差异；核心结论是保护早期层、允许深层移动，这能改善平均性能与遗忘指标。

papers.title: Crystal-structure design by agentic AI in a language of motifs
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven materials discovery interpolates more reliably than it extrapolates and seldom reaches new structure types. We present MatEvolve, an agentic-AI framework designing crystals, proposing each candidate with a stated rationale and testing it. The agent reasons in an interpretable \emph{language of motifs}, writing each crystal as a \emph{motif profile} that describes the recurring geometric patterns---the \emph{motifs}---composing it. The motif profile serves not merely as a description of a material but as the medium for material design: the agent edits the profile and constructs a crystal from the modified one, and the most promising candidates are validated by first-principles calculation. Applied to the design of rare-earth-lean permanent magnets, MatEvolve---built on the state-of-the-art language model Claude Fable~5 without fine-tuning---reaches new structural prototypes more than three times as often as generative models under an equal validation budget, at a comparable on-target-magnet rate. Beyond design, analysing the discovered crystals' human-readable profiles reveals structure--property relationships.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MatEvolve，一个面向晶体结构设计的 agentic-AI 框架：智能体用可解释的“motif 语言”将晶体写成 motif profile（描述组成晶体的重复几何图案），并通过编辑 profile 来设计新材料，再用第一性原理计算验证最有希望的候选。作者以稀土贫化永磁体设计为应用场景，基于 Claude Fable 5 语言模型且未做微调，结果显示该方法在相同验证预算下发现新结构原型（structural prototype）的频率是生成模型的 3 倍以上，同时达到相近的目标磁体命中率；对所得晶体可读 profile 的分析还揭示了结构-性质关系。
Motivation: 数据驱动的材料发现以内插（interpolate）为主，可靠性高于外推（extrapolate），因此很少触及新的结构类型；现有方法难以主动跨越已知结构空间去探索新原型。
Method: 构建一个 agentic-AI 智能体，迭代地以 motif profile 形式描述晶体，理解并编辑该 profile 后重建晶体结构，并对优先候选执行第一性原理验证；整个流程基于未微调的 SOTA 语言模型 Claude Fable 5。
Result: 在稀土贫化永磁体设计任务中，MatEvolve 在相同验证预算下发现新结构原型的频率比生成模型高出 3 倍以上，且目标磁体（on-target magnet）命中率与生成模型相当；通过分析发现晶体的可读 profile 还揭示了结构-性质关系。
Conclusion: 作者强调 motif profile 不仅是材料的描述，更可作为材料设计的操作媒介；该方法将材料设计外推到新结构类型，并借助可解释的剖面分析获得结构-性质洞察。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Breaking and Defending LLM-Powered Social Media Bot Detection Systems
papers.abstract_en: The rise of social media bots poses a persistent threat, enabling misinformation, opinion manipulation, and the erosion of trust in online platforms. To combat this, machine learning systems have been developed to detect and limit bot activity, but attackers continuously adapt through techniques such as adversarial learning and behavior imitation, fueling an ongoing arms race between bots and detection tools. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have significantly improved bot detection by enabling deeper semantic and contextual analysis of accounts and their content. However, this shift also introduces new attack surfaces, allowing adversaries to craft exploits that directly target the reasoning and generation mechanisms of LLM-based classifiers. Industry tools such as Anthropic's Claude Code Security similarly leverage LLMs for security-critical decisions, further motivating a careful study of their attack surfaces. In this work, we investigate both the offensive and defensive aspects of LLM-powered, threat-specific cybersecurity applications. While centered on the challenge of social media bot detection, our methodology and insights generalize to a broad class of LLM-powered cybersecurity systems, including phishing detection, email classification, and fraud analysis. We introduce two novel adversarial attack strategies that systematically exploit the semantic and contextual weaknesses of LLM-based classifiers, degrading their detection accuracy by up to 48%. To counter these threats, we propose a robust multi-LLM defense architecture designed to preserve detection reliability under adaptive adversarial conditions. Our solution, LSABRE (LLM-powered Social Adversarial Bot Recognition Ensemble), is a multi-LLM framework that substantially improves robustness across a range of attacks, maintaining 86% detection accuracy even under strong, adaptive adversarial pressure.
papers.comment: Accepted at ACISP 2026 (Australasian Conference on Information Security and Privacy). Also accepted as a poster at IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (S&P) 2026. Published in Pragmatic Cybersecurity 2026, 1(2), 10, https://doi.org/10.53941/pc.2026.100010. 19 pages, 11 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 驱动的社交媒体机器人检测系统的攻防两侧。作者提出两种新的对抗攻击策略，利用 LLM 分类器的语义和上下文弱点，将检测精度降低最多 48%；为抵御此类攻击，提出多 LLM 集成框架 LSABRE，在强自适应对抗压力下保持 86% 的检测精度。
Motivation: 社交媒体机器人持续构成威胁，LLM 虽能通过语义和上下文分析改善检测，但也引入新的攻击面，攻击者可针对 LLM 分类器的推理与生成机制直接构造利用。作者认为该问题可推广到更广泛的 LLM 驱动网络安全应用，如钓鱼检测、邮件分类和欺诈分析。
Method: 提出两种系统性的对抗攻击策略，针对 LLM 分类器的语义和上下文弱点进行利用。防御方面提出 LSABRE（LLM-powered Social Adversarial Bot Recognition Ensemble），一种多 LLM 防御架构，旨在自适应对抗条件下保持检测可靠性。
Result: 摘要报告两种攻击策略可将检测精度降低最多 48%；LSABRE 在强自适应对抗压力下维持 86% 的检测精度，显著提升跨攻击场景的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 论文强调其方法论和洞见可泛化到一类 LLM 驱动的网络安全系统，并指出对 LLM 在安全关键决策中的攻击面进行严谨研究是必要的。
